notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 12th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/968a03eb3821d65c703ffcc3da7c85a3491d1328.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Zombie Rebalancing Survey Event (6/12 - 6/26)You'll be able to participate in a survey regarding the zombie balances added in this update. After the survey ends, 50 players who have provided valuable feedback will receive rewards.

Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Giveaway (6/12 - 6/26)In celebration of the Dragon Boat Festival, get a Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade on your first login during the event period.

Eid al-Adha Event (6/12 - 6/26)Complete the missions during the event to earn rewards.

Eid al-Adha Celebration Mileage Auction (6/15 - 6/18)You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

New Transcendence Weapon "Pulse Reactor" Promotion (6/15 - 7/10)The Pulse Reactor can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

Update Information
Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta)
Newly Evolved Zombies! Face the Humans!
Zombie Hero Rebalance Update!

The Zombie Rebalance will run as a beta test for 2 weeks.
During the beta period, there'll be a survey event to gather your opinions,
so we'd appreciate it if you could share your valuable feedback on the rebalance.
After the 2-week beta period, we'll switch back to the original Zombie Hero mode
and release a new Zombie Rebalancing exclusive map, so get ready!

For details, please refer to the Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Preview.

Evolved Reinforced Host Zombie
A new zombie with otherworldly powers has appeared!
 It boasts a very high Defense, as well as immunity to knockback and stuns.
 Its skills are also greatly enhanced, making it a dangerous foe indeed.
 The Evolved Reinforced Hosts owe their extraordinary power to otherworldly energy, but have lost the ability to infect in return. Their attacks will inflict bleeding instead of infection.
 Humans suffering this new status must find First Aid Kits scattered across the map to stop the bleeding.
 The Evolved Reinforced Host is the first Host Zombie that appears when the round begins. After enough time passes, their otherworldly power will fade.

Enraged Reinforced Host Zombie
This is a new type of zombie which evolves from the Reinforced Host via the Rage gauge.
 The Rage gauge starts draining as soon as the Enraged Reinforced Host emerges. It will return to the Reinforced Host state once the gauge is empty.
 While enraged, its HP and Armor are greatly increased, and it gains extremely strong defensive stats and skills.

Zombie Respawn Effect Enhancement
Respawn effects for zombies have been enhanced!
 The respawn effect duration is increased, and zombies will also enjoy reductions to knockback, stuns, and damage taken.

Special Supply Boxes
Special Supply Boxes will appear that give immediate access to the Sidekick Shop.

Automatic Rage Gauge Gains
The Rage gauge will automatically fill as time passes.


Event Information

Zombie Rebalancing Survey Event (6/12 - 6/26)
You'll be able to participate in a survey regarding the zombie balances added in this update. After the survey ends, 50 players who have provided valuable feedback will receive rewards.

Reward: Transcendence Decoder x30 (50 players)
Winner Announcement and Reward Distribution: 7/10


Zombie Hero (Beta) Weapon Supply Event (6/12 - 6/26)
In celebration of Zombie Team Rebalancing (Beta) update, weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero (Beta) during the event period.

Primary Weapon: Failnaught/Hyper Gaebolg/Devastator
 Secondary Weapon: Lightning Fury/Laevateinn/Twin Hawk
 Melee Weapon: Demolition Hammer/Spell Lance Scarlet Rose/Holy Sword Divine Order
 Equipment: Hellhound/Satellite Mine/Trinity Grenade

Details
You'll get one Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Melee Weapon, and Equipment based on probabilities for each.
 Trial weapons are only available in Zombie Hero (Beta).
 Regardless of when you receive them, the available weapons will change every day at midnight.


Login Supplies Event (6/12 - 7/9)
Logging in during the event will give you daily and cumulative rewards!

Daily Login Rewards: Daily Weapons Supply
Daily Supply Contents
 Receive all four of the following items: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day), M3 Black Dragon (1 Day), Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day), and M249 Phoenix (1 Day).
 Two Rare, Unique, or Transcendence weapons (1 Day) have a chance of appearing in the Daily Supply.
 One Transcendence Class (1 Day) has a chance to be included.
 You will receive all the contents of the Daily Attendance Reward Box.

Details
Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
 Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation, and Rare Decoder (x3)
 All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).

Total Rewards
5 Days: Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
 10 Days: NEGEV NG-7 Ajax (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
 15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
 20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1

Details
Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
 Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
 Rewards can be claimed immediately after game login, and rewards are available until midnight every day.


Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (6/12 - 7/10)
Earn CP by completing missions during the event.

New Items Added
Devastator: Costs 20 CP/Unlocked at 210 CP/Can be exchanged once
 Sparkling Shores Nameplate (300 Days): Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once
 Summer Hunting Zombie Spray: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once
 Ice Cream Cone: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once
 Lotus Leaf Rice Mask: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once

How to Participate
Earn 1 CP for every 15 Kill Points from zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 8 CP per day).
 Clear 1 session after scoring 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 1 CP (up to 8 CP per day)
 Every 20 minutes of in-game playtime: 1 CP (up to 2 CP per day)
 Earn 1 CP when you complete 2 of the following missions (up to 1 CP per day):
Click on the Event Missions tab to check your Event Missions.
 Purchase a Point Transcendence Decoder or a Point Class Decoder from the Shop.
  Go on an Exploration once.

How to Earn Kill Points
Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
 Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
 Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
 Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points

Details
You can earn up to 10 CP a day.
 Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.
 You can earn playtime in all modes, including Studio Mode.
 Besides playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
 You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
 Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
 Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
 Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
 You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
 All CP will be removed during maintenance on 7/10.


Updates to the New/Returning Weapon Supply Box
Rewards will given to new and returning players upon logging in during the event.

Welcome Supply Box (15 Days/Bound)
Trinity Grenade
 Infinity Laser Fist
 Dual Beretta Gunslinger
 Hunter-Killer X-90 (Vampiric Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
 Hunter-Killer X-12 (Speed Up Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
 +6 Dual UZI (Damage +3/Ammo +3)
 +8 Winchester M1887 Xmas Edition (Damage +2/Weight +2/Fire Rate +2/Ammo +2), (Knockback Up Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
 +8 M95 Xmas Edition (Damage +2/Accuracy +2/Recoil +1/Ammo +3), (Speed Up Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
 Tomahawk Xmas Edition (Speed Up Part - Grade 6 + Knife Reach Part - Grade 6)

Details
Rewards can be claimed once per account.
 Returning players are those who have not logged in for 30 days or longer.


Return of the New and Returning Player Welcome Attendance Event
Rewards are given to new and returning players after staying logged in for 10 minutes during the event.

Login Reward
Day 1: Event Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage
 Day 2: Event Decoder x2 + 1,000 Mileage
 Day 3: Event Decoder x3 + 1,500 Mileage
 Day 4: Event Decoder x4 + 2,000 Mileage
 Day 5: Event Decoder x5 + 2,500 Mileage
 Day 6: Event Decoder x6 + 3,000 Mileage
 Day 7: Event Decoder x7 + Epic Weapon Pass (2 Days)

Details
Rewards can be claimed once per account.
 Returning players are those who have not logged in for 30 days or longer.
 Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and are removed afterwards.


Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Giveaway (6/12 - 6/26)
In celebration of the Dragon Boat Festival, get a Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade on your first login during the event period.

Obtainable Items
Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade
 During the event, the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade can be used for free, but it will be removed during the 6/26 maintenance.


Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Destruction Event (6/12 - 6/26)
Get rewarded for killing 10 zombies with the Lotus Leaf Grenade in Zombie Mutant, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Z modes, where the damage can vary greatly.
Damage: 50% chance for normal damage, 40% chance for 2x damage, and 10% chance for one-hit-kill damage

Conditions / Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4960831d3afb02dfd547473ab13ceb0adb12f216.png
Get Outing Nameplate (300 Days) by killing 10 zombies with the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade in Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes.

Details
Rewards can be claimed once per account for the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Destruction Event.
 Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
 Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.


Eid al-Adha Event (6/12 - 6/26)
Complete the missions during the event to earn rewards.

Conditions / Rewards
Earn 1 point each time you reach 10/20/30 minutes of playtime (up to 3 points per day).
 Earn Event Decoder x1 by reaching 30 minutes of playtime (up to once a day)

Point Rewards
3 points: Rare Decoder x10
 6 Points: Unique Decoder x8
 9 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
 15 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3
 18 Points: Class Decoder x5
 24 points: Transcendence Decoder x5
 30 Points: Lamb Doll Mask x1
 33 points: Transcendence Decoder x7
 36 Points: Class Decoder x10

Details
Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Studio Mode and Laboratory).
 Each reward can only be claimed once per account.


Eid al-Adha Celebration Mileage Auction (6/15 - 6/18)
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

Permanent Auction Items Added: Roy, Romy

Auction Details
Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
 Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
 Market Price of Items: Lowest bids and direct purchase prices are shown in the Auction House when listing an item.
 Item Display: Items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed first.
 Auction Filters: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
 Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
 Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM - 11:59 PM). When the auction is over, all currently listed items will be canceled.

Other Details
Remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
 You can only bid on one item at a time.
 Regular auction items will be listed with an additional 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
 If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
 Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
 If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
 The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
 When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
 Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.


Shop update

New Transcendence Weapon "Pulse Reactor" Promotion (6/15 - 7/10)
The Pulse Reactor can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

Pulse Reactor Drop Rate
Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
 Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%

Pulse Reactor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/82c8d279fcc6b2b8fe91c5fd1dd0012555e8420d.png
An SMG equipped with an energy reactor and capacity of 75 projectiles. The reactor recaptures pulse energy to fire special ammunition for basic attacks and basic ammunition for special attacks. Basic attacks also deal reduced damage to additional enemies near the target.


New Transcendence Weapon "Pulse Reactor" Guaranteed Giveaway (6/15 - 7/10)
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you may be guaranteed to receive the Pulse Reactor!

Reward Threshold
Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points

Details
Earn 6 Guaranteed Points each time you use a Transcendence Premium Decoder.
 Receive a Guaranteed Point each time you use a Transcendence Decoder.
 All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be removed and replaced with 500 mileage each during maintenance on 7/10.


New Rotation Class Appearance Event (6/15 - 7/10)
The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

Appearing Classes: Smile Mary/Immortal Eric/Lynn/Kai

Details
Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.
Winning Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
 Winning Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
 Winning Lynn will automatically provide Black Dragon Mask (Permanent).
 Winning Kai will automatically provide Tactical Goggles (Permanent).
 The Rotation Group will be removed from the possible contents of the decoder once the event ends.
 The contents of the Rotation Group can change at any time.
 The Rotation Group is added to Class Decoders only during the event.

Guaranteed Class Rotation Group Giveaway Event (6/15 - 7/10)
Select a guaranteed Class from the Rotation Group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

Eligible Classes: Smile Mary/Immortal Eric/Lynn/Kai
Each time you reach 150 points, you can choose 1 class from the Rotation Group.
 You'll get 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
 Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.


Other Information


Discontinued Product Sales
Discontinuation of sales of 6 types of paint patterns sold in the Store & Mileage Store

 Sale period: Until the maintenance on July 10th

Discontinuation of sales of 6 types of paint patterns sold in the Mileage Store

Earn 1 CP for every 15 Kill Points by zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 8 CP per day).

Earn 1 CP when you complete 2 of the following missions (up to 1 CP per day):
- Click on the Event Missions tab to check your Event Missions.

Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points

Details
You can earn up to 10 CP a day.
Daily Missions are reset every day at midnight.
You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
Other than playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.

Complete missions during the event period to earn CP (Counter-Strike Points).

→ Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
→ Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)

At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.

Participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

Details
Weekdays and Weekends - 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM CEST
Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b306d0f548b23fa07a5fb3b8369900dd56c64d89.png

A sword made of smaller sword parts linked together in the form of a whip, increasing the weapon's attack speed and range. It has numerous attack combos that connect one attack to another, making it a very versatile weapon for the battlefield.

Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points

Earn 6 Guaranteed Points each time you use a Transcendence Premium Decoder.
Receive a Guaranteed Point each time you use a Transcendence Decoder.

The popular and charming cheerleader known as Evita has a secret: she's actually a special agent for the government! Directed to find and locate the super soldier Angelina, one of Douglas Jacob's pet projects, Evita went deep undercover as a cheerleader for one of Angelina's favorite sports teams in order to meet her, all to no avail. However, one day Evita gets lucky and runs into Angelina while being chased by agents of Kronos and is finally able to make contact.

As a child, Angelina lost her parents in the war and had to join the army to survive. During her time there, she was invited to come back to America with Douglas Jacob, who was visiting the war zone as part of his relief organization. His wealth and her incredible beauty quickly propelled the former soldier on the path to fame and stardom, but in exchange for Jacob's sponsorship, Angelina was coerced to take a special Kronos-developed serum. However, thanks to a unique gene structure that prevents the virus from mutating within her, Angelina awakened from her operation as a powerful Super Soldier.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 30th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/25890ddfbdd32e1f4898f22efaed01d37127a2ae.jpg
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Spring Fling Event (04/30 - 05/15)
Time to smell the flowers and feel the warm breeze! Spring is just around the corner!

Mileage Auction Event (4/30 - 5/15)
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

Family Nameplate Creation Request Event (4/30 - 5/15)
Show your family pride to receive an exclusive Nameplate!

Sandalphon/Belial Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)
During this special event, Sandalphon and Belial will appear in Epic Decoders!

Tyrant's Mace Resale Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)
The Tyrant's Mace can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during this event.

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

Event Information

 Spring Fling Event (04/30 - 05/15)
Time to smell the flowers and feel the warm breeze! Spring is just around the corner!

Participation / Rewards
Stay logged in for 30 minutes/60 minutes: 1 point (up to 2 points a day)
Every 20 minutes/40 minutes of playtime: 1 point (up to 2 points a day)
Use any type of Decoder: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
Go on an Exploration: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
Place a bid, list an item for sale, or directly purchase an item from the Mileage Auction House: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
Enhance or disassemble an item, paint a weapon, equip or combine a part: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
Every 6 Kill Points scored in Zombie Mode: 1 point (up to 15 points a day)
Clear 1 session in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 3 points (up to 15 points a day)
Maximum Daily Mission Points: 20 (per day)

How to Earn Kill Points
Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points

Point Rewards
20 Points: Rare Decoder x3 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10
40 Points: Rare Decoder x5
60 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
100 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x1 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
120 Points: Event Decoder x5
140 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Italian Chicken Nameplate (300 Days)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/564ec7df3ff603bd88c2bb765bb253385a439128.png
160 Points: Old-Time Costume Box x1
180 Points: Feline Hat (Permanent)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8328ba08c79c4dd367c96b5ca3b813bbf36dff30.png
200 Points: Class Decoder x7 + Event Decoder x3
220 Points: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Event Decoder x3
240 Points: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP x5
260 Points: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5

Details
The pileup rewards above can be only be obtained once per Nexon ID.
Earn up to 20 points a day!
Kill Points you've earned will reset every midnight.
You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
Other than playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and are removed afterwards.


 Mileage Auction Event (4/30 - 5/15)
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

Permanent Auction Items Added: Ismael, Ethan, Satellite Mine

Auction House Quality-of-Life Improvements
Upper Price Limit for Parts adjusted
Lower Price Limit set
Reverse Auction for Classes added
Detailed Search for Weapons added
Auction House History added
Unlisting Items now available 
Item Labels added
Transaction Price Listing added
For more details, please refer to the Auction House Quality-of-Life Update notes.

Auction Details
Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
Market Price of Items: Lowest bids and direct purchase prices are shown on the Auction House when listing an item.
Item Display: Items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed first.
Auction Filters: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM - 11:59 PM). When the auction is over, all currently listed items will be canceled.

Other Details
Remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
You can only bid on one item at a time.
Regular auction items will be listed with an additional 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.


 1,000 Mileage Auction Event! (4/30 - 5/15)
Throughout the event, rare items selling for 1,000 Mileage will appear.

Times / Items
3:00 PM (CEST) : Epic Decoder x3 
4:00 PM (CEST) : Transcendence Decoder x3 
8:00 PM (CEST) : Epic Decoder x3
9:00 PM (CEST) : Transcendence Decoder x3

Details
The auction house items listed above only appear at specific times.
These items will appear within the first 10 minutes of each auction hour. Bidding lasts for 10 minutes.
Players who lost the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage after the auction closes.
Click Obtain to claim your rewards after you've won.


 Family Nameplate Creation Request Event (4/30 - 5/15)
Show your family pride to receive an exclusive Nameplate!
Please refer to the Related Announcement for more details.


 Goodbye Season 18 Double-Up Event (4/30 - 5/8)
Earn double Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


Shop Update

 Sandalphon/Belial Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)
During this special event, Sandalphon and Belial will appear in Epic Decoders!

Weapon Rates
Sandalphon: 0.175%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/36ba671029d23d30be514331838020f6b3801b60.png
A weapon from a different dimension, known as the Heavenly Relic. Activate to protect the wielder and summon a heavenly being.
Belial: 0.175%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9d46037d35b02087036928581914e9f3b46b7070.png
Once a relic of the heavens, this corrupted weapon now resides in the demonic realm. Can be used to attack enemies at close or far range or to summon demonic beings.


 Sandalphon/Belial Guaranteed Giveaway (4/30 – 5/29)
Get Guaranteed Points when you use Epic Decoders during the promotion!

Conditions and Rewards
Each time you reach 300 points, you can choose one of the following weapons:
Sandalphon/Belial/Devastator/Failnaught/Laevateinn/Lightning Fury

Details
You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Epic Decoder.
Rewards are earned every 300 points. You can select weapons at 300 points, 600 points, 900 points, and so on.


 Sandalphon/Belial Crafting Event (4/30 – 5/29)
Receive the Sandalphon or the Belial during the event if you purchase the Belial blueprint with one of these weapons in your inventory.

Crafting Instructions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1f5155a67e715b10fe7894cd51b659774e58138f.png
Sandalphon (Permanent) can be obtained by using the Belial blueprint while both the Belial (Permanent) and the Belial blueprint are in your inventory.
Belial (Permanent) can be obtained by using the Belial blueprint while both the Sandalphon (Permanent) and the Belial blueprint are in your inventory.
Either the Belial (Permanent) or the Sandalphon (Permanent) can be obtained using the Belial blueprint while the Belial (Permanent), the Sandalphon (Permanent), and the Belial blueprint are in your inventory.

Details
Using the Belial blueprint will remove it from your inventory.
Use the Belial blueprint after purchasing to craft either the Sandalphon (Permanent) or Belial (Permanent).
It can only be crafted once per account.
If you have not used the Belial blueprint during the event, they will be used automatically on the 5/29 (Wed) maintenance. (Conditions and rewards are same as above)


 Tyrant's Mace Resale Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)
The Tyrant's Mace can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during this event.

Tyrant's Mace Drop Rate
Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0f7d87e0f0852a08130e5408091482a67f08bc7e.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Check out the following sections for more information.

Hidden Panda Points Event (4/17 - 4/30)
That adorable panda is bound to show up...so don't miss out! Collect points to receive items for him and his friends!

Classic Weapon Giveaway (4/17 - 4/30)
Reach 30 minutes of playtime every day during the event period to receive new Zombie Classic weapons and other fabulous rewards!

Zombie Hero mode is about to get even wilder! Rules will now change every round during the event!

Bonus Disassembly Event (4/17 - 4/29 11:59 PM)
Participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cousteau (4/17 - 4/30)
Cousteau will now drop from normal and Premium Transcendence Decoders!

---------- Details ----------

Update Information

 Graphical Update
The title, logo (BI), loading screen, background wallpaper and library icon have been updated.

Zombie Z mode and Zombie Hero mode have been updated.
Zombie Z Mode
The HP for Minor Zombies has been increased from 15,000 to 18,000.

Zombie Hero Mode
The Max HP for Minor Zombies has been increased from 15,000 to 18,000.
The amount of Host Zombies at the beginning of each round has been increased.

The Bonus Disassembly system has been improved.
A random waiting system has been added.

Other Improvements
Improved Entry Screen
The Lobby and Studio selection screens have been removed, instead reconnecting back to the lobby.

Updated Lobby Navigation Menu
Zombie Mode will stay the same for 30 days for players starting or returning to the game.
Recommended Mode has been changed to Zombie Hero Mode for existing players.

Reduced New & Returning Player Pop-Ups
The number of log-in pop-ups have been reduced to allow faster entry into the game. (First log-in only)

Added Pop-up Options on Log-in
Pop-ups shown after logging in will now have an option to not be displayed without new information.

Season Pass Pop-Up Display
Checking the 'Do Not Show Until Next Season' box will prevent the pop-up from displaying until the next season begins. 
Click on the Season Pass icon at the bottom right side of the screen to view information about season rewards.

Mission Chain Pop-up Display
Checking the "Do Not Show Until Next Mission Chain" box will prevent the pop-up from displaying until the next mission chain begins.
View Mission Chain information from [Missions] > [Go to Mission Chain] at the top of the screen.


Event Information

Hidden Panda Points Event (4/17 - 4/30)
That adorable panda is bound to show up...so don't miss out! Collect points to receive items for him and his friends!

Conditions / Rewards
Daily Log-in: 2 points (once daily)
Every 5 minutes of playtime: 1 point (up to 10 points a day)
Score either a zombie kill or a human infection a total of 2 times, or score 6 assists (excluding bots): 2 points (up to 40 per day)
Clear a session after scoring 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher: 5 points (up to 40 per day)
* Maximum Daily Mission Points possible per day: 50 points

Daily Rewards

50 Points: Rare Decoder x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10
150 Points: Unique Decoder x5 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e1998d3a4c6abf93de44bf47ab3aa163d26117d0.jpg

Greetings from the CSN team!
We're announcing two new events that will take place on the Official CSN Discord server. Get terrific gifts just by joining the server and writing how-to guides for the game!

 Join the Official CSN Discord Event
How to Participate
 Join the Official Discord server to receive a Join Coupon in the Join Gift channel.
 Official Discord [Link]


Event Duration
 4/11 (Thu) - Until further notice


Event Reward
 Counter-Strike Nexon Joining the Official Discord Gift (Zombie Beginner Weapon Set (7 Days) + Event decoder x3)


Details
 Players who have already joined the Discord server can still receive this reward.
 The coupon code can only be used once per account.
 Please use the coupon before it expires on 12/31/2025.
 Unredeemed coupons may become unusable after the event ends. 



CSN Guide Writing Event
How to Participate
 1) Write a how-to guide and post it in the Official Discord's #csns_walkthrough channel.
Official Discord #csns_walkthrough Channel [Link]

 *[Required] Make sure posts on the #csns_walkthrough channel pertain to a how-to guide. 
 *When writing a how-to guide, you'll have a higher chance to win if you upload a video you created yourself to YouTube with the hashtags #CSN and #Counter Strike. Don't forget to share the URL!

 If you're having trouble deciding what topic you should write about, consider one of the following:

Short Ideas
①	Things you didn't know when you first started the game.
②	Information that is difficult to know because it isn't explained in-game or is otherwise hard to find.
③	Any other useful information that you want to highlight.

Detailed Ideas
①	Strategy as Human on certain maps. (Detailed map guide + your strategy)
②	Strategy as Zombie on certain maps. (Detailed map guide + your strategy)
③	Recommended modes and tips on playing them.
④	Recommended classes (Human or Zombie) and tips on how to use them to win.
⑤	Guides on recommended weapons and how best to use them. 
 
 2) Root for the best and most useful guides by reacting to them with a 👍emoji! (You can vote for multiple guides)


Event Duration
 4/11 (Thu) - 4/23 (Tue)


Event Rewards
 Guide Writing Rewards (24 winners)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c2eaeb2d1c2a66ea286fbfa58d89293fae3c4c42.jpg


 Cheering Participation Reward (10 winners): Event Decoder x1
* 10 people who have cheered by leaving a 👍 emoji on a useful guide will be selected from a raffle and awarded an Even Decoder.


Winner Announcement Schedule
 Winners will be announced in #notices channel of the Official Discord server on 5/10 (Fri).


Details
 It is recommended to write your guides in English to reach the most players. However, there are no penalties against writing your guide in other languages!
 Any guides you write may be used in the creation of future official CSNS content. By participating in this event, you agree to these terms.
 There is no limit to the number of guides you can write. You are allowed to contribute multiple times.
 Posts in channels other than the one designated for the event will not count toward participation.
 If you plagiarize or write a guide unrelated to CSNS, you may be removed from the event without warning.
 You will not receive any participation rewards if your content does not relate to the event.
 You may be excluded from the winner's raffle if the guide you've posted is removed after participating.
 Stealing or copying other people's video guides or creating controversial content may result in your disqualification from the event and the cancellation of prizes without warning.
 If a guide that includes a video becomes a winner, additional verificiation may be necessary to determine that it is original content. 
 Video guides set to Private will not be eligible for the raffle.
 You'll have one chance to win per Discord account when rooting for guides. The number of emojis you leave doesn't affect your chances.

notes.title: [Event] Studio #Fairytale Theme Contest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d4ab9228dde3746ecb9798d1f533d518a563a812.jpg

Show off your creative skills in this Fairytale-themed Studio contest! 
Participate now to receive the 1st place prize and Steam gift card!

Event 1: Celebratory Studio Contest
Event Schedule Application Period: 3/20 – 4/17
 Finalists Announced: 4/30
 Player Vote: 4/30 - 5/14
 Winners Announced: 6/12
 Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 7/12

How to Participate Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
 Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
 Step 3: Add "#fairytale" to the map's title
 Step 4: Leave a comment to this post including your In-game Nickname, Map name, Steam ID, Steam Profile Link


Conditions 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
 If you make promotional video for YouTube, there will be extra points.  There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.

Prizes 1st: Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 2nd: Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 3rd: Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal

Notice Only maps created on or after 3/20 will be able to participate.
 Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
 You must include the #fairytale tag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
 Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
 Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
 If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
 If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
 Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
 Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.


Event 2: Celebratory Studio Contest- Steam Gift Card Giveaway!
Studio Event schedule Application Period: 3/20 – 4/17
 Gift Card Winners Announcement: 4/30
 Personal Information Collection: 4/30 - 5/14 
 Gift Card Distribution: 6/12

Conditions Earn more than the total of 10 points within the criteria below
 Map design - Is it unique, creative and not repetitive? (1-5)
 Functionality - Does the map have good FPS? Does everything work? (1-5)
 Map gameplay - Is it fun? Is it too hard? Or perhaps too easy? (1-5)
 Story - Does it have cool stories or narratives? Or just shoot and win? (1-5)


Prize 10$ Gift Card (50 people)
Once you claim the gift card, it will automatically be converted the amount to your country's currency.

Notice Gift cards are provided via raffle, and are only available to contest entries that have met the prerequisite requirements.
 You must include the #fairytale hashtag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
 If there are less than 50 entries, all participants that met the requirements will receive the gift and no additional raffles will be held.
 Multiple winnings are not allowed (one player cannot win with 2 or more contest entries)
 Studio maps that have been entered in the past are excluded from the prize raffle.
 Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
 If you fail to deliver your personal information within the announced period, you will be removed from the raffle without notification.

Rare and Unique Decoder Supply Boxes are opened immediately when collected. You will receive two Decoders each day you log in. You will not receive Decoders on days you did not log in.
Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained.


Mileage Auction Event (03/13 - 03/19 23:59:59)
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

Details
Item Rank: Premium (All other weapons are Normal Rank)
Auction Time: 1 hour (All items)
Number of Auction Listings: 2 (This number increases based on your VIP rank)
Pricing Details: Current Auction House prices, such as Lowest Bid and the Direct Purchase, can be referenced when listing an item.
Items Displayed: Only items with lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
Auction Hours: 00:00 AM - 11:59 PM (When the auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled)

Details
The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
You can only bid for 1 item at a time.
Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
If an item listed on the auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
Items listed on the auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
If you list an item, you cannot cancel it until the auction is over.
Items you have listed will be shown on the bid page.
When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
Some recently released items cannot be placed for auction.


Promotions

Steam Spring Sale Event (3/13 - 3/20)
This spring save up to 99% off on Decoder Supply Boxes! 
For more information, please visit the Promotions page.


Transcendence Class Promotion (3/13 - 4/3)
Two Transcendence Classes, Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Blue Rabbit Mirage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/899d66393f899f88197560de25ce4f9652bf1ad8.png
Mirage is a famous virtual streamer with a lively personality on the VR platform Chrono World, who enjoys chatting with her fans in cute outfits. In reality, she is a timid but accomplished hacker who accidentally stumbled upon suspicious records having to do with Chrono World. Ever since, Mirage has been trying to contact Aegis Institute while avoiding those who are hunting her down for what she uncovered.
Paired Weapon: Magnum Launcher
Earn special rounds every time you left-click fire a certain amount of times.
Using right-click increases the number of special rounds that are fired.
A direct hit with this special round will have increased damage in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.

Zombie Scenario Skill: Saber Protocol
Passive: Critical Rate and Movement Speed is increased when playing in Zombie Scenario mode together with Alpaca Anemone.
(Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
Applies the Addict Add-On Effect (Which can be stacked, increasing the effect).

Active: Applies Invincible to yourself and any nearby allies for a certain amount of time in Zombie Scenario mode.
While Invincible, steal a certain amount of damage done to enemies to yourself.

Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

Alpaca Anemone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/822db48252d382ee984b21cccf8ded961747efe0.png
Anemone, a pro gamer on the VR platform Chrono World, is renowned for her skill in the world of competitive gaming. Unlike her older twin sister Mirage, she's both strong and sociable. She is dedicated to protecting Mirage after she learned that the developer behind Chrono World is part of a suspicious conspiracy.
Paired Weapon: Magnum Launcher
Using right-click will fire special rounds out in 3 rows.
Direct hits with Special Ammo will have increased damage, but any Explosion Damage will be reduced in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.

Zombie Scenario Skill: Valorous Energy
Passive: Critical Rate and Movement Speed is increased when playing in Zombie Scenario mode together with Blue Rabbit Mirage.
(Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
Applies the Free Market Add-On Effect (Which can be stacked, increasing the effect).

Active: Applies a barrier to yourself and any nearby allies for a certain amount of time.
Attack power is increased for a certain amount of time (First at a significant amount, then reduced as time passes).

Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.


Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (3/13 - 4/3)
Get two Transcendence Classes (Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!

Conditions and Rewards
After reaching 150 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
After reaching 300 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
Select either Blue Rabbit Mirage and Giant Carrot, or Alpaca Anemone and Alpaca Keyring.

Details
One Guaranteed Point is awarded each time you use a Class Decoder.
Three Guaranteed Points are awarded when you use a Premium Class Decoder.
Selecting Blue Rabbit Mirage will automatically give you the Giant Carrot (Permanent).
Selecting Alpaca Anemone will automatically give you the Alpaca Keyring (Permanent).
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be collected once per account.


Other Fixes
Fixed an issue where the item purchase limit for the Mileage Shop wasn't being updated.
Fixed an issue where some class selection windows were not displayed.

 2024 Character Collection Event (2/6 – 3/20)
When you collect the characters 2, 0, 2, and 4 during the event, you will receive a Blue Dragon Gift Box. When you collect the characters E, P, I, and C during the event, you will receive the New Epic Weapon, the Naberius (Permanent).

 2024 New Epic Weapon Promotion (2/6 - 3/20)
During the event, Epic Decoders with the collectible letter "C" will be available in the shop.

Check out the following sections for more information.

2024 Character Collection Event (2/6 – 3/20)

In moments of crisis, you can use Soul Armor to automatically block and knock back zombie attacks.

 Getting the "C" from Epic Decoder will grant you "C" and a 2024 Nameplate. Completion of all the characters in 'EPIC' will unlock the Naberius (Permanent) reward.

Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos

notes.title: [Update] Event Patch Notes: February 6th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/629280d74c2f7942bb6147dc627fb60cc4565cbf.png
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

 New Year Holiday Play Event (2/6 – 2/27)Pick up New Year Supply Boxes to earn rewards while celebrating the new year!

 Catch the New Year Blue Dragon! Event (1) (2/6 - 2/27)2024 is the year of the Blue Dragon! It's your year to catch it and earn rewards!

 Stingray Kite Carnage (2/6 – 2/27)Hit Stingray Kites during the event to get the Honor Medal!

 Crossbow Classic Login Event (2/6 - 2/27)Log in to claim the new weapon and play the game to obtain Enhancement Material!

 New Year Gift Event (2/6 - 2/27)Receive the following rewards by staying logged in for 5 minutes during the event period.

 Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)The new year begins with a Mileage Auction! Auctions only last a limited time, so don't miss out!

 Special Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)Become the winner of the special item that appears at a specific time.

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

New Year Holiday Play Event (2/6 – 2/27)
Pick up New Year Supply Boxes to earn rewards while celebrating the new year!

Participation & Rewards
Earn a Lucky Pouch each time you log in (1 a day)
Earn a Lucky Pouch for reaching 5 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 minutes of game play (up to 7 a day)
Earn a Lucky Pouch for obtaining a Supply Box in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z modes (up to 2 a day)
Earn a Lucky Pouch or obtaining a Point Box in Zombie Scenario mode in Normal or above (up to 2 a day)

Lucky Pouch Contents (Chance to get 1 of these items)
Rare Decoder x1
Event Decoder x1
Unique Decoder x1
50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x1
Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x1
Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x1 
Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1 
Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1
Random -1 Dehancement Material x1
100 Mileage Coupon x1
200 Mileage Coupon x1
1000 Mileage Coupon x1
Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x1
Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)

Notice
You can obtain up to 10 Lucky Pouches per day regardless of the mission.
Excludes Zombie Scenario: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
Participation only counts in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio, includes Laboratory Modes).
All Lucky Pouches will be removed during maintenance on 2/27.
 The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.
Supply Boxes (Zombie Mode) and Point Boxes (Zombie Scenario) will appear as Lucky Pouches during the event until the 2/15 maintenance.

Catch the New Year Blue Dragon! Event (1) (2/6 - 2/27)
2024 is the year of the Blue Dragon! It's your year to catch it and earn rewards!

Participation & Rewards
Catch a Blue Dragon in the waiting room/lobby to obtain Lion Mask Hat (1 Day) or Lucky Pouch Spray (1 Day)

Notice
You can participate in this event up to twice a day.


Catch the New Year Blue Dragon! Event (2) (2/6 - 2/27)
Get even more rewards for catching more Blue Dragons!

Participation & Rewards
Catch 100 Blue Dragons in the waiting room/lobby to earn the New Year Hunter Medal & Event Decoder x10 & 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5

Notice
You can only participate in this event once per account.
Players who already possess the New Year Hunter medal cannot receive another one, but they can still claim the rest of the rewards.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


Stingray Kite Carnage (2/6 – 2/27)
Hit Stingray Kites during the event to get the Honor Medal!

Participation & Rewards
Hit 300 Stingray Kites to earn [Honor] Killer K Medal + Transcendence Decoder x10.

Notice
Players who already possess the Killer K medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
Maps with Stingray Kites: Mouse Hole, Survival: Double Gate, Survival: Trap, and Survival: Lost City
You can claim your reward once you kill 300 Stingray Kites during the event.
Eligible Modes: All modes excluding bot modes (but includes Laboratory mode)

Crossbow Classic Login Event (2/6 - 2/27)
Log in to claim the new weapon and play the game to obtain Enhancement Material!

Weapon Giveaway
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a3561b567dd2e652b2ecec3c3b5581732f393024.png
Reach 10 minutes of playtime to obtain Crossbow Classic (Permanent)

How to Participate & Rewards
Reach 30 minutes of playtime for the following rewards (can only claim once a day)
1x: Rare Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x6
2x: Rare Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x6
3x: Rare Decoder x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x6
4x: Rare Decoder x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x6
5x: Rare Decoder x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x6

Notice
The reward can only be earned once per account.


New Year Gift Event (2/6 - 2/27)
Receive the following rewards by staying logged in for 5 minutes during the event period.

Reward
Failnaught (7 Days)
Holy Sword Divine Order (7 Days)
Lightning Fury (7 Days)

Notice
The reward can only be earned once per account.


Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)
The new year begins with a Mileage Auction! Auctions only last a limited time, so don't miss out!

Permanent Auction Item Added
Anemone
Mirage
Norinco Type 86s
Bomb Boost Part - Grades 1 - 6
Bomb Self-Shield Part - Grades 1 - 6

Auction Details
Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or have a direct purchase price are displayed.
Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM – 11:59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.

Notice
Premium Line Changes: 
[Added] Anemone, Mirage, Bomb Boost Part - Grade 6, Bomb Self-Shield Part - Grade 6
[Removed] Boss David Black, Leader Soi, Rage Down Part - Grade 6, Armor Break Part - Grade 6
Lower Price Limit: 700 / Upper Price Limit: None
The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
You can only bid on one item at a time.
Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.


Special Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)
Become the winner of the special item that appears at a specific time.

Special Auction time
12:00 PM / Transcendence Red Dragon Cannon Gold
1:30 PM / Transcendence Magnum Drill Gold

Notice
Auction items only appear at specific times.
Bidding Time: 60 minutes of public bid, then 10 minutes of private bid.


Other Changes
[olist]In order to prevent macro use, making a set trade in the auction house will require new authentication.
Antarctic Base map's playable area has been adjusted and some objects have been removed.
The value of the Rolling Vulcan shop has been adjusted and the Rolling Thunder's condition was changed from 3 to 1 Hero Energy.
Fixed an issue in zombie mode where if a zombie dies while using their skill where they would continuously inflict damage on a human. 
Fixed an issue where dying while using Aksha's Absorb skill and then reviving would display the skill UI as unactivated. 
Fixed typos on Ismael, Idol Miho, and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose item descriptions. 
Fixed an issue in specific situations where ending the session would not close the notification window. 
Fixed an issue in zombie scenario mode where Infinite Ammo would be applied to a different firearm.
Fixed an issue in classic mode where the Nata Knife Hero would inflict an incorrect amount damage.
Fixed an issue for some weapon paints where the textures would display incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where using the decoder would not provide any mileage.
Mileage that was not correctly distributed will be given out upon maintenance.[/olist]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 17th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4fc67bc7215bece254b4b82a694735612374a257.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

New Year's Luck! Event (01/17- 01/31)
Get ready for lots of luck and good fortune in 2024!

Good-Bye Season 17 Double Badges Event (01/17- 01/24)
Earn double Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.

Transcendence Class Promotion (01/17 -02/06)
Two Transcendence Classes, Special Agent Mei and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (01/17 - 02/06)
Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

---------- Details ----------

Update Information

Zombie Z Event Mode (01/17 - 02/06)

Zombie Z Event Mode Information
Zombie Z Event Mode is only playable on Dust, Assault, and Estate maps.
There are only seven rounds and Karma/Morale Boost is unavailable.

Notice
You cannot earn EXP from combat during the Zombie Z Mode event, but instead gain six levels every round, up to level 40.
Weapons and zombies available change based on your level.
Using Mutation Points will allow you to choose from one of three random mutations.
Choosing an already obtained mutation will increase its level and improve its power. When a mutation reaches level 6 (maximum level), the power will increase drastically or additional abilities will be given.
Mutations are given in order and divided into one of two groups (A/B) each time you spend points. Each group can earn up to five of the eight mutations.
A hidden mutation may sometimes appear when certain mutations reach max level.


Event Information

New Year's Luck! Event (01/17- 01/31)
Get ready for lots of luck and good fortune in 2024!

How To Earn Charms
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/294d7f606d047519cee4083deedc617a65b9906e.png
15 minutes of playtime: 3 Rare Decoders (once a day).
30 minutes of playtime: 1 Event Decoder + 2 Good Luck Charms (once a day).
60 minutes of playtime: 1 Class Decoder + 2 Good Luck Charms (once a day).
90 minutes of playtime: 2 Good Luck Charms (once a day).

In-game Missions
Score a total of 30 Kill Points Zombie Mode: 2 Good Luck Charms (up to 6 per day)
Score 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on hard or higher, then clear it: 1 Good Luck Charm (up to 6 per day)

How to Earn Kill Points
Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points

Rewards for Total Charms Collected
10 Good Luck Charms: Rare Decoder x10
20 Good Luck Charms: Unique Decoder x5 + Rare Decoder x5
35 Good Luck Charms: Event Decoder x5 + Rare Decoder x15
60 Good Luck Charms: Unique Premium Decoder x2 + Rare Decoder x10
80 Good Luck Charms: Event Decoder x5 + Rare Decoder x10
100 Good Luck Charms: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Unique Premium Decoder x5
120 Good Luck Charms: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Class Decoder x5
130 Good Luck Charms: Transcendence Premium Decoder x3 + Class Premium Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x10

Notice
You can earn up to 12 Good Luck Charms a day, per Nexon account.
You cannot collect more than 130 Good Luck Charms.
All remaining Good Luck Charms will be removed during maintenance on 2/6/24.
All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders and Premium Class Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 2/6/24. Each Transcendence Premium Decoder will be replaced with 500 Mileage and each Premium Class Decoder will be replaced with 50 Mileage.
Each cumulative reward can be earned only once per Nexon account.
You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
Credit will only be granted in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
The Event Decoders can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


Good-Bye Season 17 Double Trouble Event (01/17- 01/24)
Earn double Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


Shop Update

Transcendence Class Promotion (01/17 -02/06)
Two Transcendence Classes, Special Agent Mei and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Special Agent Mei
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/75b6df5a437352efa682fef3d0d304808bc76231.png
Background: Mei is a Chinese-born special agent who works for the Intelligence Agency and is trained in high-level combat. Most recently, she had been assigned to assist a fellow agent, but has found this difficult. In a turn of events that wrecked her resume, Mei has been unable to track her target due to their masterful disguise. When she discovered that the troublesome pyromaniac that had been terrorizing the world was actually the agent that she had been told to support, Mei became extremely conflicted, but carried on. Still struggling to find the pyromaniac agent, she eventually received intel that they had met up with David's company, so now Mei is on the move again to finally provide support.
Paired Weapon: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
Feast's activation time has been decreased, and damage increased.
Zombie Scenario Skill: Special Agent's Stance
Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Pyromaniac Yuri (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent Mei is in the same room (up to 2 players). 
Trap Evasion's Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: Uses Conceal in Zombie Scenario, which will obscure you. Your HP will slowly recover during this time, but inflicting damage on an enemy will reveal you. Once Conceal is disabled, your movement speed will return to normal, and a set amount of HP will be restored immediately for you and your allies within a set range.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

Pyromaniac Yuri
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f0ed63fef3b67d8e25da7d00298fec62ccdb1e06.png
Background: A mysterious girl with an amazing talent for handling explosives, Yuri is known for working exclusively on more destructive activities. Although she successfully completes most of her missions, she once unintentionally injured Jennifer while on an assignment. Yuri is a master of disguise and can infiltrate any location to get the job done, but recently, she has been on the run from Mei, who has been persistently chasing her after Yuri had planned on using David Black and his company but ended up exposing her current whereabouts to Mei. Now, the two of them find the chase and each other’s company to be getting exhausting.
Paired Weapon: Dual Beretta Gunslinger
Gun Kata's damage is now unaffected by distance, rather than decreasing the farther away your target is.
Gun Kata's damage has been increased
Zombie Scenario Skill: Blow It Up
Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Special Agent Mei (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent Mei is in the same room (up to 2 players).  
Giant's Feet's Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: Applies explosion damage within a set range around you in Zombie Scenario (Not applicable to objects).
Damage of allies within the explosion range is increased for a set duration.
Explosive Ammo is loaded in your magazines, which explode at set intervals.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/356215264fa06dd9452c9f57c23c110f32e695d6.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Login Supplies Event (12/27 - 01/30 11:59)
Adieu, 2023! Collect the Dragon Orbs for the Year of the Dragon Event (12/27 - 1/17)Say your goodbyes to year 2023! Welcome the year of the Dragon by collecting Dragon Orbs and earn plenty of rewards!

Zombie Scenario Playthrough Event (12/27 - 2/27)Play through Zombie Scenario Seasons 1 - 8 and earn rewards!

New Year's Hot Streak Event (12/30 8 PM – 1/2 11 PM)Hot Streak event will be available from 8 PM to 11 PM every day during the event period.

New Year's Welcome Play Event (12/30 12 AM – 1/1 11 PM)Reach 24 minutes of playtime during the event to obtain 2024 Mileage and 1 Lucky Raffle Ticket!

New Year's Raffle Event (12/30 12:00 AM - 1/1 11:59 PM)Players who earned the Lucky Raffle Ticket during the event can enter the New Year's Raffle.

The New and Returning Players Welcome Event has Returned! (12/27 - 03/13)New and Returning Players Welcome Event returns at the end of 2023! Welcome new and returning players!

Find the Zombie Event (1/10 12:00-1/23 11:59)You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway (1/10 12:00 - 1/23 11:59)Locked and loaded! Before you take down those zombies, you're going to need some ammo!

Bullet Pileup Reward Giveaway (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)Keeping collecting bullets, and the rewards will be delivered with a BANG!

Daily Bullet Collection Event (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)Keep collecting bullets to get your own reward!

---------- Details ----------

Update Information

Zombie Z Update Information

New Mutations Added
Rage Bomb: Increased Zombie Bomb damage based on missing HP.
Danger Sprint: Increased Movement Speed based on missing HP.

Zombie Enhancement per round
The effectiveness of Zombie Skills will be enhanced each round.

Zombie Z Mode Gun Level Adjustments
Drakar I: 10 → 13
Ancient Berserker: 15 → 17
AK47 Paladin: 17 → 16
AK47 Royal Knight: 17 → 16
Starlight Sword: 17 → 19
FG Launcher: 17 → 19
Laser Storm: 18 → 19
M4A1 Dark Knight: 19 → 17
M4A1 Shadow Knight: 19 → 17
Drakar II: 21 → 28
Gran Bird Cannon: 29 → 30
Drakar III: 32 → 38
Barrett M95 White Tiger: 32 → 30
Death Eater: 35 → 36
Gungnir: 36 → 35
Dark Star: 36 → 35
Failnaught: 37 → 36
`Spell Lance Scarlet Rose: 38 → 36


In-game Improvements

The Karma perk change that was applied in the laboratory is now effective in the official mode
1. Karma System
- Separate Karma Gauges, Zombie Karma Perk Change, Human Karma Sub Perk Change
2. Zombie Skill Revamp
3. Human Hero/Sidekick Change

Nameplate Font Shadow Effect added
A shadow effect has ow been added to medal names, player nicknames, and family names

Vampiric Part Grade 1 to 6 Balance Adjustment
Previous: 1x HP Recovery amount cannot exceed x% of max HP
After: 1x the accumulated HP Recovery amount cannot exceed x% of max HP
The calculation used for Vampiric Part's HP recover limit that once determined individual damage now calculates total damage accumulated instead.

System Revamp
Order of the pop-ups upon log-in has been improved (in the following order: Studio Guide, Season Pass, Announcement, Login Supplies, and finally, Mission Chain)
Weapon rank is now displayed in Scenario Buy Menu
Auto-scroll for the quest description window has been added
An icon will now display when client network is unstable.
Weapon restriction options have been improved (weapon category restrictions option added)


Event Information

Adieu, 2023! Collect the Dragon Orbs for the Year of the Dragon Event (12/27 - 1/17)
Say your goodbyes to year 2023! Welcome the year of the Dragon by collecting Dragon Orbs and earn plenty of rewards!

How to Participate
Daily Log-in: 6 Dragon Orbs (once per day)
Clear 2 Daily Missions: 10 Dragon Orbs (once per day)
Every 10 minutes of playtime: 1 Dragon Orb (up to 4 per day)
Every 6 Kill Points by kills, assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 2 Dragon Orbs (up to 30 per day)
Score 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on hard or higher, then clear it: 5 Dragon Orbs (up to 30 daily per account)
Each time you reach 10 minutes of playtime: : 1 Dragon Orb (up to 4 daily per account)
Daily Mission - Max Dragon Orbs Acquired Per Day: 50

How to Earn Kill Points
Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
Human Infection as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points

Daily Rewards
Collect 40 Dragon Orbs: 1 Exploration Support Box (once per day){STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1691b91e42df3a0fcce4885491a3374f2b31466e.png
Exploration Support Box Contents
Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (1 Day)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7a7e81b4791c681291a82875a1758cf906e4681a.png
Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x2
Exploration Success Rate-Up +20%
Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x5

Cumulative Rewards
x50: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
x100: Unique Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
150: Event Decoder x5
x250: Shiho's Pink Wave Nameplate (300 Days) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/70b4c219b935550346dcef562aa958cf74375bc7.png

x600: Random -1 Dehancement Material x5
x650: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5

Notice
You can earn up to 50 Dragon Orbs a day.
Pileup rewards can be collected only once per account.
All unused Exploration Support Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 1/17/2024.
You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
Other than playtime, missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
The Event Decoders can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.

Find the Zombie Event (1/10 12:00-1/23 11:59)
You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

How to Participate
Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
Among a group of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans), find and hit the zombies using the right bullets.
Get these bullets from the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway.
Hitting a zombie will increase your reward by 1 and allow you to take an additional shot. Hitting a human will decrease your reward by 1 and reset the Find the Zombie in progress.
The reward grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit enough zombies in a row, and you can claim the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
Click "Automatic Fire" to quickly proceed through one game.

What is "Automatic Fire"?
Proceed by randomly firing in a game.
You must have more than 1 bullet to continue.
If you are in the Claim Reward state, you must claim your reward to use this feature.
※ Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed amount of time. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage.

Blue B-Box

You won't receive exclusive costumes from selecting a class in this Selection Box.

Special Transcendence Weapon Box
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/252b98e669c4f2f1ab8c2789fd7adcc7b30bae7a.png
Select one of these permanent items: SKULL-T9, Magnum Shooter, SG552 Cerberus, Laser Ripper, Twin Hawk, or Demolition Hammer

Notice
Reward grade will be reset upon claiming the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
The grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box, and players can earn better rewards by consecutively hitting zombies.
Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed duration. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage
If you own both event and purchased bullets, event bullets will be consumed first.
Click on "Claim Reward" to receive reward items.
Chance to Find a Zombie: Remaining Zombies / Remaining Slots (Example: If there are 10 zombies left and 14 slots left → 10/14, there is about 71% chance to find a zombie.)
All unused Old-Time Weapon Paint Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.
All unused Blue B Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.
All unused Mystery Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 1/23.


Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway (1/10 12:00 - 1/23 11:59)
Locked and loaded! Before you take down those zombies, you're going to need some ammo!

Conditions and Items
Earn 20 bullets each for playtime at 15min / 30min / 45min
Earn 30 bullets each for playtime at 60min / 75min / 90min
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c08d50698385151aa6766202ac462dcb6cae90c7.png


Notice
Each account can obtain up to 150 bullets per day.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Studio and Laboratory Modes).
All unused Find the Zombie bullets will be removed on 1/23 11:59 PM


Bullet Pileup Reward Giveaway (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)
 Keeping collecting bullets, and the rewards will be delivered with a BANG!

Total Bullets / Rewards
x1,050: Transcendence Decoder x2
x1,200: Transcendence Decoder x4
x1,350: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Find the Zombie Event Nameplate (300 Days)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/46d4f4c942e7cf371d6e3fe37c41c74c87ba49fa.png



Daily Bullet Collection Event (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)
Keep collecting bullets to get your own reward!

Daily Total Bullets / Rewards
x45: Event Decoder x1

Notice
Obtain up to one a day per account.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Studio and Laboratory Modes).


Zombie Scenario Playthrough Event (12/27 - 2/27)
Play through Zombie Scenario Seasons 1 - 8 and earn rewards!

How to Participate
Score 100 kills in Zombie Scenario mode on normal or higher and clear all maps from Season 1 through 8 to earn the Veteran Nameplate (Permanent)

Hot Streak Event

Other Information
Tattoos have been added to the Enhancement Materials in the Exploration system.
Fixed an issue where hitting a female bot would trigger sounds meant for a male bot.

Fixed an issue in some Zombie Modes where setting the maximum player count to two and playing against the AI would automatically end the session.

Fixed an issue where applying Miracle Prism Sword Moonlit Night Weapon Paint would display the inventory image differently than before. 
Fixed an issue where the animation of the Heavy Zombie Trap activating would not display in Zombie Scenario mode. 
Fixed the issue where the additional rounds of the NEGEV NG7 Ajax were not unlimited in Zombie Scenario mode. 
Fixed an issue where you could purchase Cannon ammo in Zombie Scenario Defense: Center.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 29th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/79a8dbc2bd2dc6ad5f904a6f7e812a135f6f6bae.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Collect Metal Points Event (11/29 - 12/13)The Metal Arena has returned! Earn Metal Points and collect great rewards every day!

---------- Details ----------

Update Information

Metal Arena Opening Announcement

Return of the Arena Medal 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fdcde35815229d0b7309c351259d30e3b50c9063.png
Condition: Play Metal Arena for 30 minutes to receive the medal

Notice
Metal Arena is an event mode that can only be played for a limited time.
The end of the Metal Arena mode will be announced in a separate update.
Apart from the new Return of the Arena medal, existing Metal Arena medals cannot be collected during the event.


Mode Improvements

Display Damage Fonts
The advanced settings for Original / Team Deathmatch / Original (AI) / Team Deathmatch (AI) rooms now have an option to Display Damage Fonts.
Original mode can now display damage fonts.
 
Expanded Set Weapon Storage Slots
Weapon slots have been increased from 9 to 12 and a issue was fixed where the shortcut key would not function properly after the 7th page.
 
Human Teams can now be changed in Original (AI) and Team Deathmatch (AI) modes.
The Maintain AI Player Team option allows humans to play on different teams.
 
Gun Deathmatch Weapon Fixes
Lv. 16 Newcomen removed
Lv. 20 Rock Breaker added
 
Studio Improvements
The maximum number of maps has been increased to 120.
Added the ability to send Background Music Blocks / BGM (Scen_S8E2_main, Scen_S8E3_boss., Scen_S8E4_boss).
Added a Ghost option to Player Settings and the ability to check Area Triggers while in Ghost mode.
New speed setting added (X5).
New Weapon Spawner weapons have been added. (M2, MP40, M1 Garand, M1918 BAR, and M1911 A1.)
A skip blocking feature has been added. When enabled this ensures that cutscenes cannot be accidentally skipped.
 
Added Class-Only Voice Blocking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/83266258269a2499bcb34024b8d05db9f9782a60.jpg
A Mute tab has been added to the far right of the chat window.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5e16aeacb77d71c11c7148a3278f0c305d553475.jpg
Pressing the Mute tab will display the Class-Only Voice Blocking window.
Checking the box to the left of the player list will mute that player's voice.
* AI is not displayed on the list.
* Pressing Block All Radio Voices will block all players on the list (excluding yourself).
* Any blocked players will have their voice muted by default.
* This setting only applies to a single session and is reset when you start a new game.

Option to Shorten Enhancement Cutscenes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/776d2296d090dc201786383ceef04c614119c211.jpg
A feature that shortens cutscenes which play after weapon enhancement has now been added.
Click on Shorten Enhancement Cutscene at the top of the Enhance button to turn this feature on. (Any changed settings will be saved until next login.)
 
Saved Night Vision Goggles Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/815b008a776ebaccc5df0b0240652e973e236473.jpg
The settings for Night Vision Goggles will be the same until the session ends. It will only be reset after logging in again or continuing on to the next session. (Zombie Evolution excluded.)
For example, playing a zombie will apply the Night Vision Goggle effect automatically, but turning the effect off will keep it that way even if you become a zombie on the next round.

AI Class Appearance and Weapon Improvements
Various costumes, weapons and AI Classes with equipped zombie skins have been added.


Added 9 New Medals and increased Honor Points

Back to Basics Medal

Received after clearing Zombie Scenario alone using regular weapons only

Received after clearing Zombie Scenario alone using Advanced weapons only

Received after clearing Zombie Scenario with two people using Advanced weapons only

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0df36fb5688b5f2a516a459d631099bfb8f2d92c.png
Received after clearing the Zombie Scenario alone using Rare weapons only

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/42f61c16793554a40b1f2e5322d3902dcb45b17a.png
Received after clearing the Zombie Scenario with two people using Rare weapons only

Keeping It Unique Medal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a10c9f812aedb808cdd799b5d8e4d2d8dbe3087e.png
Received after clearing the Zombie Scenario alone using Unique weapons only
