notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/87560bae09806d8a1fa86889e3d15c64fb3acd04.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

11 Minutes! 11 Points! 111 Kills! Event (11/15 - 11/29)Earn 11 points during the mission and play 11 minutes at a time to get great rewards! Enjoy a reward-packed November!

 Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (11/15 - 11/29)During this event, you can play the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! We've got newly-added popular weapons, epic weapons, and even epic edition weapons! Test your luck!

 Black Friday Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (11/15 - 11/29)To celebrate Black Friday, we are selling a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box with 20 Transcendence Weapons!

 Transcendence Weapon Photon Launcher Promotion (11/15 - 12/13)The Photon Launcher can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during the event.

 Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (11/15 - 12/13)Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Skadi and Nyx) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

---------- Details ----------

Event Information

11 Minutes! 11 Points! 111 Kills! Event (11/15 - 11/29)
Earn 11 points during the mission and play 11 minutes at a time to get great rewards! Enjoy a reward-packed November!

How to Participate
Daily Log-in: 2 points (once per day)
Every 11 minutes of playtime: 1 point (up to 3 points per day)
Every 8 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 1 point (up to 11 points per day).
Clear 1 session after scoring 111 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 2 points (up to 11 points per day)
Maximum Daily Points: 15

How to Earn Kill Points
Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
Human Infection as a Zombie: 4 Points (excluding bots)
Human Infection Assist as a Zombie: 0 Points

Cumulative Rewards

Background: A princess from another world transported to this world while looking for the frost flower. She was recruited alongside Nyx when they were found by the institute, freezing the first zombie she encountered. She is full of royal pride and is adapting to this world by speaking formally and trying to learn new customs. She is cooperating with the Aegis Institute to return to her original world. Wherever she treads freeze, regardless of the climate.

Passive: If engaging in Zombie Scenario with Nyx, critical rate increases (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). /  Add-On effect is applied by default.

In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

Nyx
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5e850dc2b20868dc61e2a2d525776a0501d04c70.png
Background: A dark elf shaman that serves Skadi who was transported to this world while seeking the frost flower. She was recruited because Skadi rushes into action, claiming that to do so is the obligation of royalty. She is satisfied with this world and its lack of class divides, and she dreams of sending Skadi back to their original world while remaining herself to enjoy the thrills of battle. She provided research support to the Kronos Institute to acquire emergency funds as well.
Zombie Scenario Skill: The Black Ark
Passive: If engaging in Zombie Scenario with Skadi, critical rate increases (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). /  Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: (Zombie Scenario) Provides special barrier effects to self and nearby allies / Increases attack power for the duration of the barrier effects for self and nearby allies.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes. This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Skadi and Nyx) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

Conditions and Rewards
Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Select one of Skadi + Sword Wings or Nyx + Moonlight Orb

Notice
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
Selecting Skadi will automatically provide Sword Wings (Permanent).
Selecting Nyx will automatically provide Moonlight Orb (Permanent).
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.

Season 17: Egypt (10/04 - 1/24)
For details, please refer to the Season 17 Pass Preview.

Black Market Opens Early
The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
New Items Added:

Season Pass Discount Coupon
Description: This is a coupon that reduces the purchase price of the next Season Pass. The Discount Coupon is given to those who have reached Season Pass Rank 100.
* Logging in during the following season will automatically redeem the coupon.
    (For example, if you receive the Discount Coupon during Season 17, it will reduce the price of the Season 18 Pass.)
* If you do not log in during the following season, however, the coupon will be automatically removed.
    (For example, if you received the coupon in Season 17 but didn't log in during Season 18, the discount will not be applied if you returned during Season 19.)

Repurchasing Previous Season Passes
A page where previous season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.
Available Previous Season Passes: Seasons 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15
The Black Market can be accessed via the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.

Survivors of the Aegis Institute received intel that Super Soldiers and Kronos were meeting up and decided they must surprise them with an ambush. Instead, after arriving at the rendezvous point, the team gets surrounded by a horde of enemies.

New Part Information
Bomb Boost Part - Grades 1 - 6
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84c7cd73672726356318bfadd5bc16939e88e38d.png
Type: Part
Content: A part that can be equipped on the bomb to enhance its performance.

She tells them about Kronos' secret laboratory and suggests that if they help her destroy it, she will consider joining them. David Black requests Alin and Dominique help her destroy the lab and provides the coordinates. When Alin and Dominique arrive at the rendezvous point, Yuri is nowhere to be found. Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

Popped Balloons / Rewards
5: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10 + Season Badge x20
10: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + Season Badge x30
15: Unique Decoder x3+ 10,000 Mileage
25: Event Decoder x3 + Season Badge x50
35: Class Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage
50: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Season Badge x100

Notice
Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.
Each account can only receive rewards once.
Eligible Maps: Dust 2, Militia, Estate, Mouse Hole, Italy, Assault
Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
The player that delivers the last hit to a popped ad balloon will receive +10% EXP/Points.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


Ad Balloon Medal Event (8/9 - 9/6)
Become a stone-cold ad balloon killer! Pop 300 ad balloons to earn medals and more!

Conditions / Rewards
Receive [Honor] Killer B Medal + Transcendence Decoder x10 for scoring 300 Kills of the Ad Balloon (depending on the last hit).

Notice
Players who already possess the [Honor] Killer B medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
Only the player that delivers the final hit that pops the balloon will add it to their total kill count (for the purpose of this achievement).


Heat Wave Targets and Water Balloon Grenade Giveaway (8/9 - 8/23/2023)
Score zombie kills with the Water Balloon Grenade in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution to receive rewards
Water Balloon Grenade: 30% Damage + Knockback Probability

Kills / Rewards
1 Kill: 500 Mileage + Rare Decoder x3
3 Kills: Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days) + Rare Decoder x5 + Unique Decoder x1
5 Kills: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
6 Kills: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 + Unique Decoder x3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ef4d2fcc8e0fd5e4ff6080d584f5a67bc69dae2f.png
7 Kills: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + Event Decoder x3 + Great Vacation Nameplate (300 Days)

Notice
Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.
Each account can only receive rewards once.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Laboratory mode and excludes Studio Mode).
Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


August Holiday event (8/9 - 8/23
Log in during the event to receive rewards based on how many days you've logged in:

Rewards
Reach 2 days of total login: Rare Decoder x5
Reach 3 days of total login: Unique Decoder x5
Reach 6 days of total login: Class Decoder x3
Reach 7 days of total login: Event Decoder x5
Reach 9 days of total login: Event Decoder x10
Reach 10 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x3
Reach 11 days of total login: Class Decoder x5
Reach 12 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x5

Notice
Each account can only receive rewards once.
You will receive your rewards each time you log in.


Shop Update

Transcendence Class Promotion (8/9 - 9/6)
Two Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Immortal Eric
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2be6331296434b42ea9734483d7dee4da00e8535.png
Background story: After a near-death experience during a zombie attack, his wounds healed up and he returned with an incredible new power. As his superhuman self-recovery rate and physical strength granted him with the resources to compete with the zombies, he willingly fought the undead on the front lines to help others. Fitting his nickname, Immortal, he returns alive every time there is a rumor that he had died. It is known that he is not part of any organizations or groups, but that he does work with Smile Mary.
Paired Weapon: Death Eater
Paired Effect: Special Attack ammo recharge rate increase
Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
Area duration skill
(Zombie Scenario) Passive: Passively restores HP and increases Defense
(Zombie Scenario) Active: Maximizes the HP recovery and Defense increase effects on self and nearby allies
Connection buff skill
(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Smile Mary grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
Add-On Feature
(Zombie Scenario)  Add-On effect is applied by default, and stacking it will increase only the 10% Decreased Damage effect


Smile Mary
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edcdb8f9cb80746aaf8bd54550a8382e0bc69667.png
Background story: As the zombie invasion brought dangers to the everyday lives of the people, some of the general public began to awaken their special abilities. Mary is one of those, having the ability to control the aggression of zombies through psychokinesis, amplify the powers of allies, and control minds. Nobody approaches her as it is said that she could even read the minds of others, but there is a rumor that she sticks with Immortal Eric, another psychic.
Paired Weapon: Death Eater
Paired Effect: Special Attack max ammo increase
Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
Area duration skill
Passive: (Zombie Scenario) When you and your nearby allies are hit, this grants a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby
Active: (Zombie Scenario) Maximizes the effects that grant a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby upon hit
Connection buff skill
(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Immortal Eric grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
Add-On Feature
(Zombie Scenario)  Add-on effect is applied by default, and using the identical Add-on will stack.


New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)
Get guaranteed 2 Transcendence Classes (Immortal Eric and Smile Mary) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

Conditions and Rewards
Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Select one from Immortal Eric + Eric's Hero Helmet or Smile Mary + Mary's Cube

Notice
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
Selecting Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
Selecting Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.


Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Death Eater (8/9 - 9/6)
Death Eater will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

Death Eater Drop Rate
Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%

Death Eater
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/638ee27eb3869435758bd358c74c2de383b17d0c.png
Description: A shotgun developed with alien technology that can hit nearby targets simultaneously with its basic attacks. Its special attack, Hyper Beam, deals damage to enemies in front of the wielder.


Death Eater Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Death Eater permanently!

Reward Thresholds
Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points

Notice
6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
1 Guaranteed Point every time you use 1 Class Decoder.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 26th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e9a0c33d6a80b85a074cd0318c75afdadaee77be.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

 New Epic Secondary Weapon 'Gravity Repulsor' Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)The new Epic Secondary Weapon, Gravity Repulsor, will drop from Epic Decoders during the event.

 Resonance Energy Collection Event (7/26 - 9/6)Gather Resonance Energy from Epic Decoders and complete missions to earn more items!

 DESERT Weapon Giveaway (7/26 - 8/23)5 Original weapons reimagined with the DESERT concept! Don't miss the opportunity to obtain these new classic weapons by just playing the game!

 Epic Decoder Special Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)Epic Decoder chain purchases with increasing discounts are available during the event!

---------- Details ----------

Improvements

Human HP Recovery Skill ON / OFF (Zombie Hero / Zombie Z Laboratory)
Fixed it so the Human HP Recovery skill is OFF when the Fire Bomb is not used (or whenever Fire Bomb is not used in Zombie Z mode).           


New Events

New Epic Secondary Weapon 'Gravity Repulsor' Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)
The new Epic Secondary Weapon, Gravity Repulsor, will drop from Epic Decoders during the event.

Epic Decoder
Obtainable Items: Gravity Repulsor + Gravity Repulsor Nameplate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1c0837c7acc7d39ccfc66c5a71744f9bacfb081b.png
Drop Rate: 0.35%

Gravity Repulsor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5fdb1ba9298b49ed2c8a8f951887771175d1b7d7.png
A weapon created with anti-gravity technology. Fires anti-gravity rounds to inflict damage over an area and sends out pulses around the player to protect them. You can also automatically charge the anti-gravity energy to leap and hover in air, and rapidly descend and inflict damage.

Gravity Repulsor Nameplate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/11b0854ab364384b17554848d87aa3be7dd7ac1e.png
 An exclusive nameplate created to celebrate the release of the 2023 Epic weapon, Gravity Repulsor. This customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.

Resonance Energy Box
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9295bd0c03b99e75c8452137fb7aaddcbe8a419f.png
You have a chance to obtain 3 - 100 Resonance Energy by using a Resonance Energy Box.

Notice
The Gravity Repulsor Nameplate is acquired upon obtaining a Gravity Repulsor.
You will receive 1 Resonance Energy Box for each Epic Decoder used.
You have a chance to obtain 3 – 100 Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Energy Box.
All unused Epic Decoders will be removed and replaced with 100 Mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
Unused Resonance Energy will be removed and replaced with 15 Mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
All unused Black Rabbit's Galaxy Boxes will be removed and replaced with 30 mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
Enhanced weapons and weapons with parts attached that are obtained from Epic Decoders have their durations stacked with already owned weapons (with the same enhancement/parts).

Resonance Energy Collection Event (7/26 - 9/6)
Gather Resonance Energy from Epic Decoders and complete missions to earn more items!

How to Obtain Resonance Energy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/697699813ed95d5bda6d32976fcd11b768c83ac2.png
Score 6 Kill Points with Kills, Assists, or Human Infections (excluding bots) in Zombie mode: Resonance Energy x1 (up to 20 per day)
Clear Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points: Resonance Energy x3 (up to 25 per day)
Reach 60 minutes of playtime in any mode: Resonance Energy x15 (up to 15 per day)
You have a chance to obtain 3 – 100 Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Energy Box.

Notice
How to Get Zombie Mode Kill Points: Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots) / Zombie Kill Assist as a Human: 1 Point/ Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)/ Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points
You can only obtain up to 30 Resonance Energy per day per account (excludes Resonance Energy obtained from Epic Decoders).
The Resonance Energy Shop has a wide and exciting selection of items available for purchase with Resonance Energy. Resonance Energy will be deducted upon a purchase, but don't forget that you'll get bonus fragments with each item!
Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).


Resonance Energy Shop Opening (7/26 – 9/6)
You can purchase new Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other various items with Resonance Energy that you've acquired from Epic Decoders and completing missions.

M3 Azhi Dahaka
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c3cba7cd51b7ac8cf92fc8d84f6613aeef396ca.png
 A shotgun imbued with the soul of a demonic dragon. Its basic attack is accompanied by dragon breath, which can be used to unleash a  on a marked target, and , which summons the dragon to fight alongside you.

Repulsor Wing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cd0ff66da39e7e17460846b1906e6e669621d807.png
Wings created using gravity panels. Can be equipped in the back slot.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 12th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/48ff6c0adc8c9a100c0b0c1b19f0c2ee346f51cb.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Daily Play Event (7/12 - 8/9)Log-in now to collect event pieces and find out how powerful the new Demolition Hammer is for yourself!

Demolition Core Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)Participate in special missions to collect Demolition Cores.

Super Soldier Landing Event (7/12 - 7/26)Check out the Expert system and the SVP in Super Soldier Mode today!

Al-Hijra Holiday Event (7/12 - 7/26)Complete the mission during the event to earn rewards.

Bonus Disassembly Event (7/12 – 7/26)You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

New contents

Super Soldier Mode Update Information
 Experience superior combat like never before!
 For more information, please refer to the [Super Soldier Mode Preview].

Super Soldier Mode Guide
A PVP mode based on Team Deathmatch where humans compete against each other.
Super Soldier players have powerful specs such as High HP and DEF, plus a double jump! Enhanced physical abilities and addition of skills make them formidable in any battle.
Play strategically with the 4 experts: Fighter, Defender, Brawler, and Sniper.
Each expert has specific skills.
You can set hotkeys for each Expert through the Option / Skill Bar Settings.
Collecting the S.V.P. Supply Box during the game will significantly enhance your Attack Power and Movement Speed.
Player specs will be changed based on the Weapon Restriction Options.


Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Update Information

Fire Bomb Options (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
You can now turn on/off the use of Fire Bombs in Room Settings.
Room Settings > Advanced Options
 (Fire Bomb will be 'on' when Zombie Restriction > Normal Zombies Only is selected)

Option added to restrict the amount of Zombie Z Mutations (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
An option that limits the number of Mutations obtained in Zombie Z.
Select 20, 25, 30, 35, or 40 in the drop-down menu in Room Settings.
Selecting 20 will allow you to acquire a maximum of 20 Mutations. You cannot collect any more after reaching 20.
 (This amount does not include mutations increased by Class, etc.)

Added option for Mutation Restriction (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
This is an option that removes up to 4 selected Mutations in Zombie Z.
You cannot remove Mutations that are automatically provided at certain levels.

Damage from the end of Fire Bomb ending has been adjusted (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
Damage from the end of Fire Bomb has been adjusted.

The projectile angle of Fire Bomb has been adjusted (Zombie Hero)
The projectile angle of Fire Bomb has been adjusted.


New Zombie Scenario Medals
Two New Zombie Scenario Medals have been added.
Period: 7/12 after maintenance - Permanent

Grim Reaper
Private Medal  has been added.

Treasure Trove
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5df40abd2c1e1f266389ee7c592474e0117808f4.png
Condition: Acquire 1 million points in Zombie Scenario drop box to obtain medals.


Improvements
Added a feature that asks for changes upon receiving a new Nameplate.
Added Weapon/Enhancement/Part/Paint information to .
Added a feature that displays what restrictions are in place by hovering your cursor over the  in the lobby.


New Events

Daily Play Event (7/12 - 8/9)
Log-in now to collect event pieces and find out how powerful the new Demolition Hammer is for yourself!

How to Participate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/255b5cd8754c928cee94d0f11c30f38a8c4bb9dc.png
Reach 30 minutes of play to obtain a Demolition Core (up to a maximum of 60 during the event)

Cumulative Login Reward
Day 1: Demolition Core, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x1 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon
Day 2: Demolition Core, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x1 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon
Day 3: Demolition Core x2, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x2 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x2
Day 4: Demolition Core x2, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x2 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x2

Day 8: Demolition Core x6, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x4 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4
Day 9: Demolition Core x8, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x5 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4

Demolition Cores stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Overages don't accumulate)
All remaining Demolition Cores will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.


Demolition Core Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)
Participate in special missions to collect Demolition Cores.

How to Participate
Earn 4 Demolition Cores by playing 10 minutes in Super Soldier Mode (up to 4 per day).
Earn 1 Demolition Core for every 8 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 16 per day).
Earn 2 Demolition Cores for every 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 16 per day).
* You can acquire up to 20 Demolition Cores per day through special mission rewards.

How to Earn Kill Points
Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points
Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points

Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos

Demolition Hammer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0b19d9160ec733804c2d0aa532d83fa7e34152b6.png
A melee weapon created using technology from the Aegis Institute. It is a heavy two-handed hammer, that is massive and imposing when held. Charging its gauge unleashes a powerful downward strike attack, and a follow up with its steel handle.

Notice

Find the Zombie Event(6/28- 7/12)
You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

How to Participate
Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
Among a group of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans), find and hit the zombies using the right bullets.
Get these bullets from the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway.
Hitting a zombie will increase your reward by 1 and allow you to take an additional shot. Hitting a human will decrease your reward by 1 and reset the Find the Zombie in progress.
The reward grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit enough zombies in a row, and you can claim the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
Click "Automatic Fire" to quickly proceed through one game.

What is "Automatic Fire"?
Proceed by randomly firing in a game.
You must have more than 1 bullet to continue.
If you are in the Claim Reward state, you must claim your reward to use this feature.

The Mileage Auction will take place to celebrate Eid al-Adha! Auctions are available for a limited time only, so don't miss out!

Auction Feature / Content
Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.

Notice
The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a23d63be942bcd8ecec76d3f41ddfca1e9da5838.jpg

Greetings Survivors!

In the April 19 announcement, we announced the beginning of another Studio Map Contest. 
It’s time to let your voices be heard and help us pick the winners! The winners will be selected based on 50% player votes and 50% on CSNS Team’s internal score.

Go Vote! <----- Click!
Original Event Post
Voting Period: 23/6/15 - 23/6/28 (All voting participants will receive 1,000 Mileage)
 Winner Announcement & Reward Distribution Date: 23/7/12
Thank you always for your love and support for CSNS.

- The CSNS Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 14th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d7c869f932500fb300e8a847bc11ef43272975e5.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Season 16: Alice in Wonderland (06/14 - 10/04)For details, please refer to the Season 16 Pass Preview.

Welcome Back Summer Event (06/14 – 06/28)Have some fun on the hot sand with the new Beach Ball!

Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (06/14 - 10/04)Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during Season 16.

New Transcendence Class Promotion (6/14- 7/12)Two new Transcendence Classes, Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

Content Guide

New Map Information
Breezeway
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e54854add92ef5f4b661dd2cc9e665473c4a8147.png
Woods Near the Wind Farm
Eligible Modes: Team Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch (AI), Deathmatch, Deathmatch (AI), Gun Deathmatch, Zombie, Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Darkness, and All-Star

Zombie Mode Changes
For details, please refer to the [Laboratory Revamp Preview]

Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z / Zombie Hero)
The projectile arc of the Fire Bomb has been adjusted.
Karma System Revamp
Zombie Skill Revamp

Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z)
Fire Bomb is now available to use starting in round 3.

Season 16: Alice in Wonderland (06/14 - 10/04)
For details, please refer to the Season 16 Pass Preview.

Black Market Opens Early
The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
New Item Added: CSO Handheld, Ancient Keeper (Parts Applied), Ancient Berserker (Parts Applied), Ancient Bringer (Parts Applied)
CSO Handheld
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6a7b23fd47ec216cf6b96678dce43d90b24ba0c0.png


Season Pass Discount Coupon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/063234730f3ccc17520c126a330bbf5b7f49e4ea.png
Description: This is a coupon that reduces the purchase price of the next Season Pass. The Discount Coupon is given to those who have reached Season Pass Rank 100.
Logging in during the following season will automatically redeem the coupon.
 (For example, if you receive the Discount Coupon during Season 16, it will reduce the price of the Season 17 Pass.)
If you do not log in during the following season, however, the coupon will be automatically removed.
 (For example, if you received the coupon in Season 16 but didn't log in during Season 17, the discount will not be applied if you returned during Season 18.)

Repurchasing Previous Season Passes
A page where previous season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.
Available Previous Season Passes: Seasons 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, and 14
The Black Market can be accessed via the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.
All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear once a new season begins.

Season Reward Weapons
Queen's SL8 (Primary Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/968120de901bc3717042b193b8495903cbfca92f.png
This sniper rifle, which fires 20 rounds of 5.56mm ammo, has been designed to overpower the opponent with its rapid rate of fire.

Queen's Special Duck Foot Gun (Secondary Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc6a906c3dc261dfe16263fed9c8aac2ef51baf8.png
This modified version of the English-made duck foot pistol utilizes four 12-gauge shells. With four rounds available per clip, it's sure to keep your enemies at bay.

Queen's Tomahawk (Melee Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9807cd3456b07cd30de262229c1b25b8a83b2f44.png
A battle axe provided to special force members. While it is a bit slow, it can deal lethal attacks against the enemy. You can push back oncoming Zombies using its alt attack in PvP Zombie and Zombie Scenario Modes.

AUG Guardians (Primary Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/01d745cd27b5d55f171d06816ec47f24c85722ef.png
An assault rifle using 50 rounds of .50 caliber special ammo, inflicting critical damage on zombies with high accuracy. Normal attacks charge special rounds, which can be used for special attacks by right-clicking.

Zombie Costumes
Queen of Hearts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/823908b6812dd751b2037742d9daf18a230e4094.png
Able to use Queen of Hearts Zombie. This will change the appearance of your Banshee Zombie.

Weapon Paints
Card Guard Weapon Paint
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/85f8cea68215f5e19dfafbe5a3c88a457e3aed30.png
Eligible Weapons: OICW / Burning AUG / VULCANUS-9 / FG Launcher / Cyclops

Costumes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6bf7752b19dcd5212fda78dc86569713d1886fb6.png
Alice Spray
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/013448112003459f0622e88d0dd31a2ccbee26c3.png


Nameplate
Season Pass Nameplate (16)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c6ff59a86c6f8d9579ecfdfd17e3295230344e61.png


Damage Font

Medal

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b7b1855c5301673fe701f24c4b55490386e0c835.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a5a25571f7c7572a69dbef393d7a3ff261eb6819.png


League Season 12 (6/14 - 9/20)
Notice
Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
New Items Added: CSO Pattern Nameplate, Military Nameplate, What are you up to, Heavy Zombie? Nameplate, CSO Congratulations Nameplate

Game Improvements
The new 'Pet' costume slot has been created.
The old 'Arm' costume slot has been now changed to Pet.
A new fix has been implemented so that kicked players can no longer re-enter matches.
 Weapon Enhancement/Parts/Paint information has been added
Fixed remaining event reward Season Badges after reaching Season 100 so that they will be converted to Black Market Badges.


Event Information

Welcome Back Summer Event (06/14 – 06/28)
Have some fun on the hot sand with the new Beach Ball!

How to Participate
Earn 5 Beach Balls by reaching 10 minutes of playtime (up to 20 per day).
Earn 2 Beach Balls each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 Beach Balls per day, excludes bots).
Earn 5 Beach Balls each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 Beach Balls per day).

Beach Ball Pileup Rewards
50 Beach Balls: Rare Decoder x3
100 Beach Balls: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
150 Beach Balls: Unique Decoder x5 + Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x5
250 Beach Balls: Event Decoder x5 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
350 Beach Balls: Sparkling Shores Nameplate (300 Days) + Class Decoder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5719b030c6f0f92bd657ed19c5c3e50792b69f1b.png
400 Beach Balls: Class Decoder + Event Decoder x8
450 Beach Balls: Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days) + Class Decoder x2
550 Beach Balls: Class Decoder x5
600 Beach Balls: Premium Class Decoder x2 + Class Decoder x3
650 Beach Balls: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5

Notice
You can obtain up to 50 Beach Balls a day per account.
Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
Aside from the playtime missions, studio mode is excluded from the eligibility to complete all other in-game missions.
Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
All remaining Beach Balls will be removed during maintenance on 6/28.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (06/14 - 10/04)
Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during Season 16.

Kill Count / Obtainable Items
1x - You can select 1 from the list: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Class Selection Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x5 / 2,000 Mileage
2x - You can select 1 from the list: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Class Selection Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x5 / 2,000 Mileage
3x - You can select 1 from the list: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Class Selection Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x5 / 2,000 Mileage
5x - You can select 1 from the list: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Class Selection Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x5 / 2,000 Mileage
7x - You can select 1 from the list: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Class Selection Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x5 / 2,000 Mileage
10x - You can select 1 from the list: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Class Selection Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x5 / 2,000 Mileage

Transcendence Weapon Selection Box Contents (Permanent/Bound)
M4A1 Dark Knight
AK-47 Paladin
Warhammer Storm Giant
Magnum Drill
Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter
SG552 Lycanthrope
Blade Runebreaker
Red Dragon Cannon

Select 1

Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box Contents (Permanent/Bound)
Sonya Lycanthrope
Transcendence Blair
Transcendence Michaela
Transcendence Yuri
Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi
Elizabeth Crimson Hunter
Dorothy Dark Knight

Select 1

Notice
Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box Contents: 20 of Reinforced Attack, Extended Magazine, Tide Turner, Shadow Blade, Survival Instincts, Explosive Ammo, Free Market, Weakness Analysis, Titan's Will, Regeneration, Swiftfoot, and Capital Add-Ons.
Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.
Each reward is given only once per account.
Up to 3 can be defeated per day.
Transcendence Weapon Selection Box and Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box's reward items are bound items.
Unused Guaranteed Transcendence Class Boxes and Transcendence Weapon Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 10/4.
The Golden Zombies have a chance to appear when playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms on Normal difficulty or higher.
Bound items cannot be used as Auction, Disassembly, or Family Storage items.


Login Supplies Event Guide (06/14 - 07/11 11: 59: 59)
Login Reward
Daily Weapons Supply
Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) & Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
3 types all provided + 2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).

Cumulative Rewards
5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
15 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
25 Days: Heaven Splitter (5 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)

Notice
Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.


Shop Update

New Transcendence Class Promotion (6/14- 7/12)
Two new Transcendence Classes, Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Blue Rabbit Mirage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/263189e99fa7dd2cce0a994c27f41b751a0a4a58.png
Description: A famous virtual streamer on the VR platform Chrono World that enjoys streaming and chatting with fans in a cute outfit, but is actually a skilled hacker. She projects a lively persona online, but is shy and timid offline. She stumbled upon and discovered suspicious records on Chrono World. Mirage is trying to escape enemies targeting her for the information, and trying to get in contact with the Aegis Institute.
Paired Weapon: Magnum Launcher
Obtain special rounds every time you left-click fire a certain amount of times.
Using the right-click increases the amount of special rounds that are fired.
A direct hit with this special round does increased damage in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.
Zombie Scenario Skill: Saber Protocol
Passive: Critical Rate and Movement Speed is increased if playing Zombie Scenario with Alpaca Anemone.
(Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
Applies the Addict Add-On Effect (This can be stacked, which increases the effect).
Active: Applies Invincible to self and nearby allies for a certain amount of time in Zombie Scenario mode.
Steals a portion of the damage you inflict while Invincible for yourself.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

Alpaca Anemone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7e1bbfa83846854dfe8be920105e28c775f38967.png
Description: Anemone, a pro gamer on the VR platform Chrono World, is renowned in the world of competitive gaming for her skill. Unlike her older twin sister Mirage, she's both strong and sociable. She accompanies Mirage to protect her as her guardian, as Mirage learned that the developer behind Chrono World is acting on a suspicious conspiracy.
Paired Weapon: Magnum Launcher
Using the right-click will fire special rounds in 3 rows.
Damage of a direct hit with Special Ammo is increased, but Explosion Damage is reduced in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes
Zombie Scenario Skill: Valorous Energy
Passive: Critical Rate and Movement Speed is increased if playing Zombie Scenario with Blue Rabbit Mirage.
(Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
Applies the Free Market Add-On Effect (This can be stacked, which increases the effect).
Active: Applies a barrier to self and nearby allies for a certain amount of time.
Your attack power will be increased for a certain amount of time (Increased significantly at first, but reduces as time passes).
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.


New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (6/14 - 7/12)
Get two new Transcendence Classes (Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!

Conditions and Rewards
Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Select either: Blue Rabbit Mirage + Giant Carrot or Alpaca Anemone + Alpaca Keyring 

Notice
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
Selecting Blue Rabbit Mirage will automatically provide Giant Carrot (Permanent).
Selecting Alpaca Anemone will automatically provide Alpaca Keyring (Permanent).
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted once per account.


New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (6/14 – Permanent)
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

Conditions and Items
Collect Blue Rabbit Mirage, Alpaca Anemone, Giant Carrot, and the Alpaca Keyring.
Giant Carrot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fb02c5afcc88033f1e206156801f12ad4542f424.png
Alpaca Keyring
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a18c5736836e187314b30c0a82e80c4c6de8e20c.png


CUTY Twins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9562b4ace4c4e72adb51c1afdd3b16484fec685f.png
Honor Points: 10
The CUTY Twins don't have an event time limit and can be obtained after the 6/14 (Wed) maintenance.
This medal can be obtained once per account.



Other Information

[olist]Karma can no longer be obtained when a zombie dies from Self-Destruct.
Fixed an issue where Class Auction premium lowest price listings could not be searched by exploration level.
Updated so the newest weapons can no longer be used in Studio 1-player Creation Mode.
Fixed an issue where the special gauge wouldn't charge until you picked up the Twin Shadow Axes when the Automatically Swaps to Obtained Weapon was enabled under Advanced Options.
Fixed an issue where the Tyrant's Mace's Glacial Impact audio would play regardless of distance.
Clicking the closed Exploration slot will now open the Mileage Shop.
Fixed an issue where using the Laser Storm's Laser Spear would have a small chance to cause the player to be moved to the waiting room in certain situations.
Selecting a random map will no longer select the Laboratory map.
Fixed an issue where using the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer in Knife Match would not let you attack, after an initial attack.
Fixed an issue where effects from skills used in Zombie Scenario as Smile Mary or Immortal Eric would be displayed in unusual locations.
Fixed an issue in Studio mode where dying or moving onto the next round would cause the screen to display abnormally when the cutscene block is active.
Fixed an issue where installing a C4 in Original: Bomb map would cause it to be displayed through objects.
Fixed an issue where using the Petrol Boomer or Flame Grenade would cause the flame to remain and continue to inflict damage on humans even after the player became a zombie.
Fixed an issue where the client would crash after entering the in-game in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where the Elegant Double-Barreled Shotgun skin would display as the Double-Barreled Shotgun in the game. 
Updated the Holy Water Grenade and Silver Medal Luger to Advanced grade.
Fixed an issue where the NEGEV NG-7 Ajax's light reflections were not being applied.
Fixed an issue where the NEGEV NG-7 Ajax's standby animation was displaying incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where X-TRACKER and AWP shop values were listed incorrectly.[/olist]

notes.title: [Complete] Regular Maintenance: June 14th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9cb5778993db56529d92cc47da45330f536ed525.jpg

2023-6-14 9:30 A.M. CEST Update:
The regular maintenance for June 14th has been completed. Thank you for your patience throughout.
----------------------------------------------

Attention Survivors,

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 19th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/997497190ded4168500e7616318e553ca171422c.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

The Stars of the Cosmos Event (4/19 - 5/3)Collect the stars of the night sky to claim your rewards!

Eid Celebration Event (4/19 - 5/3)Wishing you a pleasant and happy holidays! We are celebrating Eid with a new event.

1,000 Mileage Auction Event (04/19 - 05/02 23 : 59 : 59)During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.

Divine Blaster/Doom Blaster Promotion (4/19 - 5/17)During the promotion, Divine Blaster and Doom Blaster will make a special appearance in Epic Decoders!

Blaster Blueprint Promotion (4/19 – 5/17)You can purchase the Divine Blaster blueprint during the promotion.

Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (4/19 – 5/17)Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

New Content

Zombie Z Laboratory Release and Other Changes
Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z)
Zombie Z Laboratory mode has been added for pre-release game testing.
Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z) Italy map has been added.
Daily Mission/Weekly Mission/Honor Mission Player Count Adjustment
The minimum number of players required to clear the mission has been reduced from 4 to 3.
Ban List Cap Increase
The cap for the ban list has been increased from 200 to 250.
The text regarding the end of the permanent event has now been changed.


Studio Mode Update
Studio Sample New Map Release! A new map showcasing the new decorations and devices in all their glory, "Yuri's Secret Aquarium" is getting released.
Studio New Block Update
A variety of new devices, characters, and decoration blocks have been updated. (7 basic and 49 decorative types)
You can view the new blocks via Creation Mode without adding a separate theme pack.


Event Information

The Stars of the Cosmos Event (4/19 - 5/3)
Collect the stars of the night sky to claim your rewards!
How to Participate (Conditions and Rewards)
Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 points per day, excludes bots).
Earn 5 points each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 points per day).
Earn 1 point for each round you use Fire Bomb in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z mode (up to 5 points per day).
Earn 1 point each time you reach 5 minutes of playtime (up to 10 points per day).
Earn 2 points each time you log in (once a day).
Starlight Box Contents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c945add7f1d2722090bcf50a84e157a3aaa01463.png
* Accumulate 50 points to earn 1 Starlight Box.
(You will have a chance to receive one of these items)
Dragon Knight Kyrix (Permanent/15 Days)

Anemone (Permanent/15 Days)
Mirage (Permanent/15 Days)

Transcendence Decoder x3
Unique Decoder x5

200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
3,000 Mileage
Grade 5 Parts Reward Box
Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x3
Random -1 Dehancement Material x3
1,000 Mileage
Rare Decoder x5
Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x2
Starlight Box Pileup Reward
1 Box: Rare Decoder x3
3 Boxes: Unique Decoder x3 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
5 Boxes: Run Zombie Run 1 (Permanent) + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/85785b1cf68861c9d9cc77f22f538ef55f60573a.png
7 Boxes: Feast of the Night Sky Nameplate (300 Days) + Event Decoder x5
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5a051b88bda47125e06c3ed4de4c359ff25405d2.png
9 Boxes: Run Zombie Run 2 (Permanent) + Class Decoder x5
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/06882c369842a3ad15172591d8617d5f0ab9eac1.png
12 Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Class Decoder x3
13 Boxes: Season Badge x100
14 Boxes: Season Badge x100
Notice
Each account can obtain up to 50 play points per day.
Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
Aside from the playtime missions, studio mode is excluded from the eligibility to complete all other in-game missions.
Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
All unused Starlight Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 5/3.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


Eid Celebration Event (4/19 - 5/3)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/45b96eb11427988087ffa85d8474d88ba7587840.jpg
Wishing you a pleasant and happy Eid! We are celebrating Eid with a new event.
How to Participate 
Earn 1 point for each log in (up to 1 point per day)
Earn 2 points + Event Decoder every time you reach 30 minutes of playtime (up to once a day)
Total Points and Rewards
3 Points: Rare Decoder x10 + Event Decoder

No mode restrictions

Can participate in Laboratory Mode
Player Requirement: 3 


Lebaran Celebration Mileage Auction (04/19 - 05/02 23: 59: 59)
Mileage Auction will take place to celebrate Lebaran! Auctions are available for a limited time only so don't miss out!
Auction Feature / Content
Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.
Notice
The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.


1,000 Mileage Auction Event (04/19 - 05/02 23: 59: 59)

Time / Special Items
CEST (GMT +1) 16:00 - 17:00 Failnaught, Devastator, Satellite Mine, and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose
CEST (GMT +1) 20:00 - 21:00 Failnaught, Devastator, Satellite Mine, and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose

Notice
1,000-Mileage auction items will appear periodically during auction hours.

Claim rewards by clicking Obtain after winning.


Login Supplies Event Guide (4/19 – 5/17)
Login Reward
Daily Weapons Supply
Both Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) and M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) provided + one of the Transcendence Enhancement or Part equipped Unique weapon (1 Day) randomly provided + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
1 out of the following Transcendence Classes will be provided at a set chance (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
Cumulative Rewards
5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
15 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
Notice
Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.


Shop Update

Divine Blaster/Doom Blaster Promotion (4/19 - 5/17)
During the promotion, Divine Blaster and Doom Blaster will make a special appearance in Epic Decoders!
Weapon Rates
Divine Blaster: 0.175%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/226dcae438fd592152c8d1d5bda41f638ef61b16.png
Description: A weapon of the heavens, made with unknown technology. Allows the wielder to fire 50 scatter-shot rounds, summon Purifying Wings to burn enemies who approach, and draw energy from the wings to blast foes with Purifying Light.
Doom Blaster: 0.175%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1a3a7bf83e1d572446c481e88e9470f2420a1475.png
Description: A demonic weapon, forged in the depths of hell. Allows the wielder to fire 60 scatter-shot rounds, summon the Wings of Doom to burn any enemies who approach, and draw energy to blast foes with the Doomsday Strike.


Divine Blaster/Doom Blaster Guaranteed Giveaway (4/19 – 5/17)
Get Guaranteed Points when you use Epic Decoders during the promotion!
Conditions and Rewards
Each time you reach 300 points, you can choose 1 of the following weapons:
Divine Blaster / Doom Blaster / Negev NG-7 Ajax / Spell Lance Scarlet Rose / Lightning Fury / Psychic Harmonium
Notice
You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Epic Decoder.
A reward can be obtained every 300 points. Meaning that you can select 1 weapon at 300 points, 600 points, 900 points, and so on.
All unused Epic Decoders will be replaced with 100 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on 5/17 (Wed).

Divine Blaster / Doom Blaster Crafting Event (4/19 – 5/17)
You can obtain the Divine Blaster or Doom Blaster if you purchase the Blaster blueprint while you own the Doom Blaster or Divine Blaster during the event.
How to Craft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b9a54eff7cadf5a1d80a78346fc61f13597770a3.png
Divine Blaster (Permanent) can be obtained by pressing [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while both the Doom Blaster (Permanent) and the Blaster blueprint are in your inventory.
Doom Blaster (Permanent) can be obtained by pressing [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while both the Divine Blaster (Permanent) and the Blaster blueprint are in your inventory.
Press [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while the Doom Blaster (Permanent), the Divine Blaster (Permanent), and the Blaster blueprint are all present in your inventory to select and claim either the Doom Blaster (Permanent) or the Divine Blaster (Permanent).
Notice
Completing [Use] of the Blaster blueprint will remove the Blaster blueprint from your inventory.
You have to press [Use] on the Blaster blueprint after the purchase to craft it into Divine Blaster (Permanent) or Doom Blaster (Permanent)
It can only be crafted once per account.
If you have not used the Blaster blueprint during the event, they will be used automatically on the 5/17 (Wed) maintenance (Conditions to obtain and rewards are same as the above)


Blaster Blueprint Promotion (4/19 – 5/17)
You can purchase the Divine Blaster blueprint during the promotion.
Notice
The Blaster blueprint can only be purchased by those who own the Doom Blaster (Permanent) or Divine Blaster (Permanent).
It can only be purchased once per account.


Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (4/19 – 5/17)
Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!
Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Drop Rate
Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%
Satellite Mine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e454a78f866aaa8452bc3acdbe3f8534623333e0.png
Description: A special mine armed with cutting-edge satellite technology. It can either seek nearby enemies on its own or be manually detonated. When activated, it creates a zone that hinders enemy movement, then calls down a laser bombardment that only harms enemies after a short delay.
Laevateinn
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3651be67321ae24dfe290155a1477b568473cbf.png
A pistol that holds 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target. When you fire beyond a certain number of rounds, a special feature becomes available.
Special Feature : Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 25% removes the Slow debuff on self, deals a set amount of damage to enemies approaching the area, and pushes them back.
Special Feature : Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 100% removes the Slow debuff on self, disables the attacks/skills/movement of enemies within the area, and pushes them back. A set portion of the damage dealt is restored as HP. (Attack/skill/movement disabling and AoE HP leeching features do not work in certain modes).


Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Guaranteed Giveaway (4/19 – 5/17)
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Satellite Mine/Laevateinn permanently!
Reward Thresholds
Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points
Notice
6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.
All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be replaced with 500 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on 5/17 (Wed).

Other Changes

[olist]Hardware Acceleration function's default value has been set to On.
The existing VVIP Free Pass and VIP Free Pass names, appearance, and descriptions have been adjusted.
Class Pass, a new Diamond rank reward, has been added.
Fixed an issue where an abnormal texture would display after reloading the Heaven Splitter.
Fixed an issue where equipping the UTS-15 Pink Gold would misalign the hand placement in 3rd Person POV. 
Fixed an issue where shooting with the M4A1 Scope would display the flame from the barrel's cover.
Fixed an issue where Pyromaniac Yuri and Special Agent Mei would look awkward while holding certain weapons. 
Fixed the tattoo tooltip on the Encyclopedia to now display the related image. 
Fixed an issue where the Arbalest's normal attacks would not properly display the effects in certain situations. 
Fixed an issue where the reward pop-up window would not display the "Bound" text for bound items.
Fixed an issue where the BGM would not play on the game result screen after ending a session. 
Fixed an issue where certain accounts could not get the BGM to play when they'd run the client. 
Fixed an issue where the AS50 and AS50 Pink Gold's accuracy values after enhancement were incorrectly set.
Fixed an issue where you were able to report yourself in the lobby.
Fixed an issue where the challenge mode would not supply the basic knife.
Fixed an issue where the Divine Blaster and JANUS-11's shop values were not being displayed properly. 
Fixed an issue where Morale Boost values were being displayed incorrectly depending on the time you acquired the Fanatic mutation.
Fixed an issue where using the right-click attack of the Dual Beretta Gunslinger as Pyromaniac Yuri would make the damage decrease depending on range. 
Fixed an issue where the Whip Sword's Special Feature was getting utilized for unusual gameplay tactics. 
Fixed an map spawn error issue in Zombie Scenario Pursuit: Angra Nest. 
Fixed the abnormal texture on the air in Zombie Scenario Pursuit: Last Clue.
Fixed the levels of certain Zombie Z grenades:
Heart Grenade: 26 -> 29
Pumpkin Grenade & Rice Cake Grenade: 1 -> 15
Special Agent May has now been revised to Special Agent Mei.[/olist]

notes.title: [Event] Studio #Underwater Theme Contest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5f62db8ca7b2e19bebd088ca7bce31139bf45f16.jpg

Show off your creative skills in this underwater-themed Studio contest! 
Participate now to receive the 1st place prize and Steam gift card!

Event 1: Celebratory Studio Contest
Event Schedule Application Period: 4/19 – 5/19
 Finalists Announced: 6/15
 Player Vote: 6/15 - 6/28
 Winners Announced: 7/12
 Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 7/12

How to Participate Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
 Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
 Step 3: Add "#underwater" to the map's title

Conditions 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
 There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.

Prizes 1st (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 2nd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 3rd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
 All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal

Notice Only maps created on or after 4/19 will be able to participate.
 Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
 You must include the #underwater tag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
 Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
 Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
 If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
 If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
 Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
 Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.


Event 2: Celebratory Studio Contest- Steam Gift Card Giveaway!
Studio Event schedule Application Period: 4/19 – 5/19
 Gift Card Winners Announcement: 6/14
 Personal Information Collection: 6/14 - 6/28 
 Gift Card Distribution: 8/9

Conditions Earn more than the total of 10 points within the criteria below
 Map design - Is it unique, creative and not repetitive? (1-5)
 Functionality - Does the map have good FPS? Does everything work? (1-5)
 Map gameplay - Is it fun? Is it too hard? Or perhaps too easy? (1-5)
 Story - Does it have cool stories or narratives? Or just shoot and win? (1-5)


Prize 10,000 Won Gift Card (50 people)
Once you claim the gift card, it will automatically be converted the amount to your country's currency.

Notice Gift cards are provided via raffle, and are only available to contest entries that have met the prerequisite requirements.
 You must include the #underwater hashtag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
 If there are less than 50 entries, all participants that met the requirements will receive the gift and no additional raffles will be held.
 Multiple winnings are not allowed (one player cannot win with 2 or more contest entries)
 Studio maps that have been entered in the past are excluded from the prize raffle.
 Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
 If you fail to deliver your personal information within the announced period, you will be removed from the raffle without notification.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 5th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/52e9146b0a48e4378d81f02377e7a4f7447f3e13.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

April Fool's Day Celebration Spring Event (4/5 - 4/19)New items have arrived with Spring! Participate in the new event and earn new gear!

Easter Celebration Costume Event (4/5 - 4/19)Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards! 

New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/5–5/3)Two new Transcendence Classes, Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

New Content

Map Added (4/5 - 4/19)
Chindren's Estate
The existing Estate map has undergone a Easter Day renovation.
Castle Land
A map with an amusement park theme.


New Event

April Fool's Day Celebration Spring Event (4/5 - 4/19)
New items have arrived with Spring! Participate in the new event and earn new gear!
How to Participate
Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 points per day, excludes bots).
Earn 5 points each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 points per day).
Earn 1 point each time you reach 5 minutes of playtime (up to 10 points per day).
Earn 2 points each time you log in (once a day).
* Each account can obtain up to 50 play points per day.
Event Rewards
50 Points: Rare Decoder x3
100 Points: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
150 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x3
250 Points: Plunger (Permanent) + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/71ee752503e93b75fe06a9c339bb4b16da5a5561.png
350 Points: Cute SD Character's Nameplate (300 Days) + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/df2e6116612891f0201343d7a521b9b199e349fa.png
450 Points: Spring Breeze (Light Zombie) Spray (Permanent) + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bb3f8205153d83077dd20dd86c0704e73cc818c4.png
500 Points: Ice Cream Cone (Permanent)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43a5a046153b077f557dc96c1cb135e82fbc094a.png
550 Points: Class Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x5
600 Points: Transcendence Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x5
650 Points: Season Badge x100
700 Points: Season Badge x100
Notice
These rewards ares given only once per Nexon account.
Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
All remaining play points will be removed during maintenance on 4/19.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.


Easter Celebration Costume Event (4/5 - 4/19)
Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards! 
How to Participate
Earn 1 balloon by reaching 30 / 45 / 60 minutes of Total Login Time (up to 3 balloons per day)
Earn 1 balloon by reaching 10 / 25 / 40 minutes of Total Playtime (up to 3 balloons per day)
Earn 2 balloons by reaching 10 / 25 / 40 minutes of Total Playtime in the Easter Estate or Castle Land (up to 6 balloons per day)
Earn 1 balloon by using any decoder (up to 1 balloon per day)
Earn 1 balloon during Exploration (up to 1 balloon per day)
Earn 1 balloon for clicking the Claim Reward on the Login Supplies window (up to 1 balloon per day)
Earn 1 balloon by performing any of the following actions (up to 1 balloon per day): Weapon Enhancement / Disassembly / Part Equipment, Combination / Painting
Event Rewards
60 Balloons: Balloon Nameplate (300 Days)
80 Balloons: Propeller Hat (Permanent)
110 Balloons: Cotton Candy (Permanent)
Notice
You can obtain up to 10 balloons per day.
All balloons are removed during maintenance on the day that the event ends.
All rewards can be claimed only once per account.
Eligible Modes: All
Cannot participate in Studio Mode
Can participate in Laboratory Mode
Player Requirement: 3 

Shop Update

New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/5–5/3)
Two new Transcendence Classes, Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.
Special Agent May
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/75b6df5a437352efa682fef3d0d304808bc76231.png
Background: May is a Chinese-born special agent who works for the Intelligence Agency and is trained in high-level combat. Most recently, she had been assigned to assist a fellow agent, but has found this difficult. In a turn of events that wrecked her resume, May has been unable to track her target due to their masterful disguise. When she discovered that the troublesome pyromaniac that had been terrorizing the world was actually the agent that she had been told to support, May became extremely conflicted, but carried on. Still struggling to find the pyromaniac agent, she eventually received intel that they had met up with David's company, so now May is on the move again to finally provide support.
Paired Weapon: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
 activation time decreased and damage increased
Zombie Scenario Skill: Special Agent's Stance
Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Pyromaniac Yuri (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent May is in the same room (up to 2 players). 
 Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: Uses Conceal in Zombie Scenario, which will obscure you. Your HP will slowly recover during this time, but inflicting damage on an enemy will reveal you. Once Conceal is disabled, your movement speed will return to normal and a set amount of HP will be restored immediately for you and your allies within a set range.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.
Pyromaniac Yuri
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f0ed63fef3b67d8e25da7d00298fec62ccdb1e06.png
Background: A mysterious girl with an amazing talent for handling explosives, Yuri is known for working exclusively on more destructive activities. Although she successfully completes most of her missions, she once unintentionally injured Jennifer while on an assignment. Yuri is a master of disguise and can infiltrate any location to get the job done, but recently, she has been on the run from May, who has been persistently chasing her after Yuri had planned on using David Black and his company but ended up exposing her current whereabouts to May. Now, the two of them find the chase and each other’s company to be getting exhausting.
Paired Weapon: Dual Beretta Gunslinger
 damage is now unaffected by distance, rather than decreasing the farther away your target is.
 damage has been increased
Zombie Scenario Skill: Blow It Up
Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Special Agent May (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent May is in the same room (up to 2 players).  
 Add-On effect is applied by default.
Active: Applies explosion damage within a set range around you in Zombie Scenario (Not applicable to objects).
Damage of allies within the explosion range is increased for a set duration.
Explosive Ammo is loaded in your magazines, which explode at set intervals.
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.


New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/5–5/3)
Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!
Conditions and Rewards
Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
Select either: Special Agent May + Mikey Panda or Pyromaniac Yuri + Bomb Bot
Notice
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
Selecting Special Agent May will automatically provide Mikey Panda (Permanent).
Selecting Pyromaniac Yuri will automatically provide Bomb Bot (Permanent).
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted once per account.


New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (4/5 – Permanent)
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.
Conditions and Items
Collect Special Agent May, Pyromaniac Yuri, Mikey Panda, and Bomb Bot to earn the Spy medal.
Spy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/677c4bab6a1eddc6034900289ba42d0da6c54f41.png
Honor Points: 10
The Spy medal doesn't have an event period limit and can be obtained after the 11/30 (Wed) maintenance.
This medal can be obtained once per account.


Other Information

[olist]Some auto aim weapons will no longer attack the Fire Bomb.
Changed the amount of Karma gained from Zombie Kill/Assist.
Fixed the issue where occasionally, the client would crash or players would be moved to the wait room while playing.[/olist]
