notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 22nd
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7cf0df5c8e92cc3deb34540c584235e84250e9c8.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Spring Seed Event (3/22 - 4/5)Grow the seed that you get upon your daily first login into a fruit to get all kinds of rewards!

Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cousteau (3/22 - 4/19)A new weapon, Cousteau, will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------

New Content

Zombie Mode Changes
Zombie Scenario Mode
Elite Monster Probability (%) slightly decreased
Elite spawns will now stop in the sections of certain maps where you cannot use your weapon.
Zombie Hero Balance Categories Added
Added Fire Bomb skill
Adjusted knockback and stun whenever a Host Zombie appears.
Human Recover HP skill
HP recovery is restored according to the amount of Morale Boost.
Zombie Z Mode
Weapon Unlock Level Changes
Weapon/Change Level
Pierrot Magic Bow: 22 -> 25
FG Launcher: 10 -> 15
Laser Storm: 20 -> 18
Avalanche TECH: 8 -> 7
Crowbar Maverick TECH: 8 -> 5
Dart Pistol TECH: 3 -> 1
EXP earned by zombies for infecting humans has been decreased.
The way that Intellectual mutation acquires EXP has been changed. The in-game description has been updated to be more accurate.
Studio Mode Improvements
HP value of the Monster Spawner Device has been increased ( HP is now identical to regular monsters)


Convenience Updates
BGM Playlist
Added a feature where you can preview and change the Lobby BGM in a playlist.
This feature can be found in the [Options] - [Audio] - [Playlist] menu.
Grouped Missions and Search Feature
Similar missions will now be displayed in groups.
A new search feature has been added that can be found on the left side of [Go to Mission Chain] in the [Missions] page.
The search feature will only display results that include the keywords found on mission or event titles and content.
Inventory Specific
You can now choose multiple selectable rewards and review what you already own.


Event Information

Spring Seed Event (3/22 - 4/5)
Grow the seed that you get upon your daily first login into a fruit to get all kinds of rewards!
Item Conditions and Rewards
Seed: First Login / Rare Decoder X5
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc72c557cef64a25bea00d4f43c3a0127baf8801.png
Sprout: Reach 20 minutes of playtime after getting a seed. / Event Decoder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1663ff2da149abb3c3940cc771fb37b4255a2604.png
Fruit: Reach 20 minutes of play time in one of the missions below:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ead9b4aee85513d4a6cdb1b67118a3d2ec9449d5.png
[olist]
 Score 10 Zombie Kills as a human, or 10 Human Infections as a zombie (bots excluded in both)
 Score 100 kills and clear 1 session in Hard or higher difficulty in the Zombie Scenario mode.
 Achieve 4 or more rounds where the Fire Bomb was used in Zombie Hero mode / Get Harvested Fruit + one of the following items based on their chance: Dragon Knight Kyrix (15 Days/Permanent), High Elf Natasha (15 Days/Permanent), Anemone (15 Days/Permanent), Mirage (15 Days/Permanent), Event Decoder (x2, x5, x10 and x20), Unique Decoder (x3), 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (x3), 3,000 Mileage Coupon, 2,000 Mileage Coupon, Grade 5 Parts Reward Box, Rare Decoder (x3 and x5), Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days).
[/olist]
Harvested Fruit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d5271bf96b2f1e7b3d6db6cfcac4ce6bf83edb2d.png
3 Total: Unique Decoder x2 + Event Decoder x2
5 Total: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder
7 Total: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder x2
9 Total: Transcendence Decoder x2 + Class Decoder x3
12 Total: Transcendence Decoder x3 + Class Decoder x4
14 Total: Season Badge x400
Notice
The Seed, Sprout, and Fruit items can all be used by pressing the Use button.
The Seed and Sprout items can't grow into their next stages upon use.
The Seed, Sprout, and Fruit items are all automatically removed every day at 11:59 PM, and the event resets.
All Harvested Fruit items are removed during the maintenance on 4/5
Cumulative Harvested Fruit rewards are given once per account.
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes normal Laboratory mode play, excludes Studio Mode).
For Zombie Scenario Mode, participation will only count when you play at least 10 minutes.
Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Original / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
The Event Decoder can be used until before midnight on the day it is obtained.
Transcendence Classes will be provided without the exclusive costume.


Login Supplies Event Guide (3/22 – 4/18)
Login Reward
Daily Weapons Supply
Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) 2 types all provided + 2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).
Cumulative Rewards
5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
15 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
Notice
Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.

Shop Update
Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cousteau (3/22 - 4/19)
A new weapon, Cousteau, will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!
Cousteau Drop Rate
Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%
Cousteau (Throwable Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f1c4bf306bb1938fe376b87a4b76d017a9ed23be.png
Description: A futuristic sentry gun that lands in a stealth state once thrown, and automatically attacks any enemies it detects with its sensors.
Switch Attack Mode: 
Attack Mode: 
 Self-destructs after detecting the enemy, inflicting explosion damage as well as damage over time.
  Slows the targeted enemy and attacks them for a set amount of time before self-destructing.


Cousteau Guaranteed Giveaway (3/22 - 4/19)
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Cousteau permanently!
Reward Thresholds
Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points
Notice
6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.


Misc
[olist]Fixed an issue where firing the mp5 with hardware acceleration turned on would add incorrect effects to the gun.
Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, the loading screen for Zombie Scenario 8-3 Pursuit: Abandoned Hound's map would only display the first image.
Fixed an issue where using the Transcendence Class buff skill while traveling to the next map in Zombie Scenario would not reset the skill.
Fixed an issue where certain weapon's attacks would not damage the Fire Bomb. 
Fixed an issue where the Fire Bomb would pass through certain objects.
Fixed an issue where Quantum Horizon's Quantum Dive effect would display when activating Arbalest's Cosmic Armor.
Fixed an issue where some classes would display an incorrect animation when switching to the Explosion Damage attack while attacking with Twin Hawk's Electric Field.
Fixed an issue where switching from Special Attack to Normal Attack while using Laser Storm would only display the corresponding animation but not inflict the damage. 
Fixed an issue where the Host alarm would appear in Zombie Classic mode.
Fixed an issue where the client would crash after playing a certain studio map. 
Removed the Supply Box and Parts from Tutorial mode.
Fixed an issue where entering a new mode would inaccurately display room options from the previous mode. 
Fixed an issue where system messages would disappear abnormally fast in Tutorial and Zombie Darkness modes.
Fixed an issue where weapon paint would not be applied after applying the Cyborg Weapon Paint to the Dual Beretta Gunslinger and using its Special Feature.
Fixed an issue during Exploration that would inaccurately sort low level players.
Fixed an issue where hacks allowed abnormally high jumps.
Changed the server region for Australia and New Zealand users.
[/olist]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 8th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/94358d72596306e4f63cc09e24d5d68568c1b6e3.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9cb9c6a513658c3d72490b51f880bd30e98c7c57.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!


Content: New Zombie Scenario 8-3 Map ReleasedExperience Ritsuka's story in the new Zombie Scenario!

 Content: Season 15: CyborgsThe theme for Season 15 is [Cyborgs], the future of humanity!

 Spring Fling Event (2/22 - 3/8)Participate in missions every day during the event to earn points!

New Content

Zombie New Scenario 8-3 Map
Pursuit: Abandoned Hound
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/740bcab1c1c5aa04ea1131fa1c7fe4ab0d4ab62d.png
This is the tale of Ritsuka's return to the Asia Red Army's hideout.

Ritsuka received the request from Douglas Jacob to stop David Black and Erica. She ambushed them, but the mission was a failure, forcing her to retreat to the Asia Red Army's hideout.
However, the Asia Red Army's hideout is in ruins, as if a full-blown war had happened.
Ritsuka investigated the area to assess what had happened there.
Uncontrollable zombies swarmed out of the hideout, with no trace of the Asia Red Army allies anywhere. Ritsuka found herself enraged as she approached the truth.

You can find detailed information in the [Zombie Scenario 8-3 Preview].

Season 15: Cyborg 
For details, please refer to the Season 15 Pass Preview.

Black Market Opens Early
The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
New Item Added: CSO Pendant
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b73f3091327385d2691e2e9c956029a9ecc91d9a.png


Repurchasing Past Season Passes
A page where past season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.
Available Previous Season Passes: Seasons 9, 10, 11, 12, 13
The Black Market can be accessed via the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.
All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear once a new season begins.

Season Reward Weapons
Dart Pistol TECH (Secondary Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e4515819015f3fa727d27625ecbdb65aa5a8aa7d.png
A pistol designed to fire 7 special darts. It may seem like a regular toy gun, but it has a hidden feature which will shock opponents, causing targets to suffer damage over time after being hit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bcc96d1b2792ca8fb37f8dec448412a036fed332.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fddbfbda3dafdddd08c5d3750faf12d359707aba.png

Laser Storm (Primary Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1a662b4e3996b0620398b484d084d35b8351c277.png
A sub-machine gun that fires 45 rounds of 45.ACP ammo. It has very low recoil and a high rate of fire. It's made of an extremely light material through unknown means, which makes it highly portable. Normal attacks charge special rounds, which can be used for a special attack by right-clicking.

That's why she chose to hide her identity and adopt the new persona of an idol. Idol by day and terrorist by night, she received a reinforcement request from Victor while out with Dominique to destroy another Kronos factory.
Exclusive Skill: One, Two, Happiness! - Increases the Movement Speed of self and nearby allies within range. Creates a shield for allies and grants invincibility for self for a set duration.

notes.title: [Notice] Happy New Year Letter from CSN:S Dev Team
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ba14dcd64480829f34429b37d128de6f19ad2abb.jpg

Hello, everyone. This is the Steam Dev team for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio.

We'd like to greet our players as we welcome the 2023 new year.
A lot of things happened this year.

We were able to welcome the new year with our players as we're doing now, through the consistent support and constructive criticism loaded with the player's love for the game.
We showcased the new mode, Zombie Conquest, as a beta version in its development stage back in June, to gather your suggestions and opinions.

It was a very important time where we made note of all player reviews and suggestions,
but we are quite disappointed that we weren't able to provide a satisfactory experience because the Zombie Conquest beta version had many elements that were inadequate.

For team-based content like Zombie Conquest to be serviced with more stability,
we will use the many suggestions that you've sent us.

In addition to the improvements and updates that we made in December, we will continue to release more updates and improvements, so we ask for your continued support.
Also, more updates and improvements are scheduled for the popular mode among players, the Zombie Scenario, so please look forward that it as well.

Lastly, we'd like to thank you once again for your support over the year of 2022.
We'll be a development team that strives to match your support and expectations in the new year of 2023, and we wish you a happy new year!

Romy's older brother. He got his quick thinking from his father, a former guard captain of Lost City, and his survival skills were essential in keeping Romy and himself safe. He once wished to become a soldier himself, but his hopes were dashed once the Lost City army collapsed. Roy's younger sister. Despite her dedication to her academic and domestic duties in the wake of her parents' deaths, she is still a cheerful, carefree girl. Following an explosion at the factory her brother had been deployed to, Romy armed herself and rushed to the battlefield. While she has no military experience, her father trained her in marksmanship. Between that and survival skills honed from living in the hell that is Lost City, Romy has proven herself to be more than just some schoolgirl.
Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.
Exclusive Skill: Crisis Breakthrough - Can use a skill that grants temporary invincibility to self and does area of effect damage in Zombie Scenario.

Romy's Survival Pack
A pack containing everything essential to survival. The more experience you get, the more things you realize are essential.

notes.content:

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!


 Event: Laboratory Experience Event (12/14–12/28)Experience the Laboratory Mode, where Douglas Jacob's frightening experiment is taking place, and claim your rewards.

 Event: Winter Festival (12/14–12/28)Meet the requirements every day during the event to earn points.

 Event: Christmas Celebration Event (12/14 – 12/28)Spend the Christmas with Counter Strike Nexon: Studio! All kinds of gifts are waiting for you. 

 Event: Advent Calendar Event (12/14 – 12/28)Complete missions every day, and claim your rewards!
Check out the following sections for more information.

---------- Details ----------
 
New Content

Zombie Z Balance Changes 
Zombie Z Level Changes
 Death Eater: 33 → 35
 Dual Sword Phantom Slayer: 30 → 32
 Petrol Boomer: 7 → 13
 Light Zombie: 6 → 12
 Venom Guard: 8 → 7
 Psycho: 10 → 15
 Stamper: 12 → 11
Zombie Z EXP Changes
Humans will now earn EXP equal to the amount of HP they take off of the zombies.
EXP earned by zombies for infecting humans has been reduced early in the round. It will gradually increase during the round.
Challenge Reward + Changes
The bonus EXP earned by Kills/Assists made with Random Purchase Weapons has been decreased (Kill 10,000 → 2,500. Assist 1,500 → 500).

New Events

Laboratory Daily Experience (12/14 - 12/28)Experience the Laboratory Mode, where Douglas Jacob's frightening experiment is taking place, and claim your rewards.
 Conditions and Obtainable Items
 Reach 10 minutes of play time as a zombie in Laboratory Mode + use zombie skills 3 times to earn 1 Event Decoder.
 Notice Can participate once per account.
 Auto hunt in Laboratory Mode will not fulfill the requirements.
 The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.

Laboratory Exploration Mission (12/14 - 12/28)Explore the depths of Douglas Jacob's laboratory, and earn additional rewards!
 Conditions and Obtainable Items
 Earn 5 points each time you reach 20 minutes of play in a zombie mode (up to 10 points per day).
 Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie (max 30 points per day, excludes bots).
 You can claim 1 Event Reward Box for 10 event points.
 Event Reward Box Content (You will have a chance to get one of the items below.)
 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
 Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x1
 Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x2
 Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x3
 Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x1
 Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x2
 Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x3
 Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
 Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
 Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
 1,000 Mileage
 Class Decoder x1
 Class Decoder x2
 Rare Decoder x1
 Rare Decoder x2
 Unique Decoder x1
 Unique Decoder x2
 Event Decoder x1
 Event Decoder x2
 Notice
 You can obtain up to 40 points a day.
 Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
 Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Conquest (beta)
 Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
 All unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 12/28 (Wed.)


Laboratory Exploration Collection Mission (12/14 - 12/28)Accumulate points by completing missions to claim your rewards.
 Total Points / Reward
 200 points / Transcendence Decoder x3 Notice
 Cumulative rewards can only be obtained once per account.


Event: Winter Festival (12/14–12/28)Meet the following requirements every day during the event to earn points.
 How to Participate / Rewards
 Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists, or infect 2 humans in zombie modes (up to 40 points a day, excludes bots).
 Earn 5 points for clearing 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 points a day).
 Earn 1 point each time you reach 10 minutes of in-game play time (up to 5 points a day).
 Earn 1 point each time you obtain a Zombie Mode Supply Box (up to 5 points per account).
 Total Points / Reward
 45 Points: Rare Decoder x3
 90 Points: Unique Decoder x2
 135 Points: Black Neon Weapon Paint x1 + Hunter-Killer X-7 (Permanent)
 180 Points: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
 225 Points: Black Neon Weapon Paint x1 + M2 (Permanent) + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
 270 Points: Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x5 + Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
 315 Points: Black Neon Weapon Paint x1 + Gaebolg (Permanent) + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
 360 Points: Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x5 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
 405 Points: Event Decoder x7 + Neon Nameplate (Permanent)
 450 Points: Black Neon Weapon Paint x1 + M4A1 Dark Knight (Permanent) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
 495 Points: Class Decoder x7 + Neon Font (Permanent)
 540 points / Transcendence Decoder x10
 Notice
 Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Darkness / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Z
 Ineligible Zombie Scenario Maps: Zombie Scenario Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos 
 Cannot participate in Studio Mode 
 Can participate in Laboratory Mode (excludes auto hunt kills in the Laboratory)
 This event excludes auto hunt kills in all modes
 Minimum Playtime: Zombie Scenario 5 minutes  
 Player Requirement: 3 
 All points will be removed on the day the event ends (12/28). 
 All rewards can be claimed only once per account.


Zombie Z Unlock Level Temporary Adjustment Event (12/14 - 12/28)Out of the weapon paints produced for the 14th Anniversary, the 3 weapons below will have their Zombie Z unlock levels adjusted temporarily. 
 Weapons Affected
 Gaebolg: 10 → 8
 Hunter-Killer X-7: 16 → 15
 M4A1 Dark Knight: 19 → 17
 Notice
 Unlock levels will be adjusted temporarily during the event, and these levels will return to normal after the event.


Christmas Celebration Event 1 (12/14 - 12/28)Log in during the event and claim the rewards below! 
 Reward
 Christmas Hat Set (30 Days)
 Christmas Spray (30 Days)
 Snowman Mask (30 Days)
 Christmas Stocking (30 Days)
 Santa Light Zombie (30 Days)
 Santa Heavy Zombie (30 Days)
 Notice
 Rewards can only be obtained once per account.


Christmas Celebration Event 2 (12/14 - 12/28)Play the game and claim the rewards below!
 Earn the following rewards upon reaching 10 minutes of play time.
 Christmas Font (30 Days)
 Event Decoder x3
 Notice
 Rewards can only be obtained once per account.
 Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).


Christmas Celebration Event 3 (12/14 - 12/28)Let's spend Christmas Day on 12/25 together! 
 Conditions and Rewards
 Obtain the Lone Combatant Medal for reaching 60 minutes of Log in on 12/25.
 Players who already have the Lone Combatant medal will get the Christmas Commando medal after reaching 60 minutes of play time. 
 Players who already have the Christmas Commando medal will get the Social Distancing medal after reaching 60 minutes of play time.
 Players who already have the Social Distancing medal will get the Zero-contact Battalion medal after reaching 60 minutes of play time.
 Players who already have the Zero-contact Battalion medal will get the It's Time! Lv.5 medal after reaching 60 minutes of play time.

 Notice
 You can participate only in rooms with 4 or more players 
 No mode restrictions



Advent Calendar Event (12/14 – 12/28)Complete the missions every day, and claim your rewards! 
 Missions / Rewards
 Mission 1: Click 'Claim Reward' from the Login Supplies window - Receive 1,500 Mileage 
 Mission 2: Click the 'Missions' tab (Check Mission) - Receive 5,000 Points 
 Mission 3: Purchase Point Decoder from the shop - Get Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 
 Mission 4: Click "Exploration" at the bottom of the Lobby screen and start the Exploration, to receive Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x3 
 Mission 5: Play Original / Zombie Scenario / Zombie Z / Zombie Classic / Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Conquest / Hide and Seek mode 1 time - Receive Unique Decoder x2
 Mission 6: Log In on Another Day - Receive Transcendence Decoder + Event Decoder
 Notice
 The rewards for each mission can only be obtained once a day per account.
 Mission 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 can be cleared in any order.
 Mission 1 through 5 must be cleared before clearing Mission 6 to claim its reward.
 You can fulfill Mission 6's conditions without consecutive log-ins.
 Completed missions are reset everyday at midnight.
 You can only do missions 1 through 5 on the last day of the event.

- Zombie Base 2 and 3: Increased amount charged over time; increased amount charged from taking damage.


Game Improvements

New Events
Find the Zombie Event(11/30–12/14)You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
 How to Participate
- Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
- Among a group of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans), find and hit the zombies using particular bullets.
- Get these bullets from the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway
- Hitting a zombie will increase the reward grade by 1 and allow you to take an additional shot. Hitting a human will decrease the reward grade by 1 and reset the Find the Zombie in progress.
- The reward grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit enough zombies consecutively, and you can claim the reward at it's current grade by clicking "Surrender."
- Click "Automatic Fire" to quickly and automatically proceed through one game.

 What is "Automatic Fire"?
- Proceed by randomly firing in a game.
- Must have more than 1 bullet to proceed.
- If you are in the Claim Reward state, you must claim the reward to use this feature.

Marksman Training Project! (11/30–12/14)Collect empty shells during the event to supply bullets!
 How to Participate / Rewards
- Earn 2 shells (up to 30 a day, including 1-1 missions) every 2 Kills, 6 Assists, or 2 Human Infections (bots excluded) in Zombie Mode.
- Earn 5 shells (up to 10 a day) for completing Mission 1 in Zombie Conquest (beta).
- Earn 5 shells (up to 30 a day) for clearing 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher.
- Earn 1 shell (up to 5 per account) every time you obtain a Zombie Mode Supply Box.

 How to Participate / Rewards

- Earn 1 Event Reward Box every 1 Kill, 3 Assists, or 1 Human Infection (bots excluded) in Zombie Mode (once a day).

Shop Update
New Transcendence Class Promotion (11/30–12/28)Two new Transcendence Classes, Skadi and Nyx, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.


 Skadi
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b026ca23f8e757107f9af6de3e5fde7bfa8da231.png

She was recruited alongside Nyx when they were found by the institute, freezing the first zombie she encountered. She is full of royal pride and is adapting to this world by speaking formally and trying to learn new customs. She is cooperating with the Aegis Institute to return to her original world. Wherever she treads freeze, regardless of the climate.
- Zombie Scenario Skill: Ice Queen's Grace
 Passive: If engaging in Zombie Scenario with Nyx, critical rate increases (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). /  Add-On effect is applied by default.

She was recruited because Skadi rushes into action, claiming that to do so is the obligation of royalty. She is satisfied with this world and its lack of class divides, and she dreams of sending Skadi back to their original world while remaining herself to enjoy the thrills of battle. She provided research support to the Kronos Institute to acquire emergency funds as well.
 Zombie Scenario Skill: The Black Ark

 Changes for previous devices

Celebratory Studio Contest InfoWe're celebrating the new theme and blocks by holding a Studio Creation Mode map creation contest!

 Studio contest schedule
- Application Period: 11/2 – 11/30
- Finalists Announced: 12/28
- Player Vote: 12/28 – 1/11
- Winner Announcement & Awards: 1/25

 How to Participate
- Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
- Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
- Step 3: Add "#partygame" to the map's title

 Criteria
- 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
- There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.

 Prizes (evaluated based on creativity and popularity)
- 1st (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 2nd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 3rd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal

 Notice
- If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
- Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
- You can only enter each prize category once, and you cannot win the same prize more than once.
- Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
- Your award may be revoked if the entry has nothing to do with the subject.
- The entries must be original creations, and your award will be revoked if the entry contains content in violation of the game's Terms and Conditions, contains plagiarized content, or violates the rights of 3rd parties in any way.
- Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
- If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
- All legal responsibilities fall to whoever submitted the entry, should there be a dispute regarding the entry.
- The award may be revoked from contestants who have violated the Terms and Conditions or operational rules of CSNS during the contest or award periods.
- Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.

 Cyclops (Secondary Weapon)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/137f9a73253348d5d01610c5c92d6e1b785164a5.png

Successfully hitting an enemy in the final stage will cause them to fall and deal continuous damage.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6f571647994f9864e309d096dfeaa7558dd93973.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: New Zombie Scenario 8-2 Map Released
Experience the New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past in the new Zombie Scenario! 

Event: Start the Firework Festival with a bang from the Firework Set! (10/5 – 10/19)
Play every day and collect Firework Sets to earn rewards! 

Event: Epic Weapon Heaven Splitter Guaranteed Giveaway! (10/5 – 11/2)
Based on the amount of Epic Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Heaven Splitter (Permanent)!

Event: Asura Hell Splitter Blueprint Promotion (10/5 – 11/2)
The Asura Hell Splitter is here! Purchase the Asura Hell Splitter blueprint for a guaranteed acquisition of the Asura Hell Splitter. 
Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------

New Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8484053203ad3b47eb7e05e6b261a6a7a6430a51.jpg
Zombie New Scenario 8-2 Map Pursuit: Planned Tragedy
 New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past
 A sudden power outage resulted in all the doors of the laboratory's experimental wards to open. Experiments such as Queen and Cyborg ended up escaping in midst of the chaos, even succeeding in hijacking a helicopter for their escape. Meanwhile, lab researchers monitored them from within the lab. They put together a tracking unit to lure them to a secure location and forced a crash landing by knocking out the helicopter rotors. Still, the Queen and her fellow experiments wished only to escape, but as they tried to leave the lavish, lifeless neon city, they were met by a horde of zombies and other, new experiments. All the while, the Kronos researchers were watching. Now a new experiment begins.
 You can find detailed information in the [Zombie Scenario 8-2 Preview].


Game Improvements 

 Inventory Lock System
- Added a locking feature to prevent important items from being accidentally lost.
- Locking the item will prevent the item from being auto-filled in situations where the item would be spent, such as disassembly, Enhancement Material selection, and auction use.
- Some items (provided by default, event items, etc.)  will have restricted locking features.

 Enhancement Simplification
- Inserting EXP Material has been removed from the process. A feature that guides the player when a high rank weapon is inserted has been added.
- Enhancement Guide and result pop-up window has been improved.

 Zombie Scenario Player Experience Improvements
- An escape feature has been added to use in when a character is stuck within the map. If you are unable to move for a set period of time, [ESC > Map Escape] becomes activated, and you can use it to move to the spawn area.
- Fixed an issue where some Phobos wouldn't appear during Pursuit: Last Clue.

 6 BGM is now added to the Music Block in Studio Mode.

 Other Changes
- Hitbox errors, unnatural modeling, and animations have been revised through class modeling and animation improvements.
- Please refer to [Developer's Letter] for more details.



New Events
Event: Mileage Auction Event (10/5 – 10/18)October opens with an open Mileage Auction! Log in now to get the items you need!
 Permanent Auction Item Added: Trinity Grenade

 Auction Feature / Content
- Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
- Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
- Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
- Regarding the Market Price of Items:  When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
- Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
- Auction Settings: You can search by bid or direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
- Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
- Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.

 Notice
- As the Trinity Grenade has been added, the M95 White Tiger has been removed from the premium.
- Lower Price Limit: 50,000 / Upper Price Limit: None
- The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
- You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
- Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
- If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
- Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
- If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
- The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
- When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
- Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.


1,000 Mileage Auction Event (10/7 – 10/9)During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.
 Time / Special Items
- 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM (CEST) / Spell Lance Scarlet Rose

 Notice
- 1,000-Mileage auction items will appear periodically during auction hours.
- Special items will appear within 10 minutes of the beginning of each auction hour, with bidding open for 10 minutes.
- Those who did not win the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage when the auction closes.
- Claim rewards by clicking Obtain after winning.


Start the Firework Festival with a bang from the Firework Set! (10/5 – 10/19)Play every day to get the Firework Set!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3733cb977f6c837d56c9cb8131d13945afbf1d25.png
 How to Participate / Reward
- When you reach 20 minutes of playtime, you will receive 1 Firework Set (up to 3 a day).
- Get 1 Firework Set for clearing 1 session (success) by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher. (Up to 7 a day)
- Get 3 Firework Sets for clearing 1 session (success) in Zombie Scenario Mode: Planned Tragedy on Hard difficulty or higher. (Up to 3 a day)
- Get 1 Firework Set each time you earn 8 Kill Points from kills/assists/human infections in a Zombie Mode. (Up to 7 a day)
- Get 3 Firework Sets for using Awakening skill 5 times in Zombie Conquest (beta). (Up to 3 a day)

- Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points
- Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point

- Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points

notes.title: Developer's Letter
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1e95bcc7124a5a9f096f394742a7e968be908cc5.jpg

Hello. This is the Dev team for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio. 
 
Thanks to the large amount of interest that players have shown in the various contents of Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio, we were able to consider the future direction of development in many ways. 
 
The 10/05 (Wed) patch content will be communicated with Counter-Strike players here, 
for us to create a Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio for everyone, together. 
 
Today, we'd like to introduce some improvements we have prepared in response  
to the opinions of Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio's fans. 
  
#Character Modeling Revision #Zombie Scenario Unstuck Feature #Inventory Lock Feature & Enhancement Simplification 

 
Character Modeling Revision {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/157e68920fe259daaeb3576361ac4b94844029b4.jpg
Character Modeling has been revised for this patch. 
Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio's playable teams are divided in to Counter-Terrorist (CT) and Terrorist (TR) sides. 
For some weapons, the character grip animation on the weapon will vary between the two teams. 
 

 
  
The problem was that certain classes were using the team motions wrong. The model shown in the game  
and the model on the game server weren't matching, so there were issues with hit detection. 
  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3de23c5f833d17ffd4b0118c10b36a1858db8144.gif

  
To resolve this issue, we are going through the character modeling  
and using a procedure where we are syncing the game server and in-game character models to be uniform. We began with the revision of human classes for now. 
After this update, we will be improving abnormal hitboxes. 

 On another note, the character animations of certain male and female classes will be improved to be more natural. The animations below are scheduled for improvement.

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e6c63efafae8863a43efb1cd278b3460576279b3.jpg
Aside from "Immortal Eric", who does not have the relevant issues, all classes were revised. 
 

Turtle neck issue 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/32fe058b29a79f781e84a13323119feae78951ac.jpg
  
Shoulder fix 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d3fde27e94d0069d85f6da44e858c5be5138007.jpg

Other joints 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/32fe058b29a79f781e84a13323119feae78951ac.jpg
Aside from the classes without the relevant issues listed below, all female classes were revised. 

1	Queen
2	Anemone
3	Mirage
4	Ismael
5	Romy
6	Agent Ritsuka
 
We are continuously improving the game to enhance its overall quality, and we will do our best to quickly address other similar issues that remain in the game. 
 
Introduction of Zombie Scenario Unstuck Feature 
There were issues of being stuck in Zombie Scenario, where the player would have to leave the game and try again as they could not progress in the game while stuck. 
To resolve this issue, we have added the Unstuck feature in this update that you can use when you are stuck for more than a short time.  
If you are stuck and unable to move for more than 5 seconds, the Map Escape button will be activated in the ESC menu. 
  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f1113fa8f0e211d614c3bf3876148970ecb0591a.jpg
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b1edfa8fe5bdafab773c12bb972a8e58ab7b0094.jpg
  
Pressing the Map Escape button will move the character to the current spawn point. The character will be moved to one of the spawn areas if they're stuck in the boss stage. 
   
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1e938da501c613067347e22c04b83ed95975b178.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/26f2c40afd4750f2a6709dd15de1f16de1581e5a.jpg
Please note that there is a cooldown before you can use the feature again. 
 
Inventory Lock Feature & Enhancement Simplification {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc8079c0734b7641b6ac31611f30df26652cf670.png
Weapons, classes, items, etc. are being utilized as a materials for other systems, after a variety of items and system were added to the game. 
We confirmed that there were many cases where players were losing their items unintentionally as materials while using these systems, and that this has been a great inconvenience to them. 
Some players have suggested that there should be a feature to lock important items so that they cannot be disassembled or used as materials.
So, we have added a Lock feature where valuable items can be locked so that they cannot be lost as materials through disassembly or trade.  
 
Some event items or pass items were already unavailable for trade or to be used as materials, so those will be distributed in the locked state. 
We will continuously improve and enhance this feature to avoid instances where player assets are unintentionally lost. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2064ac14c6858156cf04d08669a8f9b419ac8f6e.png
 
The existing Weapon Enhancement system is divided into 2 stages. One is where the Enhancement Material is added, and the other is the Enhancement attempt. So, it always required two clicks. 
There were some suggestions that this was inconvenient, so we simplified them into a single click that takes care of both the material selection and the Enhancement attempt.  
Also, we added a step for weapons of high value, confirming that they have been selected as material, so that we can prevent a highly-valued weapon being accidentally used as material.  
 
 
We will continue to do our best to incorporate all of your suggestions and ideas to create a better gameplay experience for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio. 
 
Thank you.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 7th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/27e86a406a0c95555728b6c2989828974f99c2c6.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: Zombie Scenario Event Mode (9/7 - 9/21)
Ability Mode is here! Zombie Ability Scenario is different from other Scenarios thus far. Go experience the power now!

Event: Zombie Scenario Event Mode Max Level Ability Event (9/7 - 9/21)
Go experience the new Zombie Scenario (Event Mode) and earn rewards during the event period!

Event: Transcendence Weapon Failnaught Guaranteed Giveaway Event
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Failnaught (Permanent)!
Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------


New Content

Zombie Scenario New Event Mode Guide (9/7 - 9/21)For details, please refer to the [Zombie Ability Scenario Preview].

Ability
 Ability: A power that inflicts special damage on monsters, apart from weapons and character skills
 Abilities cannot inflict damage on structures.
 You can only have 1 Ability.
 Abilities change according to acquisition rates, but ability levels can always increase.
 Ability Points are earned in increments of 12 levels, from player Lv. 27.
 - Max Level for Abilities is 7.
 - You can also earn EXP from Ability attacks.
Ability Types
 Blizzard: An ice storm surrounds the player. Inflicts damage on monsters within range.
 Meteor: A meteor falls around the player. Inflicts big damage on the enemy.
 Energy Round: Fires a piercing Energy Round straight ahead.
 Gaebolg: Attacking enemies leaves a mark, shortly followed by a spear of light that inflicts damage.
 Flame: Attacks will inflict fire damage. Killing a burning enemy will damage other enemies around them.
 Splash Ball: Shoots a sphere forward that penetrates enemies and ricochets on impact with walls.
Maps for the Event
 Total of 2: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1)

VIP System ImprovementVIP System has been relocated to the Home screen, for easier access.

VIP System page has been improved.
 Privileges at all ranks are now available for viewing.
 Tooltip feature has been added to enable players to see the information of reward items.
 Information required for Rank upgrades is now more accessible.
VIP System Perk Renewal
 VIP Perk Enhanced: Supplied mileage increased + Zombie Scenario clear reward enhanced
 VIP Additional Perks
 - Additional distribution of Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100)
 - Additional distribution of Exploration Success Rate-Up 20%
 - Additional distribution of Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
VIP System Weapon Catalog Renewal
 Available items on Transcendence Decoders updated, and rotation weapons added to VIP Weapon Pass
 Available items on Class Decoders updated, and rotation classes added to Class Pass distributed above Diamond Rank
 Unique Weapon Pass distributed above Platinum Rank now updated with the Unique Decoder's contents 
 Rare Weapon Pass distributed above Gold Rank now updated with the Rare Decoder's contents

Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Update InformationFor details, please refer to the [Zombie Conquest (beta) Update Preview].

Some items in the supplied weapon list per base for the Human Team will be changed.

Added 2 Zombies
 Blotter Zombie is now available from the 2nd base.
 Aksha Zombie is now available from the 3rd base.
Zombie Awakening Effect Change
 Light Zombie: Previous awakening effect removed. Conceal duration and cooldown decreased, damage and range during Conceal increased, stun and knockback during Conceal decreased
 Venom Guard: Increased range of damage inflicted on enemies nearby during Awakening
Maps added and bases changed
 Assault and Dust maps will be added.
 Bases will now appear in fixed locations on Town Hall and Skyscraper maps.
Safe Zone: Respawn Areas of both teams are set as Safe Zones.
 Players located inside the safe zones do not take damage, and they can attack outward.
 Players outside of the safe zone cannot attack inside.
 Safe zones can only be entered by that team's members. The opposing team cannot enter the safe zone.
 Humans can press B inside the Safe Zone to access the purchase menu.
 - If you're using supplied weapons, the weapon list will not change until you die.
 - If the base changes, players will be able to purchase weapons relevant to the next base in the safe zone.
Waiting Room Team Integration: Players will be displayed in a single list in the waiting room instead of on their teams.
 Players will be assigned to A and B teams when the game begins. Players who join while the match is already in progress will join the team with less players. If both teams have the same number of players, they'll be placed randomly. 
 [Extra Room Settings > Separate Integrated Team] option will be added, and selecting this option will separate the A and B team members to play.
Other Information
 End of Session related revision: information displayed when the session ends early will include more details.


New Events

Zombie Scenario Event Mode Max Level Ability Event (9/7 - 9/21)Go experience the new Zombie Scenario (Event Mode) and earn rewards during the event period!

How to Participate 
 Reach Lv. 7 (Max Level) on Normal or higher in Ability once
Reward Contents (You'll have a chance to get one of these items)
 Point Class Decoder x3/ Point Transcendence Decoder x3/ Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2/ Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2/ Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x5\n Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon 200 x5/ VIP Free Pass (1 Day) x1
Notice
 Event rewards can be earned up to 2x a day.
 There are two relevant Zombie Scenario modes: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1).
 Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players. (Event Mode default settings)
 At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to participate in the event.

Zombie Scenario Event Mode Special Reward Giveaway (9/7 - 9/21)You will receive rewards based on the total number of times you have reached Ability Lv. 7 (Max Level) during the event!

Total / Rewards
 6 times / Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
 8 times / Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
 10 times / Unique Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
 12 times / Unique Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
 14 times / Event Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x4 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x4
 16 times / Event Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x4 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x4
 18 times / Class Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
 20 times / Class Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
 22 times / Transcendence Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
 24 times / Transcendence Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
Notice
 Can be claimed once per account.
 Reaching Ability Lv. 7 only counts up to 2x a day.
 There are two relevant Zombie Scenario modes: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1).
 Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players. (Event Mode default setting)
 At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to participate in the event.
 The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.

New and Returning Player Welcome Attendance Event (9/7 - Permanent) New and returning players get cumulative rewards by staying logged in for 10 minutes every day during the event.

Login Days / Reward
 1 Day: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x1 / Point Class Decoder x1 / 500 Mileage
 2 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x2 / Point Class Decoder x2 / 1,000 Mileage
 3 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x3 / Point Class Decoder x3 / 2,000 Mileage
 4 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x4 / Point Class Decoder x4 / 3,000 Mileage
 5 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x5 / Point Class Decoder x5 / 4,000 Mileage
 6 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x6 / Point Class Decoder x6 / 5,000 Mileage
 7 Days: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + VIP Free Pass (2 Day) all distributed
Notice
 Can only be obtained once per account.
 Returning players are those who have not logged in for 30 days or longer.

Mileage Auction Special Event (9/9 - 9/13) It's a 10,000 Mileage special event, available through the [Event] tab during the Mileage Auction period! Special items priced at 10,000 Mileage will appear periodically.

Time
 Appears four times a day at a time between 16:00 and 17:00 (CEST)/ 21:00 and 22:00 (SEA)
Special Items
 X-TRACKER
 Infinity Laser Fist
 Dual Beretta Gunslinger
 Barrett M95 White Tiger
 Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
 Negev NG-7 Ajax
 Trinity Grenade
 Psychic Harmonium
 Lightning Fury 
 Failnaught
Notice
 After the 10,000 Mileage auction is over, participants who haven't won will have their 10,000 Mileage refunded.
 10,000 Mileage bids can be made 10 minutes after the special auction begins.
 Claim the contents by clicking Obtain after winning the auction.


Shop Update

Transcendence Weapon "Failnaught" Promotion (9/7 - 10/5)The Failnaught can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

Failnaught Drop Rate
 Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9ae7ae80146659b122e91f27dc2ed464032ef586.png
 Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%
Failnaught
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d1188089f47e94861b1086ef08f7e8e8bc13cc2.png
 Failnaught fires 250 holy arrows, automatically aiming at the closest enemies within range of the crosshairs when using the default firing mode. Hitting the same enemy with the default firing mode stacks a mark. Upon reaching 5 stacks, damage is transferred to nearby enemies and the stacks are reset. While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of nearby enemies and attack through obstacles. The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).
Notice
 All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 10/5 (Wed).
 500 mileage will be awarded in return for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed in this manner.
 Transcendence Decoder is always available for sale.
 Transcendence Premium Decoder is available for sale until maintenance on 10/5 (Wed).
 Check for details in Decoder Rates on the web page after 9/7 (Wed) maintenance.

New Transcendence Weapon Failnaught Guaranteed Giveaway (9/7 - 10/5)Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Failnaught (Permanent)!

Conditions and Items
 You will receive a Failnaught (permanent) every time you reach 300 points.
Notice
 6 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
 1 Guaranteed Point is earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 24th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d8fd533abd7ce235fdc4a58131b28624d63fae71.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: Class Auction House Opening
Recruit for perfection! It's the Class Auction update! Go trade for the class that you want at the Auction House now.

Event: New Transcendence Class Promotion Event (8/24 - 9/21)
Immortal Eric and Smile Mary are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders! Go find them now. 

Event: Play every day for rewards every day! (8/24 - 9/7)
Play every day, and earn plenty of rewards! 

Event: TEAM'WAR'K 2GETHER (8/24 - 9/7)
Play Zombie Conquest (beta) during the TEAM'WAR'K 2GETHER! event again to collect TEAMWARK points and earn rewards!
Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------


New Content

Class Auction House Opening (8/24 - 9/13)Recruit for perfection! It's the Class Auction update! Classes can be traded during the event via Auction.

Notice
 Season exclusive classes and some of the recently released classes are ineligible for auction.
 Standard classes and seasonal classes cannot be traded.

New Events

Event: Mileage Auction Event - Class Auction Included (8/24 - 9/13)You can access the auction via the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby during the event.

Auction Feature / Content
 Item Rank
- Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
 Auction Time
- 1 hour for all items
 Number of Auction Listings
- 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
 Regarding the Market Price of Items
- When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
 Item Display
- Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
 Auction Settings
- You can search by bid or direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
 Sell-to-System Feature
- When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
 Auction Hours
- 24 Hours (00:00.00 – 23:59.59) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.
Notice
 The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
 You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
 Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
 If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
 Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
 If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
 The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
 When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
 Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.

Event: TEAM'WAR'K 2GETHER (8/24 - 9/7)Play the Zombie Conquest (beta) during the TEAMWARK TOGETHER! event again, and collect TEAMWARK points to earn rewards!

How to Earn Points
 Earn 1 TEAMWARK point for each kill in the Zombie Conquest (beta) mode (up to 20 points per day) 
Reward
 20 TEAM'WAR'K points: Unique Decoder x3
 60 TEAM'WAR'K points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x9
 100 TEAM'WAR'K points: Event Decoder x3
 140 TEAM'WAR'K points: Class Decoder x3
 200 TEAM'WAR'K points: Transcendence Decoder x3
Notice
 You can earn up to 20 TEAMWARK points a day, and up to 200 during the event period.
 Only rooms with 4 or more players count toward these goals.
 The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.

Play every day for rewards every day! (8/24 - 9/7)Don't forget to play every day during the event, and earn rewards!

Conditions / Rewards
 Reach 60 minutes of playtime in any mode to earn an Event Reward Box (once daily) 
 Reach 30 Kill Points in Zombie mode to earn an Event Reward Box (once daily)
 Reach 100 Kill Points in Zombie scenario on Hard or higher to earn an Event Reward Box (once daily)
Event Reward Box Content (You will have a chance to get one of the items below.)
 Class Decoder
 Class Decoder (x2)
 Rare Decoder
 Rare Decoder (x2)
 Rare Decoder (x3)
 Unique Decoder
 Unique Decoder (x2)
 Premium Unique Decoder
 Event Decoder
 Event Decoder (x2)
 Event Decoder (x3)
Notice
 Can only be claimed three times a day per account.
 Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
 Laboratory Auto Hunt kills do not count for the event.
 At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario Mode missions.
 Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution /  Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Conquest (beta)
 Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
 All unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 9/7 (Wed.)
 The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.

Play every day to keep the rewards rolling! (8/24 - 9/7) Don't forget to play every day during the event to earn Event Reward Boxes! Round up as many as you can for more rewards!

Conditions / Rewards
 3 Boxes: Unique Decoder
 6 Boxes: Rare Decoder x3
 15 Boxes: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
 21 Boxes: Event Decoder x3 + Rare Decoder x2
 27 Boxes: Class Decoder x3 + Rare Decoder x5
 33 Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
 36 Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
Notice
 Can only be obtained once per account.

New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (8/24 - Permanent)
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

Conditions and Items
 Collect all four of Smile Mary, Immortal Eric, Mary's Cube, and Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent) to earn the Psychic medal.
Mary's Cube
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c140031b5703d395384278e798eddabd1b02821b.png

Eric's Hero Helmet
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f4a835f0a083b11575d9ee7e50889e257709539b.png

Psychic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2f331846067c18349036fdb3b34404d82b654a88.png
 Honor Points: 10
 The Psychic medal can be obtained after the 8/24 (Wed) maintenance without event period limit.
 The medal can be obtained only once per account.

Login Supplies Event Guide (8/24 - 9/20)
Login Reward
 Daily Weapons Supply
-Both Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) provided + one of the Transcendence Enhancement or Part equipped Unique weapon (1 Day) randomly provided + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
-Daily Attendance Reward Box : Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
Cumulative Rewards
 5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
 10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
 15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
 20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
 25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
 Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
-Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
Notice
 Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
 Rewards can be claimed immediately after game login, and rewards are available until midnight every day.

Shop Update

New Transcendence Class Promotion (8/24 - 9/21) Two new Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

Immortal Eric
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2be6331296434b42ea9734483d7dee4da00e8535.png
 Background story: After a near-death experience during a zombie attack, his wounds healed up and he returned with an incredible new power. As his superhuman self-recovery rate and physical strength granted him with the resources to compete with the zombies, he willingly fought the undead on the front lines to help others. Fitting his nickname, Immortal, he returns alive every time there is a rumor that he had died. It is known that he is not part of any organizations or groups, but that he does work with Smile Mary.
 Paired Weapon: Death Eater
 Paired Effect: Special Attack ammo recharge rate increase
-Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
 Area duration skill
-(Zombie Scenario) Passive: Passively restores HP and increases Defense
-(Zombie Scenario) Active: Maximizes the HP recovery and Defense increase effects on self and nearby allies
 Connection buff skill
-(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Smile Mary grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
 Add-On Feature
-(Zombie Scenario)  Add-On effect is applied by default, and stacking it will increase only the 10% Decreased Damage effect
Smile Mary
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edcdb8f9cb80746aaf8bd54550a8382e0bc69667.png
 Background story:  As the zombie invasion brought dangers to the everyday lives of the people, some of the general public began to awaken their special abilities. Mary is one of those, having the ability to control the aggression of zombies through psychokinesis, amplify the powers of allies, and control minds. Nobody approaches her as it is said that she could even read the minds of others, but there is a rumor that she sticks with Immortal Eric, another psychic.
 Paired Weapon: Death Eater
 Paired Effect: Special Attack max ammo increase
-Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
 Area duration skill
-Passive: (Zombie Scenario) When you and your nearby allies are hit, this grants a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby
-Active: (Zombie Scenario) Maximizes the effects that grant a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby upon hit
 Connection buff skill
-(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Immortal Eric grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
 Add-On Feature
-(Zombie Scenario)  Add-On effect is applied by default, and using the identical Add-On will stack.

New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (8/24 - 9/21)Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Immortal Eric and Smile Mary) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

Conditions and Rewards
 Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
 Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
 Select one from Immortal Eric + Eric's Hero Helmet or Smile Mary + Mary's Cube
Notice
 1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
 3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
 Selecting Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
 Selecting Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
 Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account. 

Mileage Transfer Coupon Sale Event (8/24 - 11/2)Mileage Transfer Coupons will be sold at 50% off during the event period.

Price Info
 10,000 Mileage Transfer Coupon: 1.00 USD
 50,000 Mileage Transfer Coupon: 5.00 USD

 200,000 Mileage Transfer Coupon: 20.00 USD
Notice

Shop New Items and Changes 
Items for sale changes
 Keith Icahn: 7.80 USD (Permanent) -> 45,000 Points (30 Days) 
 Spade: 7.80 USD (Permanent) -> 45,000 Points (30 Days)
 Blair + Silver Medal Luger: 8.69 USD (30 Days) -> 128,000 Points (30 Days)

 Transcendence Classes from the Mileage Shop once per day.

Decoder Item Update Information 
Relevant Classes
 Isabelle / Gerard / David Black / Alin
4 removed from groups
 Premium Class Decoder
 Class Decoder

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/838a24981604219c685546cb5aea7dc7721cc786.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: New Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Added
Compete as a team in the Zombie Conquest (beta) Update!

Content: Zombie Conquest League Season 1
The first Zombie Conquest League is here! Don't miss out!

Event: New Mode Release Celebration Event (8/10 - 8/24)
Win Zombie Conquest matches for rewards! 

Event: TEAMWARK TOGETHER (8/10 - 8/24)
Play Zombie Conquest (beta) during the event to collect TEAMWARK points and earn rewards!
Check out the Details section below for more information. 


---------- Details ----------


New Content

New Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Release
Zombie Conquest (beta)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/38cb21d6e474728a40d424e6f75b63fa346570de.jpg
 Mode Rules
- Humans earn points by capturing and holding bases, and zombies must prevent them from doing so. Each team will swap between playing as humans and zombies. The team that ends with a higher score wins.
- Humans capture bases by occupying them. Each base has a maximum amount of points that can be earned. If this maximum is reached, the target base will cycle to the next one, and more time is added to the round. Points will be based on how many bases out of the 3 have been captured by the end of the round.
- Base Disruption: Zombies enter bases to disrupt humans from capturing them.

 Human Rules
- Remember, getting hit by zombies hurts. If you get hurt too much, you die!
- Dead humans may revive to rejoin combat after a waiting period.
- For humans, weapon purchases will be restricted depending on base progression.
- All humans will begin combat with the weapons supplied at the first base.
- Once the second base is active, humans can decide whether they will use the unlocked weapons or keep the weapons they currently have.
- When the third base is active, a previously selected ability will be enhanced for humans.

 Zombie Rules
- For zombies, class selection will be restricted depending on base progression.
- You may only use normal zombies in the first base.
- Light Zombie, Stamper, and Banshee are available for use in the second base.
- Heavy Zombie, Voodoo Zombie, Rusty Wing, and Venom Guard are available for use in the third base.

 Awakening
- The Awakening gauge will charge as you play the game, and [V] will activate it.
- The Awakening gauge will charge over time and can be accelerated through combat and capturing bases.
- Awakening is available for both humans and zombies. Humans have a single, uniform effect, while zombies acquire different effects depending on the zombie class in use.

 Additional Info
- Teams will swap each round.
- If the difference in score becomes too large to overcome, the game may end early.

 Notice
- Press [TAB] in game to check current restrictions, selected abilities, and Awakening effects.

New Map Information
Hacienda
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0f16689a7a86e2c156496fa25bfe071549e0a1a3.jpg
 A Latin-style mansion (Available in various modes including Zombie Mode, Conquest (beta), and Team Deathmatch)

Zombie Conquest League Season 1 (8/10 - 10/19) 
Notice
 You can check your league status under My Info.
 You can review the score and weapon information for the top 500 players in the Hall of Fame.
 League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
- Master: top 1%
- Diamond: top 5%
- Platinum: top 10%
- Gold: top 25%
- Silver: top 55%
 Unlike the current League, Conquest League points will increase with wins and decrease with losses.
 Conquest League ranks will be determined by percentile instead of points.
 Increases and decreases in ranks are updated in real-time.
 Unlike the current League, Conquest League rewards are distributed at the end of the League. 
 Rewards will be determined based on your final rank when the League ends.
 Since this is a Trial League, points, ranks, and reward standards are subject to change and may be adjusted mid-League.
Conquest League Rewards
 Master: Zombie Conquest Master Nameplate, 10,000 Mileage Coupon, Devastator (20 Days), Anemone (20 Days), Grade 6 Parts Reward Box x3 
 Diamond: Zombie Conquest Diamond Nameplate, 10,000 Mileage Coupon, Satellite Mine (20 Days), Mirage (20 Days), Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5, Achievement Point 5 Box x2
 Platinum: 5,000 Mileage Coupon, Eternity Laser Fist (20 Days), Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10, Achievement Point 5 Box
 Gold: 5,000 Mileage Coupon, Mummy Stamper (20 Days), Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
 Silver: 1,000 Mileage Coupon, Chef Heavy Zombie (20 Days)


New Events

New Mode Release Celebration Event (8/10 - 8/24)Win a match in the Zombie Conquest (beta)'s new map, Hacienda, for the first time during the event.

Reward
 Guardian Spark x10
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4a1e498447ea68d67620ce65a15c5c046d76c7c0.png
Notice
 Only rooms with 4 or more players count toward these goals.
 Rewards can be claimed once per account.
 All unused Guardian Sparks will be removed and replaced with 15 mileage each during maintenance on 9/7 (Wed).

TEAMWARK TOGETHER (8/10 - 8/24)Play the Zombie Conquest (beta) during the event and collect TEAMWARK points to earn rewards!

How to Earn Points
 Earn 1 TEAMWARK point for each use of the Awakening skill in the Hacienda map (up to 20 points per day)
 Earn 5 TEAMWARK points for completing a match in the Hacienda Map with a family member (up to once per day)
Rewards
 20 TEAMWARK points: Unique Decoder x3
 40 TEAMWARK points: Rare Decoder x10 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
 60 TEAMWARK points: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x9
 80 TEAMWARK points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
 100 TEAMWARK points: Event Decoder x5 + Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
 140 TEAMWARK points: Unique Premium Decoder x3

Notice

 Only rooms of 4 or more players count toward these goals.
 The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.

Part Mania Event (8/10 – 8/24)Complete missions during the event for parts! 

Conditions
 Give 3 compliments after the session ends for Grade 2 Parts Reward Box x5 (up to 3 times a day)
 Win a Zombie Mode round as a human for Grade 2 Parts Reward Box x5 (up to 3 times a day)
 Clear a Zombie Scenario Mode on Normal or higher difficulty for Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x5 (up to 3 times a day)

Notice

Conditions / Rewards

 The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.

Bonus Disassembly Event (8/10- 8/23)You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking the "Bonus Disassembly" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble. One player will receive extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

Details

 Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
 Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
Bonus Disassembly Participation Level Limit Adjusted: Lv. 15
Special Bonus Event

Reward Thresholds
When Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points
Notice
6 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.

Anemone/Mirage Drop Rate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f06c11e59af717ad7e72a67861475ff28d439b99.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84c207a4cc96dcf231630ea97902b74698eb24d4.png
Premium Class Decoder: 2% each
Class Decoder: 0.5% each
Notice
Unused Premium Class Decoders are removed at the end of the event, and are replaced with 50 Mileage each.

Anemone/Mirage Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/6 - 5/4)Get a guaranteed Anemone/Mirage based on the amount of used Premium Class Decoders/Class Decoders!

Reward Thresholds
Reach 150 Guaranteed Points: Choose Anemone or Miracle
Reach 300 Guaranteed Points: Choose Anemone or Miracle
Notice
Get Anemone's Drone upon selecting Anemone and Mirage's VR HMD upon selecting Mirage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a6f6a779ad1343d761212e092587cb55c9b74c7a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/501aa2b8359e81570af1731700fb7db0d4dfbc62.png
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
Rewards from each stage can only be claimed once per account.


Other Miscellaneous Changes
[olist]
 Medals are distributed based on the final rank reached (Master, Diamond) at the end of Zombie League (Official) Season 7.
 Add-On and part rewards added for clearing Zombie Scenario mode.
- Previously, the opportunity to acquire add-ons could only be earned through battles with elite monsters, but with this patch, add-ons are added as a reward for final clearing the zombie scenario map, and differential rewards are made for each map difficulty.
 Elite Zombie Kill Rewards adjusted for Zombie Scenario.
- Added a reward element that randomly distributes 20 of the 12 popular add-ons with high preference.
 Fixes to Agent Ritsuka's Zombie Scenario instant kill or powerful attack class skills.
- Kill count goes up upon killing an Elite Zombie using Agent Ritsuka's "You Think I'm Joking?" skill.
- Damage dealt from Agent Ritsuka's failed "You Think I'm Joking?" skill is applied as a fixed value.
- Fixed issue of skills being activated even while a player is dead.
- Class description added and adjustments made.
 Fixed issue of certain objects sticking out in Hideout mode.
 Fixed issue of sounds not playing for additionally charging the jet pack when the Bear Fury Mk. 3 is charged.
 Fixed issue of a different Season Conqueror Medal effect displaying from the one that's been set by the player.
 Exchanged menu icon on the bottom of the lobby. (Text can be checked by hovering the cursor over.)
 The enhancement success rate displayed in the game is now the same as the actual algorithmic logic.
- Despite the enhancement success rate being calculated down to the second decimal point, the game has been omitting them. This has been changed to reflect the full value.
- An example of the above is when using 10,000 enhancement EXP, the game would show a 0% success rate, but the actual value was 0.n%, resulting in some success cases.
- The enhancement success rate formula is the same as the one that was made public below. 
- Enhancement Success Rate = Cumulative Material EXP / Required Enhancement EXP
Hardware Acceleration has been added to the Video Options menu. Be sure to check it out for improved framerate and smoother gameplay![/olist]
