{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9a89122f5e0eaf7d9d191d723f59c347adcf114a.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: Laboratory Mode Update
The Laboratory is a mode added for pre-release testing, so we hope many of you check it out!

Content: Zombie Mode Update
Check out the new updates from Competitive Matches to Zombie Z!

Content: New Studio Map
Check out the newly created sample map made to showcase mine-themed blocks!

Event: Studio Mine Theme Contest
A new studio contest will take place with the mine-themed Studio block update! We hope many players can participate!

Promotion: New Transcendence Classes Agent Ritsuka, Pop Star Alin (3/10 - 4/6)
Get the Class (Premium) Decoder with 4x rates right now!
Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------

 
New Content

Laboratory Mode UpdateSee [Laboratory Mode Preview] for more details.

Laboratory Mode Added
A Laboratory mode has been added for pre-release game testing. New features and balance changes that require testing will be applied here first, and will proceed to official updates based on player feedback.
March Test Items: Zombie Hero Mode (Italy)
- The number of Host Zombies will increase based on the number of participating players. (Max 5) There is a chance for an additional Host Zombie to spawn if the Auto Zombie Balance option is active.
- Normal Zombie base HP is increased from 15,000 to 18,000.
- The knockback and stun resistance of Zombies are increased.
Notice
Test items added to the Laboratory are subject to change.
You can progress in events in the Laboratory, but you can't earn League Points / progress in missions / add to total stats for Info - Zombie Mode / obtain Accolades.

Zombie Mode Update
Cooperative Match Update
Cost by Rank Changed
- Epic: 15 - 20
- Transcendent: 9 - 14
- Unique: 5 - 8
- Rare: 3 - 4
- Advanced: 1 - 2
- Regular: 0
- Weapons with the same rank may have independent costs.
Zombie Z Update
Weapon Unlock Levels Changed (Previous Unlock Level → New Unlock Level)
- Psychic Harmonium: 32 → 33
- Thunder Force: 34 → 35
- Laevateinn: 34 → 35
- Negev NG-7 Ajax: 30 → 27
- Gran Bird Cannon: 27 → 29
- Vendetta: 8 → 9
- Hunter-Killer X-15: 10 → 11
- Star Chaser SR: 16 → 15
- Magnum Drill: 15 → 14
- M4A1 Dark Knight: 18 → 19
- M4A1 Shadow Knight: 18 → 19
- SCAR OZ-D: 19 → 20
Mutation Changes
- Painful Memories: Decreased damage taken from 50% to 30%.
- Quick Change: "Increases damage of the first attack after swapping" boost effect increased from 800% to 500%.

New Studio Map Information
New [Crystal Cave] Studio Map Released
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c8510c2c4c9807068d34b6150786ac814dc7f59a.png
Description: A background created to display mine-themed blocks. This is a sample map with basic Zombie Escape devices placed.
Studio Mine Theme Block Update
The new mine-themed basic blocks and decorative blocks have been updated.


New Events

Login Supplies Event (3/10 - 4/6)
Daily Rewards
Login Supplies
-Contents: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box
Cumulative Rewards
5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days)
10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days)
15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days)
20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days)
25 Days: Gungnir (10 Days)
Extra Cumulative Rewards Event
Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.

A Sweet Reward Bundle for Completionists! (3/10 - 3/23)Simply play Zombie modes to get Mileage, Decoders, Reward Boxes! Complete the missions below during the event to get various rewards based on total cumulative points.

Missions
3 Points when finishing a round in Zombie Mode as a Human
2 Points when finishing a round in Zombie Mode as a Zombie
5 Points for clearing (completing) a session in Zombie Scenario mode on Very Hard
Total Points - Obtainable Items
40 Points: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
100 Points: Unique Decoder x3
200 Points: Event Decoder x3
250 Points: Event Decoder x5
350 Points: Unique Decoder x15
430 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x3
450 Points: Class Decoder x15
520 Points: VVIP Free Pass (1 Day)
560 Points: 20,000 Mileage + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
Notice
Daily Max Obtainable Points: 40
Eligible Zombie Modes: Zombie Hero, Zombie Z
Does not count Survival: Double Gate, Survival: Lost City, or Survival: Trap Zombie Scenario maps.
For Zombie Scenario Mode, participation will only count when you play at least 5 minutes.
Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
The Event Decoder can be used until before midnight on the day it is obtained.
Laboratory Mode Included

Hello, Rookies! Check Out These Dailies! (3/10 - 3/23)Hello, Rookies! Complete these daily routines in CSNS to get rewards! Log in the next day after completing the past day's routine to get a unique decoder.

Stage / Mission / Obtainable Items
Stage 0: Click Claim Reward from the Login Supplies window - Get 100 Mileage
Stage 1: Click the Missions tab (Check Event) - Get 5,000 Points
Stage 2
- Purchase Point Decoder from the shop - Get Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
- Click on the Exploration tab - Get Exploration Success Rate-Up x1
Stage 3: Play Original / Zombie Scenario / Zombie Z / Zombie Classic / Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Hide and Seek 1 time - Get Rare Decoder x3
Stage 4: Log in (next time) - Get Unique Decoder x1
Notice
This is an event that all players can participate in.
Complete Stage 0 to proceed to Stage 1, and likewise complete Stage 1 to proceed to Stage 2.
You can progress normally from Stage 2 by completing either of the missions.
You can claim the reward for Stage 4 without having to log in consecutively.
Completed stages (missions) are reset every day at midnight.
You can progress until Stage 3 on the maintenance date of 3/23 (Wed).
Laboratory Mode Included

Studio Mine Theme Contest (3/10 - 4/6)Show off your creative skills in this mine-themed Studio contest! Participate now to receive the 1st place prize!

Event Schedule
Application Period: 3/10 - 4/6
Finalists Announced: 5/4
Player Vote: 5/4 - 5/25 (All voting participants will receive 1,000 Mileage)
Winners Announced: 6/2
Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 6/2
How to Participate
Create an original, creative Studio map and leave a comment on the Event Submission page with the following information to participate: (SUBMIT ENTRY HERE!)
- You must add the hashtag '#Mine' to the map title to be accepted.
- You can participate multiple times with multiple maps.
You must include this information in your Event Entry Comment:
- Required: In-game Nickname (IGN), Map Name as it appears in the game, and STEAM ID!
- Optional: Additional information, such as a brief introduction of the map, etc.
Evaluation Criteria
Finalist selection: 20 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, diversity of blocks and scripts used, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
The winners will be selected based on 50% player votes and 50% on CSNS Team’s internal score.
- Entries will be rated based on original aspects and setups, as well as creative use of options.
- Players may make multiple submissions and receive multiple rewards.
Prizes
1st Place: 300 Transcendence Decoders
2nd Place: 200 Transcendence Decoders
3rd Place: 70 Transcendence Decoders
4th - 10th Place: 30 Transcendence Decoders
11th - 20th Place: 20 Transcendence Decoders
Additional Rewards
All Prize Winners: Excellent Creator Medal + Trophy Theme Pack
All Participants: Contest Participation Medal + 5,000 Mileage
Rewards will only be given to maps with a play count of at least 10 and at least 3 recommendations
If you already have the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given
Notice
You must include the #Mine tag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.

Play Laboratory Mode Event (3/10 - 4/6)Reach 30 minutes of playtime in the Laboratory during the event to get 1 Transcendence Decoder.

Reward is given only once per account.

Event EndGuaranteed Transcendence Decoder Rotation Giveaway Event (- 3/23) End Notification


Shop Update

New Transcendence Class Promotion (3/10 - 4/6)During the event, the drop rate of the two new transcendence classes (Agent Ritsuka and Pop Star Alin) from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders is 4x higher.

Decoder / Chance
Premium Class Decoder / 2% each
Class Decoder / 0.5% each
Obtainable Items
Agent Ritsuka
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/acba22b17f89f8b29cd7601cff5a59655fff39c5.png
- Born in Asia, Ritsuka wandered from one war zone to the next and grew up in the midst of battle. She is currently under the employ of Kronos to kidnap or murder those who dare to resist the company. After being placed under heavy scrutiny due to the failed kidnapping of Ji Yoon Choi, she hid her affiliation and personally engages in missions to ensure their success. * This class has changed to the CT team.
- Exclusive Skill: You Think I'm Joking? - The skill activates automatically upon encountering an elite monster in a Zombie Scenario for a chance to instantly kill elite monsters and increase Ritsuka's attack power upon activation.
- The Shadow Blade Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases)
Pop Star Alin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b44c56ab3085b6dea1508d17a6404528c820170.png
- After making her escape with the help of the mercenaries, she couldn't risk revealing herself to the world. Even if she chose to go public, she could be marked for elimination by Kronos and the government agencies that work with them. That's why she chose to hide her identity and adopt the new persona of an idol. Idol by day and terrorist by night, she received a reinforcement request from Victor while out with Dominique to destroy another Kronos factory.
- Exclusive Skill: One, Two, Happiness! - Increases the Movement Speed of self and nearby allies within range. Creates a shield for allies and grants invincibility for self for a set duration.
- The Group Tactics Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases)
- A humming sound has been added when using the Psychic Sizer.

New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (3/10 - 4/6)Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Agent Ritsuka, Pop Star Alin) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

Decoder
Upon Reaching 150 Guaranteed Points
Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points
Obtainable Items
Select Agent Ritsuka or Pop Star Alin
Agent Sunglasses or Pink Crystal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edc166996ada0bb77c0f8cf2126e3c681ebeac98.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/98f653556bc53f959468a87d2af97582965a6e10.png
Notice
1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
Upon selecting Agent Ritsuka, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Agent Sunglasses.
Upon selecting Pop Star Alin, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Pink Crystal.
Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account.

New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (3/10 - Permanent)When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

Condition (Upon Owning All of the Below in Permanent Inventory)
Agent Ritsuka
Pop Star Alin
Agent Sunglasses
Pink Crystal
Obtainable Items
[Honor] Pop Star
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c6b3c6ab08778c8f66713c16fd6e7f81e8553dda.png
A medal given to those who have obtained Agent Ritsuka, Pop Star Alin, Agent Sunglasses, and Pink Crystal.
Notice
[Honor] Pop Star Medal can be obtained after the 3/10 maintenance without event period limit.
The medal can be obtained only once per account.

notes.title: [Notice] New Year’s Greetings from the CSNS Director
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e1998d3a4c6abf93de44bf47ab3aa163d26117d0.jpg

Hello CSNS Fans!

This is the Director of Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio, Jin-hyuk Choi.
Happy New Year!

2021 was a year that taught the Development Team we have a need for new ideas and experimentation.
However it was also a personally disappointing year, as I feel that we failed to meet the expectations of our players.

For 2022, we are setting sights on new development goals. 
Our focus will be to ensure more fun for our players, and increase communication with players through various channels. 

Finally, we've prepared a small gift for all our players who continue to play CSNS during the Lunar New Year period.
We thank you for your continued support for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio, and we will continue to work hard to meet your expectations.

Thank you.
Yours Sincerely, Jin-hyuk Choi


The Director's Small New Year's Gift1 of Each of the Following Decoders + 2,022 Mileage
Rare Decoder, Unique Decoder, Transcendence Decoder, Point Transcendence Decoder, Class Decoder, Class Point Decoder, Epic Decoder, Event Decoder

CSNS Fans!

In 12 days, the last update for the year 2021 will feature the new Season 11 and a new game mode brought to you as “Competitive Match (Beta)!”

Get into the game ahead right now and enjoy the variety of seasonal in-game events while you wait for the big release prepped just for you for the end of this year!

Check out the recent Patch Notes to catch up on the latest contents and events and,
PLAY NOW FOR FREE!

[Brief Sneak Peek]
> New Season 11: Mecha Dino!
The theme for the new season 11 is the world of mechanical dinosaurs - "Mecha Dino!”

From weapons to zombie skins, unique designs that are combined with dinosaur textures and machines will be ready for your excitement!
> New Game Mode: Competitive Match (Beta)!
A new competitive rule for Zombie Mode will arrive!

This new mode can be found in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes and you can expect a much fairer and tenser battle that will not go easy on you.

Competitive Match will rely much more importantly in how you utilize the weapons you have rather than having multiple strong weapons that you can simply sweep with.

This new game mode will depend more of one's skill which will determine the outcome of the game more than any other rule in CSNS!
Ignite the fire within this winter with the coming new game mode, and don’t miss out on any of the seasonal Mecha Dino pass items! See you soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed2fd24f004c33076a9c1fbac7487c3f88891124.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Zombie Scenario Mode Update
Try the new Event Mode update and the new map Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B!

Exploration System Improvement
Check out which of the Exploration System's rewards have been revamped!

Family System Improvement
Check out the new Family System improvements, from achievements to storage!

New Transcendence Class Promotion (12/1 - 12/29)
Meet the new Transcendence Classes, sibling survivors of the Lost City, Roy and Romy!Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------


[New Content]

Zombie Scenario Mode Update
Zombie Scenario New Event Mode Update (12/1 - 12/15)
Random Transformation: End of Madness & Random Transformation: Truth Uncovered
Information: Killing zombies on the event map during the event period grants a chance to drop gene orbs. Earning the orbs (4 types) fills the gauge, and once the orb gauge is full, press the T key to transform into a random monster.
- The 4 types of orbs have a chance to drop from all zombies.
- Earning an orb fills up one tick of the gauge and changes the color of the gauge to that of the orb.
- The more orbs of the same color you collect, the higher your chance of transforming into their respsective monster.\n- Red: Revanant. Green: Yeti. Blue: Dr. Rex. Yellow: Frozen Wrath
- Earning additional orbs after transforming grants a buff that lasts a particular period of time (once per 4 gene orbs).
- If you are having difficulty playing or don't like the selected monster, you can manually cancel the transformation by pressing the T key again.
- While transformed, you will transform back into a human upon death.
- Sitting down after transforming to a monster as certain classes can cause the bottom half of the body to be buried under ground.
New Zombie Scenario Map - Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ccfb304aca5033910307523e9bd59bbe507f390f.png



Exploration System Improvement
Exploration System Rewards Revamped
Rate for exploration start availability changed for each difficulty.
- The difficulty been reduced so the standard class level 1 can run easy difficulty.
Base Reward and Success Reward Changes and Additions
- Base Reward, which is granted regardless of success, now gives a Scenario Add-On and Part.
- For Decoder-related contents (weapons/class) from Success Rewards, it has now been changed to grant unlimited items for a small chance.
Added Exploration Success Rate-Up +10%p item.
- 10%p success rate is added, regardless of the selected difficulty.
- You can buy this item at the Shop with points. An informative pop-up will appear, when you press the Explore button from the Exploration System, and you currently have a Rate-Up item.
Exploration Pileup Progress Event Open
- Points are distributed when you receive exploration rewards.

Family System Improvement
Family Achievement Improvement
Family Rewards Revamped: Changed rewards to fit the current state of the game.
Family Achievement Added: With the addition of new Modes and Scenarios, 9 new achievements have been added.
Quality-of-Life Improvements: You can now exclude the achievements you can't pursue when viewing the achievements, and total points are provided in order to see your overall progress.
Family Storage Improvement
When listing enhancements/parts weapon, the portion listed without the enhancements/parts information can now be used with the enhancements/parts information.
The method of viewing weapon enhancement information and part information in storage (outlines, tooltip, etc.) is now displayed the same way as personal inventory.
Other Information
Added Login rate information of the past week to Family Search List and Main Page.
- This information changes in real-time and it marks your attendance if you log in at least one out of the seven days.
- This information is also available on Family Search, so it can help determine which Family members have actually been active in the past week.
If inappropriate actions are detected in certain gaming environments related to Family Storage, level or count limits can be implemented to limit item listings/usage.
It's been decided that one of the Family Emblems is inappropriate so it's been changed to a different image.

Failnaught
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d46260c66fc4eeedd48032d78e5691009afb0f3.png
 Type: Rifle
 Description: Failnaught, which fires 150 holy arrows, automatically aims enemies within a certain range of the crosshairs when using the default firing mode. (Does not auto-aim if beyond the range.) Hitting the same enemy with the default firing mode stacks a mark, inflicting additional damage each time it stacks. Upon reaching 5 stacks, damage is transferred to nearby enemies and the stacks are reset. While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of enemies within a certain distance and attack through obstacles. The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).
 Taking a body hit with Failnaught's charged shot temporarily inhibits natural recovery.

New Transcendence Class Promotion (10/6 - 11/3)During the event, the drop rate of the two new transcendence classes (Ismael and Ethan) from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders is four times higher!

Ismael
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2ea1cd4116e7eef4dda5e940f2c03f6e105ac469.png
 A human-vampire hybrid, born into a noble family, she has lived her life suffering from discrimination and neglect because of her mixed blood. Her pride as nobility has become a twisted defense mechanism that leads her to sneer at everything. While she appears human, her vampiric blood gives her great physical abilities. She is the sole survivor of her family. Her parents were executed by the inquisitors when the townsfolk sold them out. She has joined a hunter's guild who highly value her abilities, making a living killing those who could be her brothers or sisters.
 Paired Effect: The maximum amount of penetration for Failnaught's charged shot increases.
 Exclusive Skill: Feast of Blood - In Zombie Scenario, she can use this skill to increase the attack power of herself and allies by 30% for 10 seconds, while restoring her HP for 1% of the damage she deals. Infinite Ammo effect is applied during the duration of this buff (herself and allies). Allies within a certain distance get the buff, but the HP restoring skill is only applied to herself.
Ethan
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1fc9bce6fcf7b6f6593b97069def10745a3d5f0b.png
 An inquisitor who eliminates evil and strives to do good. He has eliminated numerous villains, as if to prove actions are worth more than words. His calm voice and handsome appearance have made him very popular. While he looks calm and gentle on the outside, he loses his cool if he makes a mistake or faces an unexpected situation. He has troubled feelings towards Ismael, who has vampire blood despite being a hunter. He watches her closely, waiting for the moment she proves herself evil.
 Paired Effect: The explosion damage for Failnaught's charged shot increases.
 Exclusive Skill: Barrier - In Zombie Scenario, he can use this skill to create a barrier in front of him. He creates a shield for the himself and allies within certain distance, and slows the movement speed of monsters who pass through the barrier.
Ismael / Ethan Common Applications
Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
Paired Weapon: Failnaught
+10% EXP/Points
In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9721224a9e4eb423f1d43ae7108e3a727a7e3712.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Content: Season 10: Steampunk
Grab your gear and begin your journey to a steampunk world that lies on the border between fantasy and reality: a place where past and future coexist!

Content: Zombie Update
From Zombie Z mode unlock level adjustments to mutation balance updates, check out all the changes now!
	
Event: Full Moon Festival
Make fun memories with friends and get massive rewards with all the Moon Festival events!Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------
 
New Content

Season 10: Steampunk
Season Information The tenth season's theme is steampunk! For details, please refer to the Season 10 News Slides!
Black Market Open EarlyStarting with Season 9, the Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
When you reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass currently in progress, the Season Missions will end and missions you can get Black Market Badges from will start anew.
New Item Added: CSN:S-Brand Hip Pack (Costume)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5ef27158549e85af0024d6f4815084730fb0ee22.png
- A CSN:S-brand hip pack. Can be equipped on the waist.
You can access the Black Market from the Mission menu. Players who have not reached Rank 100 can use the Black Market only during the off-season period.
All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear when a new season begins.

Growing Weapon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/470dbcbe7ce9aa93429addde91ec6c89cacffc8b.png
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 1: A powerful cannon that blasts a certain area in front. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 1)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/67feffbd0e331d246ce194da1fe59acaa0e3c533.png
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 2: This powerful weapon can have the Gear-Bird on its muzzle transformed. Fire the cannon at the moment the transformation ends to make the Gear-Bird fly ahead of you, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 2)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6a6af5587bb0acf832d6e16674709b9a4f197f84.png
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 3: This powerful cannon discharges a huge blast of energy, which damages nearby enemies, when the Gear-Bird on its muzzle has finished transforming. Fire the cannon at that moment to make the Gear-Bird fly ahead of you, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 3)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2512f224871612ced5997c6ce0c96084c962f537.png
- Gran Bird Cannon: This powerful cannon discharges a huge blast of energy, which damages nearby enemies, when the Gran Bird on its muzzle has finished transforming. Fire the cannon at that moment to make the Gran Bird fly ahead of you, not only damaging and knocking back enemies in its path, but also leaving flames in its wake, dealing damage for a certain amount of time afterwards. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 4)

Zombie Costumes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a40136297caaf20a537cb02a7f59bb197e81bed8.png
 - Armored Soldier Ganymede: Able to use Armored Soldier Ganymede. (Season 10 Reward Zombie Skin)

Weapon Paints

- Clockwork Weapon Paint (Glock 18C, SKULL-9, Shining Heart Rod, Ripper, and Lightning Fury)

Costume

Spray

Medal

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e97f431a7f4f19efbd9954aa3601485b00d19144.png
- Season 10 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)

Zombie Content Update
Zombie Z Mode Unlock Levels Adjusted

Mutation Balance UpdatesExplosive Ammo: Lv. 1 explosion damage has been adjusted from 35% of weapon attack power to 20%; Lv. 2 explosion damage has been adjusted to 100% of weapon attack power.
Contact Infection: Base range value was adjusted from 1.15 to 0.3 (radius); per-round range increase value was changed from 0.05 to 0.1.
Penetrating Rounds: Armor penetration rate has been adjusted from 1.35 to 17.5.
Claw Enhancement: Claw Enhancement mutation's Lv. 2 base range multiplier has been changed to 24; range multiplier for when using Claw Enhancement Mutation Boost has been changed to 60.
Aggressive Investment: Additional dollar rewards obtained from infecting humans has been adjusted from 50% to 75%.
Fetch: Lv. 2 Zombie Dog HP has been changed to 1,500.
Notice:
- Explosive Ammo mutation's Lv. 2 base performance has been improved.
- Contact Infection mutation's damage radius now starts at a greatly reduced value. However, the radius increases as the rounds progress. The radius in the final round, round 17, is the same as before the update (= 2).
- The Penetrating Rounds mutation's armor piercing rate has been increased, allowing you to damage on zombies more effectively than before.
- With the Claw Enhancement mutation's adjustments, the basic attack range of zombies with this mutation has been slightly increased.
- With the Aggressive Investment mutation's adjustments, the bonus dollars the zombie with this mutation receives from the infected target has been increased to 75%.
- The HP of the Zombie Dog summoned by the Fetch Lv. 2 mutation has been increased by 50%.

New Content and Events have been added!


New Content

Information Accessibility and Player Quality-of-Life ImprovementsMade improvements to areas that were inconvenient or lacking in information about the game. Also updated areas that can help players make the best use of the game’s features, as below. You can find details in the [Convenience Feature Updates and the Mission Chain System Preview].

Hideout ImprovementsHideout's base mode is changed to Zombie Z.
Updates include adjustments to the Firing Range features, command help, expansion of the space next to the Firing Range, etc.
Encyclopedia Various sorting filters, including Zombie Z unlock level, have been added.
Information on parts, enhancement, ratings, etc. has been fleshed out.
Event/Season Missions Unified Under the Missions Page Event details, which had previously been split between the Notifications page and the Missions page, have been unified under the Missions page.
Mission Chain System - Tutorial Mission AddedAdded the Mission Chain system, consisting of 25 guides and 25 missions.
You can only clear one Mission Chain stage (5 guides and 5 missions) per day.
Per-Stage Completion Rewards
- Stage 1: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)
- Stage 2: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent)
- Stage 3: Transcendence Yuri (Permanent)
- Stage 4: Claymore (Permanent)
- Stage 5: Python Desperado (Permanent)
Mission Chain Final Completion RewardsHunter-Killer X-12 (Permanent) + Complete the Guide Medal
NoticeThe table above only shows the stage rewards and the final rewards. There are also interim rewards for checking out the guides, as well as rewards for completing the individual missions.
Complete the Guide MedalType: Medal
Description: A token for those who have completed all the missions of the Mission Chain tutorial


New Events

Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/25 - 9/8)During this event, you can play the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! Blast your foes with new weapons, popular weapons, and even +6 weapons! Test your luck!

Featured Maps: Italy, Assault, and Dust
New Weapons: Blazing Nova, Twin Shadow Axes, Astra, Satellite Mine, Blue Storm, Devastator, and Elemental Tracker
Notice: When you're on the Zombie Team, your zombie class will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each class.
When you're on the Human Team, each of your primary weapons, secondary weapons, melee weapons, and grenades will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each weapon/grenade.
Base game rules are the same as those for Zombie Hero mode.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5de839959ecc67f0b3a4ec67ed7e7324fefe1599.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Content: New Zombie Scenario 7-4 Map
David and Erica learn the truth. Check out the next chapter of the story right now!

Content: Studio Zombie Scenario Features
A mysterious benefactor drives Gerard to his limits. Track him down in Researcher's Log #7!
	
Content: Zombie Z Season 2 Content Update
From mutation balancing to gameplay experience improvements — check out all the changes!See the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------
 
New Content

Zombie New Scenario 7-4 Map{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/65697c7959978a96b439598e2c014daf0979f66a.png
Pursuit: Truth Uncovered
 Information: David and Erica travel to the coordinates they found in the laboratory. When they arrive, they meet Gerard instead of Dr. Soi. Gerard tells them about the man behind Rex: Douglas, who was also behind Erica's abduction. After learning the truth, David and Erica find new resolve, even while Douglas' forces draw ever closer...

 For more details, see the [Zombie Scenario Season 7-4 Preview].

Studio Zombie Scenario Features
Studio Zombie Scenario Update Play Mode rules added: Level Rules and Difficulty Rules
 Device added: Cutscene Camera device, Ranking Board features expanded
 For more details, see the [Studio Zombie Scenario Update Preview].
Researcher's Log #7: The Search
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/052a5075e71378c0bd5458e7349649cd33a88444.png
 A mysterious figure with unknown motives approaches Gerard. Calling himself a friend, the figure drives Gerard to his limits... Track down this mystery man to learn his intentions and identity!

Zombie Z Season 2 Content Update
Mutation Balance Updates
 Rapid Reloader: Lowered the value added per round, so that the number of rounds it takes for auto-reload to trigger is now 17 rounds
 Gene Booster: Now guaranteed to get at Zombie Z Lv.30
 Endurance: Activation rate now increases when you upgrade Endurance to Lv. 2
 Incendiary Ammo: Increased the base damage of the fire that the Incendiary Ammo creates
 Contact Infection: Greatly reduced the base range, and removed the stun effect, for Contact Infection damage, but revised it so that it now increases in range as the round progresses.
 Drop Zone: Reduced the chance to make an enemy in the air fall
 Support Bombardment: Increased the chance for Support Bombardment to trigger
 Explosive Reaction: Reduced the increase, as the round progresses, in the damage required to create a Zombie Bomb
 Fireball: Increased the base damage; when Mutation Boost is activated, burst now fires 2 Fireballs
 Bomb Defense: Greatly increased the knockback resistance against Zombie Bomb; additionally, if you have the Bomb Defense mutation, it now reduces the screen shake from Zombie Bomb
 Supply Contamination: Increased the number of supply boxes you can infect
 Furiously Fast: Increased the remaining HP threshold for the mutation to activate, as the round progresses
 Poisonous Cloud: Increased the damage and duration, removed stun effect
 Darkness: Increased the skill gauge charge amount for Darkness Zombies
 Intellectual: Increased humans’ EXP rewards for zombie kills
Mutation Distribution Method Changes Intellectual: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 1 (if zombie revival restriction is applied)
 Specialist: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 1 (if zombie infinite revival is applied)
 Fanatic: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 20
 Gene Booster: Now guaranteed to be given at Zombie Z Lv.30
Reinforced Challenge Reward + RewardsIncreased the dollar, EXP, and Karma rewards from eliminating zombies with a weapon purchased through Challenge Reward +
- Kills: 20,000 dollars, 10,000 EXP, and 2x Karma
- Assists: 4,000 dollars, 1,500 EXP, and 2x Karma
Revamp of “Automatically Improve Zombie” Balance settingsAutomatically Improve Zombie Balance settings will be applied by default. Details are as follows:
For rooms with 30 or more players, the number of Host Zombies spawned will be 4
If the Human Team wins, 1 additional Host Zombie will spawn in the next round
When meeting the following conditions, 1 additional Host Zombie will be spawned:
- ① Human Team wins 2 times in a row
- ② Human Team's cumulative winning rounds are 4 rounds or more
- ③ Final round (The number of additional Host Zombies spawned will not exceed 2. Based on a 32-player room, the max Host Zombie count per round will be limited to 6.)
Reduced Zombie Respawn TimeIn the event of a death after Detoxification Time, the respawn time has been reduced from 8 sec to 3 sec.
Gameplay Experience ImprovementsMade improvements to the excessive effects when being hit by weapon attacks, alleviating the vision-blocking effects of being hit when you play as a zombie.
Added the Z, X, and C keys as available options for the Zombie Mode skill bar.

Game Guide System Revamp Information
Hideout Improvements Added Zombie Z and allowed freely testing mutations
 Added a weapon command guide
Check latest trending weapon information


New Studio Zombie Scenario Map EventResearcher's Log #7: The Search is a tutorial-type sample map with expanded features for the existing Play Mode, allowing for Zombie Scenario presentation options such as levels and difficulty. When you meet the requirement below in this map, you will receive the following reward:

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0c8eed56017ef6d433e8a8b97d2aee5a6eea145e.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Content: Zombie Z Season 2 Update
The evolution continues! Achieve greater power in Zombie Z!

Content: Mileage Auction System Improvements
New options for people looking to buy weapons!
	
Event: Get the New Weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)
Collect Special Ammo and unlock the new weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)!

Promotion: New Transcendence Classes, Anemone & Mirage
One's a pro gamer, the other is an iconic virtual streamer (and hacker) from the VR platform Chrono World. Now available in Premium Class Decoders!Check out the Details section below for more information.


---------- Details ----------
 
[New Contents]

Zombie Z Season 2 Update
System Revamp
Max level increased from 30 to 40!
Zombies get greater dollar rewards for dealing damage and infecting targets.
Boosted in-game rewards for playing as a zombie.
- Fixed an issue that prevented a zombie from getting dollar rewards for damage dealt immediately before being killed.
Mutation Improvements
Mutation Enhancement
- Certain mutations can now be enhanced to Lv. 2. Each player can have up to 5 Lv. 2 mutations.
- Press the P key to upgrade one random mutation to Lv. 2. The upgraded mutations will display in the HUD. Each upgrade costs in-game dollars.
- If you already have 5 Lv. 2 mutations, the newly upgraded mutation will randomly replace one of your existing Lv. 2 mutations.
Mutation Boost System
- Mutation Boost lets you temporarily amplify the effects of a Lv. 2 mutation. Mutation Boost lasts for 5 seconds and has a 30 second cooldown.
Added new mutations and improved existing mutations.
- [All] Early Adopter: Reduces all unlock levels by 1.
- [All] Discount Coupon: All purchase amounts in dollars are discounted by 10%.
- [Humans] Quick Change: Increases weapon swap speed.
- [Humans] Double Impact: Grants a low chance to apply damage one additional time.
- [Humans] Net Round: Grants a small chance for attacks to fire a net round.
- [Humans] Glass Cannon: Increases attack power, but also increases damage taken.
- [Humans] Busy Life: Increases attack power when you cannot use skills.
- [Humans] Emergency Escape: Escape into the air after taking what would have been a lethal blow.
- [Zombies] Mutant: Zombie gains an additional skill.
- [Zombies] Furiously Fast: Zombie becomes faster when its HP is low.
- [Zombies] Poisonous Cloud: Creates a cloud of lethal gas when a zombie dies.
- [Zombies] Aggressive Investment: Gain bonus dollars from infected targets.
- [Zombies] Hook Bomb: When a Zombie Bomb explodes, it pulls enemies in.
- [Zombies] Liberator: Increases your strength as you infect more humans.
- [Zombies] Fetch: Inflicting damage with a Zombie Bomb creates a zombie dog.
- [Zombies] Darkness: Allows rebirth as a Darkness Zombie.
- [Changed] Craftsmanship: Reduces skill cooldown.
The zombies from Zombie 4: Darkness now appear in Zombie Z.

Weapon purchase process and other gameplay improvements
Added a recommended weapons page that shows recommended weapons for your level.
- This page appears where Bookmark used to be displayed in the purchase window.
Check Weapon Recommendations system improvements
- Recommendations will be sorted and shown in the order of monthly purchase counts in Zombie Z mode, from high to low.
Random Purchase improvements
- Challenge Reward + is added to Random Purchase. When you score kills with the weapon that is purchased, you will receive additional rewards.
- This bonus only applies to weapons purchased with Random Purchase (Challenging Reward +) early in the round. It ends when you swap weapons, if you get infected, or when the round ends.
Advanced Random Purchase improvements
- Reduced the weapons pool for Advanced Random Purchase, increasing its usability.
Added a checkbox to close the purchase window
- Added the option to toggle closing the purchase window pop-up on or off.
HP bar display for attack target
- An HP bar will display for any enemy you hit directly and any enemy you target with your crosshair for 2 seconds or longer.

Mileage Auction System ImprovementYou can now place buy orders when you want to purchase a weapon
- Looking to Buy tab: Choose a weapon and list the price you want to buy it for.
- Eligible weapons: Regular auctionable items that haven't had any successful transactions in a while.
- Bidding: Potential sellers can browse bids in the Looking to Sell tab.
- The auction runs for 1 hour after the buy listing is posted. One seller is chosen from among those who offered to fulfill the bid and the transaction is completed.
- If the number of sellers exceeds a certain threshold within the 1 hour limit, the auction will end early.

New Transcendence Class Medal DistributionWhen you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

Welcome to the 2nd Round of the CSNS Official Discord Launch Celebration Event!

As many of you already know, Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio has finally opened its very own official Discord server last month! Since then, 2,245 Survivors (and counting...) have joined us at our Discord and in light of our launch and event, they have won 65 Transcendence Decoders each! To give those who yet haven't joined our new community, as well as for our Discord members to invite more of their friends and families, we have brought round 2 of milestones and Transcendence Decoder rewards! So do not miss this chance! Check out the details to the event below and collectively win a total of 65 Transcendence Decoders each! As always, thank you for your love and support and enjoy the new Season!

- The CSNS Team

What: 2nd Round of Discord Launch Celebration Event

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 20th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/eb469470628f3c82204ab355b75b2077542468b5.jpg

[previewyoutube=Xr5SURj6AhY;full][/previewyoutube]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Content: Season 9: Fantasy World
In CSN:S' ninth season, fantasy world we invite you to explore a fantasy world full of adventures!

Content: League Season 5
The official league returns for a brand new season, Season 5!
	
Content: Zombie Content Update
From the revamped Zombie Limit option to the updated Lobby UI, check out these new changes!

Content: Inventory Improvement
The inventory system has been improved tooltips to extra information!Check out the Details section below for details.



Details

New Contents

Season 9: Fantasy WorldIn CSN:S' ninth season, fantasy world we invite you to explore a fantasy world full of adventures!

1. Season Pass ChangesSeason Pass Reward Revamp
  - Starting with Season 9, Season Pass rewards have been revamped.
  - You'll now receive rewards for each rank of the Free Pass. For details, please refer to the reward table below.
  - You can now check the remaining uses and duration of reward items from the Season Pass reward screen.
Black Market Early Access
  - Starting with Season 9, the Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
  - When you reach Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, the Season Missions will terminate, and you'll get access to new missions rewarding Black Market Badges.
  - You can access the Black Market from the [Mission] menu. Those who have not reached Rank 100 can only use the Black Market during the off-season.
  - All Black Market Badges you've obtained will vanish when a new season begins.
2. Season InformationA 'season' is a reward system that runs for a set period of time. Complete missions and events during a Season to earn Season Badges which raise your Season Rank. You'll receive rewards based on your rank throughout the season.
3. Season RankSeason Ranks indicate how much progress players have made participating in missions and events in the game. You'll earn various rare rewards when you increase your Season Rank. Season Rank and Season Badges are specific to their respective season.
4. Season RewardsRewards are immediately distributed as you achieve new ranks each season.
If you purchase a Season Pass, you'll get the Season Pass rewards in addition to the free rewards.
Starting with the Season 9 Pass, season rewards will no longer be limited-time items.
Growing Weapons: When you receive a weapon's new stage (from 1-4), you will get to keep the previous stage of the weapon.
  - 1. Wind Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a73f78f8a53a0b5d362ba2042b851a40d87bd5a4.png
This rifle is enchanted with wind magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 2 guided wind missiles upon exiting the scope view.

  - 2. Fire Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 2 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/28e92ee4d1a9ce5872c14e429458395e499048f1.png
This rifle is enchanted with fire magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 4 guided flame missiles when you leave sniper mode.

  - 3. Lighting Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 3 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c034f842dc932684cd6a5e92e48fdf0886f21411.png
This rifle is enchanted with lightning magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 6 guided lightning missiles upon exiting the scope view.

  - 4. Elemental Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 4 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7bfd9f17483da540c2297f5168bf329e9767a6a9.png
This rifle is enchanted with the magic of multiple elements. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 10 guided elemental missiles upon exiting the scope view. Press the Forward Arrow Key twice while holding down the Shift Key to change elements.

Zombie Costumes
  - 1. Orc Warrior Deimos: Season 9 Reward Zombie Skin 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a21d38e457eba366f9c91f483b977f7f9c1e9a12.png
Allows you to change the appearance of your Deimos Zombie to that of an Orc Warrior.

  - 2. Dark Elf Witch Banshee: Season 9 Reward Zombie Skin 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5cc49339ba5506a31cf97ecf870dfd1d2da9bbbb.png
Allows you to change the appearance of your Banshee Zombie to that of a Dark Elf Witch.

Weapon Paints
  - 1. Dragon Knight Weapon Paint (Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, Rail Cannon, SG550 Commando, Warhammer Storm Giant, Air Buster) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/eca55e8b6fd31e3e5a9c89e729de8e9fcb5c405a.png
The 5 Season 9 Reward Weapon Skins

  - 2. High Elf Weapon Paint (Desert Eagle, Hunter-Killer X-12, Broad Divine, Vendetta, Spell Lance Scarlet Rose) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6ad87a1b1a2d8841b126bd8ed66096cbc17b94b.png
The 5 Season 9 Reward Weapon Skins

Costumes
  - 1. Dragon Knight Helmet, Seelie Tiara, Dragon Wings, Seelie Wings, Dragon Pet, and Forest Sprite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/535f2c63885efe845849fea029e66227a2abd3fd.jpg
Season 9 Reward Costumes - 6 Fantasy-themed Outfits 

Sprays
  - 1. Orc Warrior Deimos Spray, Dark Elf Witch Banshee Spray, Dragon Knight Kyrix Spray, High Elf Natasha Spray, Fantasy World Spray 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4f41b114c045484dccc8b7818e146d2f80d71a61.jpg
Season 9 Reward Sprays - 5 Fantasy-themed Sprays. Fantasy World Sprays display a special effect when used.

Medals
  - 1. Season 9 Trailblazer Medal (Pass)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/860db249db04854404d9161091362a2f697dedd7.png

  - 2. Season 9 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b95265f3834513f84a3b24162062384bb98717c.png
Season 9 Conqueror medal displays a special effect when equipped.

League Season 5
1. League Season 5: The official league has reopened for Season 5.

2. Changes (Compared to previous trial leagues)As we enter the new league period, the scores required to advance to each rank are changing.
  - Master: Top 100 players -> No Change
  - Diamond: 2700 -> 4000
  - Platinum: 1500 -> 2000
  - Gold: 750 -> 1000
  - Silver: 300 -> No Change
The following previous league rewards were limited to the previous season, and will be removed. Achievement Point Box items will be added to the league rewards.
  - Zombie League Nameplate/Zombie League Spray
Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
  - 4 new nameplate items added: (Venom Sting Nameplate, Cluckin' Chicken Nameplate, (Animated) Pursuit Nameplate, and Violet Spot Nameplate)
When handling individuals who have tied for league points, the first player to reach that point total will now take precedence. This may affect the overall rankings.
It is no longer possible to get Zombie Scenario League Points from the following maps:
  - Double Gate, Lost City, Survival: Trap, and Survival: Groundwater
Starting with the new official league, a "rest" period will be added after each league ends, as is currently the case with seasons.
3. The League Fairness Monitoring System has been implementedA monitoring system has been implemented that checks in real-time for behaviors deemed atypical of normal gameplay. A penalty will be applied to obtaining Points and EXP (including League Points) for repeat offenders.
You can now view your league status under My Info.
You can now review the score and weapon loadouts for the top 500 players in the Hall of Fame.
League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
* Master Rank can only be achieved through competition. You may drop down to Diamond Rank when competing within Master Rank.
* There are no player count restrictions for obtaining League Points, however you will receive greater bonuses when playing with more people.
* You cannot obtain League Points in private rooms with a password set.
* You cannot obtain League Points if abnormal activity or cheating is detected, such as:
  - Inactivity and non-participation, as well as for killing or infecting inactive players.
  - Abnormal activity pertaining to Studio devices or map structures.
4. Zombie League RewardsMaster: Zombie League Master Zombification + Holy Sword Divine Order (20 Days) + Kalael (20 Days) + Medea (20 Days)
Diamond: Achievement Point Box x2 + Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Private Erica (20 Days) + Female Student Light Zombie (20 Days)
Platinum: Achievement Point Box x1 + Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Nurse Venom Sting (20 Days)
Gold: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Mummy Stamper (20 Days)
Silver: VIP Free Pass (20 Days) + Chef Heavy Zombie (20 Days)
Bronze: None
Notice:
  - Zombie League Master Zombification: Changes the revival effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode. It is removed when the season ends or your rank drops.
  - The zombification is distributed to those of Master Rank, and is removed if your rank drops or the season ends.
5. Zombie Scenario League Rewards[list[Master: Holy Sword Divine Order (20 Days) + Titan's Will Add-On x100 + Grade 6 Parts Reward Box x3
Diamond: Achievement Point Box x2 + Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Weakness Analysis Add-On x75 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
Platinum: Achievement Point Box x1 + Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Tide Turner Add-On x50 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
Gold: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Reinforced Attack Add-On x20
Silver: VIP Free Pass (20 Days) + Capital Add-On x20
Bronze: None
6. Achievement Shop: Added 4 new nameplate items as achievement productsVenom Sting Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/55c26e693e46b5595164e98dddc486472711fc7e.png

Cluckin' Chicken Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c33fd42b48f754b86741ab1e2d5e30d32d6c2641.png

(Animated) Pursuit Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a56b3473b9ef62f462cc3bc4c072811cf19a4075.png

Violet Spot Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b5538467d017b7c6cbfca7e242debff6e0c92b7.png

Zombie Content Update
1. Zombie Limit option updateNew limit option added: Aside from Normal Zombies, each Zombie can be used only once per round per player. If only Normal Zombies are remain as available zombies, their HP, Armor, Defense, and HP Recovery will increase.
  - HP and Armor: +3000/Defense: +10%/HP Recovery: +300
Individual zombie limit changed: Increased the max number of individual zombie limits to 4. If you set individual zombie limits, the HP, Armor, Defense, and HP Recovery of all zombies will increase in proportion to the maximum number of zombies.
  - 1 limit: HP and Armor: +0/Defense: +0/HP Recovery: +0
  - 2 limits: HP and Armor: +1000/Defense: +0/HP Recovery: +50
  - 3 limits: HP and Armor: +2000/Defense: +3%/HP Recovery: +100
  - 4 limits: HP and Armor: +3000/Defense: +5%/HP Recovery: +200
2. Zombie Karma updateZombie Stage 2 Karma: Upon using Karma, immediately transforms into a hero zombie class and becomes invincible for 6 sec.
Zombie Stage 3 Karma: Upon using Karma, die and then revive as human after 3 sec. Can only be used after virus detoxification. (If all zombies revive as humans, the round ends in a Human Team victory.)
3. Zombie balance update (skill update)Normal Zombie: Damage taken during Berserk reduced from 150% → 140%
Deimos: Shock cooldown increased from 12 sec -> 15 sec
Metatron: Movement Speed increases by 10% while using Immortality
Psycho: Smokescreen's damage reduction amount reduced from 75% → 65%; Smokescreen cooldown increased from 15 sec → 20 sec; duration per each Smokescreen increased from 1.5 sec → 2 sec
Jiangshi: Invincibility duration reduced from 5 sec → 4sec; invincibility cooldown increased from 15 sec → 18 sec
Aksha: Absorb cooldown reduced from 20 sec → 16 sec, Knockback Resistance slightly increased
Chaser: Defense slightly increased
Rusty Wing: Defense slightly decreased 
4. Zombie Z ContentIf the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, the Adaptability mutation will not appear.
Fixed mutation added: Adaptability will be fixed as the 26th mutation given. (If the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, you will get a different mutation.)
Mutation Changes
  - Contact Infection: Changed so that the damage inflicted is in proportion to the max HP of the targeted human player
  - Endurance: Changed the default activation rate from 1% → 1.5%
  - Armored Advance: Defense increase per round - 1.5% → 1%
  - Speedy Crouch: Default Movement Speed increase - 50 → 40; Movement Speed increase per round - 5 → 6
5. Lobby UI changeWith the Zombie Limit change, the limit setting UI has been updated.
The "Death>Kill Rule" option has been moved under Extra Room Settings.
The "Remove Zombie Permanent Death" option has been moved under the room settings.

Inventory Improvement
1. Inventory InformationYou can now see information pertaining to the remaining slots in your inventory.
The slot information displayed will not include inventory information that the player cannot manage directly, such as for PC cafe or VIP pass.
From the inventory's model view, can now toggle the UI on/off by right-clicking the mouse icon on the top right of the model view.
* There may be instances where Default items do not take up inventory slots, depending on how they are distributed. There may also be cases where items are distributed on the system level but do not appear in the inventory. Thus, the actual number of slots available differ slightly from what is displayed.
2. Disassembly InformationWhen you disassemble items in the disassembly page, icons will show which inventories are affected.
Icon information: Weapons, Parts, Craft, Classes, Costumes, and Items
The number of items you can disassemble at once has been increased from 9 to 99.
A filter feature that allows you to check per each inventory category will be provided on the right of Select Items for Disassembly.
* However, since there are minimum disassembly requirements, you can only change to quantities designated for each item.
You can also batch-apply with Ctrl + drag or Ctrl + double-click.
3. Pop-Up InformationAdded a feature to display icons in the Item Acquired pop-up, so that you know which inventory you need to make space in. You can see which inventory it will apply towards when your inventory is full.

Season Pass Reward RenewalStarting from Season 9, the Season Pass rewards and distribution method have been revised!

Season Pass Reward Distribution ChangesDistribution method changed from Season Random Box -> guaranteed item (individual item)
Distribution method changed from Grades 3-4 Parts Random Boxes -> guaranteed item (individual item) sorted in the order of high player preference
Distribution method changed from Grade 5 Parts Random Box -> guaranteed item (individual item) sorted in the order of release date
The Mileage Box is a fixed reward, kept the same as before.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc3fa6b220d44444e64bf5c917891a44d61d82eb.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Content: Daily Mission Revamp
Daily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season!

Content: Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements
Zombie Scenario is back with even more improvements.
	
Content: Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario Maps
Introducing an even new level of difficulty: Abyss! Monsters are tougher, stronger, and faster. Are you up to the challenge?

Promotion: New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/21 - 6/2)
Meet the 2 new classes now available from Class/Premium Class Decoders!Check out the Details section below for details.



Expanded Info
 
New Contents

Daily Mission RevampDaily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season! For more details, please refer to the Daily Mission Revamp Preview.

There are now 3 types of Daily Missions.Instead of choosing from many missions, now you just need to complete the 3 set missions.
Daily Missions won't reset until you've completed them.
Completed Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.
Significant changes have been made to the Reset Daily Mission items.This item has been renamed to Daily Mission Difficulty Change.
Using a Daily Mission Difficulty Change allows you to change a mission to high, normal, or low difficulty.
When you change a mission's difficulty, you'll keep any progress you've already made. Use this when the going gets tough!
The Black Market is open for business.Before each new season begins, the Black Market will be open.
Get Black Market Badges from Daily Missions and use them to buy items.

Black Market Badge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/34ae41fa94bd08003dbb24f671b9ab27416f512f.png
  - Type: Item
  - Description: Collect these badges and exchange them for items from the Black Market.
  - All Black Market Badges will disappear when a new season starts.

CSN:S Brand Backpack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c23595142ef1a9cb079dfbacc5c99da57630b881.png
  - Type: Costume
  - Description: A CSN:S brand backpack. Can be equipped on the back.

Black Market Items
  - Red Baron Weapon Paint (Permanent): Black Market Badge x300
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1362c3f79e90de84f5e60b30c6631904bf75a13b.png
  - CSN:S Brand Backpack: Black Market Badge x300
  - Spring Flower Nameplate (3 Days): Black Market Badge x90
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5faec65b72a08a28fa360fcb7a1f90fd124390ef.png
  - Spring Flower Font (1 Day): Black Market Badge x30
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bda72203caacc3d55bd399b4d570bf406cfa4f63.png
  - Lusty Rose (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - SAF Scout (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Dragon Tattoo (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Tiger Tattoo (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Daily Missions will award Season Badges during a season and Black Market Badges during the off-season!

Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements 2
New Add-Ons and Balance ChangesNew Add-Ons
  - Veteran's Help: When you equip this Add-On and drop a weapon on the ground on Very Hard or higher difficulty, the weapon will remain on the ground without disappearing. Only up to 1 weapon will remain.
  - Deft Movement: Grants a chance not to take damage when hit by an attack.
  - Abundant Returns: Obtain 1 additional Add-On after defeating elite monsters.
  - Healer: Whenever you heal yourself, nearby allies are also healed for a portion of the healing effect's value.
  - Revenger: Increases attack power each time an ally dies.
  - Group Tactics: Reduces damage taken for each nearby ally player.
  - Steel Physique: Increases maximum HP.

Add-On Balance Changes
  - Ammo Reserves - Activation Rate: 5% → 7%
  - Reinforced Attack - Base Damage: 120 → 100
  - Quick Rejoining - Cooldown Reduction: 12% → 15%
  - Addict - Cooldown Reduction: 6 sec → 10 sec
  - Nouveau Riche - Base Dollar Obtained Increase: 150% → 200%
  - Trap Evasion - Activation Rate: 25% → 30%
  - Giant's Feet - Base Damage: 250 → 300

Map Playlist Automatic Add-On Feature
  - When the map changes while you play a Map Playlist, your most recent Add-Ons will keep being used repeatedly until the Map Playlist ends. If you use up all of an Add-On in the middle of a Map Playlist, the other Add-Ons that you haven't used up will continue to be used.
Elite Monster Balance ChangesMonster Stat/Enhancement Effect Balance Adjustments
  - Attack Power Increase: Reduced the amount this increases the monster's attack power.
  - Spider Web: Weakened the movement speed reduction.

New Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario
New Zombie Scenario Difficulty AddedAdded the Abyss difficulty.
Abyss is an even higher difficulty than the existing Inferno difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Probability Item Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg

Greetings from the Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio Team!

We provide the rates for probability-based items on Steam and our website. In order to keep providing transparent service for our players, we're also releasing rates for the weapon enhancement system and season pass rewards below.

To begin, here is information on weapon enhancements and their rates.

Weapon enhancement is an in-game system that allows you to improve your weapons by enhancing them. Enhancement requires you to consume your spare weapons as "material" to upgrade the desired weapon. Both paid and free weapons can be spent using this system.


[Weapon Enhancement System]Every enhancement attempt grants EXP towards your weapon's enhancement level. The EXP needed per level is listed in the first table below.

Each material weapon grants a certain amount of EXP based on its rank and enhancement level. Formulas for how this EXP is calculated are included in the second table, with several examples after that.
EXP Needed per Enhancement

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e841ed0eddb47a681999977fbd565826acaf41aa.png
Accumulated material EXP is reset after increasing enhancement level or failing enhancement.

The success rates are calculated according to the below formula, based on the cumulative material EXP and the required enhancement EXP.

Enhancement Success Rate = Cumulative Material EXP / Required Enhancement EXP

Each weapon has a different enhancement material EXP per weapon rank, from Regular to Epic. This is defined in the next table.
Enhancement Material EXP per Weapon Rank/Enhancement Level

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cebf5d6898d8121a4d8b501c219ad7c0b751586c.png
If the material weapon is the same as the weapon you're enhancing, you'll get a 100% EXP bonus on top of the base enhancement EXP.
Example: Material EXP for Rare Weapon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f4ce8701de093254d8165924afafe402c12130e5.png
As illustrated above, materials with higher enhancement levels provide more EXP. Bonuses are rounded down to whole numbers.

  - Upon a successful enhancement, one attribute is increased at random. Every attribute has an equal chance of being selected.

  - The available attributes vary by weapon. You can see what attributes are available in the weapon's in-game description.

  - Once an attribute has been maxed out, it will be excluded from attribute selection.

  - When performing dehancement, one enhanced attribute is decreased at random. Every enhanced attribute has an equal chance of being selected.
We have also prepared a rate disclosure for the Season Random Box. This item can be obtained as a free reward from the Free Pass and as part of a paid season pass.



[Season Random Box]When awarded as part of the Season Pass system, the Season Random Box will be used immediately upon obtaining.

You will receive one of the following items. The chance of obtaining each is listed below.
Season Random Box Rates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d6a70df9a62255a40a74b513e1ecea4faa3a3331.png

Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio has been able to continue its service for the past 7 years thanks to your continuous support and affection.

In order to make our game even more transparent and trustworthy, we plan to perform an overall review of in-game terminology to see whether there has been any unclear communication in our probability-based content. We are also making preparations to implement a real-time probability monitoring system so that Survivors can check the rates.

Starting with this rate disclosure post, we will continue to work hard so that Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio earns even more of your trust. 

Thank you.

- The CSNS Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c31ae6c26449d4a186d464fc64129a177bc3a791.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Content: Zombie Scenario 7-3 (Pursuit: Missed Connections)
Search the destroyed laboratory for clues! Check out this brand new story today.
	
Content: Zombie Scenario Improvements
Zombie Scenario has been improved! Check it out today!
	
Content: Zombie Content Update
From updates to mutations to changes to Zombie Z mode's unlock level, see all the updates coming to Zombie content!

Promotion: 2021 New Epic Weapon Promotion (2/17 - 3/31)
During the event, Epic Decoders with the letter  as a possible reward will be sold in the shop!

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



Expanded Info
 
Content

Zombie Scenario 7-3 - Pursuit: Missed ConnectionsEver since she escaped from the Panic Room, Erica has suffered from mysterious bouts of debilitating pain. Time passed in vain without being able to find the cause. One day, David Black receives a message from Soi out of the blue. Soi claims that there is information about Erica's condition and suggests that Black go to Rex Laboratory to search for a cure. When Black and Erica get there, however, the laboratory is in shambles after an attack. Now they must search the lab for any signs of Soi and a cure.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3fb42c15dccc847efd406addf2b8864e0b552cbc.png
 

Zombie Scenario Improvements
Introducing Elite MonstersWhen you play Zombie Scenario on Normal difficulty or higher, there is a chance for new elite monsters to appear.
Elite monsters have more powerful stats than normal zombies, as well as enhancement effects. The higher the difficulty is when you encounter them, the more powerful their abilities become.
If you clear the scenario after defeating an elite monster, you can get Add-On and Part items.

Introducing the Add-On SystemNew item type, Add-Ons, can be obtained by defeating elite monsters.
Add-Ons are consumable items which, when used, apply their effects to the next Scenario Mode match. You can view your Add-On items in the mode-exclusive section of your inventory.
You can equip Add-Ons in the lobby before playing Zombie Scenario Mode. When the match starts, 1 of each equipped Add-On will be consumed, and the Add-Ons' effects will be applied to that match.
You can press the M key during the match to see the currently equipped Add-Ons.

Other System ChangesThe Round Re-Challenge item no longer has a cooldown. Instead, there is now a limit on how many times it can be used per match based on difficulty. You can see how many uses you have left by pressing Tab during the match.
Easy and Normal: No limit
Hard: Up to 15 uses
Very Hard: Up to 10 uses
Hell: Up to 5 uses
Inferno: Up to 3 uses
In Zombie Scenario maps on Very Hard or above difficulty, when you discard a weapon, the weapon will now disappear immediately.
You can view special conditions and rewars for each difficulty with the Difficulty Guide button in the Zombie Scenario Mode lobby.
The number of parts you can get from the daily reward boxes have been doubled.
Poor Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x2f

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 23rd
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/490038044bd7dc699500c1c0f29391d11de14bf2.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Content: Added the New Zombie Draugr
A new zombie has been released in Zombie Evolution! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!
	
Content: Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z Rebalance
A new change comes to zombie modes! Read on to learn how they've been rebalanced.
	
Content: New Inferno Difficulty Map for Zombie Scenario
Total War has been updated with Inferno difficulty! We plan to add Inferno difficulty to more maps in the future, so have fun.

Content: Medal System Improvement Part 2 Information
The Medal System has been further improved! 3 new medals have also been added, so be sure to check them out.

Promotion: Transcendence Class Promotion (12/23 - 1/27)
New Transcendence Classes, Leader Soi and Super Soldier Jennifer, have been released! Get them from Class Decoders today!

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



Expanded Info
 
Contents

New Zombie: Draugr{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/017e1b1e64001c2a59feeda07cfe11a0e958d352.png
A new zombie exclusive to Zombie Evolution has been released! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!

IntroductionDraugr is a powerful mutant zombie class that uses a sword. It has a very long attack range, but slow attack speed. Hold right-click to charge up to 3 stages. Range and damage increase according to the charge stage.

SkillDeflect: Block enemy projectiles with your sword. While using this skill, the effects of knockback and stun against you are reduced. Use the skill again to deactivate it. The gauge gradually drains while using the skill, and refills when not using it.

Dimension Slash: Channel your focus and teleport forward, dealing damage to all humans in your path and pulling nearby humans in. Cannot move through obstacles.


Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z RebalanceA new change comes to zombie modes!

Zombie Evolution Mode1. Human Skill Limit Change: After learning 2 skills, you can use virus to learn more skills. Doing so will replace the first skill you already learned with the new skill.

2. Added Human Team Banshee skills.
  - Vampire Bats Skill: While the skill is in effect, vampire bats attack when you hit an enemy, inflicting additional damage and healing you for a portion of all damage dealt.
  - Banshee Buff: Marks Zombies in the direction you are facing in red.

3. Increased the amount of virus required to use skills while you are Human from 2 to 3.

4. Slightly increased the periodic virus gain when Humans survive.

5. Adjusted Human skill balance.
  - Aksha: Reduced the cumulative damage required for the Discharge skill and increased the attack power boost to up to 250%.
  - Rusty Wing: Slightly increased the Glide skill's cooldown.
  - Deimos: Slightly reduced the Shock skill's cooldown.
  - Venom Guard: Reduced the Zombie Explosion skill's cooldown.

6. Reduced the number of Virus Essences generated upon a zombie death from up to 6 to 5.

7. Reduced the amount of virus obtained from Virus Essence when you are a zombie from 50 to 35.

8. Increased the amount of virus obtained when a zombie kills a human from 120 to 150.

9. Increased the virus level required to transform into a mutant zombie from 7 to 9.

10. Increased the virus level consumed to transform into a mutant zombie from 6 to 9.

11. Respawn time now increases even when dying from normal headshots, not just from Deadly Shot.

12. Adjusted Brutus and Arachne balance.
  - Slightly increased Brutus defense.
  - Slightly increased Brutus HP.
  - Slightly reduced Arachne HP.
  - Slightly increased Arachne armor.
  - Reduced Arachne's Web Walk skill cooldown from 6 to 5 sec.

Zombie Z Mode1. Mutation Changes
  - Contact Infection: Damages nearby humans every second. The damage increases every round.
  - Icarus: Has a 2-sec cooldown after using Glide.

2. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Levels Adjusted
  - Changed the unlock level for some zombies and weapons.

3. Additional Changes
  - Fixed the issue where you could attack while using Venom Guard's Self-Destruct skill.
  - Round settings can now be selected in 2-round increments with a minimum of 5 rounds and maximum of 17 rounds.


New Inferno Difficulty Map for Zombie Scenario{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3f215453bf479427d28a2912e78c506f884d0e68.jpg
A new Zombie Scenario Inferno difficulty map has been added! Play it now! 
Featured Map: Pursue: Total War


Medal System Improvement Part 21. Changed player count criteria for achieving medals.
  - Player count requirements, which were different per medal, are now 1 or more players by default.
  - Several medals, which require a higher player count due to the medal's nature, will stay the same. This information is mentioned in each medal's description.

2. Added medal colors according to Honor Points.
  - Added medal colors for 1500-1999 points, as well as 2000-2999 points.
  - Medal colors can be checked under the Help button on the top right side of the Medals page.

3. Added the option to not display medal stages.
  - Added the option to not display the stage for earned medals.
  - You can activate/deactivate this feature in the Display Medal section under the Medals page.

4. Improved notation of obtainable Achievement Points/Honor Points.
  - Changed the notation for unobtained Achievement Points/Honor Points to look engraved.
  - Removed all Honor wording that was displayed before the medal names in the Medals page.

5. Added the feature to check medal stages.
  - For medals that have medal stages, you can select each stage and check the achievement goals and rewards in advance.

6. Added 3 new medals.
  - Welcome Medal: Reach 10 cumulative logins.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0773fc33fd6e7fd5e188951ff7a107d9e4a5b35c.png
  - Not Missing a Beat Medal: Reach 5 consecutive logins.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e1ddb5682981f44e4ca33214c8e244a101a0264d.png

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 25th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8ae980e72a4d024dd0e3d1774746020ef6b381c4.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Content: Scenario TX Update
This is a "shooting RPG" based on Studio Mode. Hunt monsters and obtain various items to grow stronger, all in an isometric view.
	
Content: Medal System Improvement Information
The medal system has been improved. Please refer to the details below for changes to the medal page, stages, Achievement Shop, etc.
	
Content: New "Inferno" Difficulty for Zombie Scenario
Zombie Scenario is now even harder! This time, you're up against the Inferno difficulty, which is even tougher than the existing Hell difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.

Balance Update Information
The balance of Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution has been updated. Please see below for details.

Promotion: Magic Lance Scarlet Rose Promotion (11/25 - 12/23) 
During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Magic Lance Scarlet Rose and Barrett M95 White Tiger. Once the promotion is over, the Barrett M95 White Tiger will become permanently available.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



Expanded Info
 
Contents

Studio - Scenario TX UpdateThis is a "shooting RPG" based on Studio Mode. Hunt monsters and obtain various items to grow stronger, all in an isometric view.

Details Items exclusive to Scenario TX, obtained from eliminating monsters, can be obtained permanently.
 Scenario TX supports individual saving per class. Enjoy various gameplay experiences with each class.
 Enjoy Scenario TX gameplay utilizing about 80 different skills!
 You can become even more powerful through the Scenario TX's Expert advancement system, exclusively for Lv. 30.

Scenario TX Hunting Map Creation You can create hunting maps for Scenario TX with even just basic blocks, without separate devices.
 Anyone can freely play the hunting maps.
 Hunt monsters and obtain items in various hunting grounds created by the community!

Scenario TX Missions A new form of scenario where the official Scenario TX lore is applied, featuring boss monsters.
 Challenge Scenario TX missions with the Mission Points you collected from clearing hunting maps!
 Hunt boss monsters to obtain exclusive loot.


Medal System Improvement InformationThe medal system has been improved. Please refer to the details below for changes to the medal page, stages, Achievement Shop, etc.

Medal Page You can view the medal page by selecting Medals under My Info.
 The search feature has been improved. You can now search by medal descriptions, not just medal names.
 You can easily check each medal's status through Medal Collection View and Medal Detail View.

Medal Stage Expansion When you complete a stage 1 medal, you can challenge the game for the stage 2 medal.
 Upon winning a medal, you can gain Honor Points or Achievement Points.

Achievement Shop The Achievement Shop is open. There, you can spend Achievement Points to purchase items.
