notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 7th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/90170341aed9f970ac74b6f1909da004b4ef715b.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Content: Season 7 Psychic Punk (10/7 - 12/23)
The new season, psychic punk, is here. You can find neon signs and futuristic accessories in Season 7. There are also many changes such as updates to the Karma system, skill changes, balance changes, and so on. Check them in the game now.
	
Content: League System Revamp
The league system has been revamped and will run in seasons. The first season, Zombie League Season 1, will run until 11/25. This season will be a trial run and there may be changes made mid-season. We plan to run various league seasons besides Zombie League in the future.
	
Content: Build Marker Release
We've added the Build Marker, which allows you to designate areas and easily edit them. To celebrate its release, we are giving away Build Marker, Build Minigun, and Build Scanner licenses for free when you play at least 30 minutes in Studio Creation Mode.

Promotion: Negev NG-7 Ajax Promotion (10/7 - 11/25)
During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Negev NG-7 Ajax and M3 Black Dragon. Once the promotion is over, M3 Black Dragon will become permanently available.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents
Season 7: Psychic Punk (10/7 - 12/23)
The new season has arrived with the psychic punk theme. Feel the future in Season 7 with fancy neon signs, futuristic accessories, and retro style.
 Main Rewards
 Growing Weapon: Plasma Rifle MK-1, Plasma Rifle MK-2, Tiamat MK-3, and Tiamat MK-4
 Zombie Costumes: Android Light Zombie and Boombox Stamper
 Weapon Paints: Cyber Neon Weapon Paint and Psychedelic Weapon Paint
 Costume: Cyber Helmet, Combat Mask, Hover Board, Hover Wings, Cube Bot, and Pulse
 Sprays: Boss David Black Spray, Android Light Zombie Spray, Boombox Stamper Spray, Special Agent Criss Spray, and Psychic Punk CS Spray
 Medals: Season 7 Trailblazer Medal and Season 7 Conqueror Medal

Season 7: Zombie Contents
Various changes will be applied to Season 7 zombie contents.
 Karma System Update
 Both Human and Zombie Teams can now fill the Karma gauge.
 Zombie Team Karma Effects
 Zombie Team Stage 1 Karma Effect: Ignore stuns and knockback for 2.5 sec
 Zombie Team Stage 2 Karma Effect: Ignore damage, stuns, and knockback for 5 sec (cannot move)
 Zombie Team Stage 3 Karma Effect: Can play as a Hero Zombie
 Newly Added Sub-Effects per Each Karma Stage
 Between Stages 0 and 1: Can select a weapon/zombie 3 levels higher than your level, respectively
 Between Stages 1 and 2: Can select a weapon/zombie 6 levels higher than your level, respectively
 Between Stages 2 and 3: Can obtain all human/zombie mutations, respectively 
 Zombie Z Balance Adjustments
 There will now be a cap for the EXP that can be obtained from taking damage as a zombie in Zombie Z mode, based on the distance between you and the human that damaged you.
 Lowered the unlock level for early-/mid-game weapons and zombies overall. (Raised for some weapons and zombies)
 Added new mutation and adjusted mutation balance 
 New Human Team Mutation
 Bomb Defense: Reduces the damage and knockback taken from Zombie Bombs
 Balance Adjustment
 Contact Infection: Changed so that infection occurs when you maintain contact for a short time, instead of infecting immediately upon making contact
 Endurance: Increased the proc rates and reduced the duration for the Endurance mutation.

Zombie Evolution Content Update
Various changes are applied to Zombie Evolution mode.
 Changes
 Added Zombie Evolution medals
 Added Zombie Evolution daily and weekly missions
 Added Zombie Evolution Studio Mode, as well as 2 Studio maps (Dust+ and Assault+)
 The more zombies exist, the longer the respawn wait time becomes
 Extended the wait time between one round's end and the next round's start to 15 sec
 You can now open the results window (F key) while waiting between rounds
 Zombie vision (N key) now maintains its on/off status throughout a match
 The skill sound now plays in 1st person view when a human uses an additional skill
 Balance changes for humans' additional skills
 Reduced cooldown for Light Zombie and Ganymede skills: 18 sec -> 16 sec
 Reduced cooldown for Voodoo Zombie skill: 20 sec -> 18 sec
 Reduced cooldown for Stamper skill: 20 sec -> 16 sec
 Increased cooldown for Jiangshi Zombie skill: 28 sec -> 30 sec
 Reduced secondary weapon attack power granted by Jiangshi Zombie skill: 80% -> 60%
 Increased movement speed granted by Venom Sting skill: 5 -> 7
 Increased damage of Venom Sting's Shadow Attack skill: 800 -> 950
 Reduced Slot 4 equipment attack power granted by Blotter skill: 50% -> 10%
 Reduced cooldown for Rusty Wing skill: 22 sec -> 20 sec
 Reduced the wings' HP for Rusty Wing skill: 400 -> 100
 Increased cooldown for Psycho Zombie skill: 12 sec -> 13 sec
 Reduced the Zombie Countermeasure Vaccine toss interval for Psycho Zombie skill: 0.5 -> 0.4
 Increased cooldown for Deimos skill: 22 sec -> 24 sec
 Increased the duration of the zombie attack lock inflicted by Deimos skill: 3 sec -> 4 sec
 Mutant Zombie balance changes
 Reduced HP recovered while resting as Brutus and Arachne
 Slightly reduced defense for Brutus
 Slightly increased duration of Charge for Brutus
 Slightly increased cooldown of Charge for Brutus
 Slightly reduced the Zombie Hound summon cooldown for Brutus
 Reduced the Zombie Hound HP for Brutus
 Slightly reduced the Zombie Hound attack power for Brutus
 Zombie Balance Fix
 The movement speed and jump boost granted by Berserk is now the same for all virus levels
 Skill Changes
 Venom Guard: New skill "Zombie Explosion" and buff added
 Aksha: Discharge skill changed and buff added

League System Revamp
The league system is being completely revamped. Leagues now run in seasons. You can see the current league status under the profile screen.
 League Changes
 Leagues will run in seasons. These seasons are separate from the existing Season Pass.
 In the Hall of Fame, you can see the points and weapons of the top 500 players in the league.
 You can earn League Points to increase your league rank. League Points can be obtained when you play the featured modes in the league. Please beware that you will not get points if abnormal activity is detected during your gameplay.
 League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
 Only the top 500 players can achieve the Master rank.
 The more people play together, the easier it is to earn League Points. 
 League Season Operation Rules
 While the first league will be a Zombie League, we plan to feature various modes in the future.
League duration may be different for each league, but they will be updated at about a 4-week interval by default.
The points required to advance in league ranks may be changed in the future. 

[Trial] Zombie League Season 1 (10/7 - 11/25)
Zombie League Season 1 will be the first of the revamped leagues. Zombie League Season 1 will be a trial run. We ask for your understanding that its schedule or details may change.
 Zombie League Featured Modes: Zombie (AI), Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Studio Zombie

 League Rewards
 Master Rank: Zombie League Master Zombification + Gungnir (15 Days) + Axion (15 Days) + Aetheris (15 Days)
 Diamond Rank: Zombie League Diamond Spray + Holy Sword Divine Order (15 Days) + Female Student Light Zombie (15 Days)
 Platinum Rank: Zombie League Nameplate + Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days) + Nurse Venom Sting (15 Days)
 Gold Rank: Infinity Laser Fist (15 Days) + Mummy Stamper (15 Days)
 Silver Rank: Trinity Grenade (15 Days) + Chef Heavy Zombie (15 Days)
 Zombie League Master Zombification: Changes the special effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode. It will be removed if you drop out of Master rank or if the season ends.

Studio Creation Mode Improvement Pt. 2
Various improvements have been made to Studio Creation Mode.
 Added Build Marker, a New Creation Tool
 You can create an area by designating the location for two markers. Left-click to place markers, and right-click to retrieve the markers.
 The area created can be filled or erased with the Build Rifle or the Build Minigun. You can only fill the area with blocks that are 1x1x1 in size and have a block cost of 0.
 If you use the Build Scanner, you can also copy the area you created and paste it into another location.
 Quick Menu Improvements
 Ghost Mode: Ghost Mode and Zero Gravity mode have been merged. The player becomes semitransparent, can pass through all objects, and becomes invincible.
 Speed Mode: Allows you to move faster than the default speed. It is also possible to adjust your movement speed.
 Camera Settings: Isometric view has been added. You can also zoom in/out with the mouse wheel.
 Show Device Tree View: You can see all device blocks currently placed in the Studio map in a single glance as a tree view.
 Player Settings: A menu that includes various creation convenience features has been added.
 Sounds Added: 30 new sound effects and 12 new music tracks have been added.

Events
Find the Zombie Event (10/7 - 10/28)
There are 16 characters on the board, and 12 of them are zombies. Snipe the zombies to get rewards. Press "Find the Zombie" on the bottom of the Lobby screen to play.
 Bullet Giveaway
 For every 30 minutes of game login time every day during the event, you will receive 1 bullet. (There's no limit to how many you can obtain a day.)
 Detailed Rules
 When you guess where a zombie is, your reward grade goes up by 1, up to a total of 13. When you snipe a human, your reward grade goes down by 1. The higher grade you receive, the better rewards you will get.
 You can claim your reward by pressing Surrender or sniping all zombies, then pressing the Claim Reward button.
 To snipe a zombie, you need bullets. Bullets can be earned from events or purchased from the Shop.

BALROG IS BACK (10/7 - 11/25)
Various changes will be applied to the BALROG series weapons.
 Temporary Changes
 During the event, damage will be increased and Zombie Z unlock level will be decreased for BALROG Blue series weapons.
 Permanent Changes
 You can now equip parts on BALROG series weapons.
 List of Weapons Affected: BALROG-I Blue, BALROG-III Blue, BALROG-V Blue, BALROG-VII Blue, BALROG-IX Blue, BALROG-XI Blue, BALROG-I, BALROG-III, BALROG-V, and BALROG-VII

Golden Zombie Kill Rewards Update (10/7 - 12/23)
Rewards for killing the Golden Zombie, which appears randomly in Zombie Scenario, have been updated.
 Rewards per Kill (You can earn 3 kills a day)
 1 Kill: AK-47 Paladin
 2 Kills: M4A1 Dark Knight
 3 Kills: SG552 Lycanthrope
 5 Kills: Python Desperado
 7 Kills: Red Dragon Cannon
 10 Kills: AUG Guardian
 Notice
 The Golden Zombie has a chance to appear when you play at least 3 minutes on Normal difficulty or higher. Hitting it once counts as one kill.
 Kill rewards can be claimed once per account.

Season Badge Giveaway (10/7 - 12/23)
Earn Season Badges by staying logged in. You can receive up to 30 a day.
 Rewards 
 30 minutes of login time: Season Badge x3
 60 minutes of login time: Season Badge x3
 90 minutes of login time: Season Badge x6
 120 minutes of login time: Season Badge x6
 150 minutes of login time: Season Badge x12

Triple Studio Build License Giveaway (10/7 - Permanent)
To celebrate the Build Marker's release, you will receive 3 Build License items when you reach 30 minutes of playtime in Studio Creation Mode.
 Rewards
 Build Minigun License
 Build Scanner License
 Build Marker License
 Notice
 The above licenses can be received once per account.
 You will only receive licenses that you don't already own.
 You can use the Build Marker if you have a VVIP Pass.

Wait! Take This Special Weapon Event (10/7 - 10/28)
You can receive rewards when you reach 20/40/80 minutes of playtime each day during the event.
 Requirements

 Rewards
One of the following is given at random. It can be used for 60 minutes starting from the time you receive it.
 Lightning Fury
 Magnum Launcher
 Holy Sword Divine Order
 Psychic Harmonium
 Infinity Laser Fist

 Dual Sword Phantom Slayer

 Barrett M95 White Tiger

 M3 Black Dragon
 Notice
 Item expiration timers count down even if you don't use the weapon.
 Earning the same item a second time will extend its timer by 60 minutes.
 Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players.

Boss Rush to 10/28 Clear Reward Event (10/7 - 10/28)
Clear a Zombie Scenario map every day to get rewards.
 Rewards (Clear counts are reset daily)
 1 Clear: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1

Boss Rush to 10/28 Event (10/7 - 10/28)
You can receive rewards based on the number of times you kill each season's boss in Zombie Scenario Mode during the event.
 Conditions and Rewards
Rewards are given for defeating each boss below 5 times and again at 10 times.

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Studio Creation Mode Improvement Pt. 1The map creator subscription system has been added to the game. UI related to map information, likes, and cheer has been improved. You can also recommend a studio map by pressing the F3 key, even during gameplay.

Event: Random Weapon Zombie Evolution (9/2 - 9/16)During the event, Random Weapon Zombie Evolution will be available.

Event: Mileage Auction Event (9/2 - 9/16)Buy and sell weapons and parts in the Mileage Auction House during the event!

Event: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter Giveaway (9/2 - 9/16)Obtain points by scoring kills or assists in featured modes. Unlock a reward for every 10 points. If you kill the Golden Zombie in Zombie Scenario, you'll get 10 points at once!

Promotion: Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (9/2 - 10/7)During the promotion, you can get the Eternity Laser Fist, a variation of the Infinity Laser Fist, and the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer from a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box. When you use 10 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes, you can get 2 boxes for free.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents

Off-Season Period
Season 6 has ended, and the next season has not started yet. Several changes applied during Season 6 have been reverted. Please look forward to our next season!

Studio Creation Mode Improvement Pt. 1
Various improvements have been made to Studio Creation Mode.
 Subscription System Added
 Map User
 You can press the Subscribe button to subscribe to the map creator.
 You will also automatically subscribe when you press the Like, Bookmark, or Cheer buttons. This feature can be turned on or off in the Manage Subscription screen.
 Map Creator
 You can access the Manage Subscriptions menu under the Create tab.
 In the Manage Subscriptions menu, you can see your current subscribers and manage Subscription Notifications, as well as send notification messages to subscribers through Write Subscription Notification.
 After sending a notification to your subscribers, you must wait one week to send another.
 Improved the Map Info window, as well as the Like and Cheer UI.
 You can press the F3 key to recommend a creator's map. You can use this feature even while you are playing in the map or in the results window after playing.

Updated the rewards for new/returning players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/011ad920c6adc879ddab40fba34902b7afef07d3.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

New Game Mode: Zombie Evolution
It's our first new game mode in a while. Experience the evolution of battle between humans and zombies in the newly added map, Zombie Junk House.

Event: Zombie Evolution Launch Celebration
Complete daily missions during the event and get various rewards, such as Epic Decoders. We'll also hold events where you can get Transcendent Living Weapons and Special Weapons, so don't miss out.

New and returning players get an extra reward! Get a Zombie Evolution Reward Box, with various items in it, just by playing for 10 minutes. The Parts Weapon Selection Box that you can get as a gift has also been upgraded.

Shop: Unique Magic Rod Weapons Rate-Up Promotion (8/5 - 8/19)
To celebrate the launch of Zombie Evolution, the rates for Shining Heart Rod and Starlight Rolling Shooter will be increased x3.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents

New Zombie Evolution Mode Update
It's our first new game mode in a while! Join this endlessly evolving battle between humans and zombies, where the S Virus changes everything.
 Background
 Despite efforts to stop Kronos Inc.'s Super Soldier Project, experiments continued. The S Virus, a new pathogen based on the Z Virus, has been discovered.
 In small quantities, the S Virus lets humans use the powerful abilities of zombies without losing their intellect.
 Kronos has been creating powerful boss zombies using the new virus. Agents tried their best to prevent this, but the S Virus was leaked during this process.
 Now, a new battle between two sides using the S Virus unfolds.
 New Zombie Evolution Map
 Zombie Junk House
 Basic Rules
 Win Conditions
 Zombies: Infect all humans
 Humans: Survive until the round ends
 New Rule
 Zombies get infinite respawns. However, the respawn timer is increased if killed by Deadly Shot.
 You can use powerful abilities by collecting and using S Virus.
 Obtaining the Virus
 Humans: Obtain S Virus when you score zombie kills or assists, or when you survive for a certain duration. The less humans remaining, the more you obtain.
 Zombies: Obtain virus when you infect humans, or when you score human kills or assists. You can also get virus from Virus Essence that other zombies leave when they die.
 Virus Stages
 Your virus stage is displayed in the center of the screen. Virus stage tops out at stage 10 and persists until the end of the match.
 Virus Effects
 Your basic stats increase with your virus stage. (You can see your current stats by pressing L.) When zombies reach a high virus stage, their respawn time is slightly increased.
 Virus Injection
If you reach a certain virus stage (stage 2 for humans, stage 7 for zombies), press V to inject the virus into your body. This consumes virus stages but gives you new abilities.
 Humans: Can inject up to 2 times to randomly obtain a zombie ability. This also grants a resistance to infection from zombies. The virus disappears from your body over time.
 Zombie: Injecting the virus will transform you into a powerful mutant zombie. There are 2 types of mutant zombies, chosen at random.
 Brutus: Has strong HP and Defense. Though it is slow, it is not knocked back or stunned by normal guns.
 Arachne: Has a skill that allows quick movement. It can attack humans with double-jump and use spider webs to move in unexpected ways.

Updates to the New/Welcome Back Supply Box

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dd26439a289b583f9f97385057b0bf1799fd1b2f.png

Survivors,

If you have a killer sense of humor, we’d like to invite you to share it with the community! Whether your funny bone tends to be snarky, ironic, or slapstick, we have created this event with you in mind!

All you have to do is post a screenshot of a funny CSN:S moment you had in-game, in the designated Discord event channel! You can edit the image to make it meme-style as well, or just add a caption along with your image, whatever works best for you. We’ll have a community vote at the end of the event period and the best entries chosen will win up to 50 Transcendence Decoders!

The invite link to the Counter-Strike Online Wiki Discord can be found here: https://discord.gg/sjjZAUm

The event channels are #funny-image-contest, where you will post your images, and #event-discussion, where you can talk about the event and the images that others have posted.

Join now - we look forward to laughing along with you and enjoying your creativity!

Sincerely,
The CSN:S Team


[Event Details]

Schedule Submission Period: July 29th 4AM CEST - August 16th 4AM CEST
 Community Voting Period: August 18th 4AM CEST - 26th 4AM CEST
 Winner Announcement & Reward Distribution: September 2nd During Maintenance
How to Participate: Take a screenshot of a funny moment you experience in-game!

 Submit your screenshot here (https://discord.gg/sjjZAUm) with the info below:

 Enjoy each other’s submissions and laugh!
Voting Scheme: Once the submission period ends, we’re going to freeze the Discord event channel.

 Spamming, multiple submissions, or abusing the event will lead to automatic disqualification for the event and a seperate penalty as well.

notes.title: The Global Weapon Paint Contest (7/8 ~ 8/19)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/74faa3383d3448dc0d9444b46308e70b9d5f32d3.jpg


Show off your design skills by creating your very own weapon paints!	 The Global Weapon Paint Contest is here! The contest will include templates for a total of 21 weapons. The First Place winner from each region will have their design implemented as an in-game weapon paint at a future date!

Event Schedule
All dates below is based on the server timezone of UTC+0.
[olist] [strike]Weapon Paint Submission Window: 7/8 (Wed.) - 7/28 (Tue.) (Ended)[/strike]
 Player Poll: 8/5 (Wed.) - 8/12 (Wed.)
 Player Poll Results Released: 8/19 (Wed.)
 In-Game Implementation: Last quarter of 2020[/olist]

Event Progression Overview
[olist] To determine winners of this contest, there will be an internal evaluation to select up to the Top Five entries, based on criteria such as creativity, suitability, and other qualitative measures. Afterwards, there will be a player poll to choose up to three finalists. The final ranking order will be decided by an internal evaluation.

 Contest applications must submitted by 11:59 PM (UTC+0) on 7/28. Any submissions made after this date will not be considered. 

 Designs in the Top Five or Top Three may be removed if there are potential legal issues, there is evidence of poll manipulation, or if other issues arise.

 Each of the first place designs that are ultimately selected for each game service region will be released as a weapon paint. (There will be a total of four paints; Korea, Taiwan, China, and Steam)[/olist]

How to Participate
[olist] Download the weapon template image from the following URL
Download


 Create the weapon paint
You can print and draw directly on the template, or utilize tools such as Photoshop or Illustrator. Please save the finalized image in JPG or PNG format, and attach it to your submission e-mail. Each entrant may submit multiple entries.

 Send your submission as an email attachment to the following e-mail address
 You will need to include certain information with your submission, detailed below. If the information you provide is incorrect, you may be excluded from participating in the event or receiving the reward.[/olist]csns2020contest@gmail.com

Information to Include in Submission
IGN
Please make sure it matches the nickname you use in the game.

Steam Account Number
We need this information to reach you if your IGN is changed. For more details, see: https://support.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/360001118286-How-do-I-find-my-Steam-ID

Weapon Paint Name
Inappropriate names may immediately disqualify your submission.

(Optional) Brief explanation of the weapon paint
or additional images that can be used as reference for implementing the design.

The weapon paint design, attached as an image
Save the file name in the format of "Your IGN_Weapon Paint Name")

List of Featured Weapons (Total 21)
AWP, AK47, M4A1, Desert Eagle 50C, Seal Knife, Nata Knife, Broad Divine, SKULL-9, BALROG-XI, XM1014 Automatic Shotgun, Arm Torch, Infinity Laser Fist, X-TRACKER, Gungnir, Dread Nova, M3 Black Dragon, Barrett M95 White Tiger, Dual Sword Phantom Slayer, Holy Sword Divine Order, Magnum Launcher, and Dual Beretta Gunslinger


Reward Information
[olist] Distribution Schedule: The contest participation reward is scheduled for distribution during the maintenance on 8/19/2020. Prizes for 1st-3rd place winners will be given out after the actual weapon paint items are released.

 Everyone who participates in the event (Assuming a submission of high enough quality to be considered) will receive:
 CSO Weapon Paint Package x1
 Top Five Finalists will receive:
 Transcendence Decoder x35
 First through Third place winners will receive:
 1st - 3rd Place: Contest weapon paint + pertinent weapon (1st place winner design from Steam, Korea, Taiwan, and China)	
 First Place: Transcendence Decoder x250	
 Second Place: Transcendence Decoder x170	
 Third Place: Transcendence Decoder x70[/olist]

Notice
[olist] Awards may be revoked from contestants who violate the Terms and Conditions or operational rules during the contest and award periods.
 Awards may be revoked from contestants who participate using accounts other than their own or who violate the Terms and Conditions by plagiarizing or causing copyright issues.
 Awards may be revoked for works that contain images that are violent, sexually suggestive, or offensive to others.
 Awards may be revoked from contestants if poll manipulation attempts are discovered.
 If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria, the reward or number of winners may be changed.
 All contestants are liable for their submissions, in the event of a legal dispute regarding the entry.
 The design copyright for contest winners belongs to the contest winner. However, by entering you certify that after you receive the previously announced reward, NEXON Korea Corporation is authorized to release the winning design as a game item and sell it for profit, change or edit it for promotional purposes, post it on websites, social media, fan communities, etc., and use it in future events. For these purposes, NEXON Korea Corporation can request the winner sign a "Consent for the Use of Copyrighted Materials". If the winning party refuses to sign the agreement, their award may be revoked.
 A GM or a game operations manager may contact contest winners for information regarding events that are planned for later dates. By participating, you consent to being e-mailed for this purpose.[/olist]

By participating in this contest, you certify that you have read and agree to all the terms described above.

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Content: Studio Map Tags
Descriptive tags can now be added to studio maps and easily searched. Categories for Studio map recommendations have also been refined, so you can quickly find the maps you're looking for.
 
Event: Bingo Event (7/8 - 7/22)
During the event, you can get Bingo Tickets based on your playtime or by using mileage. You can receive various rewards as you gradually complete the bingo board using the Bingo Tickets.

We will be holding a Weapon Paint Contest where the 1st place winner's entry will be implemented as an in-game item. Please check the separate announcement for detailed information and schedule.

To celebrate the Weapon Paint Contest, 6 Global Weapon Paint items will be sold at 50% off.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.

Contents

Studio Map Tags
Creators can now add tags to Studio maps they create. A number of pre-designated tags are available, however custom tags can also be entered. Tags are also searchable, making it even easier for players to find the right map. The Studio map recommendations section has also been improved with the addition of new categories.


Other Changes
 You can now paste into the My Ban List> Add to Ban List window.
 Weapon performance of the SKULL series has be reverted to their original state.

notes.title: [Notice] Dev’s Note Regarding VoP Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg


Dear Precious CSNS Fans,


First of all, thank you all for participating in our Voice of Players Events.

This opportunity has allowed us to listen to our Fans much more closely hearing your raw, yet diverse, and heartfelt opinions about our game, and it was a very rich moment to understand what our Fans were really thirsting for in detail. Every single feedback you’ve sent us will be a valuable reference for us for future developments and operations, and amongst some of the questions/concerns you’ve sent, we’ll try to answer a handful of them that will be reflected soon in development in Q&A format below.

The answered below are from the questions/concerns raised from our 712 previous CSNS Fans through the VoP Event (4/15 – 5/12) that are considered to be reflected soon undergoing development.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Category[/th]
        [th]Weight[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Content[/td]
        [td]11%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Weapon[/td]
        [td]5%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Map[/td]
        [td]2%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Studio[/td]
        [td]2%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Game Operations[/td]
        [td]25%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Community[/td]
        [td]9%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Economics[/td]
        [td]11%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Events[/td]
        [td]26%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Balance[/td]
        [td]9%[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Details to improvements regarding overall game balance, bugs, and events will be shared through our future patch notes. Once again, thank you all for your valuable comments, and we will continue to do our best to communicate with our CSNS Fans to bring you the most enjoyable Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio life.

As always, thank you for your love and support.

- The CSNS Team


----- Q & As -----

[olist]Do you have any plans on a new mode, or bring back/remake the old?

  - A: One of the biggest advantages of CSNS is the variety of modes, but there was a lack of updates for each mode. Modes other than mainstream mode, such as Zombie Z, will be taken more into consideration for future updates with the great ideas you have provided us with. 


Do you have any plans to improve the league system or competition within families etc. in the future?

  - A: Since competitive content is very important in FPS games, the development team is always thinking about good competitive content. Also, the development team is also aware of the league abuse that many people are pointing out and the need to reorganize the league system. We are struggling with various ways to solve these problems, and we will showcase it to you with good updates in the near future.


I think it is necessary to improve weapons with relatively low utility value.

  - A: First of all, we plan to gradually expand the enhancement for brand weapons, and continue to release reinforced weapons afterwards and plan to complement weapons with relatively low utility value.


AI mode needs to be expanded and improved.

  - A: First, in the case of Gun Deathmatch mode, AI application is being reviewed positively as development. We aim to apply AI to various modes in addition to Gun Deathmatch mode, but currently, we are looking for ways to solve the AI's typical problems, such as the roadblocks, from various angles.


In studio mode, the 'block making function' has only the basic function, and has many restrictions.

  - A: There are features (build guns) that developers too need, such as creating large buildings at once or copying and pasting. We will actively develop related functions to shorten the time required for creation.


I wish I could add pre-made buildings.

  - A: We are constantly updating blocks to create a colorful studio map. Various ideas given by our Fans, such as structure blocks, will also be updated in the future.


Are there any ideas of modes that users have proposed that is possible for future development? 

  - A: We were really surprised by all the ideas of modes you came up with than we thought you would. One of them is the [Zombie Scenario Map, which clears a powerful zombie at the boss level as a challenge]. We are also reviewing it positively and we plan to try to reflect it by referring to it when updating the zombie scenario in the future. We will also use other ideas as a valuable base for planning future mode-related updates as well. Please feel free to raise various ideas through our official website discussion board at any time.


Can we add various background sounds and effect sounds? (Ex: “They are coming” sound)

  - A: We will provide background and effect sounds that exist in normal game mode as well in studio mode.


Do you have any plan to develop functions that can respond to unfriendly/malignant user behavior?

  - A: We know that you may have had a lot of inconveniences in playing the game due to various malignant users. The development team is also aware of this problem and is investigating carefully for a countermeasure. However, we would like to hear more details about these issues. It may be a bit troublesome, but we would appreciate it if you could provide more details to our operation team.


I wish we had more variety of Medal updates. Do you have any plans to update this in the future?

  - A: Yes, we do. We are planning to release new medals related to modes or items that have been relatively lacking in updates, and further update existing medals as well.


Is it possible to categorize browser blocks or decorations by category?

  - A: Till now the blocks were interspersed, so you may have been very uncomfortable with your creation process. We think it is a necessary function for all of our creative creators, and we will develop it in the near future as fast as possible as well.


Many users want the manufacturing system. Do you have any plans to remake or restore this? I miss the good old days of making and playing with the weapons only through gameplay.

  - A: The manufacturing system, which was able to acquire unlimited weapons through a combination of designs, was not intuitive at the time, and received feedback that it was a difficult system for new/return users who lacked prior knowledge recognition. As a result, the weapon acquisition route remains only for direct sales, auctions, etc., based on the current decoder system. Unfortunately, it is difficult to recover the manufacturing system again. However, the key is understood as the provision of a path for nonpaying users to get unlimited weapons with effort, and in the future, we will solve this part where our players feel thirsty for weapons through various events that are easy for you to participate.


The fps drop is getting worse with the launch of colorful weapons, and low-end computers are becoming difficult to play. I'm curious about the opinion of the development team regarding optimization.

  - A: In order to prevent the FPS drop as much as possible, especially in the studio, the MDL exposure method was changed, but there are still engine limitations to match the height of our users. We tried to optimize by planting nxlog, but the current situation is the best.


We hope that the inflation of weapons does not occur when new weapons are released. Weapon balance enhancement is required.

  - A: In the past one year, the development team's internal standards have prevented the upward trend of balance, but there is no guarantee that weapon inflation does not occur due to factors such as sales pressure and consumer expectations. 

However, in order to allow users to use various weapons in the game, we have tried to release the Zombie Z mode, which unlocks available weapons depending on the level, and parts and enhancement system updates, and the recently run 'hero/sidekick weapon return event' and '11 brand weapon series temporary enhancement event.' But it is still undeniable that we cannot easily close the gap in weapon balance between paid and non-paying users.

We will continue to struggle and seek ways to reduce this gap in the future, and first of all, we plan to expand parts and enhancement weapons and rebalance old weapons in various ways.

We would like to ask for your interest in the 'SKULL IS BACK' event that’s starting from today, June 10th, and we will set up future plans in line with the feedback from our Fans.

Lastly, in the case of new weapons, we will ensure that more skillful weapons will be released as given in the comments. We ask for your continued love.[/olist]

Thank you.

- The CSNS Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a89a401b660d786d71ae63049242b5a6734f1bef.jpg


Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
Contents: Season 6, The Wizard of Oz (6/10 - 9/2)

The theme for Season 6 is the Wizard of Oz! Season levels have been increased to 100. Also, new content like the quest zombie, which is a random quest, has been added
 
Contents: Weapon Paint Switching System

You can now apply 2 or more paints to a single weapon. Once you apply the paint, you can freely swap it on and off. With the switching system's implementation, the Paint Reset Blueprint item will no longer be sold.

Shop: Premium Room Host Release 50% Off Promotion (6/10 - Until Separate Notice)

The Premium Room Host is a temporary item that grants all kinds of benefits. To celebrate its release, you can purchase it at 50% off!

Shop: SKULL IS BACK Promotion (6/10 - 7/8)

The SKULL series has been selected as the first Weapon of the Month! During the promotion, you can purchase the SKULL series directly from the Shop, and these weapons have received tweaks as well. Also, the Blood Weapon Paint item will be sold at 50% off.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info

Contents

Season 6, The Wizard of Oz (6/10 - 9/2)

The theme for Season 6 is the Wizard of Oz. You can increase your season level when you play during the season, and you will receive rewards according to your level. If you own the Season Pass, you can receive additional rewards.
 Zombie Content Changes
During the season, the following changes will be applied.
1. Venom Guard
 Self-Destruct skill's duration increased (5 seconds → 15 seconds)
 Self-Destruct skill's explosion range increased
 Self-Destruct skill's knockback effect increased

2. Heavy Zombie
 Trap skill's human binding duration reduced (7 seconds → 3 seconds)
 Trap skill's human detection range reduced
 Trap skill's human seeking speed increased
 Trap's transparency removed

3. SCAR-OZ Enhancement Effects Applied

 Season Changes
 Added new Season 6 items and increased the max level to 100
 Added the Season Pass reward preview feature
 Can purchase Season Badge items even if you do not purchase the Season Pass


New Feature: Quest Zombie (Random Quest)

After the game starts, you will receive a quest automatically when each team respawns.
 Eligible Modes: Zombie Z, Zombie Hero, and Bot Zombie

 Human Team
You will receive a mission to kill a specific zombie. When you complete the mission, you will receive 1 of the following effects randomly: attack power buff, movement speed buff, maximum HP buff, revive as human when dying as infected.

 Zombie Team
You will receive a mission to play as a specific zombie, and can select the quest zombie at #0 in the class selection screen. When you complete the mission, you will receive the following 3 effects: maximum HP buff, additional Armor, decreased stun and knockback effects.

 Notice
 You will receive bonus effects each time you complete a quest in your current round.
 For the Zombie Team, effects received from completing a quest will have different values per zombie.
 Regardless of the team, clearing the quest once is considered meeting the condition once. (Event Conditions)


Weapon Paint Switching System

You can now apply 2 or more paints to a single weapon. Once you apply the paint, you can freely change to and from it. With the switching system's implementation, the Paint Reset Blueprint item will no longer be sold.


Other Changes
 You can now use the automatic removal feature for inactive accounts, under Family Management.
 The Premium Room Host item is now available.
 The Mileage Duffel Bag item has been revamped.
 Other minor bugs have been fixed.


Events

Random Quest Clear Event (6/10 - 6/24)

You can earn rewards based on the number of random quest zombies you clear during the event. You can find detailed information about quest zombies in the content notice. 
 Eligible Modes
 Zombie Z, Zombie Hero, and Bot Zombie

 Quest Achievement Rewards
You can earn rewards based on the daily quest clear count during the event. (Up to 10 times a day) Regardless of the Human/Zombie team, clearing the quest zombie once is considered meeting the condition once.
 Clear 1 time: Rare Decoder x2
 Clear 3 times: Rare Decoder x3
 Clear 7 times: Rare Decoder x5
 Clear 10 times: Unique Decoder x1

 Daily Achievement Rewards
When you clear the quest zombies 10 times in a single day, it will count as 1 day towards the total day count. You can get additional rewards based on total days. These rewards can only be obtained once.
 5 Days Total: Keep Out Spray
 10 Days Total: Run Away Spray

 Notice
 Quest achievement count resets at midnight each day.
 Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players. Does not count in Studio Mode.


Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Event (6/10 - 9/2)

You can earn rewards based on the number of Golden Zombies you kill during the event. Golden Zombies randomly appear when you play Zombie Scenario.
 Rewards per Kills
 1 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)
 2 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)
 3 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)
 5 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)

 Notice
 Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.
 Kill count rewards can be obtained only once per account.
 The Golden Zombies randomly appear after playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms at regular difficulty or higher.


Season Badge Giveaway (6/10 - 9/2)

When you log in to the game during Season 6, you can get 3 Season Badges every 30 minutes. You can obtain them up to 4 times a day, for a total of 12.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 13th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
Content: Studio All-Star/Gun Deathmatch
You can now play All-Star, All-Star+, and Gun Deathmatch modes in Studio Mode. Added a new map, "Industrial Warehouse", where you can play these modes.

Event: CSN:S Land Supply Box Event (5/13 - 5/27)
During the event, you can get CSN:S Land Supply Boxes in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Modes. You will receive rewards based on the total number you collect.

Event: Mileage Auction Event (5/13 - 5/20)
We're opening up the Mileage Auction, where you can trade weapons. There will also be a 1,000 Mileage Auction Event where special items show up at specific times.

Shop: Transcendence Weapon Promotion x3 Rate Boost (5/13 - 6/10)
The new Transcendence Weapon, Psychic Harmonium, will be available during the promotion period. 
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents
Studio Mode Update: All-Star Mode / All-Star+ Mode / Gun Deathmatch Mode
You can now play All-Star, All-Star+, and Gun Deathmatch modes in Studio Mode.
 All-Star/All-Star+ Modes
 Added new theme blocks that can be used in Studio Mode.
 You can choose Studio All-Star Mode and All-Star+ Mode when you create a room.
 Studio All-Star: Play by selecting the "Random transformation at spawn" game rule in the waiting room.
 Studio All-Star+: Play by selecting the "Random transformation at 3 kills" game rule in the waiting room.
 Studio Gun Deathmatch Mode
 This mode allows for new rules.
 Melee weapon kill point (+1) activated
 Lv. 3+ player kill point (+1) added

New Map Added
 Studio Sample Map, Industrial Warehouse
 Added Industrial Warehouse, a new map where you can play the Studio All-Star and Gun Deathmatch modes.
 CSN:S Land: Dust
 Added CSN:S Land: Dust map, a Dust-style map in the theme of an amusement park. You can play the same modes as the original Dust map.
 Available from 5/13 to 6/10.

Off-Season Period
Season 5 has ended, and the next season has not started yet. Several changes applied during Season 5 have been reverted. Please look forward to our next event!
 Removed season-related features
 Increased the Zombie Z level for Season 5 weapons and Blistering Bolt Repeater
 Reverted the balance for Banshee and Voodoo Zombie
 Removed the Random-1 mutation removal feature

Other Changes
 Reverted the specs for the Old-Time Brand Weapon 11 series
 Expanded maximum inventory space
 Fixed many other minor bugs

Events
CSN:S Land Supply Box Event (5/13 - 5/27)
During the event, the shape of the supply box in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Modes will be changed to a gift box image. Each time you use this box, you can get a CSN:S Land Supply Box. You'll receive rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
 How to Get the CSN:S Land Supply Box
 Each time you use a supply box by pressing E in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Modes, you can get 1 CSN:S Land Supply Box item. 
 In the CSN:S Land: Dust map, you can get 2 supply box items each time.

 Collect 40 boxes: Rare Decoder x20

 Collect 70 boxes: Unique Decoder x3

 Collect 100 boxes: Rare Decoder x50

 CSN:S Land Supply Boxes cannot be used on their own. You can only receive rewards based on the total number collected.
 You can only get up to 10 CSN:S Land Supply Boxes a day. All boxes will be removed during the maintenance on 5/27.
 Participation will be counted only when playing in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z rooms with eight or more players. You cannot participate in Studio Mode.

All-Star/Gun Deathmatch Mode Play Event (5/13 - 5/27)
To celebrate the addition of Studio All-Star and Studio Gun Deathmatch, you will receive more EXP.

 You will get 3x EXP when you play All-Star and Gun Deathmatch modes. This will apply to both Studio and Normal Mode.

 Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players.

Buy and sell weapons in the Mileage Auction House during the event!

 Each day between 12:00 and 23:59, from maintenance on 5/13 until 5/20

Regular Players

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 29th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
Event: Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (4/29 - 5/13)
Random Rules maps for Zombie Hero are now available! In these maps, the rules of the game change each round. You can receive all kinds of rewards when you meet the playtime and zombie kill conditions in Random Rules Zombie Hero Mode.
 
Shop: Lucky Spring Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (4/29 - 5/13)
Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be on sale during the promotion. You have a greater chance of obtaining the Barrett M95 White Tiger or the M3 Black Dragon than other Transcendence Weapons. Every time you use 10, you'll receive 2 as a gift!
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents
Other Changes
Fixed other minor bugs.

Events
Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event (4/29 - 5/13)
In Random Rules maps for the Zombie Hero mode, the rules of the game change every round. The rules will be displayed for 3 seconds prior to the beginning of the round, and you can check them at any time by pressing the L key during the match.
 Featured Maps
 Assault and Italy
 Changes
 12 New Rules Have Been Added
 Bad Touch - All zombies become Venom Stings. Skill can be used repeatedly, and trigger automatically on death.
 Moon Bounce - Low gravity mode. After jumping, you will float gently to the ground.
 Bloody Bullets - Every time you reload, you lose HP and gain Attack Power.
 Special Delivery - If an enemy out of sight is hit by your throwing weapon, its Attack Power is greatly increased.
 Rule of Threes - Attack Power of your 3rd, 6th, and 9th melee attacks is greatly increased.
 Shocking - When a zombie lands from jumping, it causes a shockwave, decreasing movement speed of nearby humans.
 Chaotic - Killing a zombie allows you to use the Shop once.
 Tunnel Vision - Humans have their visibility reduced but Attack Power increased.
 In This Together - If a zombie takes damage, nearby zombies are healed for a portion of the damage.
 Rifleman - Attack Power of assault rifles is greatly increased.
 Steel Rain - Attack Power of machine guns is greatly increased.
 Bang for the Buck - The cheaper the price of primary and secondary weapons, the more overall Attack Power increases.
 Balance Adjustment
 Common Rule Adjustment: If a classic weapon buff and a weapon buff are applied at the same time, only the buff with better effects will be applied
 Improved 3 Existing Rules: We Are Venom, Counter Strike War Z, and Out With a Bang


Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (4/29 - 5/13)
Every day, you can receive rewards when you reach zombie kill and playtime goals on Random Rules maps in Zombie Hero mode.
 Conditions
 Score 10 zombie kills and reach 30 minutes of playtime every day. (You need to meet both conditions.)
Rewards - The rewards change based on the total number of days you participate.
 1 Day - Event Reward Box x1
 2 Days - 1 random Rare Class (Permanent) (Total 37 classes)
 3 Days - 1 random Unique Class (Permanent) (Total 6 classes)
 4 days - Event Reward Box x2
 5 Days - 2 random Rare Classes (Permanent)
 6 Days - 2 random Unique Classes (Permanent)
 7 Days - Event Reward Box x3
 8 Days - 3 random Rare Classes (Permanent)
 9 Days - 3 random Unique Classes (Permanent)
 10 Days - Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box x1
 Notice
 You can obtain one of 72 weapons from the Event Reward Box, according to their rates. Some weapons can be obtained as +6 weapons.
 Rewards can be obtained only once per day. You can get up to 10 kills a day.
 You can only make progress in rooms with 8 or more players.
 Unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed on 5/13.

Shop
Lucky Spring Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (4/29 - 5/13)
Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be on sale during the promotion. You have a greater chance of obtaining the Barrett M95 White Tiger or the M3 Black Dragon than other Transcendence Weapons. Every time you use 10, you'll receive 2 as a gift!
 Lucky Spring Transcendence Weapon Box Event (4/29 - 5/13)
 Every time you use 10 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes, you can get 2 additional ones.
 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Rates
 Barrett M95 White Tiger: 3.0%
 M3 Black Dragon: 3.0%
 Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/.
 Notice
 All unused Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be replaced with 1,000 Mileage each during maintenance on 5/13.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 16th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

Content: Exploration System
We've added the brand-new Exploration system, where your classes bring back items even while you're logged out. Check it out by pressing the "Exploration" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
  
Event: Old-Time Costume Box Event (4/16 - 4/29)
You can get an Old-Time Costume Box every time you reach playtime milestones during the event. You can also get additional rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
 
Event: Transcendence Erica and Gerard Release Event (4/16 - 4/29)
During the event, you can get rewards for playing Zombie Scenario maps where Erica and Gerard appear as NPCs.
 
Event: Old-Time Brand Weapon 11 Event (4/16 - 5/13)
During the event, Brand 11 weapons will be stronger.

Event: Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon Giveaway (4/16 - 4/29)
You will receive an Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (14 Days) when you log in and reach 10 minutes of playtime during the event.
 
Shop: Season 5 Transcendence Class Promotion (4/16 - 4/29)
The new Transcendence Classes, Private Erica and Drill Instructor Gerard, can be obtained from decoders during the promotion. You can get Erica's Beret (Permanent) if you get Private Erica, and you can get Gerard's Peaked Cap (Permanent) if you get Drill Instructor Gerard.

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents
New Content: Exploration System
The Exploration system is a new mode where your classes will bring back items even while you are logged out.
Check it out by pressing the "Exploration" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
 Exploration System Overview
 You can select and send 3 classes to an exploration area.
 The exploration success rate changes based on the area, the level, and the exploration levels of the classes.
 The duration changes based on difficulty. (Easy: 2 hours, Normal: 4 hours, and Hard: 8 hours)
 You'll receive the base reward when the exploration ends. If you complete the mission, you'll get an additional reward.
 Please be careful, as the reward will be reset if you do not claim it within 24 hours after completing the exploration.
 Starting Exploration
When you press the button in the Lobby, the "Exploration" window will appear. The Exploration window has 3 parts.
Exploration Slots: 1 area will be provided by default. You can open up to 2 additional slots by using Exploration Slot Expansion Coupons, for a total of 3 slots.
 Exploration area information will be updated every day at midnight.
 Exploration Settings: You can select the difficulty for the currently selected area, and set the 3 classes to dispatch.
 You must fill all 3 class slots to depart. There are minimum and maximum success rates for each difficulty.
 When the exploration area changes, there is a chance to get the "Bonus Class" mark. If you send the Bonus Class, the exploration success rate increases.
 You can change the exploration area randomly by pressing the button on the top left. However, using this option will cost Mileage.
 To cancel an exploration that is already in progress, select the exploration area and press the X button on the top right. The assigned classes will not need to rest.
 Classes Owned: You can check the status of the classes you have.
 Each class has a different exploration level. Temporary classes cannot be used for exploration.
 Classes that complete an exploration once will need to rest. They cannot go on another exploration that day.
 Classes on exploration can be used in other game modes without restrictions.
 Exploration Level Enhancement
In the Enhance screen, you can raise the exploration level of the classes you own.
 When enhancing, you can use classes, costumes, and sprays as material.
 Temporary items can also be used as material. You will receive the same rewards as you would from dismantling the item.

Other Changes
 Changed Quick Start to recommend the appropriate mode based on player patterns.
 Added a feature to restrict weapons in Continuous Maps.
 Added an option to hide the Studio creator.
 Fixed other minor bugs.
 

Events
Old-Time Costume Box Event (4/16 - 4/29)
You can get an Old-Time Costume Box every time you reach playtime milestones during the event. You can also get additional rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
 How to Get Old-Time Costume Boxes
 You can obtain 1 Old-Time Costume Box when you reach 11 minutes of playtime in any mode, excluding Studio Mode.
 You can obtain up to 11 rewards a day. You must be in a room with 4 or more players to make progress.
 Old-Time Costume Box Pileup Rewards
You can get additional rewards based on the number of boxes you get.
 11: SKULL-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)
 55: JANUS-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1) and THANATOS-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)
 99: TURBULENT-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1), CROW-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1), and BALROG-XI (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)
 Old-Time Costume Box Rates
 Costume x1 (Permanent) - 91.5% (Includes 12 costumes)
 Cat Fish, Alice Bunny Ears, Dao Mask, Bazzi Mask, Polar Bear Head, Fierce Penguin, Indian Warbonnet, Indian shield, Dinosaur Head, Dinosaur Buddy, Pharaoh Mask, and Mummy Doll
 Unique Decoder x3 - 2%
 Class Decoder x3 - 2%
 Rare Decoder x15 - 4.5%
 Notice
 Unused Old-Time Costume Box items will be removed during maintenance on 4/29.

Transcendence Erica and Gerard Release Event (4/16 - 4/29)
During the event, you can get rewards for playing the designated Zombie Scenario maps.
 Featured Maps
 Track: Enemy Behind
 Track: Envy Mask
 Celebration Event 1
 When you clear a featured map, you can obtain 2 Old-Time Costume Boxes.
 Each account can only earn the reward once per map, up to 4 total. 
 Celebration Event 2
 If you play an event map as Private Erica or Drill Instructor Gerard, you can obtain 3 additional Old-Time Costume Boxes.
 Each account can only earn the reward once per map, up to 6 total.
 Notice
 You can only get the rewards in rooms with difficulty set to Hard 1 or higher, with 4 or more players. You must play at least 5 minutes.
 Rewards for Celebration Events 1 and 2 are counted separately. If you have a new Transcendence Class equipped, you can participate in both simultaneously. Can obtain up to 10 boxes total.

Zombie Scenario Annihilation Series Opening Celebration Event (4/16 - 4/29)
When you clear a featured map, you can obtain 2 Old-Time Costume Boxes.
 Featured Maps

 Notice

You can earn reward weapons per stage by reaching the requirements of the play missions during the event period.
 Conditions

Hello, Survivors, who have showered CSNS with unceasing love, 

We would like to fill you in on the details of a recent bug and the actions we've taken to address it. Before we get into the details, we want to express our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience and disappointment the bug may have caused you.

Bug Details
 We discovered a bug that allowed players to duplicate enhancement material parts.

 Actions Taken So Far
[olist] Discovered the bug around 10:30 CET on 3/22.
 Performed an emergency maintenance at 15:00 that same day, blocking both further duplications from occurring and the usage of enhancement materials.
 Investigated players who exploited the duplication bug and the number of items they duplicated (found a confirmed total of 61 players).[/olist]
 4/1 Maintenance Actions
[olist]After the 4/1 maintenance, you will be able to use enhancement materials again.
 As an apology for the inconvenience the bug may have caused you, we plan to give the following as compensation:
 Compensation Redemption: Log in between the end of maintenance on 4/1 (Wed) and midnight CEST on 4/14 (Wed)
 Compensation Items: Transcendence Decoder x3
 All materials wrongfully gained by the bug will be removed.
 If the materials were already used, EXP will be deducted from enhanced weapons based on the materials used. EXP deductions will be applied only to values changed after the maintenance on 3/18.
 Players who exploited the bug will be restricted from playing the game for up to 30 days, depending on the number of times they used the exploit.
 2 times: Restricted from playing the game for 1 day
 3 times: Restricted from playing the game for 7 days
 4 or more times: Restricted from playing the game for 14 days[/olist]
We will do everything in our power to provide a stable, bug-free service in the future. We apologize once again for the inconvenience caused by the bug.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43f2bb6621c3125876fdf16fd9ae3c2a9861bf1d.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration
Season 5 is built around a collaboration with the drama Kingdom. 
This time, we're enhancing the perks of the Season Pass and updating Zombie Mode. Check out the mysterious weapons, costumes, and other items based on the Joseon theme!
 
Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration: Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin Class Promotion (2/19 - 3/18)
 Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin, the two main characters of Kingdom, will appear as the new Transcendence Classes. The Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin classes are equipped with a unique synergy effect that enhances Season 5 weapons. These classes can be obtained not from Decoders, but from packages.

Various Events
There are tons of events celebrating the Season 5 collaboration with Kingdom. 
You can earn all kinds of rewards simply by playing the game and participating in events, like the Golden Zombie Event, Zombie Z Newbie Event, Heart Attack Event, and more! 
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


Expanded Info
Contents
Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration (2/19 - 5/13)
Season 5 is built around a collaboration with the drama Kingdom.

You can obtain Season Badges from Missions, Events, and other activities during the season. All kinds of rewards will be given when you collect these badges and level up your grade. Purchasing the Season Pass will grant you additional rewards! 

Check out the mysterious weapons, costumes, and other items based on the Joseon theme!


Season 5 Zombie Mode Update
For Season 5, we've made the following changes to Zombie Mode.
 You can level down in Zombie Z mode.
 Press the L key to level down, which will remove 1 random mutation. If there are no mutations that can be removed, 1 point will be deducted.
 The balance of Banshee and Voodoo Zombies has been changed.
 Banshee
 Damage taken reduced by 70 while using the Pulling skill.
 Range and pulling force increased for the Pulling skill. Voodoo Zombie
 The Heal skill now recovers 1,800 HP every 1.5 seconds over 6 seconds.
 Cooldown for the Heal skill reduced to 12 seconds.
 Increased amount of HP recovered automatically to 800.
 Slightly increased Movement Speed.
 The weapons obtained from the Season 5 Pass will be enhanced when used in Zombie Z mode.
 This enhancement effect will end when Season 5 ends.

Season Pass Improvements
The following changes have been applied to the Season Pass.
 The amount of Season Badges distributed will be approximately doubled compared to Season 4, so that players will be able to reach season ranks much faster.

 The difficulty of the daily missions has been adjusted.
 The difficulty of particularly challenging daily missions has been adjusted further.
 The chance of getting missions to score kills using rifles, machine guns, sub-machine guns, and pistols has been lowered.
 Missions to participate in Team Deathmatch, Gun Deathmatch, All-Star Mode, Zombie Escape Mode, and the New Zombie Shelter for 10 minutes have been removed.

Weapon Synergy Effects with Classes
The new Transcendence Classes Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin will gain enhancement effects when they are equipped with Season 5 weapons.
 Weapons Affected
 Hwando, Timed Bomb, Scythe, Arquebus, Reflex Bow, Matchlock Pistol, Moon Glaive, Blistering Bolt Repeater
 Enhancement Effect
 Increased Damage
 Matchlock Pistol – Has a 10% chance to instant kill by default. This rate is increased to 15% when equipped by Lee-Chang or Yeong-Shin
 Blistering Bolt Repeater (Lee-Chang) – Default ammo count +5. Charge time reduced by 1 second for alt fire
 Blistering Bolt Repeater (Yeong-Shin) - Number of alt fire projectiles +1. Rate of fire delay reduction for alt fire (0.7s -> 0.55s)

Other Changes
 The Shield skill for the Cyborg class has been changed to not take damage from allies
 The effect caused when hit by the Heaven Splitter will no longer block line of sight
 The explosion sound from the Magnum Launcher's alt fire has been fixed
 The issue where the Studio Monsters still attacked the players using the Conceal skill in New Zombie Shelter has been fixed
 The issue regarding incorrect variable values for World Settings from the Lua Script has been fixed
 Other miscellaneous crashes and minor bugs have been fixed


Events
Zombie Z Newbie Event (2/19 - 3/4)
You can earn reward weapons per stage by reaching the requirements of the play missions during the event period.
 Conditions
 Mission 1 - Login to the game once during the event period
 Mission 2 – Score 10 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 2 times
 Mission 3 – Score 30 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 5 times
 Mission 4 – Score 40 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 8 times
 Mission 5 – Score 50 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 10 times
 Rewards
 Mission 1 - M950 +8, Claymore Mine MDS, Arm Torch, Rail Cannon (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up)
 Mission 2 – Plasma Gun +6, Vendetta +6
 Mission 3 - BALROG-XI (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Hunter Killer X-90 (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Rage Down)
 Mission 4 – BOUNCER, Broad Divine (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Heal Disruptor)
 Mission 5 
 Select 1 from the 3 following weapons (Permanent): M950 +8, Plasma Gun +6, Vendetta +6
 Select 1 from the 7 following weapons (Permanent): Claymore Mine MDS, Arm Torch, BOUNCER, BALROG-XI (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Rail Cannon (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Hunter Killer X-90 (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Rage Down), Broad Divine (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Heal Disruptor)
 Notes
 The weapons given as rewards from Missions 1 - 4 will be removed during maintenance on March 4th.
 You are unable to participate in Studio Mode.
 Only counts in rooms with four or more players.

Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration Special Item Giveaway (2/19 - 3/18)
You can earn a special item celebrating the collaboration when you first log in to the game during the event. Each account is only able to claim the item once.
 Rewards
 Kingdom Poster (Lee-Chang) Spray (Permanent)

Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration Badge Giveaway (2/19 - 5/13)
You can earn Season Badges for reaching the requirements during Season 5.
 Conditions
 Reach a total play time of 30 minutes / 60 minutes / 90 minutes / 120 minutes / 150 minutes per each day
 Rewards
 Obtain x3 / x3 / x3 / x3 / x12 Season Badges according to total play time (Up to a maximum of 24 per day)
Can be used before level 16 in Zombie Z. (Actual level differs per weapon.)

Season 5 Golden Zombie Kill Rewards Event (2/19 - 5/13)
The reward items for killing Golden Zombies have been changed. You can earn rewards based on the total number of Golden Zombie kills in Zombie Scenario during the event.
 Conditions and Rewards
 1 cumulative Golden Zombie kill - SG552 Lycanthrope +6 (10 Days)
 2 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - Dual Beretta Gunslinger (10 Days)

Heart Attack Event (2/19 - 3/18)
You can obtain the Heart Grenade when you first log in during the event. You can earn rewards for reaching the requirements using the Heart Grenades.
 Heart Grenade

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 2nd
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/592b32a06bf3e048b2bdacab8828b6a8c124a001.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
New Game Mode: Manhunt
The new game mode ‘Manhunt’ has been added. Become a Human and fix the generators to secure your escape while hiding from the prowling zombie, or become a Zombie and ensure that no human leaves alive!

New Transcendence Classes: Queen & Cyborg
Season 4 Transcendence Classes Queen and Cyborg can be obtained from the Class Decoders, as well as Premium Class Decoders for the duration of the promotion. A giveaway promotion, as well as a promotion that boosts drop rates will take place at the same time, so don't miss out on your opportunity to obtain the new Transcendence Classes!

Enhancement System Revamp and New +6 Enhancement Weapons
The enhancement system has been revamped. The maximum enhancement has been increased to +9, and you can now employ unused weapons as enhancement materials. Additionally, the Warhammer Storm Giant and the Dual UZI can now be enhanced to +6.

2020 New Year! Surprise Mileage Auction (1/2 - 1/15)
You can buy and sell items on the Mileage Auction from 12:00 - 23:59 each day between 1/2 after maintenance until 1/15. Also, special items will appear from 20:00 - 21:00 each day between 1/2 - 1/12 (CET). Don't miss out on a weekend full of rare items!

There are also other events, and updates to the Family system. Check out the Expanded Info section below for details!



Expanded Info
Contents
New Game Mode: Manhunt
The new game mode ‘Manhunt’, and a map associated with the mode has been added. Become a Human and fix the generators to secure your escape while hiding from the prowling zombie, or become a Zombie and ensure that no human leaves alive! 


New +6 Enhancement Weapons
2 new weapons that can be enhanced to +6 have been added.
 Warhammer Storm Giant
 Dual UZI

Enhancement System Revamp
The Enhancement System has been revamped. The changes are as described below.
 Changes to the Enhancement Method
 You can add Enhancement EXP to a weapon by using other weapons as enhancement materials. You can attempt to enhance a weapon with at least 1 Enhancement EXP, and your odds of success will vary according to how much Enhancement EXP you've accumulated. Temporary or rental weapons may not be used as materials.
 The maximum enhancement has been increased to +9. The weapons that can be enhanced up to +9 are listed below. However, the 'Damage' enhancement value for +9 weapons are applied only in Zombie, or Zombie Scenario Modes.
 Weapons whose max enhancement increased to from +8 to +9: WA2000 / Thompson Chicago / KSG-12 / RPG-7 / WA2000 Gold Edition / KSG-12 Gold Edition
 Weapons whose enhancement increased to +9 from +6: Volcano / Ripper / Savery / Crimson Hunter / Dark Knight / Paladin
 Convenience Features Added
 Enhancement suffix deleted
 Enhancement search feature added
 The names of Anti-Enhancement material items have been changed. Use these materials during enhancement to lower the enhancement level by 1.
 (Prior to the change) Anti-Enhancement (Anti-ENH)
 (After the change) Dehancement (DEH)

Family Content
The UI for the Family content has been revamped, and rewards have been added.
 Bonus for Playing Games with Family
You are able to obtain rewards based on the accumulated play time of the family members.

 Rewards
 Reach 60 hours played: Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x10
 Reach 80 hours played: Rare Decoder x5
 Reach 100 hours played: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
 Reach 120 hours played: Rare Decoder x10
 Reach 140 hours played: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x3
 Notice
 The play time accumulates only when you play in rooms with 2 or more players.
 The play time accumulates 10% faster if you play together with your family members.
 The accumulated play time gets reset each week. (Monday 00:00)
 The rewards are given only to the players who are registered as family members at the moment the play times are reached.
 Concurrent Player Bonus
You are able to obtain rewards based on the number of Family members currently online.
 Rewards (Given Cumulatively)
 2 members or more: Brick Piece T50
 4 members or more: Claymore Mine MDS
 7 members or more: Bouncer
 10 members or more: Star Chaser AR
 Player is unable to take ownership, as these are event weapons
 UI Improvement
 New family members are able to check their member benefits.
The markings to distinguish family members in game will become reinforced.

2nd Decoder System Revamp
Building upon the past revamp from November 27, 2019, the 2nd round of revamp has been applied for the Decoder System.
 The sale of Top 50 and Top 50 Unlimited Decoders will be discontinued. Additionally, Rare and Unique Decoders have been added to the game.
 Unique Decoder : You are able to obtain Unique - Advanced grade weapons.
 Rare Decoder : You are able to obtain Rare - Regular grade weapons.
 The design of the Decoders will be changed.
 The cycle for which the list of passes are given out from the VIP System will be applied as shown below.
 VVIP Grade - When new items having a Transcendence grade or higher are added
 VIP Pass - When the items of the Transcendence Decoder are changed 
 Diamond Grade - When classes having a Unique grade or lower are added
 Platinum Grade - When the items of the Unique Decoder are changed
 Gold Grade - When the items of the Rare Decoder are changed
 The display in Hideout will be changed.
 The rewards for leveling up will be changed.
 The Top 30 Brand Decoder will be changed to Rare Decoder.
 The Top 50 Decoder will be changed to Unique Decoder.
 The Top 50 Unlimited Decoder will be changed to Unique Premium Decoder.
 The Top 30 C and C Decoder will be changed to Class Decoder.

Changes to the New and Returning Player Supplies
The items contained in the supply package given to new players, or players who have not logged in for more than 30 days have been changed.


Bug Fix
The issue where the weapon Hellhound was interfering the view has been fixed.



Events
Play the Manhunt Event (1/2 - 1/15)
You are able to obtain rewards every day based on the play time of the Manhunt Mode during the event.
 Rewards
 You are able to obtain an event reward box each time you reach 10 minutes of play time. (Maximum of 60 minutes per day)
 You are only able to participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
 Unused boxes will be removed during maintenance on January 15th.

2020 New Year! Surprise Mileage Auction (1/2 - 1/15)
You'll be able to buy and sell weapons in the Mileage Auction House during the event.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/82dea62b618a20c78eaa2c8a91a6100edebc25a1.jpg

Greetings from the CSN:S Team.

Here's a notice regarding the Decoder System Revamp, as well as the 11/27 Decoder rates.

There's an increase in the types of weapons, as well as a deviation in terms of performance for weapons in identical grades as we have go through more and more updates, gradually making it difficult to determine the performance level of the weapons. Therefore, we wish to revamp the Decoder system so it would be more intuitive to determine which weapons are good, as well as making it more straightforward to determine the source of acquisition of those weapons. Previously owned or purchased Decoders will remain until they expire, so you have nothing to worry about.


[Decoder System Revamped]
After 11/27, the existing Top 50 Decoders that were sold will gradually be stopped being sold, and a new grade system will be applied to the newly sold Decoders. 
  The weapons included in the Decoders will be distinguished as disclosed below. 
The weapons in each of the groups were selected based on performance as well as popularity, and are subject to change from updates.
  Transcendence Group 1 – Transcendence Weapons with outstanding performance
  Transcendence Group 2 – Transcendence Weapons
  Unique Group 1 – Unique, or Parts Weapons that can be enhanced up to +6
 D.	Unique Group 2 – Unique Weapons
 E.	Rare Group – Brand Weapons
 The Decoders are largely classified into 3 categories according to the highest grade of the weapons included.
 Transcendence Decoder: Can obtain up to Transcendence Weapons as the highest grade
 Unique Decoder: Can obtain up to Unique Weapons as the highest grade
Rare Decoder: Can obtain up to Rare Weapons as the highest grade
 All Decoders are classified into 2 types: Regular/Premium. 
Durational items do not appear from Premium Decoders, and the lowest grade of the weapons is 1 grade higher than regular Decoders.
Ex. Transcendence (Regular) Decoder: Can obtain weapons of Rare - Transcendence grades
Ex. Transcendence Premium Decoder: Can obtain weapons of Unique - Transcendence grades

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 27th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/28f20a13819908445ffee6aeb88b49f068133fc4.jpg

Here's a rundown of some of the changes in today's update!

Some of you may have been confused to discover that the game's title was recently changed from Zombies to Studio. In our never-ending struggle to keep the game fresh and provide a better, funner experience, we have been developing the game in a much broader direction. Our new focus includes allowing players themselves to participate in content creation. Of course we fully intend to continue to improve and expand upon our existing Zombie modes as well. As always, we are extremely grateful for your continued support.

Studio Feature Expansion – Scenario T
Scenario T is the very first studio update since the game was retitled. Scenario T is a Zombie Scenario in Studio Mode. Use the newly added features to create maps with RPG mechanics.

New Item: Season 4 Transcendence Weapon, the Hellhound, and Etc.
The Hellhound is a new type of weapon that automatically patrols the vicinity of its user. It is usable alongside your primary weapon, unleashing a wide variety of new strategies! In addition to the Hellhound, 3 kinds of ZS boxes, each filled with a variety of items, that you can purchase with points. Additionally, the Small medical kit has been can now be purchased in bundles of 30.

Decoder Improvement
We improved the Decoder system so that it would be more straightforward to understand the source of acquisition of the weapons based on their grades. Please refer to the separate notice for details. 

In addition to the announcements above, there have been changes to the Zombie Meta, and the Zombie Scenario has been revamped as well. Please refer to the [Details] section below for details.


Expanded InfoContentsStudio Feature Expansion – Scenario T
This is a 'Zombie Scenario' in Studio Mode. Utilize the newly added features to create maps involving RPG mechanics, such as leveling up and farming items.
 Monsters
 3 kinds of new monsters have been added.
 The creator is able to control many different types of monsters at the same time using the script.
 The grades of monsters can be configured. The grades are differentiated into 5 stages (Regular, Rare, Unique, Champion, Named).
 EXP, as well as items exclusive to the Scenario T can be obtained by defeating monsters.
 Weapons
 The weapons are differentiated into 4 grades (Regular, Rare, Unique, Transcendence). Additional attributes are applied at random for weapons having higher grades.
 Weapons can be obtained from rewards for defeating the monsters, as well as shops located in the map.
 Weapons have levels and attributes. These attributes can be configured using the script.
 Caution: Weapon usage is restricted for the weapons not possessed in the players' inventory.
 Sample Maps
 2 sample maps have been included in the updated to experience the new features at your convenience.
 Scenario T01 – Missing Advance Troops (Tutorial Map)
 Scenario T02 – Sewer Depths (Play Map)

Decoder Improvement

Create a new Studio map with a Halloween theme to earn Top.50 Unlimited Decoder, as well as Medals and Trophies!

B. 1st Round of Announcements - Finalists: 12/11

 100 Mileage will be given for participating in the poll, and 50 participants will be selected by raffle to win 10,000 Mileage.

B. 2nd Prize - 1 Winner: Top.50 Unlimited Decoder x 40 ($300 worth)

C. 3rd Prize - 1 Winner: Top.50 Unlimited Decoder x 15 ($100 worth)

 The Contest Participant award will be given only to maps that were played at least 10 times and have more than 3 recommendations.



4. How to Participate

A. Navigate to STEAM >> CSNS >> Discussion.
(URL: https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/eventcomments/)

B. Click on the 'Season 4 Studio Contest' notice pinned to the top of the forum page.

C. Register using the comments located at the bottom of the notice. Enter your registration according to the format shown below.

* Incorrect information may hinder the judging and reward processes, as we have no way to reach you. Please make sure your information is correct before submitting.

D. Information required (Please ensure all information is correct.)

 CSN:S in-game nickname (write exactly as it appears in-game)

 Brief introduction about the map, or additional notes (please write in English)
