Get a theme package to if you are a participating creator out there who wishes to decorate their maps with a whole new kind of look and feel. This support event will last until 11/17. Please refer to the event notification for more details.



6. Participation Notes

Please check the terms shown below, as participating in the contest means that you agree to all of the following.

A. The award may be revoked from contestants who violate the Terms and Conditions or operational rules during the contest and award periods.

B. The award may be revoked from contestants who participate using accounts other than their own, or violate the Terms and Conditions by plagiarizing or causing copyright issues.

C. Entries containing sexually suggestive and violent images may be deleted.

D. If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria, the number of winners may be changed.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 30th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d4d33e00db4ad5a1a59921b9ee0d5af92f90f58.jpg

Updated Content
Season 4 Halloween Content Update
 Season 4 is here with a spooky Halloween theme! Check out all the new Season 4 items, such as the Season 4 Weapon, Ghost Knight, and the new classes, Wraith Bride Ritsuka and Ripper Henry.


Studio - New Feature Update
3 new features have been added to the Studio.

A. Cheer Feature
You can gift Cheer Cubes to the creators of maps that you enjoy using the Cheer feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/90cf35ff7af7fa909386ef9b8336bce3f1210b9e.png
1) How to Cheer the Map Creators
Find the Cheer button to the top left of the screen when looking at the Map Info in Studio Mode. You can also use the Cheer feature in-game if the creator has a Cheer Message Board placed in the map.

2) Gifting Cheer Cubes
 You can send the creator a message, or convert the Cube Fragments in your possession to Cubes to gift to the creator from the Cheer window. Cube Fragments can be earned by purchasing cash items.

3) Using Cubes
 The creator can use the Cubes they get to exchange them for Mileage.

B. Shop Feature
 Players on the map can use blocks such as the Coin Checker block, Item Buying block, and Weapon Shop blocks to use Cheer Cubes and Points as they would use Coins. The Points and Cubes used on the map will be saved to that map for the creator.
1) The creator is unable to use Cheer Cube Fragments or Points on maps they created themselves.

2) Using Cubes Saved on a Map
 Just as with the Cheer feature, the creator can exchange the Cubes for Mileage. Be aware that Cubes expire over time if not used.

3) Using Points Saved on a Map
 The creator can retrieve the points on the map after paying a small fee. The points will be refreshed every day at midnight, and there's a limit to how many can be retrieved per day. As with Cubes, these points expire over time if not used.

C. Studio Player Event
 We've added the Event Ticket item, which creators can use to host 30-day events on their own maps. Please note that the Event Ticket is an experimental item that will be given out only in a limited fashion. Please refer to the ‘Who Wants to Make Their Creation Maps Go Viral?! (10/30 - 11/13)’ event notice for details.

1) Hosting an Event
 Using an Event Ticket on one of your maps allows you to host an event on it. The event will be applied according to the duration and conditions configured with the ticket, and such values cannot be changed once applied. Moreover, tickets can only be applied to maps listed as Public. Using multiple tickets allows you to increase the number of winners. Be warned that you won't be able to use additional tickets once the event is applied.

2) Checking and Participating in Events
 Check out the maps with events going on by sorting and filtering from the Studio screen. Maps with an event in progress will have an event tag attached, and be displayed at the top of the list even if they have low recommendations.

 Hover your mouse over maps with an event in progress to check the participation conditions. If a map has a ‘Give a recommendation’ condition, the condition can be satisfied from the pop-up menu displayed when you play the map for more than 3 minutes.

3) Checking Event Winners
 You can find information on the event winners from the Cheer pop-up window after selecting the map.


Hide and Seek Mode Revamped
 New changes have been applied to Hide and Seek Mode, and 3 new medals have been added.
 Changes
 We're adding a feature to turn yourself invisible to allies and spectators. Select this option by clicking the check box when you choose an Object to transform into.
 Selective Random Decoration Block: A block that transforms randomly into one Object from a selected list has been added.
 Configurable Category Added: Restrict the type of objects that a player can transform into, as well as configure the damage taken by the Seeker
 3 Medals for Hide and Seek Added
 New Medals (3 Kinds): Can only be earned in rooms with four or more players
 Award-Winning Actor
 A medal awarded to those who received Golden Thumbs Up a total of 100 times
 Hawkeye
 A medal awarded to those who killed objects a total of 100 times as a seeker
 Fortune's Favored
A medal awarded to those who killed objects a total of 200 times during Burning Time


Zombie Scenario Mode Revamped
The Scenario Reward Boxes, as well as the Clear Rewards have been changed, and 7 new medals have been added.
 New Medals (7 Kinds): Can only be earned in rooms with four or more players
 Mechanical Engineer
A medal awarded to those who defeated Colossus 100 times.
 Brought a Bigger Boat
A medal awarded to those who defeated Megalodon 100 times.
 Season 2 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 2.
 Season 3 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 3.
 Season 4 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 4.
 Season 5 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 5.
 Season 6 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 6.


Partner Mode Revamped
New changes have been applied to Partner Mode.
 Changes
 The new map Villa has been added.
 The attacking location (respawn) can now be selected, and the target location (bombsite) will be randomly selected.
 Sub-objectives have been added that will provide combat support upon completion, such as weapons, ammo, recovery items, armor, and movement speed buff effects.


Quality-of-Life Improvements
The changes below have been applied to make the overall game experience better for players.
 Changes
 The list of recommended weapons in Zombie Z and Zombie Modes has been improved.
 You can check the Accolades obtained from the round in battle results.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e7b6e769f0f44bde4b85ec761297ec6165c91da8.jpg

Contents
Partner Mode
Partner Mode, where you cooperate with AI Partners, has been added.
You can check the details in the Preview section.
1. A list of maps available to be played will be displayed when you select Partner Mode. Only Demolition is supported at present, but we plan to add a variety of other modes in future updates. (Minimum of 2 players required)

2. You can select your Partner at the beginning of the game. Each partner is unique, with different personalities and abilities.
 AI Abilities: Partner's overall intelligence and skill.
 Reflexes: How fast the Partner reacts. The higher the value, the quicker the Partner reacts.
 Combat Power: Measurement of combat skills. The higher the value, the better the Partner is in combat.
 HP: Amount of HP. Partner dies when HP reaches 0.
 Movement Speed: How fast the Partner moves. The higher the value, the faster they move.
3. Give commands to your partner using the Z key.	


Zombie Meta Change
Zombie Meta has been changed, and new medals have been added as well.	
 28 Medals Added
 Zombie Fixes
 Zombie Armor: Overall HP increased
 New game option added in Zombie Mode
 Zombie skill balance fixed
 The Light Zombie's Conceal skill has been changed to slow movement speed temporarily upon use, and then restore to normal speed if the zombie is not attacked
 Rusty Wing's Glide skill has been changed to lower speed upon use
 Zombie Z Balance Fix
 EXP required for level ups increased: 22,500 -> 25,000 EXP per each level up
 Zombie Z Weapon Adjustment
 3 New Mutations Added: Intellectual, Zombie Bomb Giveaway, Revenge


Vote Kick System Revamp
The Vote Kick system has been improved.
You can check the details in the Preview section.

1. Vote Kick system has been separated from the Report and Manner Systems
 The Vote Kick system does not affect Manner points.
 If a vote to kick has been called, players in the room will be notified via chat.
 The status of the vote can be checked with the icon displayed in the View Advanced Multiplayer Func. Window (Tab or Caps Lock key).
2. Vote Kick system changes
 You can call for a vote to kick if 3 minutes have passed since the start of the game, or you've played for more than 3 minutes in the room.
 You can call for the vote from the View Advanced Multiplayer Func. Window (Caps Lock key). You can only open it when the option is available.
 There is a limit to how many votes can be called, and you can use it once per player.
 A player who was voted to be kicked may not enter the room again.


Studio Features Added
New features have been added to the Studio.
You can check the details in the Preview section.
 Studio Save feature added: The save feature can be used in play modes that allow scripts.
 Studio block added: Kartrider contents have been added.
 Studio guide added: API description has been updated.


Hide and Seek Mode Revamped
 Option to turn Outlines on/off provided
 Decorations included in the Studio Package have been added as objects that players can transform into
 Fixed position lock to remain upon 2nd Transformation

100P: Lightning Dao-1 (Permanent) + Lightning Bazzi-1 (Permanent)

 CSO Guaranteed Weapon Box Contents
Upon opening the box, you'll be given 3 different reward groups. You'll be able to select 1 weapon from each of the groups (All weapons are +6)	
 Reward Group 1: Gae Bolg, SG552 Lycanthrope, Black Dragon Cannon, M4A1 Dark Knight, Magnum Drill, Guillotine

notes.title: [Notice] Here Are the New Items for Season 2!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg

Survivors,

Season 2 is finally here!

As you all know, the Season system is a great way to earn more items.


As a follow-up to the Windrider from the previous season, you'll be able to claim a weapon called the Stinger as the big item for Season 2.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/24b828d51c8d4e96fc6966b184fa5ffe52957bed.png

It may resemble the Gae Bolg, but it's much more powerful.

As a matter of fact, it's a weapon designed to destroy the hearts of vampires from the medieval period. It fires 3 rounds of special stakes that cannot be removed once stuck.


There's also the Season 2 Spray!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/623d869ac2286763e5b8cbf6e7260023ae8f5e0a.png

The 3 sprays available in Season 2 are the [Black Anarchist Spray], [Sheriff Gerard Spray], and [Pioneer's Crest Spray].

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/89bd3c5c8d892a61ba53a1f2c8b4549171fd19a0.png


There are 2 new Zombie Skins as well!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/edb99dcf728e4ec5ea524f38f731c2ea4d8f15a1.png

One is the [Scarecrow Blotter], and the other is the [Cowgirl Light Zombie]. Freakish indeed, but don't forget, this IS a zombie game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2ef57007f55c5e994176b9d11deff4f7e36aa2cf.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/4eeea260139508dd97a1cef54ef6bf80c8a629d4.png


2 new classes with new appearances have been added, too!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/670ba135851699912a607439876b1bbd38460aef.png

Behold, [Anarchist David] and [Sheriff Gerard]! [Anarchist David] still manages to keep up his notoriety, despite having returned to the 20th century.

And now [Sheriff Gerard] finds himself with a sheriff's star and on the trail of David Black the anarchist.


We don't need to mention the newly added Season 2 Badges, right?
These are the [Season Pass Medal] and the [Season Rank Achievement Medal]. You're sure to feel powerful once you earn these!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/9ae2ac23dbce01f754ca7990d805261b5bb502a2.png


Season 2 exclusive weapons and costumes have been updated.
Costumes like the [Lantern], [Sheriff's Hat], [Leather Auxiliary Bag], [Anarchist's Hat], [Lasso], and [Tomahawk] have been added.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/5297c4da42fff0e13039649d123c82bb5072ed64.png

These fancy weapons from the Season 2 Pass rewards will take you right back to the days of the 20th century.
Why don't you all chase down an anarchist yourself, after arming yourselves with weapons like the [Elegant Winchester M1887], [Elegant Double Barrel Shotgun], [Elegant Mosin-nagant], [Elegant Python], [Elegant Mauser C96], [Elegant Hunting Dagger], and the [Elegant Aeolis]?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3c29e5f75922514b972bf1790351c1e4ae19b382.png

Don't miss out on the Season 2 Pass, filled with all sorts of awesome weapons, items, and costumes!


Most importantly, don't forget that you won't be able to get your hands on these items once Season 2 is over!

We'll be back with more information next time!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Survivors,

We've just finished maintenance, so here's a breakdown of today's CSN:Z update!


Updated Content

+6 Black Dragon Cannon Premium Enhancement Available!
The Premium Enhancement for the Black Dragon Cannon is here!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/cb4c50236e1c587b0aa94895fe28ea8cbd613a44.png

The Black Dragon Cannon is a cannon weapon that can knock down everyone within range, strong enough to make you think of a volcano erupting. It boats high portability thanks to its relatively short barrel. Activate long range firing with a right-click.

This means you'll be able to enhance the Damage and Magazine by 3. (Exclusive to +6, this weapon will fire long-range fireballs. Regular ammo will be used to fire.)


Parts Mileage Auction Event is Coming! (May 29 – June 12)
Following the success of the previous Weapon Mileage Auction, another round of Mileage Auctions will be opened just for Parts.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3b0a7a445b29223d6979950c3c809a29d7ebc665.png
Auction Duration: 5/29 - 6/12
Auction Time: 12:00 - 23:59 (CEST)

We hope to see a lot of players participating, as this is an Auction where all Parts can be traded.


Hunter Killer X-45 Sale (May 29 – June 12)
You can get the Hunter Killer X-45 from Top 50 Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Decoders during the event.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7bd8d28af85809266e8297cad3a6220f66e05a33.png

Probability: 10 times the normal rates! Get yourselves a Hunter Killer X-45 no problem!
Larger Decoder Bundles: Packages containing 30 of the Top 50 Unlimited Decoders will be added during the event! Furthermore, a package containing 50 of the Top 50 Decoders will also be added for sale!


Hunter Killer X-45 Guaranteed Giveaway (May 29 – June 12)
To assure each and every one of you will get the Hunter Killer X-45, we've prepared a Hunter Killer X-45 Guaranteed Giveaway!

You'll receive guaranteed points based on the number of Decoders you open during the event, and you'll receive a Hunter Killer X-45 (Permanent) when you reach 60 points.

Earning Guaranteed Points
Get 6 guaranteed points each time you use a Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.
Get 1 guaranteed point each time you use a Top 50 Decoder.

Notes
Reach 60 guaranteed points to receive a Hunter Killer X-45 (Permanent).
Each account can only participate once in this event.


Grade 4 Parts Reward Box Giveaway! (May 29 – June 26)
We've got more good news for fans of guaranteed points! 

Parts will be given when you earn enough guaranteed points during the event.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/b7547495fa9f39d6f7500b6b1e52319c51feb203.png

Requirements
Get 3 Grade 4 Parts Reward Boxes when you reach 30 guaranteed points

Notes
Each account can only participate once in this event.

Earn yourselves 3 Grade 4 Parts Reward Boxes by obtaining 30 guaranteed points, and while you're at it, collect a bit more for a Hunter Killer X-45 (Permanent) as well!


Black Dragon Cannon Guaranteed Giveaway! (May 29 – June 12)
Here's how you can get the Black Dragon Cannon, and the method's exclusive to CSN:Z!
Remember, this is how you can receive a Black Dragon Cannon (not +6) guaranteed.

Actions/Conditions
You will receive a Black Dragon Cannon every time you reach 30 points.

Earning Guaranteed Points
Get 6 guaranteed points each time you use a Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.
Get 1 guaranteed point each time you use a Top 50 Decoder.

You can get up to 7 Black Dragon Cannons this way.
At this rate, you'll be able to get a Black Dragon Cannon +6 in no time!


Sharing the Awesome Studio Maps from the Korea Event (May 29 – )
We're hosting an event to share some of the awesome Studio Maps selected from the Korean branch of CSN:Z.

Outstanding Studio Map, the 'Death Run'

Creator: EnterShikari
Map Name: [Zombie Escape] Death Run Zombie Escape
Try out this map created by a player just like any of you from Korea! Needless to say, we also encourage all of you to showcase many of your brilliant ideas for the Zombie Z map creation contest!


Let's watch CSN:Z Korean influencer [Ryohen]'s 'Death Run' play video on YouTube!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=idFzya8YT_o

You all know that the rewards can only be earned once per account during the event, right?


Mileage Giveaway (May 29 – June 12)
You'll be rewarded for reaching the requirements listed below during the event.

Actions/Conditions
Simply reach 30 minutes of game play each day!

Rewards
30 Minutes on Day 1: 100 Mileage
30 Minutes on Day 2, Cumulative: 200 Mileage
30 Minutes on Day 3, Cumulative: 300 Mileage
30 Minutes on Day 4, Cumulative: 500 Mileage
30 Minutes on Day 5, Cumulative: 700 Mileage
30 Minutes on Day 6, Cumulative: 900 Mileage
30 Minutes on Day 7, Cumulative: 1200 Mileage


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/30626baebee5bd6943b30d5ff6d8f2b4280c3f8e.png

Notes
Once you've reached the requirements for 7 consecutive days, you can start over from Day 1.
Game play only counts in rooms with 8 or more players.
In theory, you could obtain up to 7800 Mileage if you participate as much as possible.


We're receiving a lot of feedback about the game regarding the Season 2 update. We're doing our best to listen and apply your suggestions.

Please continue to enjoy the game so we can bring you bigger and better content!

See you all for the next patch!

notes.title: [Notice] Dev. Note - How Have You All Been? It's Been Awhile!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg

French
German
Russian
Turkish

Survivors,

CSN:Z Dev Team sent a new letter for you guys AGAIN. Please see below!


Q: It's been awhile indeed! Why don't you greet all of the CSN:Z players?
A: Hello, survivors of CSN:Z! Some of you may already know, but this is Dev Y from Nexon Korea, in charge of CSN:Z development. Howdy!

Q: Last time, you told us about the season system updates after CSOGS. Is there anything you'd like to add regarding the season system?
A: Firstly, I'd like to say a word of thanks to all of your support for season 1. I really appreciate it! All your comments and opinions play an incredibly important role in development.

We're putting a lot of effort into preparing for season 2, as we believe season 1 wasn't quite up to par. It was the first of its kind, after all.


Q: Season 2? What is that about?
A: It's a bit difficult to give you the details, as it's in the core stages of development. But I can tell you that the background will be early 20th century western areas. Keep up the hype as we prepare!

Q: I see. There are rumors of a shop revamp, too.
A: Where did you hear such a thing?

Q: The source cannot be disclosed.
A: Hmm, must be a reliable source, because you're right. We're in the process of developing a new game shop that will allow Survivors to purchase useful CSN:Z items with several types of currencies. The details cannot be given out at this point, though. I hope you understand.

Q: We've also heard that you'll be hosting a Studio Map Contest. And that there will be an extraordinary prize.
A: Ha ha ha, the prize hasn't been decided just yet. However, there indeed will be a Studio Map Contest. We thought of a competition between the maps you created yourselves and thought we'd give out rewards more realistically suited for the best designers.

Q: Any plans for new weapons?
A: Already being created. A new transcendence weapon, that is. The only hint I can give you at this point is that it's quite similar in style with weapons that you've already seen. To give you a hint… Think of the similarities between Thanos and Winter Soldier from the Marvel Universe to get an idea of the weapon.

We're also thinking about an enhanced version of the Black Dragon Cannon as well! Hang on tight to find out what kind of awesome weapons we've prepared for you all.


Q: All right, thanks. Is there anything else you'd like to say to the CSN:Z community before we conclude?
A: Every moment of development is a swamp of concerns. I constantly ask questions like 'Will the players enjoy this content?' or 'Will our efforts bring joy and satisfaction to our players?'

I'm aware of the negative reviews that have been left recently. I'm also aware of the criticisms saying that the game is P2W. Although there are moments when a difficult decision has to be made against our will, I plan to set a development direction from now on to bring player friendly updates so that as many players can get settled into the game as possible.

Please keep supporting us!


Q: Thanks for your time.
A: I'll see you all next time with a fresh set of news! Thanks as always, y'all!


Do you have any questions on this or want to tell something to 'Dev Y?'
Leave us a comment!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team



Spanish version:


[Notificación] Nota del desarrollador: ¿Qué tal va todo? Ya hace tiempo desde nuestra última notificación.

P: ¡Sí que hace tiempo desde la última notificación! ¿Quieres saludar a todos los jugadores de CSN:Z?
R: ¡Hola, sobrevivientes de CSN:Z! Algunos de ustedes quizás ya lo sepan, pero les habla el desarrollador Y de Nexon Korea, encargado del desarrollo de CSN:Z. ¡Un saludo a todos!

P: La última vez, nos contaste sobre las actualizaciones del sistema de temporadas tras el CSOGS. ¿Te gustaría comentar algo más sobre el sistema de temporadas?
R: En primer lugar, me gustaría agradecerles a todos por el apoyo recibido en la Temporada 1. ¡Muchas gracias! Todos sus comentarios y opiniones juegan un papel verdaderamente importante en el proceso de desarrollo.

Estamos trabajando muy duro para prepararnos para la Temporada 2, ya que creemos que la Temporada 1 no fue tan buena como esperábamos. Después de todo, fue la primera.


P: ¿De qué se trata la Temporada 2? ¿Puedes darnos algún adelanto?
R: Es complicado entrar en detalles, ya que se encuentra en plena fase de desarrollo. Pero puedo contarte que estará ambientada en el lejano Oeste a principios del siglo XX. ¡Mantengan las expectativas bien altas mientras terminamos con los preparativos!

P: Ya veo. Existen rumores de que también habrá una renovación de la tienda.
R: ¿Dónde escuchaste eso?

P: No puedo revelarte mi fuente.
R: Entonces tu fuente debe de ser confiable, porque es verdad. Estamos en pleno proceso de desarrollo de una nueva tienda del juego que les permitirá a los sobrevivientes comprar los artículos de CSN:Z que necesiten con distintos tipos de monedas. Pero no puedo darte más detalles ahora mismo. Espero que lo entiendas.

P: También nos enteramos de que serás el presentador de un concurso de mapas de estudio. Y que el premio será increíble.
R: Jajaja, todavía no decidimos cuál será el premio. Pero sí, organizaremos un concurso de mapas de estudio. Pensamos hacer una competencia con los mapas que crearon los jugadores y otorgarles recompensas más acordes a los mejores diseñadores.

P: ¿Planean crear nuevas armas?
R: Ya la estamos creando. Hablo de una nueva arma de trascendencia. El único adelanto que puedo darte ahora mismo es que tiene un estilo bastante similar al de las armas que ya conocen. Para darte una pista... Piensa en las similitudes entre Thanos y el Soldado de Invierno del Universo Marvel y podrás darte una idea de cómo será el arma.

¡También pensamos lanzar una versión mejorada del Cañón Dragón Negro! Estén atentos, ya que pronto daremos a conocer las armas increíbles que hemos creado.


P: De acuerdo, gracias. ¿Te gustaría decirle algo más a la comunidad de CSN:Z antes de terminar?
R: Durante el proceso de desarrollo, nos surgen muchas inquietudes. Constantemente me pregunto: «¿Les gustará este contenido a los jugadores?» o «¿Nuestro esfuerzo será suficiente para que nuestros jugadores se diviertan y estén satisfechos?».

Soy consciente de las reseñas negativas que hemos recibido últimamente. También soy consciente de las críticas que dicen que este es un juego P2W. Si bien a veces tenemos que tomar decisiones difíciles aunque no queramos, mi intención es fijar una dirección del desarrollo, desde ahora en adelante, que se base en lanzar actualizaciones que mejoren la experiencia del usuario. De esta manera, más jugadores podrán adaptarse mejor al juego.

¡Por eso les pedimos que sigan apoyándonos!


P: Gracias por tu tiempo.
R: ¡Nos vemos la próxima vez con muchas más novedades! Como siempre, gracias a todos.

notes.content:

Survivors,

Are you having an exciting April? Hopefully these patch notes for 4/3 will make it even better!


Updated Events

The Thunder Ghost Walker is here! (April 3 - May 1)
The long-awaited Thunder Ghost Walker has finally arrived! This is a single-shot pistol equipped with an optical invisibility system and .50 BMG special ammunition. If you use the Conceal skill while wielding the Thunder Ghost Walker, your Movement Speed will also get a big boost.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/be30018843fe1ff59493ed53402896f7ac68714a.png

Have a look at the review video for the Thunder Ghost Walker if you haven't yet. Special thanks to [Huxley], who created the video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dP9-88Y6pLo
How to Get
Get this awesome new weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/238f3ff4045d1b5791eb95d96a86637c90c58a8e.png
Notes
All Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders sold during the promotion will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, May 1st.
Each unused Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder will be replaced with 500 Mileage.
Each unused Top 50 Premium Decoder will be replaced with 50 Mileage.

The Thunder Ghost Walker becomes even more powerful when used with the Conceal skill, making it a must-have weapon!


Thunder Ghost Walker Guaranteed Giveaway! (April 3 - May 1)
We are offering a guaranteed Thunder Ghost Walker for everyone interested in giving this powerful weapon a try!

Conditions
Use 210 Top 50 Premium Decoders, OR
 Use 35 Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders, and we'll give you your very own Thunder Ghost Walker.

When you've used enough, you'll get the item immediately. Keep in mind that each account can only receive this reward once!


Find the Zombie Event! (April 3 - April 17)
During the event, click the Find the Zombie tab at the bottom of the screen to participate!

There are 16 characters (12 Zombies, 4 Humans) in total, and you can progress through the event by hitting zombies with bullets.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7aee85381338ed0a5d46c780200cdd468d4d3b04.png

How to Get Bullets
You can get bullets by playing the game for 15 minutes or longer.
You can also purchase them from the Shop, in bundles of 1, 10, 30, or 50.

How to Progress
The more zombies you hit, the higher your reward rank grows. You also earn more shots.
When you hit a human, your reward rank goes down, and the game ends.
When you select Surrender, the game ends and you get your current rewards.
Every time you receive your rewards, the event scoreboard will reset.
You can participate in the event as long as you have bullets, either earned from play time or bought from the Shop.

What Are the Rewards?
Class 1 - Class 4 Bronze Box (Contains one random item)
Class 1 - Class 4 Silver Box (Contains one random item)
Class 1 - Class 4 Gold Box (Contains one random item)
High Class Gold Box (Contains ALL items)

Reward List
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/484ac3711b83803aad6c0656ab790d3931156c99.png
Notes
You can obtain up to 10 bullets a day from play time.
Over the course of the event, you can earn up to 150 bullets.
Play time can only be earned in rooms with 8 or more players!


Information on Parts Error Compensation
Recently, we confirmed an issue where certain part effects were not applied, due to a code error in the service. 

We apologize for any inconveniences this may have caused. We have fixed the error in today's maintenance.
We will also give a 5000 Mileage Coupon as a login reward to all players who may have been inconvenienced. (Excludes new accounts created after 4/2 23:59:59)

Once again, we apologize to all players affected by this issue. We will do our best to minimize such issues in the future.


We want to thank you all for your continued support of CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Notice] Dev. Note - Hello and Welcome to 2019!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg
German
French
Turkish
Russian


Survivors,

CSN:Z Dev Team sent a letter for you guys. Please see below!


Q: Please say a quick hello and introduce yourself to the CSN:Z community.

A: Hello, survivors of CSN:Z! This is "Dev Y" from Nexon Korea, in charge of game development. It's nice to meet you like this. I really wanted to do this more often, and this is a long overdue greeting, since we've been so busy.


Q: We've been hearing since CSOGS that you're working on a new Season System. Could you please give us a brief overview of the Season System?

A: Sure! The Season System is brand-new content for 2019 which will cycle every 3 months, with its first season from 2/20 to 5/15. You can earn Free Pass rewards for the rank you achieve during each season, and you can get even more rewards if you purchase the Season Pass. What's important to note is that, rewards specific to a season cannot be obtained from other seasons.

The main idea is that it's a system where you can earn a variety of rare rewards like weapons, classes, and costumes by completing daily or weekly missions, along with events that we've prepared for you!


Q: Great. I've also heard you've got more in store, such as Epic Weapons?

A: That's correct. We're working hard to introduce them to you by next week. We're preparing the new Epic Weapon Gungnir. You can use it to annihilate zombies with a variety of modes such as the lightning-type for melee, firing-mode for ranged, and the ultimate ability, Javelin Throw.

Don't forget that the new Epic Weapon Gungnir can be obtained from Epic Decoders and Epic Reward Boxes. We've put a lot of effort into it, so we hope you enjoy this new Epic Weapon!


Q: On top of that, we heard that the new Zombie Scenario Season 7-2 is being released. What is that about?

A: The new boss, Megalodon, will make its appearance. Like we revealed earlier, it's a boss that looks similar to a shark. You'd better steel yourself, as it is a very powerful boss.


Q: There are rumors that Enzo and Lucia might be in danger.

A: That's correct. After reaching the destination, they encounter situations like being attacked by a mysterious poison, or almost getting barbecued from a fire attack. You'd better pay attention to the appearance of the mysterious man and woman.


Q: By mysterious man and woman, do you mean there are new classes?

A: Ha ha, I can't reveal too much... We encourage you to play the game and discover it yourself.


Q: All right, thanks. You've told us quite a lot so far. Do you have anything else to tell the CSN:Z community?

A: It's almost been 5 years since we started servicing CSN:Z, and so much has happened since then. We can't thank all of you who continue to play CSN:Z enough. The dev team promises try our hardest to create much more enjoyable contents and game play to ensure that your experience is as fun as possible.

We hope that you continue to love and support all of CSN:Z, including the new contents being released this time, like the Season System, the Epic Weapon Gungnir, and the Zombie Scenario 7-2!


Q: Thanks for your time.

A: No problem! I hope we have more opportunities like this in the future to speak to the players!

Do you have any questions on this or want to tell something to 'Dev Y?'
Leave us a comment!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Reward Thresholds

Updated Events

Play the Killer Parts Event and Earn Free Mileage and Top 50 Decoders! (December 5 – December 19)

Get the following rewards for scoring Zombie kills using weapons with parts attached in Zombie Z mode.

REWARDS
2,000 Mileage for a total of 25 kills
10 Top 50 Decoders for a total of 40 kills

What Part Weapons do I have to use to kill Zombies?
Hunter Killer X-12

NOTES

Total Kills will be shown every time you score a kill.
Kills only count in rooms with 8 or more players.

Don't miss this fantastic chance to obtain free Mileage and Decoders!

Barrett M95 WHITE TIGER Promotion! (December 5 – December 19)

The long-awaited Barrett M95 WHITE TIGER is finally here! The M95 WHITE TIGER features very special feedback, where every tenth hit summons a WHITE TIGER projectile. You won't believe your eyes the first time you see that!

Let's take a look at a demonstration video of the M95 WHITE TIGER in action, prepared by im.Baron, a YouTube influencer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X0G3hNyv4Yk&t=54s

You can obtain the permanent M95 WHITE TIGER from the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2d428dec04a884c5154974b5a2c3bf42cf5617a3.png

It's also possible to obtain other Top 7 weapons besides the M95 WHITE TIGER from the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box.
RED DRAGON CANNON
PYTHON DESPERADO
MAGNUM DRILL
BLADE RUNEBREAKER
GUILLOTINE
GÁE BOLG
SG552 LYCANTHROPE

NOTES
From Top 8 to Top 25, these 18 weapons are all permanent weapons.
All unused boxes will be removed during the maintenance on December 19th, 2 weeks after the promotion ends.
When the boxes get removed, they will each be replaced with 1,000 mileage.

Transcendent Living Weapon Giveaway Promotion! (December 5 – December 19)

You'll be rewarded with the items below for logging in during the event!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e354bba286b39d2167193a59f3e4bb7594a409f2.png

REWARDS
Transcendent Living Weapon Box (a.k.a. Transcendent Life Weapon Box)

Well, what kind of items are inside the Transcendent Living Weapon Box?
PYTHON DESPERADO
AUG GUARDIAN
RED DRAGON CANNON
+6 MAGNUM DRILL
+6 BLADE RUNEBREAKER
+6 GUILLOTINE
+6 GÁE BOLG

You can choose the weapon you want from your own Transcendent Living Weapon Box.

NOTES
Each account can only participate once in this event!
All unused Transcendent Living Weapon Boxes will be removed during the maintenance on December 19th!

Transcendent Living Weapon Extension Event! (December 5 – January 30)

How can you extend the expiration of the weapon you obtained from the Transcendent Living Weapon Giveaway Promotion? (a.k.a. Transcendent Life Weapon, too)

The Living Weapon will not disappear if you log in every day. That's because the duration is extended by 1 day every time you log in.

However, you can extend it even further through the methods below.

REWARDS

The duration of the Transcendent Living Weapon will be extended as follows for getting zombie kills in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes using the Transcendent Living Weapon.
10 Total Kills: 1 Day Extension
20 Total Kills: 1 Day Extension
30 Total Kills: 1 Day Extension

The Living Weapons have a duration cap of 15 days, but you can keep the duration extended for a full two months simply by logging in every day!

This event is only active when playing in rooms with 8 or more players, and it isn't possible to extend the expiration after January 30th.

Remember all of this to keep your Living Weapon alive!

Do NOT purchase CSN:Z DLC until we tell you otherwise!

Currently, CSN:Z is not officially selling any DLC. No matter how you are able to purchase DLC, that's not an intended sale on our end! 

You might have noticed when you visited the CSN:Z DLC page, but we do not sell DLC. We are sorry to inform you that we cannot provide support for any DLC purchases made after September 4th, 2018, when CSN:Z DLC was removed from the shop.

We're working on new DLC, and we will let you know when it is released. Please do NOT purchase CSN:Z DLC until then!

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

How can I get tokens?

You’ve got three different ways to get those sweet, sweet tokens!

Method 1: Get 1 token every time you achieve 3/6/9 Zombie Kills in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes!
Method 2: Get 1 token for 30 minutes of game time!
Method 3: Get 1 token for every Zombie Scenario Total War clear at Normal or higher difficulty.

How many tokens can I get across the whole event?
You can get a total of 84 during the event.

How many tokens do I need for rewards?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/69fe9ccafecdbbebdb0b1ad005257280ee601b33.png

Level 1 Event Reward = 4 tokens
Level 2 Event Reward = 12 tokens
Level 3 Event Reward = 32 tokens
Level 4 Event Reward = 36 tokens
Level 5 Event Reward = 44 tokens
Level 6 Event Reward = 56 tokens
Level 7 Event Reward = 60 tokens
Level 8 Event Reward = 68 tokens
Level 9 Event Reward = 80 tokens
Level 10 Event Reward = 84 tokens

What can I get from each of the reward levels?
Level 1 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x1
Level 2 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x2
Level 3 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x3
Level 4 Event Reward = Choose one: Guillotine, Ripper, Gáe Bolg. (Selective)
Level 5 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x4
Level 6 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x5
Level 7 Event Reward = Choose one: Python Desperado, Stun Rifle, Red Dragon Cannon. (Selective)
Level 8 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x6
Level 9 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x7
Level 10 Event Reward = Guaranteed +6 M4A1 Dark Knight / +6 AK47 Paladin Exchange Coupons + Level 7 Reward.

What kind of items are in the Event Reward Box?
Red Dragon Cannon
Python Desperado
Stun Rifle
Star Chaser AR
Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
AUG Guardian
Hunter Killer X-15
Hunter Killer X-90
Bouncer

The above items come in 1 Day/7 Days/14 Days/Permanent variations from the Event Reward Box. 

When you earn tokens, you’ll be notified immediately of how you earned them and how many you have received. You can only earn up to 4 tokens per day. All earning methods only work in rooms of 4 or more people, and method 3 (Zombie Scenario) only counts if you play longer than 3 minutes.

All you have to do is play the game normally, and watch the tokens roll in! We hope to see lots of players taking advantage of this chance to earn rare and transcendence weapons!

Counter-Strike Online Global Showcase Participant Selection

The participant selection for CSOGS has concluded! All participants have either been contacted or will be contacted very soon.

Thank you all for participating, and we hope to see you again at the CSOGS venue!

Mileage Shop Notice

You can purchase package items using Mileage through the Mileage Shop located at the bottom of the Lobby.

See you next update!

CSOGS (Counter-Strike Online Global Showcase) Recruitment!

The CSOWC, a festival for players across the world who enjoy CSN:Z (or CSO) will take place in Seoul, Korea on December 9th. Instead of taking the form of a competition, this year's CSOWC will have more of a feeling of celebration, and participation will be open to all who love playing CSN:Z/CSO.

We're currently accepting applications to participate in the CSO:GS. Lots of players have applied so far, but if you haven't, don't delay: the registration period ends in about a week!

Player Recruitment Criteria (2 Chosen)
[strike]The character on your personal account must be level 72 or higher.[/strike] Your level is no longer an obstacle! If you know CSN:Z well enough to play well, go ahead and apply!
We do count it a big plus if you've got the CSN:Z chops to take on challengers from around the world, of course
Also a big plus if you have an active presence in the CSN:Z community or on the forums
Basic ability to communicate in English

https://g00.gl/forms/BaptCFVOfjrWttPB2 (Registration for users, please change number '00' to letter 'oo' after 'g' in the address. Steam blocked Google's link address so we have to change it to number '00')

Getting to meet CSN:Zs developers
A visit to Nexon's headquarters
Travel costs and lodging compensated for participating in CSOGS
...and more!

We greatly appreciate the support of everyone who can participate, since we have lots of great events being planned.

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Mila
Lisa

Mirage

Straight Talk with CSN:Z

We here with CSN:Z are always doing our best to ensure that you have an enjoyable environment for playing. We do, however, want you to be aware that how you experience the game on your end is influenced by many geographical, technological, and infrastructural conditions outside our ability to control.

We completed the migration process to AWS from the former IDC environment (and its many troubles), which should guarantee a greater degree of stability. While it does cost more than before, we felt the migration was worth it to give you a better gaming experience.

Redd, a huge fan of the game, posted a thread in the Discussion section before. (https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/3338745825891944954/)

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z. We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Zombie Scenario 7-1 Challenge Event (August 29 - September 12)

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 7th: Part 2
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg

Survivors,

You have arrived at the SECOND part of this week's patch notes. If you haven't seen the FIRST part yet, click 'here' to catch up on all the news!


Studio Soccer Mode Update
You can now create Soccer Mode maps in Studio Mode. The Rules are identical to those of the previously existing Soccer Mode. This mode has a maximum of 24 participants.

We added 3 new NPCs: Soccer Coach, Male NPC (Uniformed), and Female NPC (Ji Yoon Choi Uniform version). We also added 2 new soccer-themed Monster NPCs. Hooligan A is a melee attacker, while Hooligan B is a ranged attacker.

To improve Studio Soccer Mode, we also added 6 new sound effects, such as the sound of a ball bouncing off metal bars.

Play Studio Soccer Mode in special Soccer-exclusive maps like Cage and Field!


Updated Top 50 Decoder Item & Weapon Content
As we mentioned in the first patch notes, we've updated the items and weapons available from Top 50 Decoders. We felt this revamp was necessary, as many new weapons have been released since the Decoders' rewards were last updated.

The following weapons have been added to the Top 7:
Red Dragon Cannon
Blade Runebreaker
Bunker Buster LTD

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 7:
M4A1 Dark Knight
AK47 Paladin
Ripper

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 25:
Papin
Crossbow
BALROG-XI

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 50:
Dart Pistol
Brick Piece V2
Ethereal

Please see below for the updated Top 50 Weapon list.

Big Changes to the Matching System!

The way you find and start games has changed significantly with today's patch.

We'd like to tell you a little bit about how we came to make this change, and what we took into account as we considered how to do it.

The matching system was developed last year with these goals and purposes in mind:

To allow players to play matches with others of similar skill levels, giving them fewer one-sided experiences and more exciting, evenly matched games.
To provide a fast, convenient UI that lets players join games easily and improves the accessibility needed to get a game started.

After the patch we did see many players' enjoyment of the game improved through use of the Matching System. However, we found that the playerbase was too split up, due to the fact that games created via the Matching System were treated as separate from Custom Games.

For many CSN:Z players, Studio and Custom Games form the majority of their play, so players using the Matching System had limited options when choosing a room.

With this patch we decided to fix the issues listed above while staying true to the system's original purpose.

Unifying the Split Playerbase
In order to solve this issue, we removed Matching System integration from all regular games, and integrated it fully with Custom Games. Our decision was based on a belief that players will enjoy their time with the game more if allowed the greatest freedom to play with the broadest possible pool of players, as represented by the players of Custom Games.

Maintain the Convenience of Finding Games
In order to maintain the ease of finding and starting a game, which was the best aspect of the original Matching System, we added a Quick Start function that is similar to the one currently employed in Matching. With this function you can select the modes you're interested in playing and select an automatically recommended room to quickly join a game.

Improved the Room Information UI functionality for conveniently starting games and checking information
Previously, Studio Maps only displayed the map name as the room title, and that title couldn't be changed. Now, players will be able to set the room name as they see fit. 

We also added a room title search function and a Studio/Regular Map filter so you can more easily check room information. Additionally, we added a feature that displays the rooms with games that started a short time ago in green, enabling players to find them more easily.

But wait...there's more! Before, you had to create and enter a room in order to change the settings. Now, you can configure the basic settings for the room as you create it. This should reduce the likelihood that players will skip over a room due to viewing only the default settings displayed as the room's creator configures it.

Improved the steps to join a game
Before, players who remained on standby in the map information or class selection screens hindered the players who wanted to start the game from actually playing. In order to minimize this issue, we've improved the flow of this process.

We removed the part that requires players to enter input on the map information screen. We also added a time limit on the studio entrance and class selection screens so that the game will begin automatically after a set time. 

Players who remain on standby after that will be automatically kicked from the room. Our intent in this is to make the time you spend with the game more meaningful.

We hope that the convenience-focused features in this update help you to enjoy and engage with our game as a member of the community.

Thank you again for your continued love and support of CSN:Z.

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We're already busy getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Studio Bot Zombie Dust Map Scavenger Hunt Event (June 7 to June 20)
When you kill zombie bots in the Studio Zombie Mode map, you'll randomly be awarded 1 Top 50 Decoder!

Enjoy the Zombie AI's Dust 1 map in Destruction Mode! You have a 1% chance obtain a Top 50 Decoder whenever you kill a zombie bot!

Rewards for this event will only be given in rooms where 4 or more players are playing. You can receive a maximum of 1 Decoder per day from this event - up to 13 Top 50 Decoders if you participate in this event each day!

notes.title: [Notice] Ongoing Efforts to Provide a Better Gameplay Environment
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/fe7fc31424eed4009608daa7d64526d26aae357b.jpg

Survivors,

Among the many suggestions for improvement you have given us through different channels, the most frequent have been requests to improve ping.

Acting on this feedback, we gathered information through several methods, including a survey about how we might improve ping speeds, but are sad to discover that you haven’t found our efforts to have made an appreciable difference.

Although our follow-up may seem belated, we want you to know that we have been working internally on improving the situation regarding ping.

Replacing Server Machines
Our first improvement was to upgrade our servers. Although we’re not yet certain how many players noticed a difference, we replaced the server with a better-performing model, allowing it to process more traffic.

We also moved from our previous local data center to the Microsoft Azure cloud system while working on account migration, investing more resources in the hopes of improving the quality of your day-to-day gameplay.

Play Log Analysis
We’ve also extensively analyzed the logs that are recorded when you play to discover the regions our players are logging in from. This allows us to see connections between geography and ping, helping us to know which regions we should monitor more closely for quality of service.

Through the visualization created as a result of this process, we now better understand what we need to do in the future as well.

Below, you can see the CSN:Z map we created based on the player distribution statistics we analyzed.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/0d56a8f90f1cc20b5ea006e64083c2e471222e6f.png 

We would like to take this opportunity to reassure you that we are very aware of the ping issue, and are looking into many ways to improve our service.

It may seem like a daunting goal, as we need to cover vast regions all over the world, but we will do our best to provide a better play environment, within the scope of the resources available to us.

Thank you for the passion you have shown for CSN:Z, even those of you playing on islands in the Atlantic Ocean, as we can see on the map. 

We are, at the moment, unfortunately behind the curve in giving you the satisfactory player experience you seek, but we’re committed to giving it our all, both now and in the future.

Thank you for playing CSN:Z.

Best Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

User Information Migration: Hurrrrrrrry!

As you know, the user information migration ends on April 25, 2018. If you agreed and chose ‘Yes’ for migration, you will receive some very special rewards after the migration period ends.

Want to know more about the event and rewards? Please click here.

Random Weapon Zombie Hero Mode (April 11 to April 25)

We are releasing a new mode called ‘Random Weapon Zombie Hero Mode’ after the maintenance on April 11, 2018. We are pleased to bring new content to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies players. Be sure to check out the new ‘Random Weapon Zombie Hero Mode’ in both the Italy and Assault maps!

You will receive 3 times the amount of EXP and points when you play Random Weapon Zombie Hero in either the Italy or Assault maps during the event period.
 
Easter May Be Over, But We Can Have A Post-Easter Celebration! (April 11 to April 25)

Complete the mission below during the event period to immediately receive a reward.

MISSIONS AND REWARDS
Play at least 10 minutes, and you will receive 1x Easter Egg per day.
Once you have a total of 7 Easter Eggs, you will receive a Permanent Battle Jackhammer.

CONDITIONS
Play with at least 4 players in the same room.
The Battle Jackhammer will be given only once per account.

New Transcendence Classes Are Coming! (April 11 to April 25)

The long-awaited new transcendence classes are coming! Meet Sonya Lycanthrope and Elizabeth Crimson Hunter!

You can obtain these new transcendence classes from Top 30 C and C Decoders via chance from April 11 to April 25.

During the event period, your chances of winning the new transcendence class characters will be 8 times higher than normal!

MISSIONS AND REWARDS
If you use 20x Top 30 C and C Decoder, you will receive a Crimson Bat Wing Headband as a reward.
If you use 40x Top 30 C and C Decoder, you will receive a Lycanthrope Wolf Tail as a reward.


And...

Enhancement parts for the Newcomen and Bendita have been released today.
We have also updated NGS today and now have better protection from hacking and abuse.

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We are already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Additional Information Regarding Game Service Migration.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/fe7fc31424eed4009608daa7d64526d26aae357b.jpg
Survivors,

As previously stated, service for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, currently maintained by Nexon Europe, will migrate to Nexon Korea during March and April of this year.

To ensure a seamless play experience, we are providing some important details concerning the transition of user information during the migration process from Nexon Europe to Nexon Korea.

Additional information concerning your user information migration.

If you DO NOT select ‘Yes’ by the end of the migration period (April 25th 2018 CEST), your user information currently saved to our database (purchasing records, scores, battle records, etc.) will be PERMANENTLY DELETED on April 25th 2018 (CEST). Please select ‘Yes’ to ensure your information is migrated to the new service.

Rest assured, the in-game environment—such as ping, network speed, and infrastructure—will remain the same after the migration, and we will do our best to continuously improve the in-game environment, as always.

The User Information Migration event reward has changed.

You may remember the announcement that you’ll receive a M4A1 Dark Knight (100 days) and a AK47 Paladin (100 days) for selecting ‘Yes’ and logging in to the game during the event period.

Well, we have decided to give you an even better reward instead!

Instead of two 100-day weapons, if you select 'Yes' and log in to the game during the event period, you will be able to choose one of the following gifts:
M4A1 Dark Knight ([strike]100 days[/strike] Permanent)
AK47 Paladin ([strike]100 days[/strike] Permanent)
40x Top 50 Decoders.

Note: You can select only one weapon. You cannot obtain both weapons through this event.

If you selected 'Yes’ AND log 600 or more minutes of playtime during the event period, you will also receive the following gifts:
10x Top 50 Decoders.
[strike]Blade Runebreaker (100 days)[/strike]

Who knows! This may be your first and last chance to actually choose a transcendence weapon, so we really hope you don’t miss this opportunity.

We sincerely hope that you will enjoy Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies with all the new improvements coming alongside this user information migration!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 28, 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

Zombie Shelter - City of the Dead: Hell Gate release. (March 28 to April 11)

Zombie Shelter – City of the Dead: Hell Gate is going to be released on March 28. There is no place to hide. Prepare for survival.
 
New Item release. (March 28 to April 11)
Battle Python. (Event weapon)
Star Chaser SR. (From Top 50 Decoder)
FNP-45. (Event weapon)
Battle FNP-45. (Event weapon)

Team Death Match Event. (March 28 to April 11)

If you complete the mission below, you will receive your reward immediately.

MISSIONS
Achieve 200 Kills: 5x Top 30 Brand Decoder.
Achieve 400 Kills: 1x Top 50 Decoder.
Achieve 600 Kills: 1x Top 30 C and C Decoder.

CONDITIONS
Play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
This event will can be completed only once per account.

Zombie Shelter – City of the Dead: Hell Gate Event (March 28 to April 11)

If you complete mission below, you will receive Battle Python (Permanent) as your reward.

MISSIONS
Survive 100 days in the City of the Dead: Hell Gate map.

CONDITIONS
Play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
Your surviving days will be accumulated and you can participate in this event only once during the event period.

New Rare Weapon Promotion. (March 28 to April 11)

Star Chaser (SR) will have 8 times higher chance rate from Top 50 Decoder during the event period.

DETAILS
Top 50 Decoder (1.2%)
Top 50 Unlimited Decoder (8%)
Note: This event will not apply to the Bingo system.

User information migration is continuing through 25th of April! (March 28 to April 25)

As you know, we are currently operating the ‘User information migration’ event and you are able to see that pop-up window when you login to the game.

Nexon Europe will cease CSN:Z game service but Nexon Korea will take the responsibility and try to provide better game service. At this point, we would like to remind everyone to migrate their account in order to continue playing CSN:Z.

Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies will not close the game service. If you select ‘Yes’ in the pop-up window, you will enjoy Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies continuously.

For this reason, agreeing to move your user information to Nexon Korea is very important. We are going to have a special event for the users who agree to user information migration.

If you disagree with the user information migration, you will not be able to play CSN:Z after April 25 2018. For your better understanding, we have prepared a special announcement. 

Please click here for more information.

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We are already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Important Notice Regarding Game Service Migration
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/fe7fc31424eed4009608daa7d64526d26aae357b.jpg

Survivors,

Service for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, currently maintained by Nexon Europe, will migrate to Nexon Korea from March and April of this year.

To help ensure continued play and enjoyment, here are some important details concerning the migration process for user information management access from Nexon Europe to Nexon Korea.

User Information Migration Details

Migration period:
From March 14th 2018 (CET) until April 25th 2018. (CEST)

Steps:
Log in to the game as usual.
Before entering the game lobby, a pop-up will display. This banner will ask if you agree to your user information being migrated to Nexon Korea.
If you agree to your user information being migrated, please click 'Yes.' If you do not agree, or if you would prefer more time to consider your choice, you also have the option of choosing 'Maybe later.'


What happens next?
After clicking either 'Yes' the pop-up will no longer be displayed.
By selecting 'Maybe later,' the pop-up asking whether or not you agree to your user information being migrated will keep displaying.
If you do NOT select 'Yes' by the end of the migration period (April 25th, 2018), you won’t be able to enjoy the game after April 25th 2018.
Accordingly, the user information saved in our databases will be deleted on April 25th 2018. (CEST)

Event for users agreeing to user information migration:

As special thanks for sticking by us and agreeing to user information migration, we have prepared two tiers of special gifts and bonuses.

If you selected 'Yes' and login to the game during the event period, you will receive the following gifts:
M4A1 Dark Knight (100 days)
AK47 Paladin (100 days)

If you selected 'Yes’ AND log 600 or more minutes of playtime during the event period, you will also receive the following gifts:
10x Top 50 Decoders.
Blade Runebreaker (100 days)

This event will be starting on April 25th 2018 and ending May 23rd 2018. (CEST)

We sincerely hope that users will be able to enjoy Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies with the new changes coming alongside this user information migration!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

Free Time Event: We apologize.

We are terribly sorry for the inconvenience that this may caused you and we appreciate your deepest understanding as we continue to improve your gaming experience.

Therefore, we are going to fix this by March 14th and we are going to have compensation event from today.

Compensation event for event bug.

As stated above, we have a compensation event with our sincere apologies.

DATE
From March 7th to March 14th, before maintenance.

CONDITION
Login to the game.
Play CSN:Z for 10 minutes at least.
Reward will be delivered to your account only once per account. (You can receive max 2 Top 50 Decoders during the whole compensation event period.)

REWARD
2x Top 50 Decoders.

Note: Reward will be given to your account only once during the event period.

We hope this will help you feel better. After some silly mistakes, we are going to improve your gaming experience.

We will remove Xigncode Anti-cheat system.

We decided to remove Xigncode program from our Anti-cheat pool. Therefore, we are going to remove it from our client on the next maintenance day.(March 14)

This anti-cheat program helped us a lot since we launched CSN:Z on Steam however, there’s fact that t created some technical difficulties for specific players in specific regions.

We hope it will help your gaming experience on CSN:Z.

New Patch update is on schedule.

We are testing new content and an update is on the way.

Unfortunately, we have not had a proper update for the last couple of weeks due to internal issues on the development side. These issues are now being resolved, and it is time to bring you new content in the next update.

We are pleased to present you with the better content and game service on the next maintenance day. (March 14)

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We're already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,

Zombie evolution removed.

System improvement regarding hero zombie selection.

Zombie Skin Event (Begins January 24th)
For users who have received medals corresponding with Zombie Evolution Level 2 or Level 3.
Zombie Evolution 2-1 = Infected 3,000 times --> Zombie Level 2 skin item will be awarded.
Zombie Evolution 3-1 = Infected 7,200 times --> Zombie Level 3 skin item will be awarded.
Both Level 2 and 3 skins will be given to users who have Zombie Level 3.

For users who own Level 2 or Level 3 Zombies.
Users who own Level 3 through Level 5 Zombies can earn Master Zombie Medals. 
Infect 10,000 times with the selected zombie to receive a Master Zombie Medal.
Each medal is worth 10 Honor Points.

Log in during Hot Time hours throughout the event period and achieve at least 30 minutes of playtime to receive a Life Weapon Box.
Only one of the weapons contained within the Life Weapon Box can be selected, the "life" of which can be extended with each log-in.
Hot Time: 17:00 – 02:00 (CET).
Unused Life Weapon Boxes will be removed when the event ends on February 7th, with items claimable only once per account.

Item Update:

New Transcendence Class Sale Promotion (January 24th to February 7th)
The drop rates of two types of new Transcendence Class characters from the Top 30 C & C Decoder are increased by a factor of eight during the promotion period.
Transcendent Yuri (1.2%)

notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Hold on to your Santa hats! A few more awesome events are headed your way just in time for Christmas!

Zombie Scenario Challenge Event!

Clear the new Zombie Scenario maps to receive great rewards!

WHEN
From now until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
Clear Zombie Scenario maps at Hard 4 difficulty level or higher!
This only includes maps from Zombie Season 6-4 (Carlito).

REWARD
Difficulty level Hard 7 and higher: 2x Top 50 Decoder
Difficulty level Hard 6: 1x Top 50 Decoder
Difficulty level Hard 5: 5x Top 30 Brand Decoder
Difficulty level Hard 4: 3x Top 30 Brand Decoder

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_02.png
DETAILS
Rewards may be claimed only once per account per difficulty level.
Users must reach a minimum play time of 5 minutes.
The event activates when playing in rooms with 4 or more players.

Clear the new Zombie Scenario maps and get your free decoders!

Christmas Celebration Event 1

With Christmas right at our doorsteps, we've prepared a series of special events to help everyone celebrate!

WHEN
From now until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
Simply enter the words 'Merry Christmas' in the lobby during the event period!

REWARD
Christmas Hat Set (30-day)
Christmas Spray (30-day)


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/06_1220.png

Pretty simple, right? And no bits of wrapping paper to clean up! 

Christmas Celebration Event 2

This second Christmas Celebration Event awards items for reaching a specific number of kill points!

WHEN
From now until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
Keep an eye on the counter to score these items during the event period!
Users must reach 1,225 kill points in a room with 4 or more players.

REWARD
Snowman Mask (30-day)
Christmas Stocking (30-day)


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/07_1220.png

Christmas Celebration Event 3

You'll have to wait until Christmas Day to enjoy this third and final event!

WHEN
Friday, December 25th, for one day only!

HOW
Reach 60 minutes of play time in a room with 4 or more players.

REWARD
Users will be awarded a Lone Combatant Medal!


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_Lone_Combatant.png

We hope you enjoy these awesome events! To all CSN:Z users, have a wonderful holiday season full of warmth and fun! Merry Christmas!

Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

Ps. Type Merry Christmas in lobby and see what happens!

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note – (Part 2) / December 20, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN.jpg

Dear Survivors,

If you liked what you saw in part one of this week's patch notes, you'll really love the list of events we've got planned!

Let’s see what’s new!

New User Welcome Event!

We'll be doling out welcome rewards in stages to all new users who sign up during the event period!

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 24th.

HOW
Step 1: Log in for the first time with a new account to receive rewards.
Step 2: Reach level 6 with the new account to receive MORE rewards. This is the level from which you can play Zombie Hero mode.
Step 3: Reach level 33 with the new account to receive EVEN MORE rewards.

REWARD
Step 1 Rewards: M4A1 Dark Knight, Gáe Bolg, Warhammer Strom Giant (7-day)
Step 2 Rewards: AK47 Paladin, Magnum Drill, Blade Runebreaker (30-day)
Step 3 Rewards: New User Package (1x), Top 50 Decoder (5x), Top 30 C & C Decoder (3x), Top 30 Brand Decoder (30x)

Note: The duration for weapons received during the New User Welcome Event cannot be extended.

We hope you'll enjoy all the great rewards for new users! And just in time for Christmas!

Returning Users Welcome Event!

Don't think we forgot about our returning users (who haven't logged in during the past 90 days)!

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 24th.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_04.png

REWARD
Life Weapon box (1 pcs)
Top 30 Brand Decoder Supply Box (10 days)
Double up (30 days)

WHAT’S INSIDE IN THE LIFE WEAPON BOX?
AK47 Paladin
Magnum Drill
Ripper
Blood Dripper

Note: All unused Life Weapon Boxes will be removed during maintenance on January 24th, so make sure to use them before then!

We hope returning users enjoy all the awesome rewards!

HELLO 2018! Surprise EXP Event!

Log in daily during Hot Time throughout the event period to receive 8 times the EXP!

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 29th until maintenance on January 3rd.

HOW
Log in to the game during Hot Time hours (17:00-20:00 / 23:00-01:00).
This event applies only to rooms with four or more players!
Enjoy your Christmas with the freshly-designed Santa Zombie Costume!

Christmas/New Year's Lucky Pouch Event!

Log in during Peak Time throughout the event period to receive a Lucky Pouch, with which you can receive between 119 and 2,018 Mileage Points!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/05_1220.png

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 10th.
Between 19:00 (including 3 minutes before and after) and 00:00 (also including 3 minutes before and after) CET.

REWARD
119 Mileage Points (60%)
152 Mileage Points (26.5%)
327 Mileage Points (10%)
551 Mileage Points (2%)
1,034 Mileage Points (1%)
2,018 Mileage Points (0.5%)


Note: Unused Lucky Pouches will be removed during maintenance on January 10th.

This is a great opportunity to score free mileage needed for Mileage Auction!

Mileage Auction Fee Discount Coupon Event!

Who says we need a reason to give out Mileage Auction Fee Discount Coupons? Nobody, that's who!

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
Reach the specified amount on purchases during the event period to receive a Mileage Auction Fee Discount Coupon.

WHAT
Spend a total of 100 euros or more to receive a 5% Auction Fee Discount Coupon.

DETAILS
Only one Discount Coupon awarded per account.
Unused coupons will be removed following maintenance on January 24th.
No separate pop-up will appear upon receiving the coupon; it'll be given to you instantly. You can check whether or not you've received it by having a look at the event notification window or the Auction UI.

We hope you enjoy the Mileage Auction Fee Discount Coupon! Nice little bonus, huh?

Top 50 Premium Decoder Promotion Event.

Now that we've released the AUG Guardian and the Magnum Drill Gold, it's time for the Premium Decoder Promotion Event!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_02.png

Premium Decoders up for sale during the event period!
Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders will be up for sale again, in sets of 1, 5, and 10.
Top 50 Premium Decoders will also be up for sale again, in sets of 1, 10, and 30.

New items added to Premium Decoders:
AUG Guardian - Promotion to increase drop rate by 3 times.
Magnum Drill Gold - Promotion to increase drop rate by 3 times.

Did we forget anything...?

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note – (Part 1) / December 20, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

Now Available: AUG Guardian

Introducing the AUG Guardian, a new Transcendence weapon! This assault rifle uses 50 rounds of special 50-gauge ammo, inflicting critical damage to zombies with high accuracy. Zoom in to make your shots more accurate.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/01_1220.png

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
This may be obtained by using either the Top 50 Premium Decoder or the Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder available in the in-game shop.
Unused decoders are to be removed during maintenance on January 24th.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_02.png
With great stun power, the AUG Guardian is a force to be reckoned with when used like the Sterling in Assault. This weapon practically pays for itself, since merely holding it has benefits! Rumor has it that it wards off zombie infection when a certain skill is activated...

Now Available: Magnum Drill Gold

And that's not all! We're also releasing the Magnum Drill Gold, an enhanced version of the original Magnum Drill. This Transcendence weapon is designed to be at least 10% more powerful than the Magnum Drill +6.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/02_1220.png

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
This may be obtained by using either the Top 50 Premium Decoder or the Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder available in the in-game shop.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_02.png

If you don't already own the Magnum Drill, this is your chance to grab one!

Now Available: Light Zombie Santa Costume & Heavy Zombie Santa Costume.

To help everyone enter into the spirit of Christmas, we're releasing Santa costume versions of Light Zombie and Heavy Zombie.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_XMAS_SANTA_SET.png

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
Available in the in-game shop!

Make your Christmas a little more festive with the new-and-improved Santa Zombie Costume!

New Theme Pack for Studio mode.

Studio Christmas Theme Pack released! Use this in Studio mode to help get yourself ready for Christmas!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/03_1220.png

WHEN
Following maintenance on December 20th until maintenance on January 10th.

HOW
Available in the in-game shop!

Use the new theme pack to create even more cool Studio maps!

New Premium Enhancement Parts released!

The range of enhancement using Premium Enhancement Parts will be expanded for two weapons.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/04_1220.png

WHAT
These may be applied to the Thunderbolt and Green Dragon Sword.
Enhance the weapons you own to make them even more powerful!

Though we usually publish one note per update, there are simply too many surprises to tell you about in one go! We haven't even begun to tell you about all the new events we've got planned!

We hope you'll be as excited about them as we are!

Stay tuned for part two of the weekly patch notes!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

ps. Oh, we will open Mileage Auction system on January 10th. ːsteamhappyː
