notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / November 29, 2017
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

Now Available: Craft – Share – Play! The Studio Mode!

The Studio Mode has been updated! Use your endless imagination to create new maps, share them with friends and play them in this completely new mode! Experience Studio Mode in CSN:Z now!


Click here for more info.

Keep in mind that, to use Studio Mode, you need a Studio Mode Build Scanner License and a Studio Mode Build Minigun License.

Now Available: Build Scanner License and Build Minigun License.

Like we mentioned before, to use studio mode, you need a Studio Mode Build Scanner License and a Studio Mode Build Minigun License.

WHEN
After the maintenance on November 29th.

HOW
Available in the in-game shop!

The Build Scanner License and Minigun License are also available together in the Build License Set (2 types). We hope you enjoy!

Is there a way to get the Build Scanner License and the Build Minigun License for free?

Of course!

To help you enjoy Studio Mode with less burden, we’re holding an event where you can get the Build Scanner License and the Build Minigun License for free!

WHEN
After the maintenance on November 29th.

HOW TO RECEIVE THE ‘BUILD SCANNER LICENSE’
Play Studio Mode (Creation Mode) for 30 minutes or more a day for 5 times during the event period to receive the Build Scanner License.
You can only participate for 30 minutes once a day, and you will automatically receive it after you play for 30 minutes or more each for a total of 5 days.
Owning this license allows you to use the Build Scanner in Studio Mode.


HOW TO RECEIVE THE ‘BUILD MINIGUN LICENSE’
Play Studio Mode (Play Mode) for 30 minutes or more a day for 5 times during the event period to receive the Build Minigun License.
You can only participate for 30 minutes once a day, and you will automatically receive it after you play for 30 minutes or more each for a total of 5 days.
Owning this license allows you to use the Build Minigun in Studio Mode.


Acquire the Build Scanner License and the Build Minigun License for free, and participate in Studio Mode to make your own map!

New weapon: Bouncer!

The Bouncer has been updated. It looks like a shotgun, and the bullets it fires bounce off of surfaces to hit enemies.


WHEN
After the maintenance on November 29th to just before the maintenance on December 20th.

Fire projectiles to inflict damage on zombies and enjoy the fast reload speed with the Bouncer! This is a very fine Rare weapon that has no damage falloff even after the bullets bounce off.

How can players obtain the Bouncer?

How can players obtain the great Bouncer?

HOW
By using Top 50 Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Decoders.

And one more thing!

During the event period, we’re holding a promotion by increasing the drop rate of the Bouncer by 8 times!

WHEN
After the maintenance on November 29th to just before the maintenance on December 20th.



During the period mentioned above, the drop rate of the Bouncer through Top 50 Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Decoders are increased by 8 times! Don’t miss your chance!

Four More +6 Enhance Items!

We introduced four +6 enhance items a couple of weeks ago, and another two +6 enhance items on top of that. Today we’re introducing four more +6 enhance items just for you!

Take a look below at the items available today!


Well, that’s all for now.
We’ll get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / November 08, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

Now Available: Bunker Buster LTD (Laser Targeting Device)

This new weapon can guide MIRV penetrating bombs with lasers and bomb targeted area mid-air! The Bunker Buster LTD has been newly released!

You can pinpoint the bombing starting area by left-click. Then when the guiding gauge is full, left-click then drag to assign the directions for the coordinates to bomb and wipe the enemy!

Bombing starting area and directions can be set up to 3 seconds after locking on. After they have been set, bombers appear from the sky with loud noises, and the mid-air bombing starts from the starting area and progresses in the set direction. The bombed areas are temporarily set aflame, making it the perfect opportunity for you to inflict extra damage.

However, the downside is that there is a long cooldown. There is a personal cooldown and a room cooldown that is shared by everyone in that room. The personal cooldown is 4 minutes; the room cooldown is 3 minutes. Both of them have to be at 0 to use it.

Don’t forget, this weapon can be used under grenades!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/1108_01.png

WHEN
After the maintenance on November 8th to just before the maintenance on November 22nd.

HOW
This may be obtained by using the Top 50 Decoder and the Top 50 Unlimited Decoder!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_07-01.png

Participate in the Human Kill Event and get free Top 50 Decoders!

Now that the Halloween event is over, it’s time for a new event! We proudly present this event. With all the brainstorming that went into making new content, we hope you enjoy this event!

WHEN
After the maintenance on November 8th to just before the maintenance on November 22nd.

REWARD
100 Kills reached: Zombie Double Up (7 days)
200 Kills reached: 2x Top 30 Brand Decoders
400 Kills reached: 1x Top 50 Brand Decoders

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_02_Top50.png
HOW
The rewards will be given the instant you reach the number of human kills as a zombie! (Includes all zombie classes!)
You can only participate once per account during event period.
You can only participate in this event in a room of 4 people or more.
Wouldn’t it be great if you got free Decoders that even gave you Bunker Buster LTD after participating in the Human Kill Event? Good luck to you all!

Decoder Peak Time Event!

The last Peak Time event garnered many good responses from survivors. So here it is one more time! This time it’s the Decoder Peak Time Event!

How does it work? You will get Top 30 Brand Decoders if you are online during Peak Time!

WHEN
After the maintenance on November 8th to just before the maintenance on November 22nd.

HOW
Log in during Peak Time!
Peak Time is from 20:00 to 24:00 CET (Central European Time)!

REWARD
2x Top 30 Brand Decoder are given every 30 minutes!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/03_0823.png
Note: The maximum number of Top 30 Brand Decoders you can obtain from this event are 16 per day.

Get decoders free of charge, and these nice costumes!

Matchmaking system notice

Ever since the matchmaking system was implemented to CSN:Z, we have been sincerely reading your feedback and relaying them to development. And as introduced earlier, we have created a new survey page that you can use to directly relay your feedback regarding the matchmaking system.

Your feedback is constantly read and considered by development and us. We thank you for your feedback, and look forward to receiving constructive ideas through the link below.

We here at the CSN:Z will do our best to provide you with the best game service possible.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/SS_Auto_Save_055.png

Matchmaking system survey link (click)

Well, that’s all for now.
We’ll get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Unused Top 50 Premium Decoder and Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder will be replaced with mileage coupons on November 22.

Rewards are given for reaching predetermined total kill counts.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / October 11, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Here is a brief summary of the update for this week.
Let’s see what’s new!

The matchmaking system has been updated.

Here are the long-awaited changes of the internal system UI and the matching system. From this week on, you can enjoy the game with the matchmaking system. Let’s have a look at the changes to the matchmaking system, shall we?
The matching system takes the option you selected the first to start searching. (Which is why you should set the matching options carefully.)
The matching system uses skill score calculations.
The longer the matching waiting time gets, the more the session clear rewards changes. (The rewards are in the form of EXP/Points, and the longer you wait, the bigger the EXP/Points you get.)
With custom games, you can also enjoy games just as you like.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/01_1011.png

We hope you enjoy CSN:Z even more with the changed matchmaking system!(Merged with prior segment)

Live broadcasting functions have been implemented.

Using the video recording function, the function to record current gameplay and send the file to streaming services have been added with this update.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/02_1011.png

Here is a brief introduction to this function.
The video will be send after a slight delay of around 5 seconds after it was recorded.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / September 20, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Let’s check our update for this week!

Now Available: Crow-1

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/0920_01.png

WHEN
Starting with the end of today's maintenance and lasting until the maintenance scheduled for October 11th.

It’s time for America! Hot Time Event!

Russia had its turn, so now we're having a Hot Time Event for the American continents!

WHEN
Starting with the end of today's maintenance and lasting until the maintenance scheduled for October 11th.

TIME
1:00am – 7:00am (MSK)
12:00am – 6:00am (CEST)
6:00pm – 12:00am (EDT)
3:00pm – 9:00pm (PDT)

REWARDS
3x EXP
1x Free Top 50 Decoder (Once per account per day)

The sheer size of the American continents had us thinking about when the best time would be to schedule the event. We hope the event window works well for CSN:Z users in the Americas. All CSN:Z users in North and South America are invited to participate in the event!

Participate in the Gun Deathmatch Event!

Get the highest kill count and obtain rewards! The Gun Deathmatch Event has plenty of rewards in store!

WHEN
Starting with the end of today's maintenance and lasting until the maintenance scheduled for October 11th.

REWARDS
150 kills: 10 x Item Duration Extender Coupons
350 kills: 5 x Top 30 Brand Decoders
550 kills: 1 x Top 50 Decoder
750 kills: 7 x Top 30 Brand Decoders, 1 x Top 50 Decoder
1,000 kills: 2 x Top 50 Decoder

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_02.png
DETAILS
Only available in rooms with 4 or more players.
Only possible up to once per account.

Participate in this event and get free decoders!

The Elite Zombie Killer Event is here!

Participate in the Elite Zombie Killer Event and obtain rewards! Participate in Zombie Hero mode to obtain rewards!

WHEN
Starting with the end of today's maintenance and lasting until the maintenance scheduled for October 11th.

HOW
Rewards are given for reaching predetermined total kill counts.
A maximum of 50 kills per day can be added to your total kill count.

REWARDS
80 total kills: 3x Top 30 Brand Decoder & 30x Item Duration Extender Coupons
150 total kills: 10x Top 30 Brand Decoder & 2x Top 50 Decoders
200 total kills: 3x Top 50 Decoders & 3x Top 30 Brand Decoders

DETAILS
Rewards are given immediately after the kill counts are reached.
Players can check their total kill count in-game.
Total kill count only increases in rooms of 4 or more players.

We hope you enjoy the Elite Zombie Killer Event! Join the fight and get in on the rewards!

Nothing further to report!
We'll get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / August 23, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Let’s check out our update for this week!

Weapon Crafting system use and shutdown notice:

Although used by many players, Crafting and Synthesis in the Weapon Crafting System are being shut down with today's maintenance.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/01_0823.png

We thank you for the love you've shown these Weapon Crafting subsystems.

Even after Crafting and Synthesis are shut down, you'll still be able to access Enhance, Weapon Paint, Disassemble and other systems.

Experience the Sterling Bayonet with the Top 50 Decoder & Top 50 Unlimited Decoder!

A new item has been added to the Top 50 Decoder / Top 50 Unlimited Decoder!

The previously included Special Duck Foot Gun has been removed. The Sterling Bayonet will take its place from today until September 6th.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/02_0823.png

Experience the stunning new Sterling Bayonet with the updated Top 50 Decoder & Top 50 Unlimited Decoder!

Top 30 Brand Decoder Giveaway Event!

We've organized this event to give you the Top 30 Brand Decoder free of charge. Before participating in the event, please read the instructions below carefully!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/03_0823.png

WHEN
Starting with the end of today's maintenance and lasting until the maintenance scheduled for September 6th.

HOW
Log on to CSN:Z between 8:00pm – 12:00am (midnight) and enjoy the game!
Receive the Top 30 Brand Decoder (2 every 30 minutes)!
Enjoy the game!

If you play the game from the start of the event until the end in one day, you will get a total of 16 Top 30 Brand Decoders!

Clear Zombie Scenario 6-3, and you'll also get a Tyrant Crab's Bag!

Let's clear Zombie Scenario 6-3 and get a Tyrant Crab's Bag! As a reward for clearing Season 6, you'll be getting all these items: Mr. X's Shell, Victor class and Tyrant Crab's Bag.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/04_0823.png

Unused Top 50 Premium Decoders are to be exchanged with mileage today!

As we mentioned before, your unused Top 50 Premium Decoders are to be exchanged with mileage today.
Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder = 500 mileage each.
Top 50 Premium Decoder = 50 mileage each.

Bug Fixes:
We've carried out some text error fixes and added translations in-game.
Added AWP Heavy Zombie Knife, SKULL-3 and AWP Elven Ranger on Mileage Auction.
Fixed a bug related to purchases.

Nothing further to report!
We'll get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Dear Survivors,

Let’s check out our update for this week!

We're Releasing The Special Duck Foot Gun!

Top 50 Decoder / Top 50 Unlimited Decoder has been renewed. So, we've put a new item in the Decoder. Say hello to the Special Duck Foot Gun!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/0809_01.png

The Special Duck Foot Gun is a seriously silly weapon. Check out the renewed Top 50 Decoder / Top 50 Unlimited Decoder and try out the Special Duck Foot Gun, as well!

The Mileage Auction Is Back!

The long-awaited Mileage Auction System has returned to CSN:Z!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/0809_02.png

This all-new system is operational in only a few countries at the moment. We're sure that it will satisfy all your Mileage-auctioning needs!

WHEN
Starting with the end of today's maintenance and lasting until the maintenance scheduled for September 6th.

HOW
As before, you can click the 'Mileage Auction' button in the lower part of the game window to use the system.

OPERATING HOURS

This time, auctions will be available only during certain hours. Please take the auction hours into account before participating!
BERLIN (CEST): 5:00pm – 5:00am (Next day)
NEW YORK (EDT): 11:00am – 11:00pm
LOS ANGELES (PDT): 8:00am – 8:00pm
MOSCOW (MSK): 6:00pm – 6:00am (Next day)
ISTANBUL (TRT): 6:00pm – 6:00am (Next day)

We hope you enjoy using the all-new Mileage Auction System!

Free Mileage Event!

Now that the Mileage Auction System is back in the picture, we thought you might appreciate a Mileage event!

notes.title: [NOTICE] VIP system update!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Special_EN.jpg

What is the VIP system?

It's a membership service that provides special benefits to users who've purchased in-game.

On the first day of each month, the membership rank is calculated depending on the confirmed purchase amount in the last 3 months (The total amount of purchases made this month, and the last two months before that).

The membership ranks are Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, VIP and VVIP. These are the benefits provided for each rank.

Check VIP Rank

Starting from the 1st day of each month, players are greeted with an information pop-up and given the appropriate ribbon upon initial log-in.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_001.png

Click the My Information button in the top left part of the game screen.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_002.png

My current rank is displayed where the VIP rank is shown, and detailed information about that rank can be accessed by clicking the view button.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_003.png

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_004.png

Daily Reward attendance benefit

Players who qualify can register for attendance for days where they didn't, or will not be able to.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_005.png

Evolution Experience benefit

Players who qualify can select the zombie for Evolution, then select Evolution to apply experience to them.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_006.png

Zombie Scenario benefit

Players who qualify can instantly receive the Cleared rewards of a selected zombie scenario map, and the Daily Reward Box rewards of the selected difficulty.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_007.png

Free Pass benefit

Players who qualify receive various Free Passes, according to each VIP rank. Players who qualify can access the Free Pass items for their rank in the event tab during the month when they keep their rank.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_008.png

Nickname change benefit

Players who qualify can change their nickname.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_009.png

Applying VIP benefit

Players who qualify can change their nickname and in-chat color to their rank-specific colors.

Only provided for VIP and VVIP ranks.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/VIP_010.png

Mileage Payback

Players who qualify receive a certain amount of their purchase amounts back as mileage. While this benefit is provided, a certain % of confirmed purchase amounts are immediately given back as mileage.

Please enjoy CSN:Z and all the benefits the VIP system provides!

Kind Regards
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / July 13, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Let’s check out our update for this week!

Red Dragon Cannon Release

It's finally here! Today, CSN:Z is releasing the Red Dragon Cannon. The design of the Red Dragon Cannon is similar to the earlier Black Dragon Cannon, but its damage to enemies has been greatly improved, making this the ultimate weapon.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/01_0713_Asset.png

The Red Dragon Cannon has three attacks.

The first is a normal attack, the second is a wave attack, and the third is a flame attack.

The normal attack lets enemies have a taste of powerful flames, much like the Black Dragon Cannon.
During the wave attack, the cannon changes to B mode and sends out targeted destructive waves. These waves deal powerful damage when they hits enemies, regardless of which part they hit.
Finally, when triggering the flame attack, the dragon breathes out powerful forward flames using detailed controls while in B mode.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/02_0713_Asset.png

In my personal opinion, this weapon is better than the Magnum Drill.

WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, lasting until the maintenance on August 9th.

HOW
You can acquire them from Top 50 Premium Unlimited Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_02.png

DETAILS
During maintenance on August 23rd, which will be 2 weeks after this item is no longer offered for sale, unused Top 50 Premium Unlimited Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders will be removed.
Unused Top 50 Premium Unlimited Decoders are to be exchanged with 500 mileage each.
Unused Top 50 Premium Decoders are to be exchanged with 50 mileage each.
The Red Dragon Cannon can only be purchased during this limited time, so don't miss your chance!

The Payback Event Has Begun!

When your total purchase amount reaches certain levels during the event, you will receive rewards.

WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, until the maintenance on August 9th.

HOW
For 100 Euros: 5x Top 30 Brand Decoder(s)
For 200 Euros: 1x Top 50 Premium Decoder(s) and 5x Top 30 Brand Decoder(s)
For 300 Euros: 2x Top 50 Premium Decoder(s) and 5x Top 30 Brand Decoder(s)
For 400 Euros: 3x Top 50 Premium Decoder(s) and 5x Top 30 Brand Decoder(s)

DETAILS
These rewards can only be acquired once each per account.

 ALL STAR PLAY MODE Release Celebration Event!

To celebrate the release of All Star Play Mode, we’re hosting a commemorative event!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/03_0713_Asset.png

WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, until the maintenance on July 26th.

HOW
Play All Star Mode to receive up to 3 times the EXP and Game Points!
Play the exciting All Star Mode and gain some more EXP and Game Points!

The Ice Cube Event Has Begun!

During the Ice Cube event, you can log into the game every day to receive ice cubes, then break the ice cubes to receive exciting rewards.

WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, until the maintenance on July 26th.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/04_0713_Asset.png

HOW
Log into the game every day to receive a LV 1 Ice Cube (Whole ice).
Upon using the ice cube, you will receive one of the reward items randomly, along with the ice cube of the next level.
There are 3 levels of ice cubes, and the ice cube for each level can only be used after playing the game for more than 50 minutes.

Note: The ice cubes distributed for each day are automatically removed at midnight (00:00) every day, so remember to use it before then!

REWARD
Whole Ice Cube - Includes 4 different items, including 100 mileage, randomly given out.
Cracked Ice Cube - Includes 6 different items including 300 mileage, randomly given out. (M4A1 Dark Knight or AK47 Paladin etc.)
Fractured Ice Cube - Includes 9 different items including 500 mileage, randomly given out. (M4A1 Blade Rune Breaker or Warhammer Storm Giant or Top 50 Premium Decoder etc.)

Survivors,

Let’s check out our update for this week!

Red Dragon Cannon Release

It's finally here! Today, CSN:Z is releasing the Red Dragon Cannon. The design of the Red Dragon Cannon is similar to the earlier Black Dragon Cannon, but its damage to enemies has been greatly improved, making this the ultimate weapon.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/01_0713_Asset.png

The Red Dragon Cannon has three attacks.

The first is a normal attack, the second is a wave attack, and the third is a flame attack.

The normal attack lets enemies have a taste of powerful flames, much like the Black Dragon Cannon.
During the wave attack, the cannon changes to B mode and sends out targeted destructive waves. These waves deal powerful damage when they hits enemies, regardless of which part they hit.
Finally, when triggering the flame attack, the dragon breathes out powerful forward flames using detailed controls while in B mode.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/02_0713_Asset.png

In my personal opinion, this weapon is better than the Magnum Drill.

notes.content:

Survivors,

Let’s check our update for this week!

Releasing Burning AUG! Acquire them from Top 50 Decoders!

We're releasing the Burning AUG, a customized version of the original AUG. The Burning AUG has the grenade launcher attached to the original AUG. You can fire the gun by clicking the left mouse button, and the grenade by clicking the right mouse button. The grenade is shot out for a few meters before splitting up, like the Thanatos-5 grenade.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_07_Brand.png

WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, until July 12th.

HOW
You can acquire them from Top 50 Unlimited Decoders and Top 50 Decoders.

Have fun with the powerful Burning AUG!

Burning AUG Obtain Rate Increase Event!

An opportunity to get your hands on the Burning AUG even more easily! Your chance to acquire the Burning AUG through Top 50 Unlimited Decoders / Top 50 Decoders is now 8 times higher!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0628_001.png
WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, until July 12th.

HOW
During the event period, your chance to acquire the Burning AUG from Top 50 Unlimited Decoders / Top 50 Decoders is now 8 times higher!

During the event period, acquire the Burning AUG with the higher acquire rate and enjoy playing CSN:Z!

Releasing new Weapons and Weapon paints!

Here is some good news for those of you who have been waiting for new weapons and weapon paints! From today on, you can meet weapon paints and weapons with diverse weapon paints applied!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0628_003.png
Attack M950 (100 days) + Weapon Paint: Honey
Laser Minigun (100 days) + Weapon Paint: Snake
Destroyer (100 days) + Weapon Paint: Plastic Model

WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, until July 12th.

For those of you who already have Attack M950, Laser Minigun or Destroyer, these individual weapon paints will also be on sale, so enjoy!

Crazy Zombie Hero Event.

The popular Crazy Zombie Hero Event is back!

WHEN
Starting with the end of maintenance today, until July 12th.

DETAIL
Human - Can acquire and use items, main/secondary weapon bullets are automatically refilled.
Zombie - Cooldown for all skills dramatically decreased, Zombie bombs are automatically recharged.
Event-applicable maps: Crazy Italy / Crazy Dust.
Italy and Dust can also be playing with the original rules during the event period.
Players can earn exp and points, and participate in the event also in the Crazy Map.
In the Crazy Map, zombie evolution, medals, mission, total stats, league points cannot be earned.

Bug Fixes.

Zombie Scenario 6-2 Ep. Victor has an issue where players become stuck to objects. We are working on fixes for this issue, and other map bugs. (Plans are to apply these fixes with the update on July 12th)

This is pretty much everything.
We will get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Patch announcement on June 15.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg

Survivors,

First off, we are very sorry for the urgent maintenance and unexpected bug. We’ve tracked down and fixed the bug, so everything should be working correctly in game now.

However, we had to implement a server rollback in order to protect innocent users and ensure a fair game environment.

The game server has been reverted to its state just after yesterday’s maintenance — 10:55 am (CEST).

We know that there will be many concerns regarding the server rollback, so we’re implementing the following procedures in order to save you time and ensure a positive gaming experience:
If you purchased an item in game after 10:55 am yesterday (June 14), your purchased item will be returned to your account.
(For example, if you purchased a 100 Top 30 C and C Decoder, it will be returned to your account.)
If you purchased decoder-type items in game after 10:55 am yesterday (June 14) and the opened items were the Top 25 items in the Top 50 Decoder, your opened items will be returned to your account.
- If you purchased 100 Top 30 C and C Decoders and received a Flora Paladin from the decoders, the 100 Top 30 C and D Decoders and the Flora Paladin will be returned to your account.
- If you purchased the 100 Top 50 Decoders and received a Magnum Drill from the decoders, the 100 Top 50 Decoders and Magnum Drill will be returned to your account.
- If you purchased the 100 Top 50 Decoders and received a Thanatos-7 from the decoders, the 100 Top 50 Decoders will be returned to your account. However, the Thanatos-7 will not be returned.

The following is a list of items that are eligible to be returned from the decoders:
Magnum Drill
Warhammer Storm Giant
SG552 Lycanthrope
M4A1 Dark Knight
AK47 Paladin
Reaper
Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter
Elven Ranger
Gaebolg
Blood Dripper
Black Dragon Cannon
Crossbow Advance
Air Buster
Volcano
New Comen
Savery
Thanatos-9
Dual Infinity Final
Thunderbolt
Attack M950
Dragon Blade
Batista
Papin
Crossbow
Balrog-XI
Dorothy Dark Knight
Flora Paladin

We know that EXP/Points lost with the server rollback is also a concern, so we’ll be giving you an EXP/Points coupon to compensate when you login to the game.

Note: Once you login to the game, you can get max 10 items. So, if you have purchased items are more than 10 times, you must login to the game one again.
(For exmaple, if you have purchased 43 items yesterday, you have to login to the game at least 5 times in order to receiver all items.)

If you have any question on this, please feel free to ask us through our ticket system.

Once again, we are very sorry for the unexpected maintenance and necessary rollback, and we thank you for your patience and understanding.

We are working on a compensation for today's lengthy maintenance. The compensation will be injected during the next maintenance.

We will do our best to ensure that this type of issue never happens again.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / June 14, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Let’s check our update for this week!

Zombie Scenario Season 6-2: Ep. Victor

Go back to a time when research on anti-virus showed progress. The sudden escape of 'Phobos' results in the initiation of a capture mission. It falls to Victor, the most trusted Commander.

He successfully leads the troops to complete the mission, then goes on to a transport mission. Without even realizing it, they fall into the eye of a massive conspiracy.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0614_EN_ASSET-1.png

Now Available: Victor Class (Permanent)

‘Victor’, the protagonist of Zombie Scenario 6-2! Enjoy Zombie Scenario 6-2 with him for an even more realistic gameplay!

Meet ‘Victor’ at an affordable price, we hope you enjoy the Zombie Scenario 6-2 Victor story!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/170602_CSS-693_600x400.jpg

Zombie Scenario Season 6-2: Challenge Event.

Clear Zombie Scenario 6-2 during the event period to obtain different rewards according to difficulty!

WHEN
From today to July 12th (before maintenance)

DETAIL
You enter the event by playing in a room with more than 4 people.
The rewards can be obtained only once during the event period.
You have to play for at least 5 minutes to obtain the rewards.

REWARD
Hard-4: 30,000 Game Points
Hard-5: 50,000 Game Points
Hard-6: 100,000 Game Points
Hard-7 or above: 5 x Top 50 Decoder.

Enjoy the newly updated Zombie Scenario, and obtain bonus items!

3rd Party View System Applied

From this version on, the 3rd Party View system will be applied! Check out your own character in-game with the 3rd Party View system!

WHEN
The 3rd Party View system can be accessed while you wait before a game starts, before a round starts, and after the results screen is displayed, before you exit to the lobby. (There are a few modes in which it won't be available!)

Now Available: Transcendence Class!

It's finally here!

We're releasing a new class - the ‘Transcendence class’!

DOROTHY DARK KNIGHT (TRANSCENDENCE CLASS)
A member of the secret special group, she has supernatural powers.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_06.png

FLORA PALADIN (TRANSCENDENCE CLASS)
A member of the secret special group. She has supernatural powers.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_05.png

WHEN
From today to July 12th (before maintenance)

Note: They can be obtained from the Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder during the event period!

Now Available: Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder!

Thank you for all the love you've shown to ‘Costume Box 1 & 2’. We're releasing a new Decoder to replace ‘Costume Box 1 & 2’. It will be called the Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder (Top 30 C and C Decoder).

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_07.png

The Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder has been designed to let you acquire the most popular Top 30 Classes and Costumes.

In particular, the new Transcendence classes ‘Dorothy Dark Knight’ and ‘Flora Paladin’ can only be acquired by using the Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder.

WHEN
From today to July 12th (before maintenance)

Enjoy CSN:Z even more with the new Transcendence class via Top 30 class & Costume Decoders!

Put Your Gears On! Dark Knight Mask And Paladin Crown Event!

In short, in this event you can get the Dark Knight Mask and Paladin.

WHEN
From today to July 12th (before maintenance)


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_08.png

HOW
All users who buy and use 50 Top 30 Class & Costume Decoders will randomly obtain either a Dark Knight Mask or a Paladin Crown.
All users who buy and use 50 more Top 30 Class & Costume Decoders will additionally obtain the other equipment that they did not obtain the first time.

Note: Buy and use 100 Top 30 Class & Costume Decoders to own both the Dark Knight Mask and the Paladin Crown!

ALL DLCs: -50% DISCOUNT.

Needless to say.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/03_DLCs.png

WHEN
From June 15th to June 17th. (48 hours)

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that kept the Blade Rune Breaker from being disassembled.
Fixed a bug that kept users from proceeding with the mission in Clinical Trial. (We offer our sincerest apologies for the time it took to solve this issue, and as compensation, we are providing 3 x Top 30 Brand Decoder to all survivors.)
Fixed Voodoo Zombie's texture color issue.

This is pretty much everything.
We will get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / May 24, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Let’s check out our update for this week!

8 Times Higher = 8 Times Better

During the event period, you’ll have an 8x higher chance to receive the new weapon (War Fan) from the decoder!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/0524_01.png

WHEN
From today’s maintenance until June 7.

Math for Mileage!

During the event period, you can receive Top 50 Decoders and a Chinese Zombie as a reward by collecting numbers and letters from Zombie Hero mode and Zombie mode!

HOW
First, get a zombie kill or human kill in the Zombie Hero or Zombie mode.
Then, get a zombie kill assist or human kill assist in the same mode.
Afterwards, you will receive a series of random numbers and letters.
Start your calculation with the numbers and letters you’ve collected.
Finally, construct a correct answer!


Example: If correct answer is 1234…
Enter ‘math(9*9*9*2)-(9*8*2)-(5*8*2)’ into the channel’s chat. If you’re correct, your reward will be delivered to your account!


WHERE IS THE ANSWER?
Type 'mathinfo' in the chatting line.


REWARD
Lv2. Mileage Coupon. (Daily)
Chinese Zombie (Permanent) + 10x Top 50 Decoder. (After completing it 7 times.)


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/0524_02.png

DETAILS
You can collect numbers and letters with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
You can collect a maximum of 10 identical numbers and letters.
Once the limit of 10 identical numbers or letters is reached, they will no longer be added.
If your answer has decimal points, decimal numbers will not be counted as an answer.
The answer to be calculated will differ for each player. The answer will always be between 1000 and 10000.

notes.title: [NOTICE] Global Weapon Paint Contest: Final Result
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg

Survivors,

As you know, we have been hosting the ‘Global Weapon Paint Contest’ for the last couple of weeks, and we’ve finally come to a decision.

Firstly, we would like to thank all participants in this event. Making the final decision was very tough.

We checked every design that you sent us, and we selected top 10 designs and sent to dev team.

The dev team also spent tons of time deciding, and now we’re finally ready to announce the winners.

Top 10 Designs

Here are top 10 most-liked designs! The creators will receive Top 50 Unlimited Decoder x30.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/170509_GWPCW_03-442x1024.png

Top 3 Designs.

As we mentioned above, it was a really difficult decision. All three designs were awesome, but we had to make a decision anyway.

3RD PLACE WINNER

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/3rd_place.png

This was a very interesting design.
It felt like there were many stories inside the design.
However, we didn’t like the dark color tone.

2ND PLACE WINNER

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2nd_place.png

We liked the variety of design effects.
We found the energetic color selection to be very creative.
However, the energetic color selection also gave us a slightly negative impression.

1ST PLACE WINNER

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/1st_place.png

This one had outstanding color selection.
We really enjoyed the dimensional design effect.
We thought it was a very unique design concept.

REWARD
1st Winner: Steam Cash (500 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
2nd Winner: Steam Cash (300 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
3rd Winner: Steam Cash (100 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
The creators of the top 10 most-liked designs will receive Top 50 Unlimited Decoder x30.

We will keep your IGN and e-mail information and inject or distribute the rewards when we release your weapon design as a commercial item through our in-game shop.

Congratulations to all the winners of this event. We’d also like to thank everyone for supporting and participating in the contest!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / April 26, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

How was our last update? Maybe it made you to collect newly released transcendence weapon? I hope you had that weapon already!

Let’s check our update for this week!

Exciting Zombie Scenario (Revenge) Event!

Yes, good-old event strikes back! Through this event, you can get a new weapon easily. There’s no reason not to participate this event.

WHEN
You can acquire this weapon from April 26 to May 10.

REWARD
You can get a weapon as a reward (ULTIMAX-100) if you clear Exciting Revenge during the event period.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0426_Asset_01.png

HOW
You have to clear at least Hard-6 or higher. (Difficulty)
Minimum participation time is 5 minute or longer.
You have to play this with at least 4 or more players at the same time.
Your reward item(ULTIMAX-100) will be given only once during the event period.

NOTE
Players moving speed is increased and you will have unlimited ammo.
You will encounter max 3 monsters in every 60 seconds.
All dropping weapons in the Exciting, will be used at event map only.
In Exciting map, you will not be able to acquire Zombie evolution, ribbon, mission, accumulated statistics, and league points.

Now Available: Thanatos-3 / Thanatos-5 / Thanatos-7 (Permanent)

Before I tell you something about this weapon, I must say this again.

“We will bring Mileage Auction system back sooner or later.”

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0426_Asset_02.png

WHAT

You can purchase Thanatos-3, Thanatos-5 and Thanatos-7 permanent items with competitive price.

Note: Why do we remind you to bring Mileage Auction System back in the near future? Well, let’s think about it.

System

What are changed now?

notes.title: [NOTICE] Global Weapon Paint Design Contest (Voting Started)
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg

Survivors,

As we previously announced, submissions for the design contest have been officially closed. Now it’s time for voting!

HOW TO VOTE
Please visit our ‘Artwork(Most Recent)’ page (If you can't see, please click the link below) on Steam and take a look at the user-submitted ‘Cyclone’ weapon designs.
If you like a design, click the thumbs up button.
If you don’t like a design, click the thumbs down button. Please note that you will not see a tally of downvotes.
You can upvote multiple designs. (Example for Design No.1, No. 2, and No. 3)
If there is a tie for most votes, the CSN:Z developer will choose the winner.

Note: If there are any designs that violate intellectual property laws, they will be automatically disqualified from the contest and removed from the contest page.

RESULT
Your rank will be decided based on the number of upvotes.
We will send the Top 3 designs to the CSN:Z developer, and they will decide the final ranking. (Top 1, Top 2, and Top 3)
The CSN:Z developer will give us the final result, which we will then announce.

WHEN
Voting will start today and will last until April 28 at 12:00 PM.

VIEW

-

We hope you all enjoy the contest. We can’t wait to see the results!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / April 12, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Your wait is over! We have been preparing quite a bit of content for this week. We know that you have been eager to learn about something new on CSN:Z. For those eagerly awaiting people, today is the day. Let’s check out the full update notes now.

Now Available: Blade Runebreaker.

Blade Runebreaker is our new melee weapon. The Blade Runebreaker can be obtained from the new decoders.

A blade that bears a mysterious, ancient power that provide sharpness and strength. The power can be amplified and has the ability to emit a powerful analyzer.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_01.png

You can take full advantage of this weapon's high damage, high stun power, and the longest melee range attack.

WHEN
You can acquire this weapon from April 12th to May 10th.

HOW
Through newly introduced decoders. (Please see below)


New Top 50 Unlimited / Premium Decoder is now available.

This is it.

We are proud to introduce the new Top 50 Premium Unlimited decoder today. This decoder is guaranteed to have the best item with permanent period of time. You can get the [Blade Runebreaker] item through this.

As far as we know, this is the only way you can get the [Blade Runebreaker] at the moment.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_02.png

We released Top 50 Premium Decoder at the same time. You can get the [Blade Runebreaker] through this decoder, but it isn't going to be a permanent item.

This is not the only advantage you can get, and there is something more!

Now, please enjoy our new transcendence weapon through this decoders.

WHEN
You can purchase these decoders from April 12th to May 10th.
This item will be removed on May 24.

Do you want new female characters?

Today, we are bringing in new female characters. They are very intelligent and look so charming! We didn’t know which one you'd prefer, so we brought them both.

DETAIL
ALICE (Limited Edition) with Rabbit Ears set: This uniform is worn by Alice when she infiltrated Kronos Company’s rival top executive house as a maid. She has completed the mission without any problems due to her understanding of high society culture. If you play with this character you will receive an extra bonus of 20% EXP and 25% of points. Rabbit Ears are also included in this set item.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_03.png
MICHAELA (Limited Edition): Pirates longed for the days of the appearance of iron-free girl vaguely. This dress is made from a pirate flag. Enjoy wearing it. Playing with this character will give the user an extra bonus of 25% EXP and 20% Points.

WHEN
You can purchase these lovely characters from April 12th to April 26th.


Zombie Evolution Event.
During the event period, Zombie’s evolution speed is faster and faster! (Max 5 times faster than usual)

WHEN
Starting from April 12th to April 19th.

HOW
This event will be activated under the following circumstances: At least 4 or more players in the same room.

DETAIL
April 12: Moving speed (x3 times)
April 13: HP Recovery (x3 times)
April 14: Jump ability (x3 times)
April 15: DEF (x3 times)
April 16: Headshot Defense (x3 times)
April 17: Special ability (x3 times)
April 18: All ability (x5 times)

Life Weapon Box giveaway Event.

During the event period, you have to play at a certain time and then you can get a reward.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_04.png

WHEN
Starting from April 12th to April 26th.

HOW
You can get Life Weapon Box when you first log in to the game.
Your life weapon has 15 life(s) and it will be initialized when the time comes. (00:00)
If you are not logged in to the game until midnight (00:00), your life will be deducted by -1.
If you are logged in to the game until midnight (00:00), your life will be increased by +3 and it will be applied only once per day.
If your life goes down to 0 (zero), your item will be gone.
Your life weapon can be seen in the ‘Life Weapon’ tab.
Unused Life Weapon Boxes will be removed on April 26th during the maintenance time.

Weapon upgrade event.

Your long, long, long time waiting is over. We have seen many requests for this event and therefore we have added it for a time. Event rules are simple and pretty similar to the previous one.

WHEN
Starting from April 12th to April 26th.

HOW
During the event period, you can upgrade your event weapon (permanent) when you reach a certain kill count. (Primary weapon = 5,000 kills / Secondary weapon = 3,000 kills)
If you play in the room with at least 4 or more players, your event weapon can be upgraded upon the result of kill point calculation.

EVENT WEAPONS
Katana --> Dual Katana
Crossbow --> Crossbow advance
Tactical Knife --> Double Tactical Knife --> Triple Tactical Knife
Dual Infinity --> Dual Infinity Custom --> Dual Infinity Final
SPAS-12 --> SPAS-12 Deluxe --> SPAS-12 Superior
Gilboa Garbine --> Gilboa Viper

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_05.jpg

Easter Event.

Let’s play CSN:Z and get a reward and free decoders!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_06.png

WHEN
Starting from April 12th to April 26th.

HOW
When you log in to the game = 1 x Top 30 Brand Decoder.
When you play CSN:Z for at least 60 minutes = Rabbit Skull Spray (30 days).
When you play CSN:Z for at least 100 minutes = Alice Rabbit Ears (30 days).
When you play CSN:Z for at least 150 minutes = 1 x Rabbit Box.
When you play CSN:Z for at least 300 minutes = P90 Lapin (Permanent).

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_05.png

Note: Unused Rabbit box will be removed on April 26th, at 8 a.m. (CEST) when we start weekly maintenance.

This event will be applied only once per account.

Improved Top 50 Unlimited/Top 50 Decoder!

We have added a new weapon into the Top 50 unlimited and Top 50 decoder! From today to May 10th, you can get a new weapon called ‘Rail Buster’.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_07-02.png

This rail gun can launch an accelerated projectile with electromagnetic energy. The finished charge will give maximum power.

Remember, this weapon will only be obtainable from the Top 50 unlimited/Top 50 Decoder.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_07-01.png

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week and we will get back to you with more content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 29, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

It’s been a long time! We are finally back with item and event updates! We have many things to tell you, but first let’s check out the full update notes!

Letter Collection Event!

Good old letter collection event has finally come back!

WHEN
Starting from March 29th to April 12th.

HOW
During the event period you can get an alphabet item or Joker in the game when you kill enemies.
You can get 5 Joker items, if you joined this event for more than 10 days.
You can get a reward weapon through the alphabet item you got from the game.
This event will be activated when you play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
You can’t get an event item through melee weapon with bots.
You can also get the same alphabet item as a reward.
If you collect all required alphabet letters, the reward will be injected right away.
Please check your inventory space before you participate in this event, otherwise the item will not be properly injected if your inventory space is full.
Your collected alphabet and joker items will be removed when the event finishes on April 12th.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_02.png

100,000 Zombie Killing Event.

Yes, we are bringing you this challenging event once again to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.

WHEN
Starting from March 29th to April 12th.

HOW
You can get a reward when you achieve 100,000 personal zombie kills during the event period.
Reward items will be delivered when you achieve 100,000 kills.
Your kill count will appear in the chat window every 100 kills.
You can participate in this event only once per account.

REWARD
30 x Item Duration Extenders.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_05.png

Perfect Pick Recipe: Crow-3

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_04.png

WHEN
Starting from March 29th to April 12th.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03.png

HOW
You can buy this item from our in-game shop.

Global Weapon Paint Design Contest.

As you already know, we are currently doing this event. Please check the announcement we previously uploaded and participate in this event!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03_0.png

WHAT
You can design your own ‘Cyclone’ item and send it back to us through e-mail. (csnz-event@nexoneu.com)

Mileage Auction System? (Q & A Session!)

Well, I have seen many questions and concerns about CSN:Z these days. Therefore I would like to address a couple of comments we have been receiving.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_04_MileageAuction-1.png

Q. Mileage Auction will not come back to the game.

A. You are incorrect. Like we stated in a past announcement, we are fixing and developing some content inside the auction system. We will bring it back to you when it is ready.

Q. When will Mileage Auction come back to the game?

A. Like we said, when we're ready for deployment. As a matter of fact, we are discussing when to release the mileage auction system again, so please don't worry. We will let you know when we are prepared.

Q. Do you have mileage decoder yet?

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 29, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

It’s been a long time! We are finally back with item and event updates! We have many things to tell you, but first let’s check out the full update notes!

Letter Collection Event!

Good old letter collection event has finally come back!

WHEN
Starting from March 29th to April 12th.

HOW
During the event period you can get an alphabet item or Joker in the game when you kill enemies.
You can get 5 Joker items, if you joined this event for more than 10 days.
You can get a reward weapon through the alphabet item you got from the game.
This event will be activated when you play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
You can’t get an event item through melee weapon with bots.
You can also get the same alphabet item as a reward.
If you collect all required alphabet letters, the reward will be injected right away.
Please check your inventory space before you participate in this event, otherwise the item will not be properly injected if your inventory space is full.
Your collected alphabet and joker items will be removed when the event finishes on April 12th.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_02.png

100,000 Zombie Killing Event.

Yes, we are bringing you this challenging event once again to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.

WHEN
Starting from March 29th to April 12th.

HOW
You can get a reward when you achieve 100,000 personal zombie kills during the event period.
Reward items will be delivered when you achieve 100,000 kills.
Your kill count will appear in the chat window every 100 kills.
You can participate in this event only once per account.

REWARD
30 x Item Duration Extenders.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_05.png

Perfect Pick Recipe: Crow-3

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_04.png

WHEN
Starting from March 29th to April 12th.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03.png

HOW
You can buy this item from our in-game shop.

Global Weapon Paint Design Contest.

As you already know, we are currently doing this event. Please check the announcement we previously uploaded and participate in this event!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03_0.png

WHAT
You can design your own ‘Cyclone’ item and send it back to us through e-mail. (csnz-event@nexoneu.com)

Mileage Auction System? (Q & A Session!)

Well, I have seen many questions and concerns about CSN:Z these days. Therefore I would like to address a couple of comments we have been receiving.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_04_MileageAuction-1.png

Q. Mileage Auction will not come back to the game.

A. You are incorrect. Like we stated in a past announcement, we are fixing and developing some content inside the auction system. We will bring it back to you when it is ready.

Q. When will Mileage Auction come back to the game?

A. Like we said, when we're ready for deployment. As a matter of fact, we are discussing when to release the mileage auction system again, so please don't worry. We will let you know when we are prepared.

Q. Do you have mileage decoder yet?

A. Like we have said in the past, the mileage decoder opening function will be removed in the near future.

Please use them before it expires.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png

Q. Something new?

A. Yes, we are preparing for that. Please look forward to our new update on April 12.

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week. We will get back to you with better content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Global Weapon Paint Design Contest.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Notice_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

We are proud announce that we are going to begin ‘Global Weapon Paint Design Contest’ starting today. (March 16th to April 12th)

WHAT WEAPON?
We are going to design our own Cyclone.

WHEN?
From March 16th to April 12th – You can submit your own design file to us.
From April 12th to April 23th – You can vote your favorite one. (At our ‘Artwork’ site.)

HOW TO JOIN?

Please design your own cyclone and send it to a@b.com until April 12th.
You have to write your Steam ID and your CSN:Z IGN (In-game name) in your e-mail with your design file(s).
Design files sent through e-mail without your information OR sending your information without a design file are not valid entries and will not be considered as potential winners.
If your design file is not qualified by us, your design file will not be shown to the public when we upload the design.

HOW TO DESIGN?

Please see the below sample and you can paint a splendid color or design an excellent pattern on it and send it to us with your Steam ID and your CSN:Z IGN.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Cyclone-1024x768.png

DESIGN YOUR OWN CYCLONE WITH THIS RENDER!

Above is a sample, so please use this. This is our weapon for this contest.

DETAIL
Your design file has to be PNG format.
Design file must be 3000 x 2250.
Your given design must not be violated other designs or any copyrights.
Nexon Europe will have all the rights for your submitted design(s).
You cannot insist any of your rights for your submitted design(s).
CSN:Z developer will select your design and use your design for the Cyclone weapon.
The designed weapon could be purchasing through our in-game shop and we can write your IGN on the weapon, if CSN:Z developer wants.

REWARD
1st Winner: Steam Cash (500 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
2nd Winner: Steam Cash (300 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
3rd Winner: Steam Cash (100 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
The top 10 most voted for design creators will receive 30 x Top 50 unlimited decoder.

We will inject or deliver the reward when we release your design weapon as a commercial item through our in-game shop.

TERMS AND CONDITION

[table]
[tr]
[th]NO PURCHASE NECESSARY TO ENTER OR TO WIN. A PURCHASE DOES NOT IMPROVE THE CHANCES OF WINNING.

I. Organizer
The organizer of the event is NEXON Europe GmbH.

II. Entry requirements
1. All natural persons aged eighteen (18) years or over upon the entering of the event, residing in the territories where the game Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies (the “Game”) is being serviced, are entitled to take part. Employees of the organizer and of companies affiliated with the organizer are not permitted to take part.
2. To enter the event the participant must (i) be a registered user of the organizer’s services, (ii) be a holder of an account for the Game, and (iii) be a holder of a Game character.
3. Each participant may enter the event only once within the period set out in article III.1.

III. How to enter
1. The event will begin on March 15, 2017 and end on April 12, 2017.
2. The participant may enter the event by: (i) submitting a weapon paint item design; and (ii) submitting the weapon paint design to the following email address: csnz-event@nexoneu.com .
3. The participant hereby assures the organizer that the submitted weapon paint item design will not infringe any intellectual property rights or any other rights of any third parties, is not subject to any acquisition of rights from third parties and with the submission the participant assigns any and all intellectual property rights related to the submitted weapon paint item design to the organizer in perpetuity.
4. Only participants completing and agreeing to the above stated conditions, within the stated period, will be included in the selection of the prizes.

IV. Data Protection
In order to receive the prize the winners will have to provide the organizer with his/her in-game character name. The information will be processed in accordance with the organizer’s Privacy Policy that the participants have agreed to when registering as a user, to the extent that the following paragraphs do not derogate from the Privacy Policy.

V. Determination and notification of winners
1. Only those participants who have participated in the event by completing the requirements in article II. and III for entry within the event period will be included in the selection of winners.
2. The 1st place, 2nd place, 3rd place winner and top ten (10) winners (including the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place winners) will be chosen by the result of a poll, and be awarded in accordance with article VI.1 below.
3. The winners will be announced on May 10, 2017 from and among all participants eligible for entry as per article II. and III. above. Only one prize per winner is permitted. The announcement will be made on May 10, 2017, where the winners’ character name will be published.

VI. Prizes
1. The prizes will be distributed as follows:
• 1st: Five hundred (500) Euros of Steam (digital) Cash + six (6 ) types of Global Weapons + six (6) types of National Weapon Skin (1st Class Winning skin).
• 2nd: Three hundred (300) Euros of Steam (digital) Cash + six (6) types of Global Weapons + six (6) types of National Weapon Skin (1st Class Winning skin).
• 3rd: One hundred (100) Euros of Steam (digital) Cash + six (6) types of Global Weapons + six (6) types of National Weapon Skin (1st Class Winning skin).
• Top 10 Winners: Thirty (30) x Top 50 Unlimited Decoders (per winner).
2. Prizes cannot be paid out in cash or transferred to other persons. If the delivery of the prize would fail due to the incorrect information provided by the participant, the organizer shall have no responsibility for the failed delivery.

VII. Changes to event rules
1. The organizer reserves the right to change the event rules at any time or to terminate or suspend the event without prior notice for reasonable causes, such as force majeure or other causes beyond the organizer’s control in connection with the event.
2. The organizer is entitled to exclude participants from the event in case the participant violates these Terms and Conditions of the event.

VIII. Miscellaneous
1. By participating in the event, the participants waives any and all intellectual property rights related to the submitted weapon paint item designs and furthermore agrees to the organizer printing the winners’ in-game name on the winning weapon paint item design when commercializing the item design.
2. Should individual provisions of the event rules be or become invalid then this will have no impact on the validity of the remaining provisions. The invalid provisions shall be replaced by a provision appropriate for the individual case at hand that most closely corresponds with the purpose of the invalid provisions.
3. Should the participants and/or the prize winners damage or harm the organizer and their respective officers, employees, directors, affiliates and subsidiaries due to their actions, including but not limited to the breach of these Terms and Conditions they agree to indemnify the organizer for the damages or harm caused.
4. Any and all disputes, claims and causes in connection with the event shall be resolved by applying the laws of Germany.
5. The organizer’s decisions in regards of the determination of the winners are final in all matters relating to this event.[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]


Every participant must agree to the Terms and Conditions. Please do not send any design(s) if you disagree with our Terms and Conditions for this contest.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 8, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

Permanent Characters Are Now Available!

We are listening your opinions!

We have newly updated permanent characters in our in-game shop! Let’s meet our new permanent characters!

David Black, Gerard, Alin, Ling Ling, and Dominique are waiting for you!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_01.png

Play Time Event! What Will Your Reward Be?

Starting from today, you are eligible to get a reward for this event. How to participate in this event? Just play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies from 19:00 to 24:00 (CET)! Based upon your play time, rewards will be delivered to you automatically!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_02.png

30 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 1
60 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 2
90 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 3
120 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 4
150 minutes of play time: Top 50 Decoder x 1

Oops, this event will be finished by March 29th.

A Free decoder chance is waiting for you!

Improved Top 50 And Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.

We have added a new weapon called ‘Tornado’ into Top 50 and Top 50 unlimited decoders.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_03.png

Tornado is a futuristic assault rifle that can fire 70 rounds of laser beams. The emitted laser will deal more damage over time. The technology that this weapon uses is unknown.

This weapon has 3 modes, the second and third modes will activate automatically when the weapon is fired for long enough.
If the user stops shooting for too long, the weapon will switch back to the first mode.
The longer the weapon is fired, the more damage it will deal.

Bottom line… what are you waiting for?

Enjoy Double? Triple? No… 8x Chance Event!

The celebration is just beginning.

Starting from today to April 12th, you will have 8x the chance to get a ‘Tornado’ weapon from the decoder.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/17.03.08_CSS-501_694x120_EN.jpg

8 times, yes 8 times higher chance to get ‘Tornado’ through our decoder.

SD Light Zombie Boss Event Map.

From today to April 12th, a new Zombie boss will appear in the 6th stage of Nightmare map.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_05.png

She is a Zombie, but she is cute and more elegant than before.

Please welcome cute SD style Light Zombie in the Nightmare map

Mileage Auction Has Closed.

As we announced previously, the mileage auction system has closed today. However we are going to bring back this system soon.

We would want to say good-bye for now because we will see this updated feature again in the near future.

We will fix some bugs in the system and will get back to you soon.

For Those Who Lost Their Items Or Mileages While Auctioning.

Today, we have injected your lost mileage and item into your account. Please check this out. We checked all player's game log and we found someone had an error. Therefore we injected your lost item and mileage.

Do You Have Mileage Decoder Yet?

Like we said in the past, the mileage decoder opening function will be removed in the near future.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_06.png

Please use them before it expires.

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week and we will get back to you with better content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / February 22, 2017
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

New Perfect Pick Recipe Sets

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0222_Banner_01.png

A New Perfect Pick Recipe is coming! You can find it in our in-game shop.

Click here for more information

Mileage Auction System? Wow! But Lack Of Mileage…

Please worry not. We heard you and were thinking about some sort of mileage giveaway event before February ends.

Therefore there’ll be the ‘Random Mileage Giveaway’ event!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/170125_CSS-474_694x120_EN.jpg

Starting today after the maintenance, you can get a free mileage randomly when you connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 (CET). You will not be able to receive your free mileage afterwards!

This event will close on March 8. before the maintenance.

If you leave a good review for our game on our Steam page, we will prepare another free giveaway event!

So please leave a positive review!

Good-Bye: Starter Pack DLC On Steam

We have removed the Starter Pack DLC on Steam. It has been showing pretty good performance for all beginners of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for a long time. However, that DLC is getting older and older, so we decided to remove it.

But don’t worry!

notes.title: Introducing New Decoders.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Now-available_EN-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

We are bringing new decoders! You can see our new decoders from our shop right away. We designed this item for your better enjoyment. Please see what we have added today!

Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.

This is a totally innovative decoder. You can get a PERMANENT weapon through this decoder! This decoder generates PERMANENT weapons only. In addition, the most sought after weapons are all available in this decoder.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_01_Top50UNLMTD.png

WHAT’S INSIDE?

Magnum Drill, Warhammer Storm Giant, SG552 Lycanthrope, M4A1 Dark Knight, AK-47 Paladin, Reaper, Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, AWP Elven Ranger, Gae Bolg, Guillotine, Black Dragon Cannon, Crossbow Advance, Air Buster, and more!

Our GM tested this item. They bought 30 decoders and opened them all. The result was totally shock and awe. I don’t want to say everything. It’s your turn to find out.

Top 50 Decoder.

If you don’t want to have a permanent weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Decoder, this would be a great alternative choice for you! It’s way cheaper than Top 50 Unlimited Decoder, but you can get a taste of the same weapons found in Top 50 Unlimited Decoder. In addition, if you are really lucky, you are able to get a permanent weapon by chance.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_02_Top50.png

WHAT’S INSIDE?

Magnum Drill, Warhammer Storm Giant, SG552 Lycanthrope, M4A1 Dark Knight, AK-47 Paladin, Reaper, Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, AWP Elven Ranger, Gae Bolg, Guillotine, Black Dragon Cannon, Crossbow Advance, Air Buster and more!

I hope this helps you to understand our patch for today!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: A decoder will be removed from the game.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg

A decoder will be removed from the game.

Survivors,

At the end of 2016 we hosted a "Good-bye" sale for the Supreme Decoders. We're no longer going to see them in CSN:Z.

However, with the New Year we also decided it's time for us to innovate the in-game formula and so we're also removing Mileage Decoders from the game altogether.

We know it comes as a surprise, but we do love surprises a lot!

You probably wonder what's going to happen now. How are we supposed to complete our Bingo Boards without Mileage?

Worry not, Survivors: with the Mileage Decoders going, something new and special is taking its place! Something that will potentially also address other in-game matters indirectly!

Mileage Decoder will be removed from the game on February 8th after the maintenance. After maintenance, you can open your purchased/stored Mileage Decoders but you are unable to buy Mileage Decoders anymore.

We will not close the Mileage opening function before the end of July 2017 and you will be informed again in a later stage about the date for the closing of the Mileage opening function.

We hope this helps and let us know if you have any questions on this.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / February 1, 2017.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN.jpg

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

Zombie Balloon Event.

This good old event is back! From today to February 15th, you can get a reward upon your contribution for destroying Zombie Balloon in game!

HOW
If you destroy Zombie Balloon, EXP/Points buff will be applied when the match finished.
If you participate in the Zombie Balloon event more than 10 times, you will receive a random amount of Item Duration Extender coupons.
The Zombie Balloon will be appeared in the Italy, Assault, Militia, Estate, Dust, Dust 2 and Mouse Hole map.
If you assault the Zombie Balloon at least once, it will be counted as participation.
If you get the item duration extender through this event, it will be given to you only once per day and you can participate in this event every day!
Your Zombie Balloon result will be initialized at 24:00 every day.
Only the last shooter of the Zombie Balloon will have buff effect applied.
Buff can be accumulated for 3 times max in the same match so you can get a max 300% buff effect.
Please make sure your inventory has space otherwise your item will not be properly injected.
In the Bot original / Bot death match / Bot team death match / Bot Zombie / Original League mode / Zombie Team League mode, there will be no Zombie Balloon event.

A decoder will be removed from the game.

After careful consideration, we decided to remove all decoders from the game.

Survivors,

Zombie Balloon Event.

This good old event is back! From today to February 15th, you can get a reward upon your contribution for destroying Zombie Balloon in game!

HOW
If you destroy Zombie Balloon, EXP/Points buff will be applied when the match finished.
If you participate in the Zombie Balloon event more than 10 times, you will receive a random amount of Item Duration Extender coupons.
The Zombie Balloon will be appeared in the Italy, Assault, Militia, Estate, Dust, Dust 2 and Mouse Hole map.
If you assault the Zombie Balloon at least once, it will be counted as participation.
If you get the item duration extender through this event, it will be given to you only once per day and you can participate in this event every day!
Your Zombie Balloon result will be initialized at 24:00 every day.
Only the last shooter of the Zombie Balloon will have buff effect applied.
Buff can be accumulated for 3 times max in the same match so you can get a max 300% buff effect.
Please make sure your inventory has space otherwise your item will not be properly injected.
In the Bot original / Bot death match / Bot team death match / Bot Zombie / Original League mode / Zombie Team League mode, there will be no Zombie Balloon event.

A decoder will be removed from the game.

After careful consideration, we decided to remove all decoders from the game.

Click here for more information.

I hope this helps you to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,

notes.title: Get your FREE Mileage Decoders and Finding Zombie Event!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Get Your FREE Mileage Decoders! (Peak Time Event)

Sadly, Transcendence Piece event has completed. However, there is a very good chance to get your mileage decoders for free. Stack up your free mileage decoders and consume them when the time comes along.

REWARD
3 Mileage Decoders


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png

HOW
Connect to the game between 16:00 – 18:00 (CET) and play CSN:Z for at least 110 minutes.

DETAIL
You will have a reward if you connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 and play CSN:Z for at least 110 minutes until 23:59:59 on the same day.
If you are not connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 but played CSN:Z for 110 minutes or more, you will not be deemed as a winner of this event.
Even if you connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 but didn't play CSN:Z for at least 110 minutes, you will also not be deemed as a winner of this event.

Finding Zombie Event!

Where’s your ammunition? Your ammunition is vital for combat so please get your ammunition over here!

REWARD
A reward item will be randomly selected in the box and will be given to you.

BOX
Grade 1 – 4 Bronze Box
Grade 1 – 4 Silver Box
Grade 1 – 4 Gold Box
High Class Gold Box

HOW
You can participate in this event through an event button at the bottom of the screen.
If you found a zombie, your reward level will increase +1 and you can shoot again if you have another bullet.
If you found a human, your reward level will decrease -1 and it will be finished.
If you give up the event, you will acquire current the reward and it will be finished.
If you acquire the reward, your event status will be reset.

Let’s enjoy this event and get the boxes!!!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team
