notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Free X-MAS Gift Package!

Seasons greeting! There’s a proverb in the old CSN:Z town. Close your mouth, and take this free item! Yes, it’s time for a giveaway!

WHEN
From December 21st to December 28th.

REWARD
Snowman Mask (30 days)
Christmas Stocking (30 days)
Christmas Hat Set (30 days)
Christmas Spray (30 days)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_Free_XMAS_GIFT_PKG.png
HOW
You can get Snowman Mask (30 days) and Christmas Stocking (30 days) when you connect to the game during the event period.
You can get Christmas Hat Set (30 days) and Christmas Spray (30 days) when you play CSN:Z for more than 30 minutes.

DETAIL
You have to play with 4 or more players in the same room.
If you abuse this event in any way, you will be suspended.
Please secure your inventory space, otherwise your reward will not be delivered properly.

We Alone Are The Brave Ones!

Don’t worry. Even if you are playing CSN:Z on the night of the Christmas Eve, you are not alone. There are people in CSN:Z. So please come to CSN:Z and make your Christmas Eve great with your single comrades.

WHEN
From December 25 (00:00 – 23:59, CET)

REWARDS
Lone Combatant medal.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_Lone_Combatant.png

HOW
Connect to CSN:Z and play CSN:Z for at least 1 hour.

Note: If you already have this medal, you will not get the same medal through this event.

Renewed Transcendence Decoder.

From today, we are going to sell renewed Transcendence decoder which consists of almost every transcendence weapons inside the decoder.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/en.jpg

WHEN
From December 21st to January 11th.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_30x_TD.png

Warhammer Storm Giant
Crimson Hunter
Dark Knight
Paladin
Lycanthrope
Magnum Drill

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_TW.png

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: X-MAS Exclusive! Free level up promotion event.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Attention! Get your free promotion coupon!

Sometimes you will have difficulty when you are trying to level up your character. It can be frustrating spending so much time on this game when at some times your level is not so quickly upgraded. Therefore we decided to bring you this event.

WHEN
From December 14th to December 28th.

REWARD
+1 Level up coupon.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1214_02_LevelUp1.png

HOW
If you clear a total of 70 daily missions during the event time, you will get a reward.
Unused level up coupons will be removed on January 11th, after the maintenance.
The level up coupon will make your level +1 but your EXP will stay the same. (For example, if you are currently 10% at level 10, you will become 10% at level 11.)
This event will be applied only once per account.
Abuse of this event will result in punishment.
If you are already reached the highest level, it will not affect you level.
Only daily missions can be counted. Other missions will not be counted toward the event.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Transcendence Piece Event, Login Event, And New Snow Base Map!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

What will come in this week? Let’s check this out!

Transcendence Piece Event Is Finally Coming Back!

Well, well, well… finally the time has come. Yes, we are going to have year-end Transcendence piece event. I think this will be the last opportunity to get your transcendence weapon in this year.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_TR_Weapons.png

WHEN
From December 7th to December 21st.


HOW CAN I GET TRANSCENDENCE PIECES?
During the event period, a transcendence piece will appear at random from Mileage Decoders.
During the event period, you will get 1 transcendence piece when you log in to the game. (Only once per day.)
During the event period, you will get 1 transcendence piece every 30 minutes. (Max 4 pieces per day.)

HOW TO USE TRANSCENDENCE PIECES?
If you get more than 888 transcendence pieces, you can select M4A1 Dark Knight or AK47 Paladin when you use transcendence pieces.

WAIT! WHAT ARE THE TRANSCENDENCE WEAPONS?
Super strong power is being applied for the AK47 and M4A1.
If you get this item in your inventory, additional EXP will be applied.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_TR_Weapons2.png

ANYTHING ELSE THAT I MUST KNOW?
After the event period, all transcendence pieces will be removed.
Please secure enough inventory spaces for smooth item injection.
After the event period, remaining transcendence pieces will be replaced with the other items based upon your remaining transcendence pieces amount. (Please see below table)
Even if you have more than 800 transcendence pieces, you will get a same reward items as those who have 800 transcendence pieces.

[table]
[tr]
[th]Number of Transcendence Piece(s)[/th]
[th]Replaceable items[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]1 - 100[/td]
[td]50 x Item duration extender coupon + 1 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 1 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]101 - 200[/td]
[td]150 x Item duration extender coupon + 2 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 2 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]201 - 300[/td]
[td]250 x Item duration extender coupon + 3 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 3 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]301 - 400[/td]
[td]350 x Item duration extender coupon + 4 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 4 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]401 - 500[/td]
[td]450 x Item duration extender coupon + 5 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 5 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]501 - 600[/td]
[td]550 x Item duration extender coupon + 6 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 6 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]601 - 700[/td]
[td]650 x Item duration extender coupon + 7 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 7 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]701 - 800[/td]
[td]750 x Item duration extender coupon + 8 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 8 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]More than 801[/td]
[td]888 x Item duration extender coupon + 10 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 10 x Random S-Grade Blueprint and 1 x Random Perfect Enhancement Material.[/td][/tr]
[/table]

Login Event Is Back With Lots Of Reward! Free Decoders Are Waiting For You!

We acknowledged that you have been waiting for this type of event for a long time. The wait is finally over now! Please enjoy!

WHEN
From December 7th to January 4th.

HOW
During the event period, you will get a reward upon your accumulated login count.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/2.png

REWARD
Day 1 – 3 x Normal Enhancement Box.
Day 2 – 3 x Large Medical Box.
Day 3 – 1 x Max 30 days Durable.
Day 4 – 1 x EXP/Point coupon. (Lv. 1)
Day 5 – 2 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.
Day 6 – 1 x Special Enhancement Box.
Day 7 – 10 x Event Mileage Decoders.

PLUS

When you get 7 accumulated logins, you will get a bonus items.

7 days – 15 x Event Mileage Decoders. (No Mileage), 1 x Lv1 Mileage Coupon, 1 x B-Grade Random Blueprint, and 3 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.
14 days - 30 x Event Mileage Decoders. (No Mileage), 15 x Mileage Decoders, 1 x Lv1 Mileage Coupon, 1 x A-Grade Random Blueprint, and 5 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.
21 days - 45 x Event Mileage Decoders. (No Mileage), 20 x Mileage Decoders, 1 x Lv2 Mileage Coupon, 1 x A-Grade Random Blueprint, and 10 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.

Note: Rewards will be injected automatically.

New Map: Snow Base!

Missing a snow covered map in the winter season would be a shame. So here’s the snow covered map where you can fight with your enemies!

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_SnowBase.png

This is a seasonal map, as such this map will be removed a month later.

WHEN
From December 7th to January 11th.

Please enjoy our prepared event for December and we hope you have great time with Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: New Dedicated South American And Turkish Server. (BR/PT/TR)
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

New Dedicated South American And Turkish Server

Survivors,

We have been listening to your opinion for a long time and we acknowledge that some of our South American and Turkish players are experiencing lags and frame dropping issues these days.

After careful consideration, we made a decision to launch a high-end dedicated server for smoother gaming and to accommodating the fast growing number of South American and Turkish players.

WHAT’S SO SPECIAL ABOUT THIS DEDICATED SERVER?

If you are into gaming on your computer in the South America or Turkey region, then you have probably dealt with the frustration of trying to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies on a slow connection. Few things in life are more frustrating than playing one of your favorite games poorly as a result of a bad connection, lag, or other connectivity issues.

As such, we decided to launch our new dedicated server for you.

This dedicated server allows you to have a dedicated, reliable connection that you can use outside of your home internet connection for gaming without lag or connectivity problems.

WHEN WILL THE DEDICATED SERVER BE AVAILABLE?

It will be available on December 7.

PLAY COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES, MUCH FASTER THAN BEFORE.

We are going to closely manage this dedicated server at first, which will allow us to check South American and Turkish player’s network environment and the ongoing connectivity issue.

Visit Forum.

Here’s the thing that you should know:
This dedicated server will provide 3-months of servicing period.
Connection speed will vary upon your connected area or region.
We will make a post in the discussion section where you can leave a comment for the dedicated server.
: Your Steam account.
: Connected area or region. Ex) Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brazil
: Average FPS.
: Average Ping.
: Broadband or Wireless. Ex) 100 bps Wired Fiber Cable connection.
: Comment. Ex) When the match finished, frame dropped significantly.
Your feedback and comments will be so helpful in improving your ongoing connectivity issue.

During this testing period, your feedback would be helpful for us to provide higher quality service.

Hope to see you in a game more often.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_ES_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Nuevos Servidores Dedicados En Sudamérica Y Turquía.

Sobrevivientes:

Hemos estado escuchando sus opiniones desde hace mucho tiempo y reconocimos que algunos de nuestros jugadores sudamericanos y turcos están experimentando retrasos y pérdida de frames últimamente.

Después de considerarlo cuidadosamente, hemos tomado la decisión de poner en marcha un servidor dedicado de alta gama para hacer que el juego sea más rápido y acomodar al gran número de jugadores sudamericanos y turcos que va en crecimiento.

¿QUÉ TIENE DE ESPECIAL ESTE SERVIDOR DEDICADO?

Si estás en juego en tu computadora en la región de Sur América o Turquía, entonces es probable que hayas tenido que lidiar con la frustración de tratar de jugar Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies en una conexión lenta. Pocas cosas en la vida son más frustrantes que jugar uno de tus juegos favoritos con deficiencias a causa de una mala conexión, retraso (lag) u otros problemas de conectividad.

Por lo tanto, decidimos lanzar nuestro nuevo servidor dedicado para ti.

Este servidor dedicado te permite tener una conexión dedicada y fiable que se puede utilizar fuera de tu conexión a Internet en casa para jugar sin problemas de lag o de conectividad.

¿CUÁNDO ESTARÁ DISPONIBLE EL SERVIDOR DEDICADO?

Estará disponible el 7 de Diciembre.

JUEGA COUNTER STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIS MUCHO MÁS RÁPIDO QUE ANTES.

Vamos a manejar de cerca estos servidores dedicados en un principio, lo que nos permitirá comprobar el entorno de red de los jugadores de Sudamérica y de Turquía, y los problemas de conectividad que estén en curso.
Aquí está la cosa que debes saber:

Visit Forum.

Este servidor dedicado proporcionará 3 meses de periodo de servicio.
La velocidad de conexión puede variar dependiendo del área conectada o tu región.
Haremos un post en la sección de discusión donde se puede dejar un comentario sobre el servidor dedicado.
: Tu cuenta de Steam.
: Área conectada o región. Ej.) Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brasil
: FPS promedio.
: Promedio de ping.
: Banda ancha o inalámbrica. Ej.) 100 bps Conexión por cable Cable de Fibra.
: Comentario. Ej.) Cuando la partida terminó, los frames se redujeron significativamente.
Tus opiniones y comentarios serán útiles para mejorar los problemas de conectividad en curso.

Durante este período de prueba, su opinión sería de gran ayuda para nosotros, ya que podremos proporcionar un servicio de mayor calidad.

Esperamos verlos en el juego más a menudo.

Saludos cordiales,
El equipo de CSN:Z

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_BR_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Novo Servidor Dedicado: América Do Sul E Turquia

Sobreviventes,

Temos ouvido a opinião de vocês por bastante tempo e percebemos que alguns dos nossos jogadores sul-americanos e turcos estão sofrendo com problemas como lag e perda de frames.

Depois de pensarmos bastante, decidimos lançar um servidor dedicado de primeira linha para melhorar a jogabilidade e atender o crescente número de jogadores da América do Sul e da Turquia.

POR QUE ESSE SERVIDOR DEDICADO É TÃO ESPECIAL?

Se você joga de um computador na América do Sul ou na Turquia, provavelmente já ficou frustrado tentando jogar Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies com uma conexão lenta. Poucas coisas na vida são mais frustrantes que jogar mal um dos seus jogos favoritos por causa de uma conexão ruim, lag ou outros problemas de conectividade.

Por isso, decidimos lançar o servidor dedicado para vocês.

O servidor dedicado oferece uma conexão confiável que você possa usar para jogar sem lag ou problemas de conexão.

QUANDO O SERVIDOR DEDICADO ESTARÁ DISPONÍVEL?

Ele estará disponível no dia 7 de dezembro.

JOGUE COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES, MUITO MAIS RÁPIDO QUE ANTES

Nós vamos gerenciar de perto este servidor dedicado, o que nos permitirá verificar a rede dos jogadores sul-americanos e turcos e os problemas de conexão recorrentes.
Informações que você deve saber:

Visit Forum.

O servidor dedicado terá um período de serviço de 3 meses.
A velocidade da conexão vai variar de acordo com sua região ou área de conexão.
Criaremos um tópico na seção de discussões onde você poderá comentar sobre o servidor dedicado.
: Sua conta Steam
: Região ou área de conexão. Ex: Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brasil
: FPS médio
: Ping médio
: Banda Larga ou Wireless. Ex: 100bps, conexão por fibra ótica cabeada
: Comentário. Ex: Quando a partida terminou, houve perda de frames.
Seu feedback e comentários serão muito úteis para nos ajudar a melhorar o problema de conexão.
Durante este período de testes, seu feedback vai nos ajudar a oferecer um serviço de melhor qualidade.

Esperamos ver você no jogo mais vezes!

Atenciosamente,
Equipe CSN:Z

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_TR_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Yeni Güney Amerika Ve Türkiye Sunucuları.

Askerler,

Bir süredir Güney Amerikalı ve Türk oyuncularımızın gecikme, frame düşüşü gibi sorunlar yaşadıklarına dair şikayetler almaktaydık.

Detaylı bir incelemeden sonra daha iyi bir oyun tecrübesi sunabilmek ve büyüyen Güney Amerika ve Türk oyuncu topluluğumuzun ihtiyaçlarına cevap verebilmek adına bu sunucuları açmaya karar verdik.

PEKİ BU SUNUCULAR NEDEN ÖZEL?

Eğer Güney Amerika veya Türkiye bölgelerinden Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies oynamaya çalışıyorsanız muhtemelen bağlantı hızınızdan şikayet ediyorsunuzdur. Hayatta, sevdiğiniz oyunu oynarken kötü bağlantı, gecikme veya diğer bağlantı sorunları yüzünden kötü sonuçlar almanız kadar sinir bozucu bir şey yoktur.

Bu nedenle sizler için yeni sunucularımızı aktif etmeye karar verdik.

Bu özel sunucular, daha hızlı ve güvenli bir bağlantı sunar. Evinizden başka bağlantıları kullanarak da herhangi bir gecikme ve bağlantı sorunu yaşamadan oynayabilirsiniz.

BU ÖZEL SUNUCULAR NE ZAMAN AKTİF OLACAK?

Sunucular 7 Aralık 'da aktif edilecektir.

HİÇ OLMADIĞI KADAR HIZLI COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES TECRÜBESİ.

Bu özel sunucuları öncelikle yakından takip edeceğizve bu sayede Güney Amerikalı ve Türk oyuncuların bağlantı durumlarını ve devam eden bağlantı sorunlarını kontrol edebileceğiz. İşte bilmeniz gerekenler:

Visit Forum.

Özel sunucular 3 aylık dönemler halinde hizmet verecektir.
Bağlantı hızınız bağlandığınız bölgeye göre değişiklik gösterebilir.
Sunucular hakkında yorum yapabilmeniz için tartışmalar sekmesinde konu ile ilgili bir başlık açacağız.
: Steam hesabınız.
: Bağlantı bölgesi. Örn) Beşiktaş, İstanbul, Türkiye
: Ortalama FPS.
: Ortalama Ping.
: Kablolu veya kablosuz. Örn) 100 bps Fiber bağlantı.
: Yorum. Örn) Maç sona erdiği zaman frame inanılmaz düşüyor.
Yorumlarınız ve fikirleriniz devam eden bağlantı sorunlarını çözebilmemiz için çok faydalı olacaktır.

Bu test dönemi süresince görüşleriniz sizlere daha iyi bir hizmet sunabilmemiz açısından oldukça önemli.

Oyunda daha sık görüşmek üzere.

Saygılar,
CSN:Z Ekibi

notes.title: [WINNERS] [NX]BlindFire's Halloween Killing Spree!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg

Survivors,

Thank you all, once again, for joining this special Event! 
Running around with a chainsaw was exceptionally fun and helped me recover from eating all of those candies (the CSN:Z Team is still mad at me).

Today, rewards were injected to the winners according to the goal scored in the various Event Rooms.
Let's have a short recap:


REWARDS

All players in the Event Room will be eligible for a reward based on the total amount of kills scored by [NX]BlindFire by the end of that round, with 100 kills as the best possible result: 


0-99 Kills: No Reward 
100 Kills: 1x Transcendence Decoder + 3x Mileage Coupon (500 Points) 
101-103 Kills: 2x Mileage Coupon (500 Points) 
104-110 Kills: 1x Mileage Coupon (500 Points) 
111+ Kills: No Reward


Source: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/527312601037148997
Congratulations, Survivors!
You should find your Mileage Coupon(s) waiting for you as soon as you log in.

A special note for those who managed to score the "100 Kills" Goal: you'll be able to use your Transcendence Decoder as soon as they'll be made available in-game again.
This is, unfortunately, a side effect of their time-limited availability in the in-game Shop, but worry not: your Transcendence Decoder will patiently sit in your inventory until that moment.

Last, but not least, an important reminder that could be cause of some confusion otherwise: some of you could be expecting a reward that never came.
The cause is most likely the following:


RESTRICTIONS

Users are allowed to join the Event Room (regardless of it being successful or not) only 1 time during the whole Event period. This is needed to let as many players as possible experience the Event. 
If you join the Event Room more than once, you won't get any reward at all, even if you won one or more rounds. Be aware.


Source: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/527312601037148997
I'm sorry to say that, no matter my warnings and notices in-game, various users tried to sneak inside the Event Room more than once, and some of them managed to. 
This resulted in those specific users losing all of the rewards earned during the Event.


Best Regards,
[NX]BlindFire

notes.title: GM EVENT: [NX]BlindFire's Halloween Killing Spree!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg

Survivors,

He has been quiet for a while now, but turns out [NX]BlindFire started doing “Trick or Treat” with the whole CSN:Z Team in his own way: sneaking around stealing candies.

As he had the brilliant idea of eating them all without asking, he's now on a strange mood. He seems full of energy but way too much, to be honest, to the point that he's not feeling too well.

Survivors, you have to help him! On his way out he stole quite the supplies from Henry's storage, so you can expect sweet rewards if you succeed!

However, he's extremely unstable... Oh, and he got a chainsaw.

WHEN
November 1, 2 and 3 from 3:40pm to 5:00pm CET in the EU Server. 


HOW
Channel and Room Number will be announced via in-game notice and will be switched after each round.
Event will take place in Deathmatch Mode on „Large” maps only (max 32 players each round)
[NX]BlindFire is immortal and will only use a chainsaw, however there are no weapons restrictions for users. 
Time limit is 10 minutes per round (120 kills max).
Round is valid if [NX]BlindFire is present in the room from start to finish.


YOUR GOAL
Help [NX]BlindFire reaching at least 100 kills before the end of the round. Teamwork is essential!
If [NX]BlindFire exceeds 100 kills, your reward will sharply decrease (round automatically ends if [NX]BlindFire reaches 120 kills)
You can check [NX]BlindFire's current kill count by either holding Tab or by checking the interface at the top of your screen (he's most likely going to be the top killer in the room, let's be honest)
When reaching respectively 50 and 100 kills, [NX]BlindFire will completely stop for 20 seconds each time to help with the flow of the Event.
When reaching respectively 103 and 110 kills, [NX]BlindFire will completely stop for 10 seconds each time to help further with the flow of the Event.
It's up to you all to ensure he doesn't score kills too fast... or too slow. How? The easiest way is attempting to avoid/steal kills from him, or go suicidal and get killed on purpose.


RESTRICTIONS
Users are allowed to join the Event Room (regardless of it being successful or not) only 1 time during the whole Event period. This is needed to let as many players as possible experience the Event.
If you join the Event Room more than once, you won't get any reward at all, even if you won one or more rounds. Be aware.


REWARDS

All players in the Event Room will be eligible for a reward based on the total amount of kills scored by [NX]BlindFire by the end of that round, with 100 kills as the best possible result:

0-99 Kills: No Reward
100 Kills: 1x Transcendence Decoder + 3x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
101-103 Kills: 2x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
104-110 Kills: 1x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
111+ Kills: No Reward

ANNOUNCEMENT
Winners will get their rewards on November 9th after the Maintenance!

Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

November 1, 2 and 3 from 3:40pm to 5:00pm CET in the EU Server. 


HOW
Channel and Room Number will be announced via in-game notice and will be switched after each round.
Event will take place in Deathmatch Mode on „Large” maps only (max 32 players each round)
[NX]BlindFire is immortal and will only use a chainsaw, however there are no weapons restrictions for users. 
Time limit is 10 minutes per round (120 kills max).
Round is valid if [NX]BlindFire is present in the room from start to finish.


YOUR GOAL
Help [NX]BlindFire reaching at least 100 kills before the end of the round. Teamwork is essential!
If [NX]BlindFire exceeds 100 kills, your reward will sharply decrease (round automatically ends if [NX]BlindFire reaches 120 kills)
You can check [NX]BlindFire's current kill count by either holding Tab or by checking the interface at the top of your screen (he's most likely going to be the top killer in the room, let's be honest)
When reaching respectively 50 and 100 kills, [NX]BlindFire will completely stop for 20 seconds each time to help with the flow of the Event.
When reaching respectively 103 and 110 kills, [NX]BlindFire will completely stop for 10 seconds each time to help further with the flow of the Event.
It's up to you all to ensure he doesn't score kills too fast... or too slow. How? The easiest way is attempting to avoid/steal kills from him, or go suicidal and get killed on purpose.


RESTRICTIONS
Users are allowed to join the Event Room (regardless of it being successful or not) only 1 time during the whole Event period. This is needed to let as many players as possible experience the Event.
If you join the Event Room more than once, you won't get any reward at all, even if you won one or more rounds. Be aware.


REWARDS

All players in the Event Room will be eligible for a reward based on the total amount of kills scored by [NX]BlindFire by the end of that round, with 100 kills as the best possible result:

0-99 Kills: No Reward
100 Kills: 1x Transcendence Decoder + 3x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
101-103 Kills: 2x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
104-110 Kills: 1x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
111+ Kills: No Reward

ANNOUNCEMENT
Winners will get their rewards on November 9th after the Maintenance!

Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: We're Hiring: Local Customer Supporter – Russian language (m/f) (Freelancer)
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_EN_Thib007.jpg

Survivors,

A pioneer in the world of interactive entertainment software, Nexon developed the world’s first graphic MMORPG, The Kingdom of the Winds, in 1995. Since then, we've become the industry leader in massively multiplayer online games, continuing to redefine the genre with each of our innovative titles.

Nexon Europe began its success story with the introduction of the worldwide hit game “MapleStory” to the European audience and quickly became a leading publisher of online content with millions of enthusiastic players across Europe. 

We are looking for a passionate

Local Customer Supporter – Russian language (m/f) (Freelancer)

to support our Customer Service Team from home (on your PC).

Your Tasks:
Perform high quality, ticket-based end-user customer support for our players (in Russian and English).
Work on the game’s knowledge base and standard customer service answers.
Maintain a high level of knowledge in any of Nexon Europe’s games.
Report about general gaming related issues.
Communicate about relevant customer issues with the related departments to improve service quality. 
Additional tasks upon request (e.g. assisting with Forum or Facebook moderation).

Your Profile
Experience in Free-To-Play Online Games, especially in Nexon Games.
Fluency in both verbal and written Russian and excellent English language skills. Additional European languages are a plus.
Very good communication skills.
Well-organized workflow.
Capable of working independently.
Technical knowledge in Internet (IT) and PC related technologies.
Your own PC and flat rate internet connection.
Skype account & headset.
Meeting previously agreed performance targets.
Work experience with customer support and/ or the gaming industry are preferred.

We offer:
Earn Skill Points: Become part of the growing Gaming Industry and get many insights about how this world operates behind the scenes. If you plan a future career in the industry this might be your entrance ticket.
Be part of the Nexon Supporter Family: You will get to know supporters from all over the world. Nobody is left alone. We assist and help each other whenever needed. 
Receive Kudos: Help other players in times of need. Become a leading part in the gaming community.
Earn Nexon Cash (NX): We pay serious amounts of our premium game currency.
Earn Real Cash: In addition to a warm thank you and access to premium currency, we remunerate you also with real money.


Interested in entering the world of online games? Send us your application (including your motivational letter, your CV and your Nexon Username (ID) as well as Game(s) you play and level in English, to recruit_ic@nexoneu.com. Please use the subject "Russian Local Customer Supporter - First Name Last Name".

Let's see you in the office.

Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: The Vulcanus-3: Trick or Treat?
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

The Vulcanus-3: trick or treat? Pre-experiencing the Vulcanus-3 before its official release!

Dear Survivors,

Some of you noticed it already, some others didn't: Vulcanus-3 was added to Blueprints Grade-1 with the latest update.

Usually, the release of similar weapons is announced with the introduction of a Perfect Pick Recipe Set to let you get your hands on them as soon as possible but for this once we wanted to give you, literally, a chance to experience the newest member of the Vulcanus series before its "official" release, in the most classic crafting way!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2016/vulcanus3.png

We're confident that the little thrill of surprise for getting the Vulcanus-3 was worth it, for those lucky ones who already got it!

notes.title: Old And Classic Weapon Remastered And The Other Events.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Remastered Classic Weapons.

Some of the players are underestimating our old classic weapons. Our top-notch gunsmith has remastered some good, classic weapons.

WHAT
AK-47: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
M4A1: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
AWP: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
XM1014: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_02_CWP.png

100,000 Zombie Kills Event.

In the past, we have had a similar event, but that event was not only for you, but also for every member of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. This time, you make your own achievement!

REWARDS
30 x Item Duration Extender Coupon
Rewards will be injected automatically when your zombie kill count reaches 100,000.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_03_IDE.png

GOAL
Kill 100,000 Zombies by yourself.

WHEN
From October 12th to November 2nd.

Zombie DNA Update.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.jpg

We have still another update for Zombies. We have added and removed a couple of skills and abilities from Zombies. Let’s check this out now!

Banshee Zombie
Rigidity and knockback resistance have been slightly increased.
The moving speed has been slightly decreased.
Pulling skill changes:
This skill changes Banshee zombie's status to damaged immunity status.
The skill makes the bat fly straight and passes allies.
When the character aims at the target, this skill pulls all enemies around the target.
According to the evolution level, the skill speed and skill range are increased.

Psycho Zombie
The skill is changed to 'smoke screen.'
Smoke screen skill changes:
The skill effect is changed and smoke screen duration time has been reduced.
The zombie's damage rate from humans will be reduced when the zombie is in the smoke screen.
When skill is over, the Psycho Zombie's HP recovers as much as the amount of absorbed damage in the smoke screen.
When the character uses smoke screen on the same location again, the higher damage reduction rate will be applied.
According to the evolution level, the skill's damage reduction rate and smoke screen area will be applied differently.

Host zombie spawn rule changes
Before the game starts, it will inform the character that he/she will change to a host zombie in the game.
The character can change to a host zombie whenever he/she wants by pressing the E key. The character will not change to a host zombie right away when the game starts.
When the character doesn't change to host zombie, it will change by force.
Even if the host zombie infects another host (human status), it will not be counted in the points.

Charging condition changes
The maximum charging rate that can be obtained by zombie kill is reduced to +40% from +100%. (+10% increases every 1 kill)
When there is a human around, the rising rate of maximum charging rate is increased from +60% to +120%.
The charging rate whenever a human joins the group is increased to +10% from +5%.

Primary weapon
Four kinds of hero weapon damages are increased.
4 kinds of sidekick weapon damages are increased.

Secondary weapon
The damage of secondary weapon 1 for hero / sidekick is increased.

Note: Some of the old weapon's zombie targeting damage will be increased to balance the human vs zombie.

Zombie assist score and ribbon
When a zombie failed to infect a human but helped other zombies, this will give the zombie +1 assist point and a ribbon.
Tis but a Zombie Bomb ribbon: The human gets infected within 4 sec. due to zombie bomb x 15 times (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).
Tanker Ribbon : Gets 3,000 damage from human x30 (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).

GP Decoder Event.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png

The beloved GP Decoder event is back! You can purchase GP Decoder from the shop with your GP.

WHEN
From October 12th to October 19th.

WHAT
You can acquire GP decoders by exchanging your GP.

HOW
Level 15 – 29: 1 GP decoder with 5,000 GP per day.
Level 30 – 49: 1 GP decoder with 10,000 GP per day.
Level 50 or higher: 1 GP decoder with 15,000 GP per day.
For example, if you are level 50 or higher, 3 GP decoders with 30,000 GP per day in total.

Purchase GP decoders will disappear after certain period, so you’d best use any in your inventory before they expire.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Blood on your weapons! + New Zombie Escape Map + SKULL Weapon series released!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Blood on your weapons!

Finally, it’s time to wrap your weapon! We decided to release the ‘Blood’ weapon paint starting today.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_Blood_On_Your_Weapons-2.png

WHAT
Player can paint the selected weapons with Blood paint.
SKULL-1, SKULL-3, SKULL-5 can be painted with this item.

SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-1_PPR_SET.png

WHEN
From September 21st to October 5th.


SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-3_PPR_SET.png

WHEN
From September 21st to October 5th.

Note: Currently, SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe's image in game shop shows 'Blood' covered image but it is SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe without 'Blood' weapon paint. Please be careful when you purchase this item.

SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + Blood Weapon Paint.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-1_PPRBLOOD_SET.png

WHEN
From September 21st to October 5th.

ELEMENTS
10 x SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + 1 x Blood Weapon Paint.


SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + Blood Weapon Paint.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-3_PPRBLOOD_SET.png

WHEN
From September 21st to October 5.th

ELEMENTS
10 x SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + 1 x Blood Weapon Paint.

New Zombie Escape Map.

After the zombie virus outbreak, a group of survivors composed of civilians, soldiers, and cops await for a signal in a secluded warehouse in the forest. After confirmation of an extraction team heading to their location, they must proceed to the outskirts of the forest in order to meet the rescue team. However, unwelcome visitors are waiting.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Rhizome_Grey_Frame-768x461.png

OBJECTIVE
Humans: Head to the rendezvous point at the outskirts of the forest within the time limit.
Zombies: Infect all the humans, or get to the extraction point before them.

TIPS
Strafing and Russian walk skills are really recommended to pass some areas quickly, especially the mill part.
AWP-Z is also highly recommended to pass the big waterfall part quickly.
There are several paths leading to the Osprey. Make sure to defend them all to avoid being ambushed by zombies.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Division Zombie Hero!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Division Zombie Hero Event.

What is the Division Zombie Hero? You will want to know what will come today.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Division_Italy.png

OBJECTIVE
Human: Survive the zombie attack for the remaining time limit or eliminate all zombies.
Zombie: Infect all remaining humans into zombies.

WHAT
Added ‘Division Italy’ map.
 A zombie killed by humans will be resurrected immediately in the place they died and the dead zombie will be divided into two other schizonts.
Players will be divided into bot and player and the divided bot will attack humans like Bot Zombies.
A max of 20 players can play at the same time.

TIPS
At the start, the humans can choose a hero.
Zombies start with their own schizont.
Upon death, you and your schizont divide into two other schizonts.
Can divide up to 2 times, and will die permanently upon its 3rd time.
In the event mode, evolution, stats, medals, and accolades do not get counted.

WHEN
From September 21st to October 12th.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Zombie Scenario Chronicle!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

What Is Zombie Scenario Chronicle?

It’s very simple. You must start playing from the First Contact in the Zombie Scenario Season 3 to 5 and finish the Last Flight in regular sequence.

Once you have done from the start to an end in regular sequence, you will be rewarded.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0907_ZSC_REWARDS.png

REWARDS
ASURA Medal
Special ENH Material

Note: If you do not have not enough space in your inventory, rewards will not be delivered properly. Please secure inventory space before participating in the event.

HOW
You must clear the First Contact in the Zombie Scenario Season 3 to the Last Flight in the Zombie Scenario Season 5 in regular sequence.
If you do not clear the levels in regular sequence, rewards will not be delivered.
You need to play with at least 4 players in the same room.
Difficulty must be ‘Normal’ or higher.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0907_Special.png

WHEN
From September 7th to September 21st.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

Dual Infinity is a pair of dual-wielded pistols capable of firing in semi-automatic or in fully automatic mode. While firing in semi-automatic mode, the accuracy and damage of the pistols will noticeably be higher but its rate of fire is lowered. notes.title: Weapon Upgrade Event!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

How Do You Get The Weapon For The Upgrade Event?

You can upgrade three weapons during this event period. However, you will likely have many questions about the event even if you've played it before. Please read carefully to check how you can do this without a problem.

WEAPONS

Infinity Silver
Dual Infinity
Kriss Super V

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0831_WPUGEVNT.png

HOW TO GET THE WEAPON?

Infinity Silver: As you can see, we are giving you a free Infinity Silver for the upgrading event from August 24th to September 14th. It’s free! You can freely upgrade this weapon!
Dual Infinity: You can purchase this weapon August 31st to September 14th as a perfect pick recipe set! Let’s check out the in-game shop!
Kriss Super V: You can get this weapon from Mileage Decoders.

WHEN
From August 31st to September 14th.


HOW
You must play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
You need 5000 kill points to upgrade Primary Weapons, while only 3000 kill points are needed for Secondary Weapons.
Infinity Silver: In Scenario mode (Human/Zombie), it can be upgraded to Infinity Red by scoring 3000 kills.
Infinity Silver: In Zombie modes (Original/Mutant/Hero/Darkness), it can be upgraded to Infinity Black by scoring 300 kills.



Please do not miss this chance and play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies with free Infinity Silver at least!

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: NEXT WAVE - GM EVENT COMES BACK ON THE STAGE!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg

GM EVENT #1: All against [NX]BlindFire!

[NX]BlindFire is ready to challenge again the CSN:Z Survivors in a fierce Deathmatch!

WHEN

August 18th at 4pm CEST in the EU Server. 

HOW

Channel will be announced before making the room to allow interested users to gather.
Room will be created shortly after.
Quickly get in the Event Room, available slots are limited!
Room and Channel are switched every round, a total of 3 rounds are hosted.
Event will take place in Deathmatch Mode.
Map will be randomly selected.
There are no Weapons Restrictions.
[NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
Time limit is 10 minutes per round.
Kill limit is 120 per round.
Max 32 players are allowed in the Event room. (round starts when the room is full)
[NX]BlindFire has a headstart of +20 points over the final score to balance the results.
The top 3 users with the highest kill count will see their efforts combined against [NX]BlindFire's total kills +20.
If total kills from top 3 users are more than [NX]BlindFire's kills + 20, the round is won.
Round is valid if [NX]BlindFire is present in the room from start to finish.
The round ends when either the 120 kill limit is reached, or the 10 minutes run out. Depending on which occurs first.
Kill farming, alliances and similar tactics invalidate the ongoing round.
Each user is allowed to join only two rounds of the Event during the same day. If more than 2 Event rounds are joined during the same day, that user won't get any extra reward from them.

REWARDS

For each round won, all players in the room during that round will get 1 x 500 Mileage Points Coupon!

ANNOUNCEMENT

Winners will get their rewards on August 31 after the Maintenance!


GM EVENT #2: [NX]BlindFire's helping hand!

[NX]BlindFire joins again the fight to assist the Survivors with the Zombie outbreak! From completing Scenario Maps at the hardest Difficulty to helping with ongoing Events, this time he means business!

NOTE: This is a weekly Event with no set end date. 

WHEN

Starting from August 25th, every Thrusday at 4pm CEST on EU servers.

HOW

REGULAR EVENT:

Channel will be announced before making the room to allow interested users to gather.
Room will be created shortly after.
Event will last approximately 60 minutes.
Slots in the Room are limited.
Event will take place in Zombie Scenario mode on HARD-9 Difficulty.
Maps are selected in a chronological order until time runs out.
After each map completed, the room will be switched.
There are no Weapons Restrictions.
[NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
[NX]BlindFire is a walking arsenal and will distribute powerful weapons to use during the battle.
Users are invited to join only one round of the Event during a given day to allow other users in.
If you already used your Scenario Daily Reward Box for that day on your own, you can still join the Event for a fun run.

OPTIONAL EVENT:
Depending on other ongoing Events, [NX]BlindFire can propose to the survivors little variations to possibly help even further.
Users in the channel/room are free to disagree and proceed with the Regular Event.

NOTE: If most of the users agree and the variations include changing difficulty of the match or, even more, switching game mode, it won't be possible to get the Zombie Scenario Daily Reward Box [Hard-9].

REWARDS

REGULAR EVENT: Zombie Scenario Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] x1.
If you already used/upgraded your Scenario Daily Reward Box for that day, you won't get a reward!
OPTIONAL EVENT: No set reward.

ANNOUNCEMENT

REGULAR EVENT: Users in the room will automatically get the Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] when the match is over. (if entitled to get one for that day)
OPTIONAL EVENT: No set reward.

GM EVENT #3: The bigger they are...

The harder they fall! ...IF they fall! [NX]BlindFire claims he refined the genetic sample he used to turn Giant Zombies into unstoppable killing machines and is ready to challenge the Survivors again. We thought he went mad, but it's worse than that. Please, stop him!

WHEN

August 24th at 4pm CEST in the EU Server.

HOW

Channel will be announced before making the room to allow interested users to gather.
Room will be created shortly after.
Quickly get in the Event Room, available slots are limited!
Room and Channel are switched every round, a total of 2 rounds are hosted.
Event will take place in Giant Zombie Mode.
Event will take place in the Forsaken map.
There are no Weapons Restrictions.
Time limit is 20 minutes per round.
Score limit is 280 per round.
[NX]BlindFire has specific advantages depending on his role:
Human:[NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
Giant Zombie: [NX]BlindFire is a regular Giant Zombie until evolution to stage 2.
Kill Giant Zombies as they appear, but be aware: if [NX]BlindFire turns into one of them, you'll have to kill him before his inevitable evolution!
If you manage to kill him before he evolves, you scored a valid kill.
If Giant [NX]BlindFire successfully evolves, he will become immortal for 60 seconds and invalidate the kill attempt.
When his immortality runs out, you'll be able to kill him but it won't count toward the goal.
It is possible for [NX]BlindFire to turn into a Giant Zombie multiple times in the same round, so you'll have multiple chances to kill him before his evolution.
The round ends when either the 280 points limit is reached, or the 20 minutes run out. Depending on which occurs first.
Letting others kill you when playing as Giant Zombies to force new Zombie selections will invalidate the ongoing round.
Each user is allowed to join only one round of the Event during the same day. If more than one Event round is joined during the same day, that user won't get any extra reward.

REWARDS

All players in the Event Room will be rewarded accordingly to the number of valid kills scored on Giant [NX]BlindFire:
Tier 1: at least 1 valid kill = 1x 500 Mileage Points Coupon
Tier 2: 4 or more valid kills = 3x 500 Mileage Points Coupon
Rewards from the two Tiers stack! If you reach Tier 2 you will win a total of 4 Mileage Coupons!

ANNOUNCEMENT

Winners will get their rewards on August 31 after the Maintenance!

Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / August 17, 2016.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

We're in the middle of August. However, the temperature is dropping day by day and now we need to start preparing for the winter. Your Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team is also preparing for autumn and winter content now. When the snow falls, you will see what we have been preparing for.

Check out the full update notes:

Summer Games Event 1

In certain parts of the world, people are getting crazy about world sports games. We are not athletes, but we are CSN:Z players! We will play our game, our way!

Click here for more information.

Summer Games Event 2

You are able to get a free Mileage Decoder from this event. There is no reason to hesitate! Let’s join!

Click here for more information.

Permanent Weapon Giveaway Event!

Click here for more information.

50,000,000 Zombie Killing Spree Event!

Click here for more information.

Bingo Weapon Update!

What’s new on Bingo? Let’s check this out now!

Click here for more information.

Vote To Kick Item Adjustment.

We have renewed ‘Vote to Kick’ item’s function. There were many requests to change ‘Vote to kick’ function due to false usage or abuse. Finally, we've made adjustments. Let’s check this out.

CHANGES

notes.title: Improved Transcendence and Mileage Decoders! Plus new Crazy maps!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Improved Transcendence Decoders came back!

We got tons of requests from you guys, and this is what we came up with. We have improved the Transcendence Decoder, and today is the day we introduce it to you! Starting today we have added two more items. The Transcendence Decoder is getting stronger and stronger.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_TD.png

CHANGES

Add new weapons: Crimson Hunter and Chain Grenade.


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_Crimson.png
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_CGrenade.png

WHEN

From August 10th to August 31st.

Note: Unused Transcendence Decoders will be removed on September 7th and automatically replaced by 5 Item Duration Extenders per every 1 Transcendence Decoder. (For example, if you have 5 unused Transcendence Decoders, they will be gone on September 7th and you will get 25 Item Duration Extenders.)

Improved Mileage Decoders!

The Mileage Decoders also got some changes. We thought that this may be way stronger than the Transcendence Decoders, but it is up to you to decide. Tell us what you think about the recent adjustment (or improvement) of the mileage decoder!

CHANGES

Remove all 18 painting items from Mileage Decoder.
Add Brick Piece T50 weapon.
Add new weapons from existing DLC.
OZ’s Trio: Tin Man’s Machine Gun, Cowardly Lion’s Pistol, Scarecrow’s Pickaxe
Journey to the West: Zhubajie minigun, Ruyi stick, Sha wujing Dual handgun.
Dragon Pack: AK-47 dragon, M4A1 dragon, Dragon knife

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_BrickPieceT50.png
WHEN

From August 10th.

New contents: Crazy Zombie Hero!

Limited duration! We just removed the stress-driven rules and left in the fun parts of the Zombie Hero! Enjoy Crazy Zombie Hero!

WHEN

From August 10th to September 7th.

WHAT

Adjusted new rules will be applied for Zombie Hero mode.

HOW

HUMAN: will use acquired items and your primary and secondary weapon ammunition will be reloaded automatically.
ZOMBIE: will have faster cooldown time and Zombie bomb will be reloaded automatically.
These rules will be applied to Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST only. However you can also play original ITALY and DUST.
You can also participate in an event in the Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST and acquire EXP and Points.

Note: Zombie Evolution, Medal, Miniature Medal, Mission, Statistics Accumulation, and league points will not be awarded in the Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST maps.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Continuous event wave… you can’t deny them!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Free Transcendence Decoder Event!

How can you get your free Transcendence Decoder during the event period? You can check the conditions here.

REWARDS

1 Free Transcendence Decoder per day by logging in. (You can get a maximum of 2 Transcendence Decoders, theoretically)
1 Free Transcendence Decoder per day through your play time of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. (You can get a maximum of 2 Transcendence Decoders, theoretically)
In total, you can acquire a maximum 4 Transcendence Decoders during the event period.

HOW

If players log in to the game on the 12th and 13th of August, they will get 1 free Transcendence Decoder per day for free.
If players play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for at least 30 minutes in any game mode during the event period, they will get 1 free Transcendence Decoder per day for free.

WHEN

Only on August 12th and 13th. (Friday and Saturday)

Note: Unused Transcendence Decoders will be removed on September 7th and automatically replaced by 5 Item Duration Extenders per every 1 Transcendence Decoder. (For example, if you have 5 unused Transcendence Decoders, they will be gone on September 7th and you will get 25 Item Duration Extenders.)

Gold Medal and Silver Medal Event!

The Summer Olympic games have begun in the real world. Let’s get Gold and Silver medals in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies! It’s a brand new item concept, so you won’t be disappointed.

REWARDS

1 Silver medal when you log in to the game. (1 Per day)
1 Gold medal when you play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for at least 60 minutes during the event period. (1 Per day)


http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_GoldNSilver.png

HOW

Log in to the game during the event period.
Play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for at least 60 minutes during the event period.

WHEN

From August 10th to August 24th.

Flag weapon bonus event!

We have a newly designed flag weapon. Shall we learn about your flag weapon here? Where is your flag?

HOW

When you purchase a specific number of Mileage Decoders, you will get a free (random) Flag Weapon Box.

BONUS

10 x Mileage Decoders = 1 Free (Random) Flag Weapon Box.
30 x Mileage Decoders = 3 Free (Random) Flag Weapon Boxes.
100 x Mileage Decoders = 10 Free (Random) Flag Weapon Boxes.

WHEN

From August 10th to August 24th.

Note: You have to purchase the 10, 30, or 100 set of Mileage Decoders. Separate purchasing will not be counted as an eligible bonus recipient. For example, you would not be a recipient if you purchase 1 Mileage Decoder 10 times, 30 times, or 100 times.

Free Flag weapon event!

This event will start on August 17th, however we wanted to let you know about this now so that you would be aware that there will be another chance to acquire the flag weapon for free.

REWARDS

1 Free (Random) Flag Weapon per day, per account.

HOW

Kill 3,000 Zombies

WHEN

From August 17th to August 31st.

If you need more information about this event, please do not miss next week’s patch note!

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/AceRebe.png

notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Killing Mosquito Event.

WHEN

From July 27th to August 10th.

REWARD

150 Mosquito kills: 3x B-Boxes
300 Mosquito kills: 5x B-Boxes and Killer F medal.

HOW

When you kill mosquitoes in specific maps, you will get your reward. (Double Gate, Lost City, Industry 2, Assault, Origin, Italy, Mouse Hole, and Trap.)
You should know that there are no mosquitoes in the Bot mode.
If your inventory is full of items, your event reward will not be injected so please make sure you have room before you play.

It’s Time For Enhancement!

During the event period, your enhancement chance is going to increase based upon your play time!

WHEN

From July 27th to August 10th.

REWARD

Enhancement Buff 1
Enhancement Buff 2
Note: This reward is a chance up for your enhancement. No physical item will be given to you.

HOW

If you play 30 minutes in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, your enhancement chance is going to up to ‘Enhancement Buff 1’.
If you play 60 minutes in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, your enhancement chance is going to up to ‘Enhancement Buff 2’.
Play with 4 or more players in the same room.
Time can be accumulated in the Zombie Scenario mode with at least ‘Normal’ difficulty or higher.
Enhancement buff will be reset at 00:00 every night.

Attendance Event For Enhancement! – Part 1

During the event period, you can get a ‘Perfect Enhancement Material Part’ randomly.

WHEN

From July 27th to August 10th.

REWARD

Perfect Enhancement Material Part x 5. (Randomly selected)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Enh_Mat_Part_03.png
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Enh_Mat_Part_01.png
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Enh_Mat_Part_02.png

HOW

You can get the reward when you log in to the game.
This will be applied only once per day.
If your inventory is full of items, your event reward will not be injected so please make sure you have room before you play.

Attendance Event For Enhancement! – Part 2

During the event period, you can get a ‘Perfect Enhancement Material’, if you play at least 1 hour game play for a week (7 days) in the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies

WHEN

From July 27th to August 10th.

REWARD

Perfect Enhancement Material x 1. (Randomly selected)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Enh_Part_002.png
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Enh_Part_001.png
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Enh_Part_003.png

HOW

You don’t need to be attending 7 days consecutively, but you have to attend for 7 days and play at least 1 hour each time.
If your inventory is full of items, your event reward will not be injected so please make sure you have room before you play.
Play with 4 or more players in the same room.

Free Giveaway Event!

There have been many hurdles to get some event items. That’s why we prepared this event. Simply log in to the game and get enhancement items!

WHEN

From July 27th to August 10th.

REWARD

Anti-Enhancement Material x 1.
Perfect Enhancement Material x 1.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/EnhancementBox.png

HOW

Just simply log in to the game during the event period.
This will be applied only once per account!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / July 20, 2016.
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

It’s hot outside. Everything is hot, and so we also want to be hot. Let’s enjoy our hot items and hot events! We hope that you enjoyed last week's exclusive 'Last Flight' map. And now, we have even more excitement coming your way! Kill zombies to get the wing of the infamous 'Crono Wing'!

Check out the full update notes:

Letter Collection Event.

Your beloved letter collection event is being prepared! Unveiling rare weapons is always exciting! Let’s participate in our letter collection event and get rare weapons through collecting a letter!

WHEN

From July 20th to August 3rd

HOW

When you kill your enemy, there is a chance for you to get alphabet letters or a Joker.
You will earn 5 Jokers if you attend more than 10 days during the event period.
There is also a chance that you can earn 10 Jokers through Mileage Decoders during the event period.
You can only earn the alphabet letters when there are at least 4 or more players in the game room.

REWARD

Horse Axe
Serpent Blade
Battle Hunting Dagger
Battle Galil
Battle FAMAS
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Serpent_HorseAxe.png

Note: Unused Jokers and alphabet letters will be removed from your inventory and the mileage decoders on August 10.

Coin Event Comes Back On The Stage.

During the event period, you can participate in this event, which offers a fancy item through the event result.

WHEN

From July 20th to August 3rd

HOW

When you play 30 minutes in CSN:Z, you can get a coin. (There must be at least 4 players in the same room)
You can earn a maximum of 3 coins and you have to use it continuously. (Otherwise, you are unable to earn the coins)

REWARD

Supreme Decoder x 10 pcs (3 players)
Mileage Decoder x 50 pcs (5 players)
Mileage Decoder x 30 pcs (10 players)
Costume Box season 2 x 3 pcs (20 players)
Perfect Enhancement Box x 1 pcs (20 players)

Double Mileage Chance Event.

From today to August 10th, you will earn double mileage when you use a Mileage Decoder. Surely, your happiness becomes double too.

Single Crow-7 Is Now Available.

Crow-7 Pre-order pack is unavailable today, but it’s a little early to say you're disappointed. Now you can check out our in-game shop and you will find a single Crow-7 is now opened.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Crow-7-Now-Available.png

GM Event Rewards Injected.

Did you enjoy our GM event last week? Your GM Event reward has been injected on your account today. Let’s check out your inventory.

GM Event For This Week.

Click here for more info.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:

EVENT #02: [NX]BlindFire's Helping Hand!

[NX]BlindFire joins the fight against the Zombies to finally uncover the mysteries behind the infection! Stand with him as he pushes through the hardest Zombie Scenario battles and seasons, from the beginning to the inevitable end!

WHEN

July 20th and 27th, at 4 PM CEST in the EU Server.

HOW

Be sure NOT to use/upgrade your Scenario Daily Reward Box if you plan to join!
Quickly get in the notified Room! Available slots are limited!
Win Zombie Scenario Mode on Hard-9 difficulty with the help of [NX]BlindFire!
[NX]BlindFire is a valuable ally: he won't die to the zombies!
The Event will last 1 hour, after each completed Scenario map the room will be switched.

Note: There are no weapon restrictions and maps are selected in a chronological order.

REWARDS

Zombie Scenario Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] x 1
If you already used/upgraded your Daily Reward Box you won't get a reward!

ANNOUNCEMENT

Users in the room will automatically get the Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] when the match is over!

EVENT #03: The Bigger They Are...

The harder they fall! ...IF they fall! [NX]BlindFire has finally found the perfect genetic sample to turn Giant Zombies into unstoppable killing machines! He's gone mad, you have to stop him!

WHEN

July 21st and 28th, at 4 PM CEST in the EU Server.

HOW

A total of 3 rounds will take place and the room will be changed after each one of them.
Quickly get in the notified Room! Available slots are limited!
Kill the players turning into Giant Zombies, but be aware: if [NX]BlindFire turns into a Giant Zombie you'll have to kill him before he manages to evolve!
If giant [NX]BlindFire evolves successfully, he will turn immortal for a set amount of time (60 seconds)!
Kills achieved after his immortality runs out do NOT count toward the goal.
While human, attacks from Giant Zombies won't be able to hurt [NX]BlindFire!

Note: A time limit for each round will be applied and there are no weapon restrictions.

REWARDS

If, by the end of the round, the Survivors successfully managed to kill giant [NX]BlindFire before he evolved at least once, all players in the room will get 1 x 500 Mileage Coupon!
If, by the end of the round, the Survivors successfully managed to kill giant [NX]BlindFire before he evolved at least 3 times, all players in the room will get additional 3 x 500 Mileage Coupon!

ANNOUNCEMENT

Winners will be announced the August 10th, and they'll get the rewards after the maintenance on August 10th.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: EVENT RULES UPDATE - All against [NX]BlindFire
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg
Dear Survivors,

Yesterday it was the first day of the GM Event "All against [NX]BlindFire" and for as much as we wanted for it to go perfectly smooth, inconvenients happened.

Specifically, the balance of the Event overall was clearly shifted toward our dear GM, preventing users from having a fair chance at winning. This is not what the CSN:Z Team planned: the idea at the base of the Event is that of having an enjoyable and fun experience in a match which sees a GM roaming around killing everyone on sight for a good 10 minutes, while players struggle to get as many kills as possible in order to beat him.

But this proved to be impossible if efforts of the users are not combined as the Event's Title suggests.

Thanks to the tests performed by [NX]BlindFire during the Event itself and the 'unfortunate users' who had to suffer from his uncontrolled killing rampage yesterday, we came up with a better solution.
Please read below for the reviewed Event Rules:

 RULES:

Rounds last 10 minutes each and the kill limit is set at 120, a total of 6 rounds will take place and rooms will be switched every 2 rounds.
EU Channel will be shared before making the actual Event Room in it, to allow all interested users to gather and have a chance to join.
Map will be randomly selected and there will be no weapon restriction.
[NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
A round is considered completed whenever the 10 minutes run out, or the 120 kills limit has been reached. Depending on which of the two occurs first.
When a round is over, the top 3 players who managed to score the most kills will see their kill counts for that round combined and then compared to that of [NX]BlindFire alone.
If the combined kills are more than the ones scored by [NX]BlindFire, the round is won and all users in the room will get a reward.
If the resulting kills are less than the ones scored by [NX]BlindFire, the round is lost.
Tactics like kill farming or similar are still not tolerated and will completely invalidate the ongoing round as a penalty.
[NX]BlindFire's presence is required from start to end in the Match for it to be valid. In case of unexpected technical issues, the ongoing round will be simply restarted.

Note: Time/Date of the Event and its rewards are NOT subject to changes.
We will keep monitoring the situation and refine even more the Rules in case it's needed.

15th July Note:
During today's Event, we'll be performing some more tests to balance it further.
Tests will see the following variables addressed:
- Kill Limit
- Calculation of the win condition

We do believe that involving you and your performances actively in this process will make us capable of reaching a good level of balance and fairness, turning this into a fun and, possibly, rewarding experience.

As for previous days: all hosted rounds will count as valid in case no technical issues occur! Testing won't invalidate them!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

New Contents: Last Flight

Jennifer finally gets information from Soy but there’s another enemy. To protect each other and destroy the new enemy: Crono Wing.

Supreme Decoder Strikes Back With New Items!

Supreme decoder will be removed from the shop on August 3rd.

Crow-7 Pre-Order Pack

Thanks for the support and encouragement that you have given us with the Vulcanus Pre-order pack. Now it’s time for us to show you our new Crow-7 Pre-order pack. This Crow-7 Pre-order pack consists of:

Crow-7 (100 days)
Supreme Decoder x 3 pcs.
Mileage Decoder Supply Box (10 days, 500% more EXP & Points)
Costume Box 2 x 2 pcs.

It is available from today until July 20th and you can buy only once per account.

10 Free Mileage Decoder Event!

During this event period, you can acquire free mileage decoders as a reward based upon your play time of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.
Click here for more info.

Improved Promotion Rewards.

notes.title: Duration Time Event, GM Event and more….
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

10 Free Mileage Decoders Event!

During this event period, you can acquire a free mileage decoder as a reward based upon your play time of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.

WHEN

From July 13th to August 31st.

HOW

Log in to the game during the event and play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.
Based on your play time, you reward is increased.
You must play with more than 4 players at least.
You can acquire a maximum of 10 mileage decoders per day.

REWARDS

30 Minutes Play = 1 Mileage Decoder.
60 Minutes Play = 3 Mileage Decoders.
90 Minutes Play = 6 Mileage Decoders.

Welcome Back! GM Event!

[NX]BlindFire has trained hard in the last few weeks and has explored the darkest corners of the Aegis Institute in order to uncover the secrets of immortality. Now he's ready to challenge the CSN:Z Survivors to prove their worth in a lethal Deathmatch!

WHEN

From July 13th to the 15th at 4 PM CEST in the EU Server.

Keep an eye out for [NX]BlindFire to announce the details (channel/room number) directly in-game shortly before the start!

HOW

Keep an eye out for [NX]BlindFire to announce the details (channel/room number) directly in-game shortly before the start!
[NX]BlindFire will create the room and announce the details for channel and room number.
A total of 6 rounds will be hosted and every 2 rounds the room will be switched.
During the match, kill as many enemy players as you can before the round is over, but be aware: [NX]BlindFire will be immortal!
Avoid being killed by [NX]BlindFire at all costs!
If at least 4 players in the room manage to score more INDIVIDUAL KILLS than [NX]BlindFire, the round will be considered a success.


Note: There are no weapon restrictions and maps are randomly selected. A time limit for each round will be applied and kill farming and similar tactics are not allowed; they will invalidate the ongoing round!

REWARDS

For each round won, all players in the room during that round will get 1 x 500 Mileage Coupon!For each round won, all players in the room during that round will get 1 x 500 Mileage Coupon!
Rewards stack if Survivors win multiple rounds!

ANNOUNCEMENT

Winners will be announced on July 20th, and they'll get the rewards after the maintenance on July 20th

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Upgrade weapons and earn rewards in multiple events!
notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

6 Upgradeable weapons!

We listened to your opinion! The most popular event is back!
Upgrade: Katana, Crossbow, Tactical Knife, Dual Infinity, Spas-12, and Gilboa!

WHEN
22.06.2016 - 06.07.2016 (For 2 weeks)

HOW
- Acquire a default weapon from the shop and enter a room with at least 4 players.
- Collect 5,000 kill points for a primary weapon or 3,000 kill points for a secondary weapon and your weapon will become upgraded.
- You can check on your upgrading progress, which is visible in the game chat as you earn points.

REWARDS
- Katana → Dual Katana (Permanent)
- Crossbow → Crossbow Advance (Permanent)
- Tactical Knife → Double Tactical Knife (Permanent) → Triple Tactical Knife (Permanent)
- Dual Infinity → Dual Infinity Custom (Permanent) → Dual Infinity Final (Permanent)
- Spas-12 → Spas-12 Deluxe (Permanent) → Spas-12 Superior (Permanent)
- Gilboa → Gilboa Viper (Permanent)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/210616_JIRA-2242_notice.png

Special missions reward.

Earn an extra weapon for completing special missions.

WHEN
22.06.2016 - 06.07.2016 (For 2 weeks)

HOW
Successfully complete 10 Special missions before the event ends

REWARDS
Permanent weapon: PJ MK3A1 (Jackhammer)

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/1-1.png

Time Bomb Event.

Log in to the game for free decoders and more!

WHEN
22.06.2016 - 29.06.2016

HOW
- Log in during the event and receive 1x Time Bomb each day
- When you log in the following day, the safe will open automatically and you will receive a reward item. However, if you don't log in on the following day, the safe will explode and the reward item will disappear.

REWARDS
One of the following rewards:
-10,000 Game Points
- A-Grade Blueprint x3
- Mileage Decoder x1
- Mileage Decoder x 5
- Mileage Decoder x 10
- Mileage Decoder x 50

Zombie Balloon Event.

Shoot down zombie balloons and get rewarded!

WHEN
22.06.2016 - 13.07.2016

HOW
Attack or destroy a balloon to participate in the event

REWARDS
- Destroy Zombie Balloon: receive EXP/Points buff after the match.
* Buff can be applied max 3 times. (Max 300% buff)
- Attack Zombie Balloon 10x in different matches: receive Item Duration Extenders. (Min 1 to Max 5)

NOTE
- You can get an Item Duration Extender only one time per day and you can participate in the event every day.
- The Zombie Balloon destroy count will be reset at 24:00.
- If you have no inventory space, the item will not be added. Please join this event after you secure enough space in your inventory
- Zombie Balloon will NOT appear in the following modes: Bot Original, Bot Deathmatch, and Bot Team Deathmatch
- Zombie Balloon will appear in the following maps: Italy, Assault, Militia, Estate, Dust, Dust2, and Mouse Hole.

Return of the M/B Box Event.

It’s way stronger and way more generous than before.

WHEN
- S-BOX: 10 / 11 / 12 of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)
- J-BOX: 17 / 18 / 19 of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)
- M-Box: 24 / 25 / 26 of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)
- B-Box: 01 / 02 / 03 of July from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)

HOW
- Play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.

REWARDS
- 30 min playing: 1 Brand box item.
- 60 min playing: 1 Brand box item.
- In total, you will have 2 brand boxes per day and 6 boxes in total. (Maximum Box count: 6 S-Boxes, 6 J-Boxes, 6 M-Boxes and 6 B-Boxes)

notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

This week’s patch is a special one as we prepared the biggest update in a while.

Get ready to check this expansion’s new powerful zombies, additional map, greatest weapon-giveaway of all time, plenty of other events, new crafting weapons, and DLC Bundle!

Check out the full update notes:

Hero Zombie Update

2 New strong zombies released for Zombie Hero mode: male and female
Metatronic zombie with 2 skills: Immortality and HP Buff

[/tr]

[td]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/HP_Buff_Meta.png[/td]

New Zombie Escape 'RISING' Map

Zombie Escape 'Rising' map
A human camp is damaged by the chasing zombies. Climb safely to the roof and navigate through a building under construction to escape. You are evacuating via a helicopter.

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/01_Map.png

Vulcanus-9 And Vulcanus-11 Perfect Pick Recipes

-70% DLC Steam Sales

Dragon Set + Permanent Character

Rivals DLC

notes.content:
http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg

Survivors,

Welcome to the next big CSN:Z expansion. June brings plenty of changes to all game areas: comeback of the 2 most wanted buff weapons and plenty of new ones in Mileage Decoder and Perfect Pick Recipes; improvements and rewards for new users and leveling system upgrade for veterans as well as the usual free giveaways.

Check out the full update notes:

Transcendence Piece Event

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/02_0608_image.png

WHEN
⋅ 8 to 29 of June (For 3 weeks)
HOW
⋅ You can get the Transcendence Piece item from Mileage Decoder during the event period.
⋅ Once you have collected 888 of the pieces you can exchange them for either the M4A1 Dark Knight or AK-47 Paladin.
⋅ After this event, remaining Transcendence Pieces will be replaced with the other items.

Vulcanus Pre-order Pack

WHEN
⋅ 8 to 15 of June
AMOUNT
⋅ Only 100 EA for the first 100 buyers.
DETAIL
⋅ Mileage Decoder Supply Boxes supply Decoders upon logging in to the game. (For example, 5 Decoders x 10 days = 50 Decoders maximum for 10 days)
⋅ Mileage Decoder Growth Box. (500% EXP/GP Bonus / 10 days)
⋅ VULCANUS-9 (100 days)
⋅ VULCANUS-11 (100 days)
⋅ Every account can buy it one time only.
⋅ Enjoy first purchaser premium 1 week earlier than others.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=699851344

Improved Mileage Decoder

Add Permanent Blair + Fernando + Heavy Zombie Knife. (Not including Silver Luger and Holy Water Grenade)
Add new weapons: Lightning AR-1, Lightning AR-2, and Needler

Revamped Tutorial for new users*

New users can receive free weapons after completing the tutorial mode where they learn about the basics of the game mechanics and compete with zombie opponents.

Weapons to win
⋅ BALROG-VII (15 days) + Grade-1 and Grade-2 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ SKULL-VII (15 days) + Grade-3 and Grade-4 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ JANUS-VII (15 days) + Grade-5 and Grade-6 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ This reward will only be given the first time you complete the mission.

Zombie Mode Play Event

New users can receive the following weapons and other rewards when they clear any Zombie mode:

WHO?: You are considered a new user if you’re under level 5 or within 30 days of character creation you can receive:
When you clear Zombie mode for the first time
⋅ BALROG-XI (15 days) + Grade-1, Grade-2 and Grade-3 Blueprints [S] + 3x Durables (30 days) + 9600 Game Points + 5x Special Enhancement Material.
When you clear Zombie mode a second time
⋅ SKULL-IX (15 days) + Grade-4, Grade-5 and Grade-6 Blueprints [S] + 3x Durables (30 days) + 9600 Game Points + 10x Special Enhancement Material.

Maximum level of account has been increased from 72 to 250

http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/01_0608_image.png

New levels are unlocked with new rank icons. You can finally rank up to General of the Armies title and reach level cap at 250! You will get ‘General of the Armies’ at level 78!
New Valor medals have been added.
New Honor Missions and medals have been added.

‘Be the first 50’ event

Be one of the first 50 players who reach level 78.
Click here for more detail.

The more, the merrier!

The more you play, the more you get!
Click here for more detail.

Return of the S/J/M/B Box Event

It’s way stronger and way more generous than before.
Click here for more detail.
