notes.title: [UPDATE] Red Weapon Series Collection
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1222/en.jpg
Do you remember the very rare red versions of classic Counter-Strike weapons? We have not forgotten about them and they are back now! All of them are available as permanent weapons only on Xmas gift promotions!

They are red-colored limited production versions of default weapons. Aside from their very seductive looks, some of them have their damage increased compared to the original counterparts.

Starting from 22nd December and only until 6th January, during the exclusive Xmas event, you can acquire them permanently for your arsenal.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/1.png

How to become owner of these fine weapons
It’s simple: every time you use 30x Mileage Decoders, as a special Xmas bonus you will be given an option to choose one of the unique red weapons. You can repeat that as many times as you want, to earn whole red weapons series set. It doesn’t matter if you bought Mileage Decoders, had them for free from events, or you kept them stocked from previous giveaways – each use counts towards receiving the rewards! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/2.png

Don’t miss out on this event and the chance to collect all of those red weapons: Desert Eagle, Glock 18, USP 45, XM1014, M4A1, AK47, Scout, AWP, and M249. 

Don't also forget that you only have until 6th January to obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fpccdHcFNA
The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

They are red-colored limited production versions of default weapons. Aside from their very seductive looks, some of them have their damage increased compared to the original counterparts.

Starting from 22nd December and only until 6th January, during the exclusive Xmas event, you can acquire them permanently for your arsenal.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/1.png

How to become owner of these fine weapons
It’s simple: every time you use 30x Mileage Decoders, as a special Xmas bonus you will be given an option to choose one of the unique red weapons. You can repeat that as many times as you want, to earn whole red weapons series set. It doesn’t matter if you bought Mileage Decoders, had them for free from events, or you kept them stocked from previous giveaways – each use counts towards receiving the rewards! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/2.png

Don’t miss out on this event and the chance to collect all of those red weapons: Desert Eagle, Glock 18, USP 45, XM1014, M4A1, AK47, Scout, AWP, and M249.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Xmas Event: Weapons Giveaway!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1218/en.jpg
The Nightmare is almost over and that means you can get ready to celebrate the upcoming Xmas period. 

The zombies surely won’t become any nicer to survivors, but the CSN:Z team has prepared something to add a bit of the winter holidays atmosphere to the land of the undead.

FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY
Starting from 18th December until 6th January, log in every day to CSN:Z to receive one of the unique Christmas weapons gifts. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X1.png

Each of the weapons will be given out randomly from a list presented below and for a period of 14 days.

Winchester M1887 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X2.png

A lever action shotgun that fires 8 rounds of 12 gauge ammo. Flip-cocking allows for quickly terminating hostile targets. A special decoration is added to celebrate Christmas.

MG36 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X3.png

A light machine gun that fires 100 rounds of 5.56mm ammo but is able to maintain high accuracy comparable to a rifle. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

M95 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X4.png

A bullpup single-shot sniper rifle firing 5 rounds of 50 cal. Its design combines the power of 50 cal rounds and sniping accuracy. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

M134 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X5.png

This minigun, which fires 200 rounds of 7.62mm, may be limited in power but its incredible rate of fire is enough to overcome this weakness. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

MG3 Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X6.png

This machine gun, which fires 200 rounds of 7.62mm ammo, is the modern version of the MG42, which was known as the chainsaw of terror during WWII. Its superior firepower and high ammo capacity makes it the core of a strong offensive but slow speed and low accuracy are its weaknesses. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

Tomahawk Christmas edition
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X7.png

The dreary winter has made an advanced payment to create a Xmas version of the Tomahawk in order to give hope back to those lonely humans. Tis the season for the Tomahawk with twinkling lights brightening up this weapon on the darkest of nights, and Rudolph antlers to subdue the enemy, Xmas style. The winter is warmer now!

Can be pushed through oncoming zombie hoards in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.

Stop by CSN:Z daily to celebrate the season with irresponsibly decorated high caliber firearms! 


Make sure to follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything related to CSN:Z!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Attack: Annihilation #5
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/over_1.jpg
The dreams are over but the true nightmare is about to begin. There has been a report that there is an ongoing experiment to revive the bosses in secret. You have to eliminate the bosses and exterminate the roots of this plot.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-1.jpg

On the 5th and final day of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion, your skills will be put to the final test in a fight against multiple bosses from various Zombie Scenarios. 

You will face Oberon, Revenant, Neid and Zavist, Dione, Fallen Titan, Siege Type Phobos, and Frozen Terror.

Search and eliminate all revived bosses in the lab! Bosses will appear randomly, so each survivor’s story will be slightly different. 

You meet Oberon. A first obstacle on your way to stop the experiment to destroy the laboratory.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-2.jpg

After killing Oberon, follow the next path! You will need to annihilate another boss, Revenant!

Revenant's Resurrection
Revenant has been resurrected, and you need to kill him through the newly opened map.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-3.jpg

A new assault on Revenant!
After killing Oberon and Revenant, the third path has been identified! You need to catch the third boss, Zavist and Neid!

Resurrection
Zavist and Neid have been revived. Through the newly opened 3rd map, you must kill Zavist and Neid and find a new path.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-4.jpg

You have annihilated Zavist and Neid. You can try a new assault now!
After killing Oberon, Revenant, and Zavist and Neid, the fourth location has been unlocked! To proceed further, you need to eliminate the 4th boss: Dione!

Dione’s Re-creation
Dione has been cured. Through the newly available 4th map, you need to destroy Dione and find a new way to the final encounter.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-5.jpg

The final episode to stop the nightmare!
You have defeated all the bosses. If you kill Fallen Titan, all specimens will be exterminated!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/18-6.jpg

We hope you found your way to successfully complete this mission and you finished all of the challenges that were brought by the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion.

Until next time, keep fighting as evil and zombies never rest. 

Make sure to follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything related to CSN:Z!

VK: http://vk.com/public78659129

notes.title: [UPDATE] Annihilated: Madness #4
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1214_nightmare/en_17.jpg
Those dreams become more and more real. You start to wonder whether you’ll die in the real world if you die in those nightmares. You don’t really want to risk checking, but you want to get out of this deadly coma. You’re getting paranoid, somehow you have to survive this madness. 

From 14th to 18th of December, each day CSN:Z will bring a new location in which you will have to fight once again the enemies you have previously defeated. 

Welcome to Night 4 of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion.

Annihilated: Madness, the fourth nightmare location in which you’ll find yourself in different maps. There you will pit yourself against Zombie Scenario #4 bosses.

Your target is to eliminate the Boss Zombies that appears in each round. If you succeed to destroy the last enemy, every player will obtain 2 random rewards from Zombie Scenario: Season 4.

Round 1: Juggernaut
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-1.png

Round 2: Frozen Wrath
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-2.png

Round 3: Gluttony
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-3.png
				
Round 4: Zavist & Neid
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-4.png

Round 5: Dr. Rex
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-5.png


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-6.jpg

To enter the 'Annihilation: Madness’ map, a room host needs to acquire a Madness Key.

A key from which the energies of powerful zombies can be felt. It feels as if you'll experience a long nightmare tonight if you hold this key. 

The key can be dropped after Zombie Scenario mode is cleared. Its duration is 1 day only.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/17-7.png

The room host must have the key, so to open 1 room you will need 1 key. Players other than the host do not need a key to join the room.

If you already have a key, you can acquire more, but the number of keys does not increase – its duration will increase. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Annihilated: Addiction #2
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1214_nightmare/en_15.jpg
You wake up from the horrible nightmare. Those fears from your past… were so real… fortunately, it was just a bad dream. Wasn’t it? You now feel even more tired and have a terrible headache... Like somebody poisoned you... You’re about to pass out, but you hope you won’t dream about anything…

From 14th to 18th of December, each day CSN:Z will bring a new location in which you will have to fight once again the enemies you have previously defeated. 

Welcome to Night 2 of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion.

Annihilated: Addiction is the second nightmare challenge. You will visit the chemical power plant were you will have to fight with Zombie Scenario #2 bosses.

Round 1: Juggernaut
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-1.png

Round 2: Siege Type Deimos
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-2.png

Round 3: Dione

Round 4: Revenant

Round 5: Angra

Your target is to eliminate the Boss Zombies that appears in each round. If you succeed to destroy the last enemy, every player will obtain 2 random rewards from Zombie Scenario: Season 2.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-6.png

Players must evacuate towards the power plant entrance after defeating Angra.

To enter the 'Annihilation: Addiction’ map, a room host needs to acquire an Addiction Key.

A key from which the energies of powerful zombies can be felt. It feels as if you'll experience a long nightmare tonight if you hold this key. 

The key can be dropped after Zombie Scenario mode is cleared. Its duration is 1 day only.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-7.png

The room host must have the key, so to open 1 room you will need 1 key. Players other than the host do not need a key to join the room.

If you already have a key, you can acquire more, but the number of keys does not increase – its duration will increase.

From 15th of December CSN:Z introduces premium tattoos in the Item Shop.

notes.title: [UPDATE] M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1214_nightmare/en_weapon.jpg

They are here! The “Enter the Nightmare” expansion brings 2 of the most awaited weapons. 

Starting from 14th December, only until 6th January, you can obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.

https://youtu.be/2fpccdHcFNA

The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png

Until 6th January, every day you log in, you will receive 5 Transcendence Pieces for free. On top of that, for every 30 minutes spent playing the game, you will receive an additional piece, up to 4 times a day.

Once you have collected 888 of those pieces you can exchange them for either the M4A1 Dark Knight or AK-47 Paladin. You can start the exchange for the weapon by pressing the 'Use' button.

Each of those special weapons come with a unique buff effects whenever you have them in your inventory. 

If you have the following weapons in your inventory, the effects mentioned below will be applied.


M4A1 Dark Night
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w2.png

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of .50 caliber special ammo. It can apply high knockback against zombies, and increase penetration with its 2nd mode to eliminate multiple enemies. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:

•	Increases the duration of Deadly Shot in Zombie Hero by 1 second.
•	Firepower is increased 5 levels at the start of the round for all players in Zombie Scenario mode (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room. 



AK-47 Paladin

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w3.png

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of 50 caliber special rounds. It can apply high push-back against zombies, and fire in powerful semi-automatic 2nd mode. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:

•	Start Zombie Hero mode with +20% morale
•	Automatic health upgrade by 5 levels in all Zombie Scenario rooms (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room.


•	The buff mark will be indicated for rooms where you can receive it. 
•	The same buffs cannot be stacked, so your bonus game EXP can be 200% max, not more, even if you possess both the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin. 
•	The EXP buff effect can be checked from the game result screen ‘Team/Family Bonus’. 


Special Skills of the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin
The M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin have unlimited Spare magazines in Zombie Scenario Modes.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w4.jpg

If you successfully hit your target with the M4A1 Dark knight or AK-47 Paladin, you will see a notification on the crosshair.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w5.jpg

Pieces can only be obtained during the event period, and upon the end of the event, the remaining pieces will be automatically exchanged for items depending on the amount of pieces left:

Pieces 1-100 = Extension Coupon x35 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x1
Pieces 101-200 = Extension Coupon x130 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x1
Pieces 201-300 = Extension Coupon x200 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x3
Pieces 301-400 = Extension Coupon x 300 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x3
Pieces 401-500 = Extension Coupon x 350 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x5
Pieces 501-600 = Extension Coupon x 450 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x5
Pieces 601-700 = Extension Coupon x 550 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x7
Pieces 701-800 = Extension Coupon x 650 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x7
More than 801 pieces = Extension Coupon x 700 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x10 + 1x Perfect Enhancement material. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [NEW] Weapon paints + Extra Mileage Decoders
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1209/en.jpg

Customize your weapons with paint!
Isn't it boring to see the same weapons over and over again? With new paint blueprints available in the CSN:Z Shop starting on 09.12.2015, you can transform the 4 most well-known default weapons into an unique new model.

If you’re a fan of Counter-Strike’s original weapons or you just prefer classic gameplay modes, you will definitely enjoy the new weapon customization feature. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/1.png

How to Paint
There are only few simple steps you need to follow in order to turn your old weapon into a new colorful model.

Buy one of the paint blueprints available in the Shop:

Red Lightning Paint
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/2.png
Blue Lightning Paint
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/3.png	
Erica Paint
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/4.png
Hawk Paint
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/5.png

Next: Navigate to the Crafting menu, then select the “Weapon Paint” tab. 

Choose one of the default weapons and the paint blueprint you want the Master Gunsmith to use for you. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/6.jpg

You never have to worry about the outcome because weapon painting cannot fail.

You can change it to different styles of paint, or if you want, the weapon can be reverted to its original state by removing the paint job with the Reset Blueprint. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/7.jpg

Please remember that paint won't affect the gun's performance, it is a purely cosmetic feature. 
Enjoy the new weapon customization system and expect some more paint blueprints to become available in the Shop.


For those who care more about weapons’ stats and battlefield performance, we have prepared yet another Mileage Decoder extended promotion.

Starting from 10.12.2015 through 21.12.2015, all Mileage Decoder bundles will come with extra units.

Check below to see how many additional Mileage Decoders you will receive as a bonus:

10x Mileage Decoders + 3x Bonus Mileage Decoders
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/8.png

30x Mileage Decoders + 10x Bonus Mileage Decoders
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/9.png

100x Mileage Decoders + 30x Bonus Mileage Decoders
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/10.png

notes.title: [NEW] Season 5, Map 3: Another Side of Truth
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/menu6_over.png

Zombie Scenario Season 5 - Pursue: Revenge
It’s the Day 6 of Tales of the Undead and the last part of our story is revealed. More mysteries, more weapons and more promotions are awaiting!

“The person responsible... I'll never forgive it!" – Jennifer

Storyline: Jennifer, who was grieving over the death of Jack, hears a voice through the radio. In order to find out the truth behind Jack’s mysterious last words, she sets out to find the owner of the voice she heard on the radio… Just who is it on the other side of the radio? Why did it send Jack to her? And what is this another truth it speaks of?

•	Be careful of the fast currents. It can get you into dire danger if engulfed in it. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-1.jpg

•	In order to safely track the owner of the voice, take advantage the the safe zones.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-2.jpg

•	Hordes of zombies summoned along with the fast water currents make it even more dangerous. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-3.jpg

•	Be careful of high falls, since it will deal significant amount of damage. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-4.jpg

“So you were here... muahaha. Things won't go according to your plan.” – Cronobotics
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-5.png

You have to face a new enemy. Heavily armoured semi-robotic monster, inflicting damage with minigun and missiles launcher, that are attached to his hands.

Join the final chapter of Tales of the Undead in Zombie Scenario 5, find out the identity of the unknown force and the truth behind Jack's change.


Together with final map to Season 5 of Zombie Scenario, there are 3 new weapons that can be found in Mileage Decoder.


Eruptor
A single-shot prototype cannon type musket that blows an area away in one concentrated blast. It’s Effective in close range, especially against multiple targets.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-6.png

Hécate II
An anti-material sniper rifle which uses 7 rounds of .50 caliber bullets. The highly efficient muzzle break decreases recoil drastically after each shot.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-7.png

M1911 A1

Jennifer, who realized that there was yet another force at play, set out to find the force that may potentially be a threat. While she was on her way to the suspicious lab, Jennifer came into contact with a familiar zombie, and recovers her lost… no, her unwanted memories.

Now it is time to join the second mysterious installment of Zombie Scenario 5. Jennifer sets out on a mission to find the killer of her informant, Laser Wing. While exploring a suspicious laboratory she will encounter a familiar zombie, and begin to uncover memories she thought were long buried. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-2.jpg

In order to obtain more info, you must install a radar satellite receiver.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-3.png

A monster that knows Jennifer appears:

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-4.png

You must cope with lots of obstacles leveraging many gears.

Having introduced a huge range of new modes revamped and Zombie Scenario Season 5 this week, we have introduced a variety of weapons and have decided to ratchet up the action with a fresh range of weapons.

Two new weapons, Fire Vulcan and P90 Lapin, are now set into the mileage decoder to show off both their appearance and power, as well as a long list of variants that are more enjoyable for all users.

Fire Vulcan
Compared to any other shotgun, Fire Vulcan has a very high magazine size, high rate of fire and low recoil. And for a shotgun, it can be used at a far range. This fire vulcan spews out 40 rounds of 12 gauge ammo at an extreme rate of fire that exceeds the limits of normal shotguns. In addition, it has a long barrel that gives it superior accuracy.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-8.png

P90 LAPIN
P90 Lapin holds 50 5.7mm rounds for each magazine. It holds 20 more bullets than other submachine gun which reduces the risk of reloading bullets in the middle of a heated battle. It also has 1% higher accuracy and lower recoil. The gun comes in pink and is decorated with rabbit-themed accessories to celebrate the year of the rabbit. How lovely!

notes.title: [NEW] Sudden Death
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/menu4_over.png

New Fun mode: Sudden Death
Half the journey is getting there! And another new game type is dropped today; Sudden Death, an intense, fast paced elimination mode – with a twist. One gun will spawn in the center of the map, meaning players will need lightning-fast reactions to outsmart the opposition, grab the weapon and be the last man standing.

Objective
The objective of Sudden Death is to be the last one standing, after eliminating all others. 
The game will be divided into 8 maps/rounds. 

Upon the start of each round, a pistol will be spawned in the center of the map. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-2.jpg

Sometimes, it’s not the best option to go for the pistol right away. You might become the target. Spawned weapons are only one clip loaded, use your weapon wisely.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-3.jpg

Bonus points will be acquired after defeating everyone else and be the last one standing. You’ll be moved to the next room upon failing to survive in the current room.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-4.jpg

Check the icon next to the timer to see how many people remain in the current map. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-5.jpg

If the outcome is not reached in the room within 1 minute, then the pre-installed C4 will explode, killing everyone in the room. 

One point is achieved whenever a player kills another. In addition, the last player will be given bonus points for his/her survival. Use tactics and your wits in order to survive to the end in these fast-paced battles!

New mode is waiting for survivors to join and new pieces of weapons are given to them to trace back all enjoyable contents in CSN:Z

Lightning Rail
Lightning Rail shots a strong bullet by electrically-accelerated energy and is optimized weapon for Zombie scenario especially for obstacles and bosses. Compared to Thunderbolt? You can evaluate it now! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-6.png

UMP45 Snake
As you can guess it from the name, UMP45 Snake is decorated version of UMP45. UMP45 Snake shares the same attribute with original UMP45 but it contains special sounds and animations. This version features a white tiger design to celebrate the year of the snake
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-7.png

From 28.11 until 5.12, the probability to receive those weapons from a Decoder are doubled!

notes.title: [NEW] Zombie Hide and Seek & Black Friday sales!
notes.content:
[NEW] Zombie Hide and Seek & Black Friday sales!

Zombie says: „Hide!”

We’re into day 3 of Tales of the Undead and zombies even though they are dead are having a lot of fun. Together with new game mode you will notice comeback of 6 characters from Mileage Decoders. We’re also celebrating Black Friday with big sales – don’t miss out!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-1.png

Black Friday -40% discount coupons and DLC is now on sales

If you waited to see the biggest sales this year in CSN:Z, this is that moment. On 27th of November we’re giving out 27 Discount Coupons that will reduce by 40% prices on any item or bundle of items. Be aware however that this sale is just 3 days long, so make the best of it before Discount Coupons expire.

What is Zombie Hide and Seek?

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-2.jpg

Zombie Hide and Seek is a new mode for up to 20 players, which zombies and humans, can enjoy together. 

The human faction needs to find out the real zombie amongst the fakes ones and the zombies must make their way to escape zone by tricking the human players. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-3.jpg
   
Humans: Starts with 200 HP, and when killing a fake zombie, 100 HP is subtracted.
There will not be any change in HP upon killing a real zombie.  

Zombies: Zombie will die after 3 attacks from humans. 
Zombies are able to move faster by pressing shift, however it will consume HP. Additionally they can use Smokescreen and Poke skills. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-4.jpg

An unfortunate light zombie who jumped instead of taking a ballet pose
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-5.jpg

How to play Zombie Hide and Seek
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-6.png
Select FUN mode, then select either Greesia or OutCity

Fever Time
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-7.jpg
When the game starts, Fever Time is triggered at random intervals.
Make sure to copy the action that is given.

Action System
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-8.jpg
- The Fever Time action is automatically chosen upon the start of the game. 
- Pretend to be a fake zombie with various actions with numbered keys 1-4.

Action keyboard shortcut
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-9.jpg
- A shortcut is supported so that the real zombies can act like a fake zombie. An appropriate action needs to be taken when the Fever Time strikes. 

Escape Zone
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-10.jpg
Zombie team wins if they reach the escape zone within the time limit or survive until all players in the human team are dead. Zombie team consists of bot zombies, to cause confusion among humans.

Special Zombie

When playing Zombie Hide and Seek, The Lusty Rose can be selected at random! Lusty Rose does not consume HP while sprinting, and it is faster than light zombie. 

More characters available for hire!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-11.png
Ling Ling, Isabella, Alin, Gerrard, David Black, Dominique are back again. Check their descriptions to see what bonuses you can get when using some of those characters.

notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/menu2_over.png

“This place is... I can't stop thinking about that nightmare...” - Jennifer

After Dr. Rex’s laboratory was shut down of its operations, Jennifer receives an intel that a different Super Soldier Experiment is at large.

In order to check the intel herself, Jennifer and her team heads to the abandoned city, putting the horrible experiences at the Lost City in the past.

The city was covered in shrubs due to the time left abandoned, and the dead still roamed around the city, as it has in the past. 

• Upon starting, you will be separated from your allies. Rendezvous with the rest of the allies and exit the building. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-1.jpg

• You may need to hold ‘E’ button for some objects. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-2.jpg

• The new types of zombies can climb walls. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-3.jpg

• Once more than ½ of the team is in the safe zone, it will proceed onto the new map. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-4.jpg

“Don't ever judge me, pitiful humans! It's time for you to go to hell!” – Laser Wing

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-5.png

A monster, another experimental creature was created who lost its identity from pure rage and have to be stopped before his anger reaches the civilians.

Enjoy the Scenario, with larger scale of action and plot twists in 2nd day of Tales of the Undead!

New stories are waiting for survivors to join and new pieces of weapons are given to them to cope we the danger lying ahead.

Slasher
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-6.png

A prototype chainsaw that shows its might in close quarters combat. Its second mode will push back enemies as it is swung. Its performances are, overall, slightly inferior to the Ripper's. It is equipped as a primary weapon, and the knockback effect is only applied in zombie mode (Original, Mutant, Hero, Darkness, Bot, Scenario, War.


MP5 Tiger
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-7.png
The MP5 can fire 30 rounds of 9mm ammo and is considered the model sub-machine gun thanks to its ideal combination of power, accuracy, and portability. This version features a white tiger design to celebrate the year of the dragon


From 26.11 until 3.12, the probability to receive those weapons from a Decoder are doubled!

After Dr. Rex’s laboratory was shut down of its operations, Jennifer receives an intel that a different Super Soldier Experiment is at large.

In order to check the intel herself, Jennifer and her team heads to the abandoned city, putting the horrible experiences at the Lost City in the past.

The city was covered in shrubs due to the time left abandoned, and the dead still roamed around the city, as it has in the past. 

• Upon starting, you will be separated from your allies. Rendezvous with the rest of the allies and exit the building. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-1.jpg

• You may need to hold ‘E’ button for some objects. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-2.jpg

• The new types of zombies can climb walls. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-3.jpg

• Once more than ½ of the team is in the safe zone, it will proceed onto the new map. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-4.jpg

“Don't ever judge me, pitiful humans! It's time for you to go to hell!” – Laser Wing

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-5.png

A monster, another experimental creature was created who lost its identity from pure rage and have to be stopped before his anger reaches the civilians.

Enjoy the Scenario, with larger scale of action and plot twists in 2nd day of Tales of the Undead!

New stories are waiting for survivors to join and new pieces of weapons are given to them to cope we the danger lying ahead.

Slasher
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-6.png

A prototype chainsaw that shows its might in close quarters combat. Its second mode will push back enemies as it is swung. Its performances are, overall, slightly inferior to the Ripper's. It is equipped as a primary weapon, and the knockback effect is only applied in zombie mode (Original, Mutant, Hero, Darkness, Bot, Scenario, War.


MP5 Tiger
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/2-7.png
The MP5 can fire 30 rounds of 9mm ammo and is considered the model sub-machine gun thanks to its ideal combination of power, accuracy, and portability. This version features a white tiger design to celebrate the year of the dragon


From 26.11 until 3.12, the probability to receive those weapons from a Decoder are doubled!

notes.title: [NEW] Premium Weapons, Game Point Weapons
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1125/en.jpg

The new, the changed, and the removed
The latest expansion changes a lot in gameplay content as well as to events and items. Check the details below to see what you should expect. 

TMP Dragon

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w1.png

This sub-machine gun fires 30 rounds of 9mm ammo is useful for fast and quiet attacks with its equipped suppressor. However, its 9mm rounds may not damage armored opponents well. It's been decorated with a dragon theme in honour of the year of the dragon.

MP7A1 Unicorn

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w2.png

MP7A1 Unicorn is a submachine gun that uses 20 rounds of 4.6mm. It has a very fast fire rate and is decorated with a horse design.

From 25.11 until 2.12, the probability to receive those weapons from a Decoder are doubled!


Zombie Shelter Survival Weapons available for Game Points!

Machete

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w3.png

A knife used to carve a path in the jungle. You can use it for logging wood. It is thick and boasts a durable, strong power.

Crowbar

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w4.png

A tool used to pull nails. Surprisingly, its hardness makes it a powerful weapon.

Claw Hammer

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w5.png

Hammer is used for construction but isn't too shabby for combat.

All these weapons can be used outside of Zombie Shelter mode. You can also repurchase them as many times as you want, even making them permanent after reaching 999+ days of duration.

New events:
All daily missions will now grant Blueprints or Daily Random Rewards, depending on what a player chooses. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w6.png
On top of Blueprints players will be able to receive daily Mileage Decoders, as a reward for their playtime.

If you reach one 1 hour of playing time you will receive 1 Free Mileage Decoder. Another Decoder will be given for 2nd hour and 3rd one for 3rd hour. To receive your reward you must be playing in a room of at least 4 players.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w7.png

Decoder itself has also some further changes. We have removed all characters from it, as they were very hard to get and we plan to move them into Item Shop, so they can be used by more players.

Those characters are: Ling Ling, Isabella, Alin, Gerrard, David Black, Dominique.

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [NEW] Tales of the Undead expansion released!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/menu1_over.png

Rebuilding: Fun modes, Zombie Giant, Gun Deathmatch, and Zombie Scenario #1

Today, the first chapter of the Tales of the Undead is revealed. There are many new plots awaiting survivors and each day will bring a story of its own. Read through to understand how the land of zombies is evolving.

Fun modes renewal
Killing zombies can be enjoyable at times, but there’s a special place in CSN:Z filled with pure entertainment: the Fun modes.
		
Hiddenhttp://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-1.png

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-2.png

In the renewed mode, humans must survive against the invisible enemy, “Hidden” and a new enemy “Traitor”. The Traitor will be chosen randomly and will be disguised as a human.

There can only be 1 Traitor at a time, but they can appear more frequently with an increasing number of players in a match.
Hidden and Traitor players can tell each other apart from all the humans, but humans cannot differentiate Traitors from other humans. Trick them into thinking that you’re one of them, and backstab them when they least expect it.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-3.jpg

Fortunately for humans, their odds of survival can be increased with supply crates that are randomly spawned in the map. Resupply your ammo through these crates, and receive buffs that will aid you in your battle against the Hidden. The buff will increase your movement speed, health, or attack. It can even reveal the Hidden on your radar.

The ever-strong Hidden and the Traitors are watching your every movement from somewhere in the Hidden City!
	
Item battle	
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-4.png

The renewed Item Battle mainly consists of Team Deathmatch type of games, and the outcome of the battle will depend on how well each team uses the items that appear in the map.

Each item box has a unique appearance, so players can choose the items to their needs. And the list of items players have can be sorted. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-5.jpg

While the player possesses 2 items, the items can be used in fast combination by pressing the E key twice in succession.

It is also easier to strategize what to use against your opponents, as you can see icons of the currently equipped items of other players.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-6.jpg

There are plenty of deadly skills to use, and some of the most powerful weapons that can be acquired only after breaking a barrier surrounding it.
	
Zombie Giant
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-7.png
Angra, which appears in the Zombie Scenario as a boss, is now available as a new zombie boss.

Angra is a powerful zombie which can dominate from the sky above. It can release toxic gas onto the battlefield, and expanding the area of it by blowing strong winds with its wings after the initial gas release. 

It can also remove the weapons of its enemies with shockwaves and then attack defenceless foes with deadly tentacles.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-8.jpg

RAH-66 Comanche is a new playable character for the Human team which can be controlled through third-person view in Zombie Giant mode. 

When the humans’ supply gauge is at its max, players will enter into either a standard TX300 or the new Comanche at random by pressing ‘E’. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-9.png
		
Gun Deathmatch
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-10.png
Gun Deathmatch extends its map list with new ‘Parking Lot’ and ‘Bunny Yard’.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-11.png

Furthermore, players will be able to experience Gun Deathmatch with rare high-end weapons instead of just the more classic ones.

Zombie Scenario #1
We have modified Zombie Scenario Season 1, so that new players can complete the maps faster. Now it should take only 1/4th of time previously needed. 

This has been done with lowering the number of rounds for each of starting maps down to 5. We reduced freeze time, and the animation of opening doors is quicker!

We only increased requirements for medals from 100 to 400 playthroughs. But don’t worry if you had your medal already, you won’t lose it.

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Comeback of the SUPREME Decoder!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1118/en.jpg

It was the biggest release in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. It changed the war, started the new era, and brought unique and permanent weapons on a scale that had not been seen before. Now, as we are so close to some of the biggest changes in this zombie infested world, it’s back again!

Supreme Decoders, as once mentioned “the most devastating tool a survivor can have”, can be the best way of extending a survivor’s arsenal. Four superior weapons, greater chances for permanent weapons, it’s all available again. But just like before, only for limited time!

That unique type of Decoder is available only in CSN:Z and only for 1 month, from 18.11.2015 until 14.12.2015. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_1.jpg
  
You open Supreme Decoders from the same Decoder menu in the game. But the results are far superior to what you formerly got.
 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_2.jpg

Each time you open the Supreme Decoder, you have an 85% chance to win any of BALROG, SKULL, JANUS, Maverick series, or Salamander, M32 MGL, AT4CS, Leviathan. Any of these weapons will be 70 Day versions. 

For any other weapon or item you can see on the Supreme Decoder list, you have the remaining 15% chance to win! However they come in 1 supreme version: Permanently only! And the list includes: Thunderbolt, Lightning weapons, Crossbow, golden weapons series, 6 characters, and so many more! 
 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_3.png
Black Dragon Cannon – Permanent


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_4.png
Ripper aka Power Chainsaw - Permanent


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_5.png
Gae Bolg aka Speargun - Permanent


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_6.png 
Guillotine - Permanent

Please also note that Supreme Decoders are separate items from Mileage Decoders and they don’t give any Mileage Points upon opening.

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [New] Terrorists: Raven and Michaela
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1111/banner.jpg

In a world that has experienced a Zombie Apocalypse, where everyone and everything wants to kill you, it’s not easy to tell who you can trust. Maybe it’s worth calling a truce with Terrorists if they can help you to destroy the common enemy. The two latest outlaws definitely know how to deal with threats and they can do so with style! 

Starting on 11th November, there are two new terrorist characters available in the Shop: Raven and Michaela.

RAVEN
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1111/1.png
Known for his acts of terror on the sea and his expertise as an assassin, he became entrapped while conducting a special mission on behalf of the government. No rescue attempt was made by the government, however, and he became a pirate with money as his only motivation.
Raven belongs to a unique emotion class and can perform two special emotions: “Taunt 2” and  “Shadow Boxing".

MICHAELA
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1111/2.png
A pirate who is wanted by the navy, she is rumored to be the sole daughter of a man who is the owner of a large fleet of ships. The moment that you become enamored by her great beauty, the angel of death will appear before you.
Michaela belongs to a unique emotion class and can perform two special emotions: “Taunt 2” and  “Surrender”.

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/

notes.title: [NEW] Oz's Trio DLC is now Available!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1028/en.jpg

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/1.png

One of the most well-known tales, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, and its lessons can easily be converted to the land of zombies. A true hero should have a strong heart and courage to fight the endless enemies, use their brains so as to come up with tactics against the toughest of bosses and not get overpowered by zombies, and most importantly, a true hero must have a good team to challenge the impossible. 

However, CSN:Z is no fairy tale and happy endings depend strictly on battlefield experience and firepower. We introduce a new set of unique DLC weapons that will help you come back home safely. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2.png

This set includes Tin Man’s Machine Gun, Cowardly Lion’s Pistol, and Scarecrow’s Pickaxe.

Now it's available with 10% release Discount.
You can purchase the Wizard of Oz DLC here

When you use the whole set, you will receive the following bonuses:

Tin Man’s Machine Gun: maximum round increases to 200 (40 rounds/magazine).
Cowardly Lion’s Pistol: rate of fire is increased.
Scarecrow’s Pickaxe: speed and damage are substantially increased.


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/3.png
 
A machine gun that uses 5 magazines. It aims to dissipate the long reload time of the previous version.

If 2 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the maximum magazine capacity increases to 30 rounds.
If 3 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the maximum magazine capacity increases to 40.


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/4.png
A modified Glock 18 which uses a 9mm round. The magazine has been modified to hold 25 rounds, from the original 20, and it boasts of great firepower in close range with its automatic fire.

If 2 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the 1st and 2nd attack’s rate of fire is increased.

notes.title: Halloween! Sales and Events!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1028/en_halloween.jpg
Halloween is always a special period on Steam. Spooky creatures are seen everywhere and things are getting strangely cheap. CSN:Z has prepared all that and more. No tricks, we promise!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-1.png

CSN:Z has prepared a survivor’s treat that will scare off even the deadliest of Zombies, the VULCANUS-7.

The VULCANUS-7 is a machine gun developed by Aegis Laboratory which uses 120 rounds of 7.62mm NATO. It is equipped with the VULCANUS Parts System which automatically transforms after a set amount of time, which allows the use of a grenade launcher or adds 3 extra barrels to the weapon.

Only from 28.10.2015 to 04.11.2015, you can immediately craft the VULCANUS-7 by acquiring the special Perfect Pick Recipe: VULCANUS-7 Set. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-2.png

Buy a bundle of 10x to increase your chances to receive a permanent version or get closer to 999 days, when you can turn the weapon into a permanent version regardless of luck. 

Halloween Event

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-3.jpg
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-4.jpg

What makes Halloween unique is that anybody can wear anything that day and not be considered weird. Although distinctive clothing usually might get you shot at in-game, during Halloween the sight of a team wearing cat costumes can distract any opposing team. So if you want to change your looks, join our event! Starting from 28.10.2015 to 04.11.2015, you can receive 3 Costume Boxes from our Shop each day, for free! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-5.jpg

You will receive 1 Costume Box every time you accomplish the following:
  Log in during the event
  Play for 1 hour
  Play for 2 hours


Halloween Sales
If you’re looking for some special Halloween sales offers, worry not, CSN:Z got you covered!

All characters that were previously sold will be available once again in the Shop at exceptionally good prices! If you haven’t had the chance to buy them yet, now is your best chance!

Natasha + Jennifer (Set)
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-6.png
Ji Yoon Choi + Ritsuka (Set)
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-7.png
Yuri + Criss (Set)
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-8.png
Erica + Mei (Set) 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-9.png
Lucia and Enzo
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-10.png
Additionally new DLC is released soon and it’s on sale! Buy the latest Wizard of Oz Set with a 10% discount.

Previous DLCs will be available from 29.10.15 with a huge 40% discount! Get the Dragon Set and Journey to the West for the lowest price yet!

XignCode Replacing HackShield
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-11.png

We have some news for all the survivors that try illegal ways to win in the game. 

Our old HackShield defender is being replaced with new anti-hack tool: XignCode. This is another step towards eliminating any threats to fair play rules.

Let us know on the forums what you think about the change and if you have any issues with the new system. 

Removal of "Bloody Blade"
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-12.png

After hearing the many opinions from our community and monitoring the results of zombie vs humans encounters, we decided that it’s time to remove the Bloody Blade skill from the game. 

Zombies are going to be harder to kill starting this Halloween. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: 1st Anniversary of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/273110/extras/cake.png?t=1444208953

Dear Survivors. It's been precisely 1 year since we officially released Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies on Steam.

We released multiple expansions and expanded into many new territories. We will continue our work to bring even more content each month and try our chances in new countries.

If you'd like to meet our team in-game, feel free to join GM event Today at 4PM CEST: 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0116/en.jpg

Server: Europe 
Channel: Europe 03 

The exact room name and number will be announced on the forums before the event starts.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/273110/extras/Image_53.png?t=1443189382

We've prepared 5x Anniversary discount coupons that you can use for purchasing Mileage Decoders and Enhancement Packs. 
They are now available and will last through 13th of October.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/273110/extras/discount.png?t=1444210794

During our Today's maintenance we worked on two big updates that you might not see in the game, but are even more important than usual updates and that took priority over new items in the game.

1.We've added strongly updated nexon game security system and prepared a client for completely new anti-hack system that will replace HackShield this month. (more information to come soon). 

2.Additionally we've built a new system that will prevent any future DDoS attacks. We will now run internal tests and it should be active next week. 

As this took all of our resources and we couldn't risk any client complications, please expect new in-game content already next Wednesday.

We'd also like to thank all the players for their support and feedback we receive each day!

Best Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Thanatos-7 Recipe and 2 New weapons in Mileage Decoder!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/en.jpg

Aegis Institute named their most powerful weapon after Death from Greek Mythology – Thanatos.

This was due to the weapon being constructed specifically to bring an ultimate end to the hordes of undead. Unlike regular weapons, it has an inbuilt special system that transforms it to its second form, giving the tactical advantage you might need when surrounded by undead. 

This update brings another version of the famous weapon – THANATOS-7. Furthermore, Mileage Decoders now have 2 additional weapons: Newcomer and Lightning LZ-1. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/1.png
THANATOS-7
This is an anti-zombie machine gun fed with 120 rounds of 7.62mm NATO.

It is equipped with the Thanatos Blade System which can deal continuously high damage to multiple targets inside the blades' radius. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/2.png

Only from 23.09.2015 to 30.09.2015, you can easily craft the THANATOS-7 by acquiring the special Perfect Recipe. Buy a bundle of 10x to increase your chances to receive a permanent version or get closer to 999 days, when you can turn the weapon into a permanent version regardless of luck.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/4.png


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/5.png

Newcomen
A submachine gun that fires 4.6mm rounds with 30 round capacity. It can use the power of a steam engine to unload all 30 bullets at once to be unmatched in firepower.

From 23.09.2015 to 30.09.2015, the Newcomer will be available in Decoders with double the probability.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/6.png


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/8.png

Lightning LZ-1
An assault rifle designed with a Light Zombie motif. Cute little light zombies are attached to it. It fires 30 rounds of special ammo and has high speed and accuracy.

From 23.09.2015 to 30.09.2015, the Lightning LZ-1 will be available in Decoders with double the probability.

notes.title: Blueprints revamp and New Classes!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_en.jpg
Decoders, Supreme Decoders, Perfect Recipes, Supreme Perfect Recipes-- Do any survivors remember the original, good old Blueprints? Well, we do, and we thought we should give them the attention they deserve! 

Blueprints Revamp
New Blueprint Bundles will be available from 16.09.2015 at extremely competitive prices. Just as an example: the smallest pack of Blueprints will include 3x Blueprints set at a price lower than the current price for 1x Blueprint set! Check the Shop tomorrow to see just how good of a deal they are! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_1.jpg

Old things need to improve and new things have to emerge. With that motto in mind, we give you 2 new classes to choose from: 

New! Asian Red Army

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_2.png
Allows you to use an Asian Red Army Faction terrorist character. You will receive an additional 15% EXP and Points. In addition, you will receive a bonus of 400,000 Points upon purchase of this character. 

New! Special Assault Team

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_3.png

Allows you to use a SAT counter-terrorist character. You will receive an additional 15% EXP and Points. In addition, you will receive a bonus of 400,000 Points upon purchase of this character.

Medals! Honor Missions
The “All for Users” update wasn’t and won’t be the only featured update that was based purely on community demands. We heard you again, and new medals have been prepared for CSN:Z. 

Rage Controller - A medal given to those who did not succumb to their rage and defeated Frozen Wrath.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_4.png

Diet Controller - A medal given to those who defeated Gluttony, he who eats just about anything.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_5.png

The Great Detective - A medal given to those who revealed the schemes of the Super Soldier Project.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_6.png

Madness Ender - A medal given to those who managed to stop Doctor Rex.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_7.png

All the new features will be available from 16.09.2015 after the maintenance has been completed.

notes.title: Thanatos-5 Recipe and New weapons in Mileage Decoder!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_en.jpg
Welcome, survivors, to the latest CSN:Z update that will be available tomorrow after the maintenace! It is the time for us to unlock the door to ultimate weaponry that everyone has been eager to land their hands on. The perfect recipe for annihilating zombies.

The THANATOS Series, by Aegis Institute, is finally here!

And it didn’t come alone. The CSN:Z arsenal has been extended with playful weapons: the latest Brick Piece model and a completely new dart pistol. Both available in Mileage Decoders that you can get plenty of by completing Daily Missions! 

New! THANATOS–5

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_1.png

This is an anti-zombie assault rifle fed with 30 rounds of 5.56mm NATO. It is equipped with the Thanatos Blade System, which uses a special grenade launcher to deal high damage by launching multiple blade fragments upon explosion.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_2.png

Starting on 16.09.2015, and only for a limited time, you can simply craft and become the owner of THANATOS-5 by acquiring the THANATOS-5 – Perfect Recipe Set. It holds all of the necessary materials: Grade-6 Crafting Blueprint, 72 Day-Permanent Durable, Points, and the Perfect Recipe that will create the THANATOS-5 with 100% success rate!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_3.png

New! Brick Piece M777

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_4.png

A shotgun made of block-like modules that can be disassembled and put together. Only made in small quantities. Depending on the situation, it can be used as an auto-shotgun or be recombined as an artillery.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_5.png


New! Dart Pistol

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_6.png

Pistol made to fire 5 special darts. It may seem like a regular toy gun, but it has a hidden feature which will shock opponents, causing targets to suffer damage over time after being hit.

Both weapons will have the probability doubled for just 1 week!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_7.png

Event! More Free Decoders from Daily Missions

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_8.png

There’s nothing better for a Mercenary or a humble Hero than a good reward after completing a tough mission. Sure, medals give plenty of honor and they’re a nice, shiny addition to your blood-covered outfit. 

But fortunately, the CSN:Z team knows that there is no medal out there that will keep you safe. Starting on 16.09.2015, Blueprint rewards for each Daily Mission have been changed to Mileage Decoders. 

That means an incredible 20x Free Decoders each day for everyone to grab! 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Last days of Supreme Decoder & permanent Balrog -XI
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0910/en.jpg

Supreme Decoders have become more popular than Mileage Decoders. It might be because of the high chances of receiving permanent items or the unique weapons that make them really Supreme.

Whatever the reason, they were never meant to be available forever. Next Wednesday (16.09.15), they will be taken out of the Shop and from the reward list for completing Daily Missions.

For those who never bought them or wish to make a last purchase, we’ve prepared a special bundle with 15x Supreme Decoders in the Shop with a great price/value ratio. Check it now and make use of these last days of Supreme Decoders! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0910/1.jpg

Some survivors might say that not having a permanent weapon is like not having a weapon at all.

We thought that we should offer players who dislike any form of luck-based systems an option for a decent firearm. Although we don’t plan to put the whole CSN:Z arsenal straight into our Shop, we might introduce a brief, single weapon sale. Let us know what you think of that.

Permanent BALROG-XI (available only from 10.09.15 to 16.09.15)

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0910/2.png
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0910/3_en.png
Based on the XM1014, this is the first auto shotgun integrating the BALROG Charging System (BCS).

Apart from its innate effectiveness at repelling hordes of undead, the incendiary ammunitions automatically generated with every 4 shots that are fired will unleash true destruction upon Zombies; they cover a wide area, don't lose effectiveness with distance, and have extremely high knockback power.

Moreover, you can stock up to 7 of them, and shoot them at will, even while reloading!

Needless to say, at point-blank this weapon will turn even the toughest of enemies to shreds.

All of these factors combined make the BALROG-XI one of the, if not THE, weapon of choice for both veteran Survivors and Zombie Hunters. 

Recommended Modes:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0910/4.png

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0902/en.jpg

It’s back to school in many countries again and It looks like Zombies’ vacations are over too. The Undead have two new Pupils in their rank: Spin Diver and Night Stalker.

You now hire and play those unique Premium Zombies in Zombie Darkness mode.

notes.title: Revamped Weapon Showcase: Upgraded Edition
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/banner.jpg

The Revamped Weapon Showcase continues with a special episode.
The ongoing events allow Survivors to upgrade their weapons into powerful destroyers, so let's take a closer look at them!

Dual Infinity Final

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual1.jpg

Few sidearms can compete with the Dual Infinity, and the 'Final' version is one of the most preferred guns by Zombie hunters. Their secondary fire mode sacrifices accuracy for rate of fire, which makes them perfect at repelling undeads who get too close.
To balance their value, they're extremely hard to get as they force you to get the 'Dual Infinity Custom' first.
The Dual Infinity Final inflict more damage and shoot faster in semi-automatic mode, while in full-auto they're less accurate due to higher recoil.
Moreover, they look awesome: one is pure gold and the other one ruby red.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual2.jpg

M134 Predator

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/M134_1.jpg

The standard M134 is an iconic weapon on its own, but it has some limitations: your movement is slowed, your accuracy is not great, and you can't shoot immediately since the barrels need to spin first.
While there's nothing much to be done about the first two limitations, the M134 'Predator' aims specifically at fixing the third point, allowing the user to manually spin the barrels so that he or she can shoot at will, and immediately unleash a rain of lead upon spotting undead hordes.

Do not let BlindFire know about the M134 Predator! Henry kept it a secret for a reason.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/M134_2.jpg

Triple Barrel Shotgun

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/T-barrel1.jpg

Do you know what's better than a two-barreled shotgun?
Exactly: a three-barreled one!
Sure, it kicks like a horse and reloading it takes time, but this weapon is perfectly suited for keeping isolated Zombies at bay while dealing high damage to them. The idea is to wait for an undead to get close and then send it all the way back to that wall on the other side of the map with a point-blank shot.
You can even fire with all barrels at once using the secondary fire mode for higher damage, but less knockback power.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/T-barrel2.jpg

Dual Kriss Super-V

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual_super1.jpg

Based on the Vector, the Kriss is a reliable SMG: lightweight with low recoil and high damage thanks to the .45 ACP ammunition. Because of this, acquiring enough experience with using one of them will allow you to wield two at the same time like a true veteran!
You will be a little less accurate for obvious reasons, but who cares? You'll have a larger magazine to compensate for that and you'll look awesome, which is always a plus.
Spray 'n Pray!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual_super2.jpg

SL-8 Custom

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/SL8_1.jpg

When modifying a weapon, there are some obvious choices to make: grab a larger magazine, put a suppressor on, find a better crosshair, and craft special ammunitions for increased damage. 
These features define the pure concept of 'customization' for any kind of weapon and the SL-8 Custom possesses all of the above, which makes it an even better middle-ranged sniper rifle.
Is there anything more to add? Yes: it's fully automatic.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/SL8_2.jpg

Master Combat Knife

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Knipe1.jpg

Legend says that this blade is somehow related to a mythical god of some sort and could be a kind of ritual knife for sacrifices...
We don't know if that's true, but this is for sure: the longer blade of the Master Combat Knife allows for both slicing and stabbing to inflict higher damage from a safer distance. However, it's preferable to avoid direct contact with a melee weapon when pegged against a gun-wielding opponent, and aim for the back instead. Especially in cases like this one, the result is a quick and deadly backstab.
If being sneaky is not possible, just keep running and aim for the head as you would do with a firearm.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Knipe2.jpg

notes.title: [NEW] Perfect Enhancing Unboxed!
notes.content:
All survivors are constantly after newer, bigger, and more powerful weapons. But there is a group of zombie hunters that prefer more old school weaponry. Not everyone wants to change their well-worn in battle M60, to a futuristic Blaster, or their retro Winchester to a shooting umbrella. 

There’s an old, wise individual in CSN:Z that highly respects that choice. He goes by the name of “Henry” and he can ensure that your classic weapons keep up with the competition using a serious enhancing procedure. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/1_en.jpg

He can improve some weapons’ stats up to EIGHT levels (+8) from stock (0).
The ones that can be upgraded will have a wrench icon on the upper right-hand side of the weapon’s image.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/2.png

Acquire the new Enhancement Boxes from 20.08.2015 and bring them to Henry to see some amazing results.

Enhancement Box (Perfect Enhancement) contains 10x Special Enhancement Material and 3x Perfect Enhancement Material. Perfect Enhancement Material guarantees a 100% success rate, and you can randomly acquire 3x of those from the box. 

Perfect Enhancement Material will increase the exact weapon statistic that is mentioned in its description. That will allow you to specifically tailor the weapon to your needs whether you want to have an extremely accurate weapon or you want to focus purely on firepower.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/3_en.jpg


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/4.png

Enhancement Box (Anti-Elemental) contains 50x Special Enhancement 
Material and 2x Anti-Enhancement Material. Anti-Enhancement Material can reset the exact corresponding statistic, and you can randomly acquire 2x Anti-Enhancement Material.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/5_en.jpg

After enhancing some of the weapons in the Crafting menu to +6 (Master Edition) and +8 (Expert Edition), their appearance will change. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/6.jpg

notes.title: [Update] New Era of Decoder SUPREME!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0817/supreme.jpg

You surely noticed all the recent updates: Zombie Rework, Zombie Darkness, Free new Zombies, Zombie War. There was so much Focus on Zombies one might think CSN:Z wants the Undead to win over the Humans - permanently.

This time we brought together with Heroine and Humans brand new skills, the most devastating tool a survivor can have: Supreme Decoders.

Unique type of Decoder in a form available only in CSN:Z and only from 17.08.2015 until 16.09.2015.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_1.jpg

You open Supreme Decoders from the same Decoder menu in the game. But the results are far superior to what you got used to.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_2.jpg
Each time you open Supreme Decoder you have 85% chances to win any of BALROG, SKULL, JANUS, Maverick series, or Salamander, M32 MGL, AT4CS, Leviathan. Any of these weapons will be 70 Days versions.

Any other weapon or item you can see on the Supreme Decoder list you have the remaining 15% chances to win! However they only come in 1 supreme version: Permanently only! And the list includes: Thunderbolt, Lightning weapons, Crossbow, golden weapons series, 6 characters and so many more!

And by many more we mean some latest weapons in CSN:Z

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_3.png

Black Dragon Cannon – Permanent

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_4.png

Ripper aka Power Chainsaw - Permanent

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_5.png
Gae Bolg aka Speargun - Permanent

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_6.png
Guillotine Permanent

With all the many permanent weapons you can now simply acquire you might find yourself in a unfortunate situation where you draw a permanent weapon which you already have. Fortunately In that case instead of receiving a 2nd one you will receive a 500 Days item extension! 2 of those and you can make any weapon permanent!

We are aware this will cause an unprecedented number of weapons in players hands that needs upgrading. Therefore we decided to make it easier for everybody to get to their +8 stats and make from now on all Anti-Enhancements materials purchasable by Game Points only.

You’ll need 20.000 Points for 10 Anti-Enhancements and 50.000 Points for 30x Anti-Enhancements.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_7_en.png

Please also take notice that Supreme Decoders are separate items from Mileage Decoders and they don’t give any mileage points upon opening.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Rework Update
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/rework_en.jpg
What is the Zombie Rework?

Since updating so many contents for Zombies, there were lots of change requests from users regarding Zombie modes.

We listened to the users (you all!!) and below are the things that have been most recently updated.
Adding double grenades for Zombies. Two powerful weapons can be chosen for Heroes and Heroines. Yes, you can finally be a Heroine, too! Or be a Sidekick and help the Hero or Heroine. A Sidekick also can be equipped with some powerful weapons.

You can also restrict the Zombie selection. The freedom to balance Zombie matches is now in your hands. You can also choose what kind of Zombie you want to be when you revive.

And the all-time most requested skills that users have asked for has been added: Bloody Blade and Deadly Shot. Now Humans can deal fatal damage to Zombies for 5 seconds to have more room to escape or annihilate them all.

There are many other changes in this patch, so please check the list below for details:

[Zombie Rework update]

1. New feature
- You can now play as Heroine in Zombie Hero mode, if you possess and have selected a female character.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_6.jpg

2. New items
- Double zombie grenade: double shock, one after another. It causes shock upon contact.
- 2 heroic weapons are added: M134 Vulcan and Dual Kriss Custom.
- You can now select or cancel heroic weapons.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_7.jpg

3. Sidekick
- In support of Heroes and Heroines, random players will be chosen as Sidekicks.
- Hidden weapons from the Supply Boxes can now be acquired upon being selected as a Sidekick.

4. Supply Box function change
- Ammo supplies, night vision goggles, and grenades available in Supply Boxes.
- Weapon buy now available again through Supply Boxes. (Cannot acquire hidden weapons anymore.)

5. Zombie Selection
- You can choose to become a different type of zombie upon revival.
- You can edit the zombie selection sequence in [Edit Buy Menu] from [My Info]
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_8_en.jpg

6. Option to restrict classes of zombies
- You can now restrict classes of zombies in the game options.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_9_en.png

7. Zombie skills
- Common skills added.
- Leap, Harden, and Confuse skills removed.
- Skills have been changed:

   Jump: Jumping ability increased for a set period.
   Regenerate: Recover a set amount of HP.
   Protect: Recover a set amount of armor.
   Trap: A set trap will move automatically once it detects a human.
   Charge: Movement speed lowered for a moment, but ignores knockback.
   Recover skill from Venom Guard: Instantly recovers half of its maximum HP.
   Rage: HP is no longer consumed upon use, but cooldown is now increased.
   Pulling: Pulling strength is decreased a tad bit.
   Heal: Healing amount decreased a bit, and cooldown increased.
   (Also, cooldown for other skills have been changed.)

8. Zombie classes abilities adjusted.
- Light Zombie
   Defense is reduced a small amount.

- Heavy Zombie
   Defense is reduced a small amount.

- Stomper
   Defense is increased a small amount.
   Movement speed is reduced a small amount.
   Jumping ability is reduced a small amount.

- Banshee
   Movement speed is increased a small amount.
   Jumping ability is increased a small amount.
   Defense is reduced a small amount.

- Voodoo Zombie
   Movement speed is increased a small amount.
   Defense is increased a small amount.

- Psycho Zombie
   Defense is increased a small amount.

- Ganymede
   Defense is increased a small amount.
   Movement speed is reduced a small amount.
   Jumping ability is reduced a small amount.

- Deimos
   Movement speed is reduced a small amount.
   Jumping ability is reduced a small amount.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_10.jpg

9. Human Skills

Deadly Shot: When activated, its user can do fatal damage to zombies for 5 seconds.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_11.png

Bloody Blade: When activated, its user's melee weapon's damage is doubled for 5 seconds. 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_12.png
