notes.title: [UPDATE] All for Users Update
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/update_en.jpg

The CSN:Z team has decided to update the game based on the feedback of users.

One of the most impressive updates is the ‘Vote Kick Renewal’. Many users kept talking about ‘Vote Kick’, calling it ‘abusive’ and ‘misused’. Thankfully, as a result of the renewal, those users consider the game to be headed in the right direction – one might call the approach ‘democratic’.

Another remarkable update is the separation of the chat windows into two division. We heard user complaints about system messages always covering player chats. Well that is no longer an issue.

One thing also to be highlighted is the Inventory arranging/search function. This is what we should have done at the beginning of service, admittedly. And now you can re-arrange your inventory as you wish. It is more convenient and more comfortable.

There are many other changes in this patch, so please check the list below for details:

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_1.jpg

[All for Users Update]
1. Vote Kick Renewal
- The Vote Kick system has been renewed so that it cannot be abused and misused, and is headed in the right direction.
- You can use the vote kick only 5 times per day.
- The one being subjected to a vote kick will have a moment to convey his defense against the kick before the vote commences.
- The vote kick item can only be used in a room with 3 or more players.
- Once the vote begins, players can either say Yes (F3), No (F4), or Withdraw (ESC). Withdrawing will not be considered as a valid vote.
- In order to carry out the vote kick, a certain percentage of the players in the room must vote, either ‘yes’ or ‘no’, and in order to kick the person out from the room, a majority of the voting players must have said ‘yes’.
- The Vote Kick item can only be used by a player who has been in the room for more than 3 minutes.
- After using a Vote Kick, regardless of the result, the item can be reused after 1 minute.
- You have to be at least level 20 to be able to purchase the Vote Kick item

2. Zombie War in the zombie rankings
- Zombie War is now included in the Zombie League rankings.
- Upon playing in Zombie War mode, Zombie League ranking points can be earned.

3. Division in chat window
- Normal messages and system messages are now separated.
- Now players can chat with ease in the new chat layout.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_2_en.jpg

4. Inventory arrange/search function renewed
- Inventory renewed so that owned items can be seen and checked more easily.
- Item categorization is further divided so that items can be better organized.
- Newly acquired items will be labeled “new” on the top of its icon to ease its finding in the Inventory.
- Function added so that items can be arranged by name, date acquired, or category.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_3_en.png

5. Expanded Blacklist
- Increased to 150 from the previous 30.

6. Number of times allowed to receive special missions increased (again)
- Increased the count to re-receive special missions.
- Before: Premium Item 5 times.
- After: Standard 2 times/ Premium Item 7 times (total 9 times).

7. Weapon crafting cost and time required reduced
- Crafting time reduced to 0.75 from 1.00 seconds.
- Crafting cost reduced 20%. (For unlimited crafting, reduced to 12800 from 16000).

8. Demo renewed
- Now players are able to record videos other than the Demo. Recording options can be found under Options.
- For a proper playback of the videos, MP2 (MPEG-1 Layer 2) and MPEG1 codecs must be installed.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_4_en.png

9. Item auto-equip fixed (Costumes)
- Costumes now can be automatically equipped, if there aren’t any costumes currently equipped. If a costume is currently equipped, then newly acquired costume will not be automatically equipped.

10. Human Scenario Buy menu renewed.
- UI changed, Favorites tab added.
- Buy menu now can be seen even when dead.

11. Issue where game options could not be saved is fixed
- Temporary bug where game options could not be saved is now fixed.

12. Minigun sound bug fix
- Fixed an issue where the sound of the spinning barrel of the M134 would be constantly played when a player was spectating another player also using the M134.

13. Dismantling Blueprints/Durables
- Blueprints/Durables can now be dismantled.
- If the mentioned items are dismantled, 2 lower-tiered items can be acquired.
- If you wish to change the category of the current Blueprint, it can be demolished and then crafted into another one.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_5_en.png

CSN:Z Team

notes.title: DLC Special Offer! Get bonus Classes ‘Spade’ and ‘Keith Icahn’ for PERMANENT!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/en.jpg
Eagle-eyed players may have noticed some rather unfamiliar faces showcasing the latest additions to CSN:Z, wielding the Dragon Set and Journey to the West DLC Pack weapons.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/journey_5.png

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/dragon.png

That is Spade and Keith Icahn, two Classes in CSN:Z who have kept a low profile! It has been a long while since they made an appearance.

Players who pick up the Journey to the West or Dragon Set DLC Packs for CSN:Z can enlist their services PERMANETLY!

From 29th July purchasing the latest CSN:Z DLC Packs includes a truly rare offer!

 Receive male Terrorist Class Spade for PERMANENT when purchasing and activating a Journey to the West DLC Pack.
 Receive male Counter-Terrorist Class Keith Icahn for PERMANENT when purchasing and activating the Dragon Set DLC Pack. 

Players who purchase both DLC Packs can get both of these skilled combatants for PERMANENT!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/4.png

If you’ve already purchased one, or both, DLC packs featured in this event you will still receive Spade and\or Keith Icahn as CSN:Z Team manually issues these rewards to eligible player accounts.

If you are having difficulty entering your code, please attempt the following;

 Make sure you are entering the entire DLC Code, which will be 30 characters long.
 Copy\Paste may result in errors, please enter the DLC Code manually.
 DLC Codes are case-sensitive and must be entered exactly as they appear. ‘abcde’ is different from ‘ABCDE’.
 Once you have entered your DLC Code, please allow the game enough time to process it. This may take 5-10 seconds.

Summer may be starting to wind down, but Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies isn’t about to let it go without a fight! CSN:Z opened its undead doors to whole new regions of the globe, unleashed days of Darkness updates, and is spreading its Zombie infection deeper into Steam with our latest DLC packages… but it’s time to break out the big guns!

Daily Missions are going to become much more rewarding with the return of FREE Bonus Decoders!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0610/1.png
From 29.07.15 to 26.08.15 completing Daily Missions will also award a Bonus Decoder. Players can earn up to 10 Bonus Decoders each day, with the event repeating each day for the duration of the event. That’s a lot of FREE Decoders waiting for you!

Please note that CSN:Z uses CEST for its events, and each day resets Bonus Decoder progress at Midnight CEST. 
The time zone where you reside may differ from CEST by a large amount. For our USA players in the Eastern Time Zone, each day resets event progress at noon. 

EVENT! – Weapon Upgrade Event is back! Earn FREE PERMANENT Upgrades
As one of the most popular events in CSN:Z,  it would have been a shame if Weapon Upgrades didn’t drop in on such an exciting summer! In addition, it is only fair that players from the newly added South America, North Africa, and Middle East regions get a fair crack at earning those FREE PERMANENT Upgraded weapons!

From 29.07.15 to 26.08.15 scoring kills with Upgradeable Weapons can earn players their Upgraded variants for PERMANENT duration for FREE! Scoring kills awards points towards completing a weapon’s upgrade, and each weapon has a different amount of points required.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0729/4_en.png

How to begin a Weapon Upgrade during the event:

M134 Minigun -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-1 Blueprints 
Dual Infinity -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-2 Blueprints
Combat Knife -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-3 Blueprints
Kriss Super V -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-4 Blueprints
Double Barrel Shotgun -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-5 Blueprints
SL8 -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-5 Blueprints

All those weapons can also be acquired from Decoders. Luckily for all survivors, you get Free Decoder Bundles when purchasing Crafting Bundles. That means higher chances to get the weapons you need for permanent upgrades! 

Please note that Weapon Upgrades can only be obtained during the event. If you have unfinished progress towards a weapon when the event ends, you will not receive the Permanent Upgraded variant of the weapon.
Please check following rules that apply to this event:

*Kill points can vary depending on game mode. Example: point can be acquired from Zombie PvP modes (15 Zombie kills, 5 Human kills) and Zombie Scenario(1 Zombie kill), etc.
*Weapon upgrade is available for both temporary and permanent items.
*If your inventory does not contain any of the listed weapons, weapon upgrade won't start.
*Kill points can be obtained only in a room with more than 4 users

notes.title: Revamped Weapon Showcase (#3)
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0616/en.jpg

The Revamped Weapon Showcase Continues!

Decoder Exclusives (Part 3)

Volcano

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0616/volcano_1.jpg

If you thought it was impossible to combine an Assault Rifle with a Shotgun, then think again, as this hybrid gets the best out of both!
The Volcano is the dream of every Survivor who has to deal with a horde of Zombies: its magazine holds 40(!!) 12g shells fired in rapid succession, the long barrel provides unmatched accuracy for its weapon type and the reload time is just a bit slower than a normal Assault Rifle.
Add to the package a truly distinct look and you'll understand immediately why no other name could fit this weapon better: a Volcano will unleash a stream of death and destruction on your enemies!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0616/volcano_2.jpg

Grade-1 Blueprint (Part 6)

M24

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0616/m24_1.jpg

While this weapon uses standard 7.62mm rounds, it should not be considered ‘just another Sniper Rifle'.
Such a reliable design allows greater freedom to a sniper during a battle, allowing for swift movement across the field while neutralizing up to 10 individual threats before having to reload.
Definitely a weapon which rewards skilled players aiming for the head, who prefer to retain their mobility at the cost of reduced accuracy in an extremely long range.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0616/m24_2.jpg

MG3

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0616/mg3_1.jpg

A core component to assault squads, the MG3 is the modern version of the notorious MG42, also known as 'Hitler's Buzzsaw' during World War II.
While it grants an incredible suppressive fire, thanks to its magazine that holds 200 7.62x51mm rounds and an efficient belt feeding system, its weight prevents swift movements and accurate shots.
Definitely not suited for Lone Wolves, but capable of shining if used as a support weapon while fighting alongside teammates.
In case of direct engagement of human targets, the element of surprise is almost always vital, as direct 1v1 battles should be avoided, if possible.
If engaging Zombies, instead, the MG3 will annihilate entire hordes without trouble.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0616/mg3_2.jpg

notes.title: [EVENT] Grab Gaming Gear in our Coin Event!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0702/coin_event.jpg

Some lucky Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies players may win themselves brand new merchandise for their gaming PC rig, such as mice, keyboards, and more! Best of all, all a CSN:Z player needs to do to enter is play!


Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.


How To Play
From 02.07 to 22.07, look for the ‘Coin Event’ button at the bottom of the lobby menu. Click the button to see what prizes are in the event, and to use Coins on prizes you would like to attempt and win.

Coins can be earned by playing in any of CSN:Z’s Game Modes, where a Coin is rewarded for every 30 minutes of tracked, valid play time. Please note that valid play time is only counted in matches with 4 or more players present.

Players can hold up to 3 Coins at a time, so remember to use them in the Coin Event menu once you reach 3 to make room for more—because you can keep earning Coins through every day of the event!

What to Win
This latest event for CSN:Z offers chances to win Decoders, which can unlock some great weapons and Classes, but what makes the Coin Event so special are the rewards you may get your hands on!

Some great gaming gear has been provided by mionix.net to offer lots of prizes to the CSN:Z Community! There are also some great gaming gear rewards to be had, care of madcatz.com!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0702/1_en.png

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0702/2_en.png

Rules / Important
Please read the following rules concerning the Coin Event:
 Only players residing in officially supported regions of CSN:Z may be eligible to receive physical prizes from the Coin Event. If a player is not located in an officially supported region, they will not receive a physical prize or compensation for the physical prize in its place.
 Those who win physical prizes from the Coin Event will be contacted by Nexon Europe by means of the Steam Account which won the prize in the Coin Event. Steam Profiles which are set to private, or cannot accept communication from other Steam Accounts, may be unable to fulfil information request requirements in order to ship physical prizes. 
Only the Steam Account which won a Coin Event prize will be permitted to fulfil information request(s) in order to receive any physical prizes. 
 Physical and in-game prizes are in limited quantities, please check the Coin Event window in-game to see which prizes have or have not yet been claimed.
 Using a Coin to attempt and win a prize will either award the selected prize, or fail. You can reattempt to win a prize with Coins until its quantity is reduced to zero.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Shelter Map HELLRIDE is now available!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/30th_shelter.jpg

All aboard! Zombie Shelter has just gotten a new Co-Op map with new challenges for your squad to try and survive. Log in today to get a turn on the train car and get your 10x FREE Decoders!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0625_1.jpg

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.


Zombie Shelter not only puts your survival skills to the test, it also requires a team of survivors to really flex their carpentry skills! Each day offers a limited window of time to gather resources and explore further away from the team’s shelter, but when night arrives Humans must work together to keep their shelter from succumbing to the undead. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_2.jpg

To stay alive, up to 4 team members need to construct additions and improvements to their Shelter using resources collected throughout the map.

Get resources, build watch towers, kill Zombies, defeat bosses, race traincars… hold on a second, what was that last one?

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_3.jpg

HELLRIDE is the first map in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies to include vehicles! In the map are 2 traincars that players can operate, allowing for much faster movement throughout the map. Just as teams must work together to survive each day of Zombie Shelter, remember to take turns! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_4.png

When in a traincar, press the [E] key to operate it. While operating a traincar tap the forward or backward movement keys (default: [W] and [S] keys.) to accelerate forwards, reduce speed, or switch down to reverse gear.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_5.png

Teamwork is also required for making the most of the traincars, such as clearing obstacles off the tracks and controlling which paths are taken using the rail’s switches. 

Zombie Shelter Tips
Of course, it doesn’t hurt to understand some important tips about making the most of Zombie Shelter!

--Share Resources: Wood and Iron collected is stored on your character, but don’t go hoarding it. Put Wood and Iron in the Shelter’s storage of resources so other team members can get to work on constructing needed buildings.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_6.jpg

--Build it Big: Press the[noparse]  [/noparse]key in-game to see what is available to construct. There’s a large variety of choices to help your team survive each day of Zombie Shelter. It’s important to know that some construction options have dependencies, and you may have to start small before the very big choices are possible.

--Use Your Skills: Press the [N] key in-game to apply skill points towards a variety of different talents. Surviving more days means more skill points, so do not forget to put your skills to use!

--Mind the Meter: Home is where the heart is, but it’s also immediately vital to your survival! At the bottom of your screen is a meter that depletes when traveling away from your Shelter. 


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_7.jpg

If it depletes fully, your HP will begin to drop until either you get back to the Shelter or die on your feet! If your vision begins to go dark, it’s a warning you need to get back to the Shelter ASAP. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_8.jpg

Don’t get too caught up in the fun of dueling traincars in HELLRIDE, as Zombie Shelter is both about daily surviving and surviving the worst of which Zombies can throw at a team of Humans…

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_9.png

The incredible battle through Darkness continues with the next Zombie Scenario Season 4 map! Log in today to take on map 3 of CSN:Z’s latest Zombie Scenario expansion, and also get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_2.jpg

Whoever Gerrard and Jim, Leader of the Red Lizard Mercenaries, are tracking down is no ordinary fiend. This much is true even if the monster has managed to keep their identity in the dark. As battle torn and weary as these mercenary teams may be, they have come too far to stop now.

Zombie Scenario is not about fair fights, so no one should be surprised that a true challenge waits at the end. With Map 3 of Zombie Scenario Season 4, it is the first time the boss battle is teaming up against the Humans!

Your eyes are not playing tricks on you. Players must face off against two towering super soldiers, Neid and Zavist. Both Neid and Zavist must be defeated, and do not pretend that they will not team up against Humans who are foolish enough to reach them and put their incredible size and strength to use in the fight. Goodness, those are some huge swords…

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_4.png

Those who have lasted this long while venturing so deep into the Darkness are brave souls. A commendable effort for uncovering the evil which lurks this far, but the journey to defeat it is not over yet.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Darkness mode is now available!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/zombie_darkness.jpg

Zombie VS Human PvP combat is about to take a dark turn! The latest mode Zombie Darkness is now available. Log in to try it out and get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.

In Zombie Darkness, new grotesque classes of Zombies are waiting to spread the undead infection to you and your currently-living team mates. However, don’t suit up for battle thinking all your strategies and tricks you’ve been refining will work as well in these new arenas. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_2.png

Normally, a strong camping strategy can outlast the undead. In Zombie Darkness, each map transitions from daylight to twilight, and under the cover of darkness, the Zombies gain a powerful advantage. Both all new Zombie classes and Human players will have new tricks to learn, making Zombie Darkness a new challenge for both long time survivors and newcomers alike!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_3.jpg

Staying alive is not just the goal of Zombie Darkness as a Human, but also the means of putting unique skills to work against the undead. During each match, Adrenaline builds over time which can be used for Human abilities unique to Zombie Darkness.

Sprinting is an effective strategy for making the trek across more open areas of the map, and a well placed Kick can quickly tell a Zombie to back off. However, the skill of Concentrated Fire is vital in Zombie Darkness and what separates the survivors from the leaders. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_4.jpg

Build the Adrenaline gauge high enough, and Concentrated Fire will not only deal far higher damage to a Zombie but will put them down for good.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_5.jpg

Humans have new ways of keeping the Darkness at bay, but they’ll need it to take on the nightmarish creations they’ll find in that Darkness…

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_6.jpg

NORMAL ZOMBIE – As the name implies, these Zombies are a staple of Zombie Darkness. Sprinting is great for ambushing unsuspecting Human enemies, but it is their wall climbing ability which can turn the tide in favor of the living dead. The Humans will be trying to hide high out of reach, so don’t let them get too comfortable.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_7.jpg

LIGHT ZOMBIE – Less hearty than other classes, the Light Zombie does not excel at defense but makes up for this with the ability to leap high distances. When leaping between buildings cannot get the job done, the invisibility skill can help get the drop on distracted Humans. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_8.jpg

HEAVY ZOMBIE – Speed? Mobility? Subtlety? These are not ways the Heavy Zombie class rolls. Unleash a powerful slam to the ground to get Humans shaking in their boots, or harden against incoming fire to withstand even greater amounts of damage.

Could Humans possibly withstand even more undead terror as nightfall approaches?... 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_9.png

Are you afraid of the Darkness? CSN:Z’s latest in Zombie PVP mode may test if you can keep your composure as night approaches, but everyone is still being drawn deeper into the void…

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Files mode is now available!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/Zombie_files.jpg

If you’re brave enough, try our new Zombie Files mode in CSN:Z and learn how the Zombie outbreak began. On top of our new mode, log in to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский , Português , Español.

Not everyone is a mercenary, soldier, or gun toting professional in an outbreak of the undead. Senior Researcher Soi is far more familiar with a pipette than a pistol, but she rose to the occasion and survived!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_2.jpg

…But, how did Senior Researcher Soi survive? How did the outbreak begin? To find out, you must uncover what is within the Zombie Files…

SPRINTING, STAMINA, SURVIVAL

Zombie Files provides a much different challenge than what you may be used to in existing modes like Zombie Scenario or Zombie Hero. Being a single player mode, there won’t be any team mates to watch your back but a group of players can join a match to indirectly compete for fastest map completion.

Another important difference is Stamina, which governs the actions Senior Researcher Soi can perform. Sprinting will come in handy, but getting winded trying to escape may prevent you from attacking any zombies until your Stamina refills!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_3.jpg

Use your wits to survive in the Zombie Files. The body count may just end up adding your own to the pile!

HELPFUL SURVIVAL TIPS
Find throwable items to lure Zombies away from your path before proceeding further, they’ll follow the sound of the object landing!
Sprinting may let you escape, but keeping quiet may prevent the Zombies from ever giving chase to begin with.
Grab a breather when you can. Stamina recharges, but takes a moment of time to refill completely.
Finding weapons is a staple of any Zombie outbreak, but just like a Zombie outbreak it is vital to conserve ammo! You’ll have to find another gun if the one you have runs out of ammo.


ESCAPING ZOMBIES AND EXECUTING ZOMBIES

Should your best efforts flop, it may become a life or death struggle with the Zombies. Always try to keep your distance or else Zombies may grab you and steadily drain your HP! Repeatedly press the [E] key to ESCAPE and quickly put space between yourself and the undead.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_4.jpg

However, there is value for getting in close when a Zombie is on the verge of defeat. Get in close and press the [E] key to instantly finish off the walking corpse!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_5.jpg


The secrets of the Zombie Files can be revealed to you, but only if you can survive to the bitter end. Don’t worry! It’s not like humanity’s fate is resting in the hands of one researcher caught in the epicenter of a Zombie infection outbreak, right?

…Right? 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_6.png


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Grrgkk! Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Big Update Out
notes.content:
The first time I tried this, you didn’t believe me. I’ll try again: play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies [official site] to marvel at the weird grab bag of modes Nexon have smashed into a free-to-play version of Valve’s dear FPS. You’ll find survival with scavenging and base-building, arena battles with floods of monsters and huge bosses, racing a chasing horde, Splash Damage-style vehicle escorting, co-op story missions, and so much more. I had a fun six hours just exploring what’s in this weird thing.
Heck yeah I’m excited a big update’s out with even more modes! One reminds me of Evolve.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Giant mode is now available!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/1_en.png

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/menu1.png

Today uncovers the first horrifying secret of the Darkness, and it is truly a GIANT one. Log in today to not only try out CSN:Z’s brand new mode ZOMBIE GIANT, but also to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!


Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский
Português Español.


Mode Review:
In CSN:Z’s latest game mode, Humans take on Zombies in exciting combat to either survive another day or succumb to the terrors of the undead. This may all seem familiar to our experienced players, but Zombie Giant is anything but.

A Human player is randomly selected to join the Zombie team, but as a towering terrifying Zombie Boss! Suddenly, joining the undead doesn’t seem so bad. 

Humans will need to work as a team to take down the massive beast that used to be their comrade, but then another is selected to unleash some damage...

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_1.jpg

Zombie Team:
There are 3 Zombie Bosses that the player may become when selected to join the Zombie Team: Dione, Revenant, or Fallen Titan. They’re all great for destroying puny Humans, but make sure to put their unique skills to work for you.

Four skills are available, but the final fourth skill is only available if you’re a proper Zombie Giant and take out enough Human enemies to Evolve during combat.

Human Team:
Odds do not seem to be in the Human’s favor, but when are they ever? Don’t give up hope just yet! For scoring kills on the Zombie Giants, or doing your part to help, Humans are awarded Support Points that can be used to level the playing field.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_2.png

For starters, you’re not alone in this fight! Bot characters will help Humans chip away at the Zombie Giant. This is a good start, but the Humans will need more.
A few Support Points can be spent to restock for another skirmish, and building a larger stockpile of Support Points can put some military-grade weaponry in the map to work for you… but if you get truly wealthy with Support Points?

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_4.jpg

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_3.png

Let’s just say it will be a hell of a fight.

It’s good to be bad! Log in to CSN:Z today and serve up some GIANT sized mayhem.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Hola! Olá! New Decoder Rewards, Languages, and Region Expansion!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/banner_en_spreading.jpg

The Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team is proud to announce some big additions in our latest update... continent-sized additions to be specific!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский
Português Español.


Quick rundown:
-- CSN:Z now offers language support for Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
-- Regions of South America and MENA are now officially supported by CSN:Z.
-- 10x Free Decoders at login each day through 1st July.
-- New rewards in Decoder with increased probability event from 24th June through 7th of July
-- Decoders from Battlefield Supply on days 4 and 7 and new daily rewards. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang1.png

Whether shooting Zombies with friends, shooting friends that are Zombies, or enjoying all the rest which CSN:Z has to offer, it can make a world of difference being able to do so in your preferred language.

To help make CSN:Z a great experience for even more of our players, we have added Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese language options. 

Whether you want to use these new languages, or switch to any of the other languages CSN:Z supports, you can do this through the Interface page of the Steam Settings window.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang2.jpg

The CSN:Z Team is proud to announce that even more countries around the globe can join in on the Zombie mayhem. It just wouldn’t feel like a proper Zombie outbreak if the infection didn’t start hopping to new continents! Starting 24.06, the new regions 

being officially supported can access CSN:Z and get started playing.

South American regions CSN:Z has been opened to:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang2.png

MENA regions CSN:Z has been opened to;
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang3.png

What better way is there to welcome these new regions to CSN:Z than with FREE Decoders?

Each day from 24th June through 1st July, receive 10x Decoders for FREE instantly when logging in to CSN:Z. Log in every day of the event to get 10x bundle of FREE Decoders!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0625_1.jpg

Remember that every Decoder activated also awards a random sum of Mileage. Spend the Mileage you’ve accumulated on your Bingo Board to unlock even MORE rewards.

Please note that the event is set to Central Europe Summer Time (CEST), please check the difference between your region’s time zone and CEST when making sure you log in to get every reward.

…And what better to go with tons of FREE Decoders than new Decoder rewards?

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang3.jpg

Avalanche – This is more than just a futuristic looking machine gun! Switch between the Avalanche’s different firing modes to land more precise controlled shots or live up to the weapon’s name with an Avalanche of lead.

Blaster – With its large capacity 45 round magazine, the Blaster rifle can sling some serious amounts of lead at a target before needing to reload. The CSN:Z Team will understand if you still choose to reload after firing only a few shots just to watch the Blaster load and unload each magazine.

Take advantage of increased probability event to get a hold of the brand new Avalanche and Blaster!

From 24th of June through 7th of July both weapons will have double the chances to be drawn from Decoder.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang4.png

You can see the event is running by the golden tag and a x2 sign next to those items from within the Decoder menu.

LOG IN! – Free Decoders from Battlefield Supply and new weapon sets.
From 24th of June, redeeming your daily Battlefield Supply reward will get you free Decoders. On the 4th  reward day, the prize is 1x Decoder. On the 7th reward day, the prize is 2x Decoders.  
Additionally each other day you will receive limited duration, high ROF weapons: MG3, MG36, MK48, M134, M2.
This will surely help any survivor to fight of new hordes of Zombies that came along with latest content expansion.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang5.jpg

In case you were wondering what is this new Coupon system in the Item Shop, we can tell you we  have prepared something special for CSN:Z, that will become active very soon. Stay tuned for more information revealed in following weeks.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang6.png

notes.content:

Quick rundown!
-- Finishing Daily Missions awards Decoders, up to 10 per day! (EVENT EXTENDED)
-- Complete Zombie Scenario maps for Decoders! 1x Decoder per map, per event period.

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский .

EXTENDED EVENT! – Daily Mission Big Bonus for FREE DECODERS!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/event1.png

From 10th June through 24th June, completing Daily Missions awards the player with a nice big bonus of FREE Decoders!

Completing a Daily Mission awards the player a bonus 1x Decoder, with a maximum of 10x Decoders per day—wait, doesn’t this sound familiar?

The CSN:Z Team has extended this event from our prior update. We hope everyone is familiar with what Senior Researcher Soi, Evelyn, and the other staples of Daily Missions require as they have more Decoders to hand over!

This event can be repeated every day, so make sure to drop in to CSN:Z daily to get each and every FREE Decoder from Daily Missions!

Please note that this event only applies to Daily Missions. 
The daily tally of 10x possible Decoders resets at midnight (24:00) Central European Summer Time (CEST). For our US players, this is 12:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time (EDT). 

EVENT! – FREE Decoders for Zombie Scenario Map Completion!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0610/2.jpg

In the midst of a Zombie outbreak, where entire cities have fallen to the undead, what could possibly send a survivor back into the madness and bloodshed?

Why, FREE Decoders, of course!

From 10th through 24th June, completing a Zombie Scenario map will award 1x Decoder, with all Zombie Scenario maps available for the event. 

Every map offers new challenges and fearsome bosses to defeat. Get your friends together and see if you can uncover the story behind the Zombie Outbreak!

Each map will only award the 1x Decoder once during the event’s duration, but every map can be completed for a total of 14 x Decoders possible before 24th June. Prior completions of Zombie Scenario maps do not affect if Decoders will be awarded during the event period.

notes.title: Revamped Weapon Showcase (#2)
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0511/en.jpg

The Revamped Weapon Showcase Continues!

Decoder Exclusives (Part 2)

Papin

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0511/1_papin1.jpg

While these gauntlets could be seen as just fancy brass knuckles, their steam engine fuels the twinblades hidden on the back of each glove, allowing the user to adapt their combat style to the situation: swift punches for weaker targets and deadly, slower slashes for tougher enemies.
The steam engine requires some time to recharge itself after each use, however, you won't be slowed down by carrying this weapon. The high mobility is vital for buying enough time between attacks!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0511/1_papin2.jpg

Grade-1 Blueprint (Part 5)

Balrog-V

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0511/2_balrog1.jpg

The intimidating appearance of the Balrog-V is largely justified by its raw power: the secret device installed gives a new meaning to “Focus Firing”.
While its rate of fire is fairly low, the shots fired will inflict an increasing amount of damage after every successful hit on the same target. After 15 consecutive hits, the Balrog Charging System will kick in, and the weapon will fire deadly explosive rounds.
The best part is that the BCS goes in stand-by if you have to reload and, as long as you keep shooting at the same target, you won't lose the damage bonus. The built-in scope will make everything easier in most cases.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0511/2_balrog2.jpg

Mauser C96

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0511/3_mauser1.jpg

Originally developed by the German Empire more than 100 years ago, this handgun went through a lot of important conflicts, including both World Wars, and underwent various modifications and improvements.
While its look (definitely unusual and iconic) is the main reason for its popularity, it is also surprisingly reliable: light, low recoil, and moderate accuracy make it a well-rounded, trusty gun.
If you ever find yourself being ambushed, the Mauser’s full-auto design will help make sure you’re the one who shot first!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0511/3_mauser2.jpg

notes.title: NEW! Classic CS Action with Fight Yard, Decoder Events, and MORE! (1/2)
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0430/patch.jpg

The latest Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies update lets players return to the Original CS arena of CT vs TR fights to the death within Fight Yard.

As Fight Yard maps require players to invent new ways of thinking fast on their feet, there are new weapons coming to Decoder that (mostly) take inspiration from some great inventors from history!

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский .


Quick rundown!
-- Fight Yard has arrived in CSN:Z. 
-- Decoder is getting a steamy update of weapons. 
-- Changes have been made to improve usability of CSN:Z.

Some players may be very curious about the EVENTS we’re offering!
Such players may want to click the following link!

http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/130945904547440375
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch1.png

In the Original Counter-Strike, the option for a strict Team Deathmatch was not possible, requiring players think up creative ways where killing the enemy could be the focus of a map. Such creativity lead CS fans to create Fight Yard, also known as FY Maps!

Round-based annihilation gets a challenging twist where your possible arsenal is laid out for any team member to grab in those first precious seconds, and no Buy Zone to load up on armor and equipment. Grab your gun, take down the enemy team, and survive until the next round with the gun you already grabbed to get the upper hand!

There are two CQC maps available for Fight Yard:

NEW! – Ice World Map

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch2_en.jpg

UPDATED! – Gallery Map

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch3_en.jpg

Players may be familiar already with Gallery, but Ice World is a must have for any Fight Yard selection! And what better way to combat an icy battlefield than with…


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch4_en.jpg

NEW! – Savery

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch5.png

Steam power helps cycle rounds through this sniper rifle for a very fast rate of fire, and its unique revolver styled cylinder allows the player to reload quickly as well!

NEW! Papin

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch6.png

When it’s time for fisticuffs, make sure to bring along your pair of steam powered armored fists that can unleash red hot blades after building up enough steam pressure.

The latest CSN:Z update also addresses the following issues to help make the game more enjoyable for our global audience.

UPDATED! – Mute BOT Radio Messages

Players can now choose to mute the radio messages sent out by computer controlled players in BOT modes of CSN:Z. This option can be found in the Advanced Multiplayer Options menu.

 http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch7_en.png

UPDATED! – Language Auto-Detection

CSN:Z will now automatically set its language to what your Steam is set to. If your Steam language is set to one not supported by CSN:Z, CSN:Z will fall back to English as a default.

UPDATED! – Option for Mouse Acceleration

An option for changing how CSN:Z checks for Mouse Acceleration is available in the ‘Mouse’ page of the Options menu with the latest content update.

UPDATED! – Numeric Keypad Support for Buy Menu

The numeric keypad will now work with CSN:Z’s Buy menus in-game as optional shortcuts for menu navigation with the latest content update.

UPDATED! – Curse Filter Corrected

In our previous content update, the curse filter had been changed to restrict a much larger range of words than intended. We have corrected the curse filter in this latest update.


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

Facebook (Polish): https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ

notes.title: Revamped Weapon Showcase (#1)
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0417/en.jpg

The Revamped Weapon Showcase starts now!

Decoder Exclusives (Part 1)
As we introduced Decoders into the CSN:Z experience, it is time to start decrypting all of those awesome weapons!

Thunderbolt

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0417/thunderbolt_1.jpg

Let's start big with this famous electromagnetic railgun.
This bad boy can pierce through everything with its supersonic projectiles, instantly killing humans and dealing heavy damage to zombies, if you have good aim. If you don't... well, we hope you found yourself a nice place to hide, as you'll have to reload after every shot taken!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0417/thunderbolt_2.jpg

Grade-1 Blueprint (Part 4)
What about some craftable weapons?
Well, here they are as always!

M134 Minigun

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0417/m134_1.jpg

Six rotating barrels, slow movement and a load of bullets define the pure concept of every “Minigun”.
The shots fired are inaccurate, and the wind-up time when pulling the trigger can be deadly... but when one of these monsters starts unleashing its usual avalanche of projectiles toward your enemies, you'll know you made the right decision.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0417/m134_2.jpg

True to his codename, BlindFire confirmed on multiple occasions that you don't really need to have good aim when you can saturate the area in front of you with bullets using one of these weapons.
Poor Henry doesn't agree, as he has a lot of work to do replacing overheated and deformed barrels over and over again.

Tar-21

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0417/tar21_1.jpg

The Tar-21 is a well-balanced compact rifle. It's designed for accurate and deadly bursts, while retaining an incredible rate of fire and knockback power. The built-in scope allows for a better target acquisition in long range scenarios.
If you need the job to be done nice and clean, this weapon won't disappoint you.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0417/tar21_2.jpg

notes.title: EVENTS! – No Fooling! Earn 30x FREE Decoders and More (2/2)
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en2.jpg

The latest update to CSN:Z is bringing in a huge amount of events... HUGE.


Quick rundown!
-- Battlefield Supply awards Decoders on days 3 and 7.
-- Log in for a free, one-time bundle of Decoders.
-- Log in for a free, one-time bonus of Bingo Mileage.
-- Our Seed event lets you earn varied tiers of prizes by clocking gametime.
-- Enjoy daily boosts of EXP in two blocks of time each day.
-- Trial Weapons are back for Zombie Scenario! Try out 2 free high powered guns for zombie slaying.
-- Don’t look too foolish with our 1st of April events!


LOG IN! – Free Decoders from Battlefield Supply
From 1st through 30th April, redeeming your daily Battlefield Supply reward will get you free Decoders! On the 3rd reward day, the prize is 1x Decoder. On the 7th reward day, the prize is 2x Decoders.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en2-1.jpg


LOG IN! – Free one-time gift of Decoders
From 1st through 30th April, CSN:Z is giving every player that logs in a FREE package of 30x Decoders! This is a system loaded with great prizes, and we want every player of CSN:Z to enjoy trying it out, on the house.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-2.jpg

Please note that this reward is a one-time gift awarded on the first login made during the event period.


LOG IN! – Free one-time gift of Bingo Mileage
From 1st through 30th April, CSN:Z is giving every player that logs in a coupon for 200 free Bingo Mileage! When playing Bingo, Mileage is used to perform the different available actions on your board such as resetting the rewards selection or changing what range of Bingo numbers may be selected.

Please note that this reward is a one-time gift awarded on the first login made during the event period.


PLAY! – Grow your rewards with CSN:Z’s Seed Event
From 1st through 15th April, log in each day to receive a Seed. The rewards it offers aren’t very nourishing, but playing matches of CSN:Z will help it grow into some much more fulfilling prizes!

Play for 60 minutes to grow the Seed into a Sapling, and play for another 90 minutes to earn a Fruit item. Spring gardening can be hard work, but when there are Crafting Blueprints in Saplings and Decoders in those Fruit items, it can be worth the effort!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-3.png

The Seed Event can be repeated each day. Seed, Sapling, and Fruit items will be removed from your inventory at midnight CEST (Noon for US eastern time zone) if you have not yet redeemed the items for prizes.


PLAY! – Daily EXP +50% Boost
From 1st through 30th April, enjoy a bonus +50% to EXP earned from finished matches, twice each day! 
The +50% EXP bonus is active during 18:00 – 20:00 CEST and 02:00 – 06:00 CEST (1PM – 5PM and 9PM – 1AM US eastern time zone).

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-4.jpg

PLAY! – New Trial Weapons for Zombie Scenario
From 1st through 30th April, your inventory will have some high powered Zombie killing weaponry for free! These Trial Weapons can be used in specific maps of Zombie Scenario mode throughout the event period without any Crafting or time limits.

--Zombie Scenario Map “Angra Nest” gets the SKULL-5
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-6.jpg
--Zombie Scenario Map “Panic Room” gets the SUKLL-6
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-7.jpg

These are the final maps of Chapter 2 and Chapter 3, so you may need to rely on the firepower of these Trial Weapons to survive! Good luck.


EVENT! – Reversed Map Item
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-8.jpg
Only on 1st April, players will receive a special Map Reversing item that will create some new challenges in the following Original maps by reversing the CT and TR spawn areas:
-- Dust 2
-- Inferno
-- Nuke
-- Train

notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en2.jpg

The latest update to CSN:Z is bringing in a huge amount of events... HUGE.


Quick rundown!
-- Battlefield Supply awards Decoders on days 3 and 7.
-- Log in for a free, one-time bundle of Decoders.
-- Log in for a free, one-time bonus of Bingo Mileage.
-- Our Seed event lets you earn varied tiers of prizes by clocking gametime.
-- Enjoy daily boosts of EXP in two blocks of time each day.
-- Trial Weapons are back for Zombie Scenario! Try out 2 free high powered guns for zombie slaying.
-- Don’t look too foolish with our 1st of April events!


LOG IN! – Free Decoders from Battlefield Supply
From 1st through 30th April, redeeming your daily Battlefield Supply reward will get you free Decoders! On the 3rd reward day, the prize is 1x Decoder. On the 7th reward day, the prize is 2x Decoders.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en2-1.jpg

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-7.jpg

notes.title: NEW CONTENT – Decoders, Cleaner Crafting, and MORE! (1/2)
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1.jpg
There is a lot of great stuff from the latest Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies update, but some of our players might be very excited just by seeing ‘Decoder’!

Relax, breathe, and read on to learn all about what you will find in the latest CSN:Z update.

Click for Français , Deutsch ,Italiano ,Polski , Türkçe , Pусский .

Quick rundown!
-- Decoder is here and there are a lot of new weapons and items to be won from it.
-- Bingo is paired with Decoder to make sure you’re always on a path to earning great prizes.
-- Crafting and Synthesize menus have been improved to make the process simpler.
-- Full Turkish language support for CSN:Z.
-- D3D can be selected in video options for users who prefer it. 

NEW! – DECODER
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/1-1.jpg

A Decoder can unlock some great weapons and items, ones that you will not find anywhere else, and there are plenty of new goodies to be had! It is as simple as using the Decoder to find out what reward was encrypted within it.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-2.jpg
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/new_character.png

‘But Nexon, we wanted C-BOX!’

Our fans from Counter-Strike Online will feel right at home with our Decoder system. The process has been rebalanced but with goals of making the process both simpler and more fun for our players. A major part of this design is matching the new Bingo system with Decoders.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-3.jpg

Decoder use racks up ‘Mileage’ that can be used in CSN:Z’s new Bingo board for collecting Bingo numbers. As you collect numbers on your Bingo board, completing vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines will unlock rewards with a full board completion awarding a grand prize!

Please note that Mileage may be earned from other various CSN:Z functions and features in future updates to the game.

There are a lot of new items to be found in Decoders... a lot. Keep checking back with CSN:Z to learn about when the rewards could be changing!


If only there were an incredible amount of events and free rewards for our players to celebrate the arrival of Decoders…
If only learning about such events and rewards were as easy as clicking on a link in this page. If only!
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/129817471115947393

UPDATED! – Improved Crafting and Supply Menus
Crafting and Synthesis are a vital combination for getting your hands on new weapons in CSN:Z. With these menus being so important, they both have been given an update to streamline both Crafting and Synthesis.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-4.jpg

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-5.jpg

The major details of these changes:
•Menus now auto-fill your needed and best-choice materials with one click.
•The odds of success are now displayed.
•Using the Repeat option will no longer require interaction to accept each result.

We hope these changes make the Craft menus faster for our existing players, and easier to understand for newcomers just joining CSN:Z!

NEW! – Turkish Language Support
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/1-6.jpg

With the 1st April update, Turkish is now a fully supported language in CSN:Z!

You can choose this language, or any of the other languages CSN:Z supports, from the Language page of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Properties window.

UPDATED! - D3D Video Settings Available
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us! The 1st April update adds ‘D3D’ back as a renderer option in CSN:Z for those who prefer it over ‘OpenGL’.

Please note that after choosing D3D, the CSN:Z game will need to be closed and restarted in order for it to switch to the D3D renderer.

notes.title: [EVENT] Group Photo! – Win Free Crafting Bundles
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0312/en.jpg
Click here for Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Polski, Türkçe, Pусский.​  

To help show off the many Costume items of CSN:Z, players can win Crafting Bundles by hopping into a Family group photo together with our latest event!

Work together with your Family members to take a group photo of everyone wearing their favorite Costume items. Arrange as many Family members that can fit on screen together, make sure their nametags are all visible, and capture the image with either the Steam screenshot button (F12) or CSN:Z’s screenshot function (F5).

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0312/img_for_notice.png

Upload the picture to the Artwork section of CSN:Z’s Community Hub. Make sure your Family members, other CSN:Z Friends, and anyone you know on Steam is visiting your upload to click ‘Like’! Entries with the most ‘Likes’ will be the winners of this event. 

Want some new Costumes to show off your best in our Group Photo Event? Or have you just wanted a giant fish to wear on your back? Now is a great time to load up on Costumes!

From 12th through 18th March, buying 3 Costume Boxes will award you another Costume Box for free! Every 3 purchased Costume Boxes will award a bonus Costume Box for free, making it easier to try and complete that Cat Set you’ve wanted.


Winners will be selected on 20.03.2015 @ 11:00 CET (06:00 AM Eastern Standard Time). The following rewards are available to win in this event. Every eligible player in a winning screenshot will receive rewards matching their winning placement:

1st Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x3
2nd Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x2 
3rd Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x1
4th Place – [A] Tier Blueprint Packages x3 
5th Place – [A] Tier Blueprint Packages x2 

Very Important! Screenshots are only eligible if players follow these instructions!

•Screenshots must be submitted to the ARTWORK section of the CSN:Z Steam Community Hub! http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/images/ , all submissions must have “[Group Photo]” added to the title of their upload.
•All players in the screenshot must be wearing a Costume item, but we will accept creative ways of editing the screenshot to add Costume items on those who are missing them!
•Only players in the screenshot, with their character name clearly legible in the screenshot, will be eligible to receive any reward.
•Editing a photo to add in players who were not originally present is not permitted.
•A Family can win only once; additional entries for the same Family will not be rewarded with prizes!

notes.title: NEW GUNS – M1 Garand and M32 MGL
notes.content:
There is a Zombie War going on, time to bring out some heavy hitting weaponry! (As if anyone needs an excuse to have fun with a grenade launcher.)

Check out the two latest weapons added to CSN:Z. If you really want to get your hands on these weapons NOW, the Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles in the Shop are what you’re looking for.

M1 Garand
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0312/Pic01.jpg
This rifle is both historic and capable of dealing a whole lot of damage despite its age. Make those shots count as it only holds 8 rounds per clip and can only be reloaded once all rounds have been fired!
 
M32 MGL
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0312/Pic02.jpg
Since when is subtlety needed in a Zombie War, or a Zombie Scenario? This grenade launcher uses a revolving cylinder to let its operator unleash repeated explosive attacks against enemies living and living-dead. You can also right-click when using the M32 MGL to land longer, more precise shots.


If a powerful rifle or raining down grenades is your style of fighting, visit the Shop to get Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles for either or both of the latest CSN:Z weapons!

notes.title: Weapon Showcase Grade-1 [S] - Part 3
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0304/banner.jpg

The Weapon Showcase continues! Take a look at what you can get from the Grade-1 Blueprint for your Rifle and Pistol needs.

Luger P08

With its unique design, the Luger P08 may have earned its place in history during World War II but is still prized by collectors. In CSN:Z you can further embellish this unique design by Enhancing it! Don’t leave this pistol with it’s large reserve of spare ammo and high damage rating in the display case.

notes.title: NEW CONTENT – Prepare for WAR!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0226/en.jpg
Until now, the battle between Human and Zombie has been a chaotic fray of hot lead and decaying flesh. It was not clear who could be trusted when your best friend in the foxhole could turn on you in the next round of combat.

It is time that this gruesome fight between Living and Living-Dead break out into a full blown WAR.

NEW! – Zombie War

Fans of Zombie PvP action will need to bring their best into the latest mode for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. In Zombie War, set teams are formed instead of randomized selection picking who will begin combat as a Zombie, letting you and your team play at your most fearsome and competitive!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/1.jpg
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/2.jpg

When the round begins, the Human team is able to move through the map and secure the best places to dig in and defend. While Humans put their best strategies in motion, the Zombies are nowhere to be found… until the timer counts down to Zero. Once the timer reaches zero the Zombie team spawns into the map and the Zombie War begins! Once half of the rounds are completed, teams switch sides between Human and Zombie for the remainder of the match.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/3.jpg
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/4.jpg

Forming set teams is not the only difference. Both Zombies and Humans stay dead for each round, and in the final 30 seconds of the round each side gets a boost to make those final moments count! Good luck hiding out the entire round when Zombies can see through walls in those final moments.

Don’t hold back! This is the time to bring your best strategies and team mates together for a real WAR!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/5.jpg

EVENT! – Rewards of WAR

What does a good Zombie War need besides bodies to fill the front lines? Weapons, lots of weapons! Playing in the all new Zombie War mode will earn you free Crafting Bundles to make sure your armory is fully stocked.

From 26th February to 12th March, play 30 minutes of Zombie War and receive the following Crafting Bundle:
-- 3x Random [A] Blueprint
-- 3x 24-30 Day Durable
-- 19,200 Points

If you play an additional 30 minutes in that same day, you will receive an additional Crafting Bundle containing the following:
-- 1x Random [S] Blueprint
-- 1x 24-30 Day Durable
-- 6,400 Points

Both sets of rewards can be earned once per day. A Zombie War match must have 4 or more players in order for its time to count towards the event.

NEW! – New Weapons, New Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles

To help get pumped for war, there’s two new weapons for you to Craft and bring to the battlefield!

M60E4 Maverick (Machinegun)

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/6.png

Mauser C96 (Pistol)

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/7.png

Following the 26th February Update, you can get your hands on these brand new weapons. If you’re looking to get your hands on these new weapons NOW check out the latest Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles in the shop featuring these two new armaments! Using the weapon’s Perfect Pick Recipe and its matching Crafting materials will guarantee the outcome of Crafting is the Recipe’s weapon!


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Read All About PvP 2.0!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0226/2_en.jpg  

Let us be clear and direct: this update is not touching gun stats! Save your pitchforks for another time, please.

We are making improvements to how PvP modes of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies show combat info, and also how accomplishments made in-game can be showcased. These changes are designed to make the fun of shooting your Zombie and Non-Zombie friends a more rewarding experience!

NEW! – Assists

Have you ever emptied magazines to pick away at an enemy’s health, only for someone to get a lucky shot and score the kill? With the PvP 2.0 update, the game will now identify when a kill had assistance!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/8.jpg

Assists will help everyone know who has been pulling their weight on the team. But, simply ‘knowing’ may not be enough for some, which will be helped by…

NEW! – Valor

Earn recognition for your hard work in matches with the new Valor system! Each Valor to be unlocked is tied to combat and objectives performed in CSN:Z game modes. While Missions and Medals cover a broad range of goals, Valor is all about the BATTLES you have waged.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/9.jpg

What must be done to earn Valor is hidden, but we trust our players are clever enough to get the hang of it quickly! At least, concerning combat before PvP 2.0, and not the new additions of…

UPDATED! – Action Report

Headshots? Revenge kills? We hope everyone remembers those, but PvP 2.0 is expanding on these staples of combat!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/14.png 

With the PvP 2.0 update, a much more diverse range of combat accomplishments are being recognized. Scoring the first kill of a match deserves recognition, but picking on the worst of the enemy team member gets recognition (for better or worse) in PvP 2.0. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/13.png

There are plenty more, including those incredible kill streaks, but you’ll have to get in game to find them! After adding all this new content it’d be great if players knew more about…

NEW! – MVP Report

CSN:Z now showcases the top performers for the game mode’s objectives, helping highlight players and their efforts. 

http://i.imgur.com/iYb2UUt.jpg

We hope this will both help players feel pride about their skill for being MVP, and make everyone else a little jealous of not being MVP. And should that jealousy turn into some well-deserved in-game payback, you will want to know all about the pain you inflicted with…

UPDATED! – Combat Info

When respawning, CSN:Z can tell you some essential info about the kills you scored during your last life or round. This information is being expanded and will provide more detail with the PvP 2.0 update.

http://i.imgur.com/07Rs49X.jpg

Changes are being made to both help the information be clearer, but also to provide more juicy details. Enjoy knowing not just which weapon dealt the killing blows on your enemies, but which body parts of your own the enemy was attacking the hardest! 



With the PvP 2.0 update, The CSN:Z Team hopes you will get more excitement out of every kill scored and greater reward with each objective completed. 

Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

Facebook (Polish): https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ

notes.title: Report #13: Hellfire
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0130/2.jpg

This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
************** 
Report #13: Hellfire

After severe combat in a sandstorm, Victor learned the origin of the unknown enemies. He heard through a Comanche Recording Device that the enemies were from the Vanguard Company. However, Victor knew that engaging against a munitions corporation would be a suicidal act... So, his troops escaped the combat zone, re-equipped themselves, and started their journey to request back up. After destroying a Comanche, the 3rd Squad tried to break through to the occupied city to join the main troops.

But rumor has it that there is a parent company behind them.
They are involved in a lot of illegal activities, like funding terrorists.

notes.title: Report #13: Hellfire
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0130/2.jpg

This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
************** 
Report #13: Hellfire

After severe combat in a sandstorm, Victor learned the origin of the unknown enemies. He heard through a Comanche Recording Device that the enemies were from the Vanguard Company. However, Victor knew that engaging against a munitions corporation would be a suicidal act... So, his troops escaped the combat zone, re-equipped themselves, and started their journey to request back up. After destroying a Comanche, the 3rd Squad tried to break through to the occupied city to join the main troops.

But rumor has it that there is a parent company behind them.
They are involved in a lot of illegal activities, like funding terrorists.
They have been upgraded with top technology. As a result, their vitality and firepower have been increased substantially. It seems as though Dr. Rex left the Vanguard Company right after he finished his job.

notes.title: FEBRUARY IS ENHANCED – Check out the latest in CSN:Z!
notes.content:
Keep an eye on CSN:Z in the next few days, you're going to LOVE what we have lined up!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0129/en.jpg

EXPANSION OF ENHANCEMENT

Before the 29th January update, the highest a weapon could be enhanced was +5. After the update, players can reach +8 with the latest changes made to CSN:Z’s Enhancement System!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/1.jpg

Use the all new Special Enhancement Material to get both better chances of Enhancement success and the ability to apply Enhancements from +6 to +8! 
In addition, should failure occur with the Special Enhancement Material, you can collect leftover parts to earn yourself the all new Perfect Enhancement Material! This rare Enhancement Material grants both 100% success rate and knowing exactly which attribute will be improved.

Now is the best time to start enhancing your inventory of weapons, especially with the lineup of events that will be available!

ENHANCEMENT GIVEAWAY EVENTS

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/2.jpg
This is an Enhanced month for CSN:Z!  We’re giving away plenty of Enhancement Materials and Enhanceable Weapons to every player with the following events:

 • Daily Reward Giveaway
From 29th January to 26th February, receive 5x Normal Enhancement Materials and 2x Special Enhancement Materials every day when logging in.
• Free Weapon Giveaway
From 29th January to 26th February, receive a free 3 Day Enhanceable Weapon after being in-game for 30, 60, and then 90 minutes. The weapon awarded is random, but will always be a weapon you can enhance.
• 50x Special Enhancement Materials via Battlefield Supply
From 29th January to 26th February, lucky players may win 50x Special Enhancement Materials from Battlefield Supply’s Random Reward. Make sure to collect your reward every day!

NEW CLASSES

Criss and Yuri are joining CSN:Z’s battle against the living dead! 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/3.jpg

These new female classes can be purchased separately, or in a combined bundle from the Item Shop, but only for a limited time! 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/4.jpg

20% OFF CRAFTING IN THE ITEM SHOP
Was your New Year’s resolution to spend your money smarter in 2015? Or are you looking to say ‘I love you’ with Crafting Bundles on Valentine’s Day? Whatever the reason, visit the Item Shop from 29th January and grab Crafting Materials at 20% off!

Remember to save even bigger by grabbing the 30x purchase option and get both the 30x price break and the 20% discount! 

INTRODUCING: THE ALL NEW COSTUME BOX

The 29th January update is adding something new to the Item Shop: the Costume Box. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/5.jpg
Each Costume Box will award one of 26 possible Costume items for PERMANENT duration. Grab a few of these new boxes and see what cool Costume sets there are to collect!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/6.jpg
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/7.jpg
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/8.jpg

NEW GUNS AND PERFECT PICK RECIPE BUNDLES

Some new firepower is joining the CSN:Z fray with the 29th January Update! Visit Henry in the Crafting menu to get yourself the all new SPAS-12 Maverick Shotgun and Mosin-Nagant Sniper Rifle to further expand your Zombie-Slaying options.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/10.jpg
To help players get their hands on these latest and greatest weapons in CSN:Z, new Perfect Pick Recipe bundles have been added to the Item Shop for the SPAS-12 Maverick Shotgun and Mosin-Nagant Sniper Rifle. 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/9.jpg
Perfect Pick Recipes will guarantee the outcome of the weapon is a specific choice when matched with the right materials, and these Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles have everything you need to craft these new guns immediately!

CHECK OUT THE NEW CSN:Z GUIDANCE

There’s a lot in CSN:Z, and with the 29th January update we’re taking steps to get players better acquainted with some of the best modes of play. A Guidance System has been added to help educate new players about how gameplay functions in CSN:Z.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/11.jpg

Of course we’re not going to stop the Zombie Killing pros from trying it, either! After all, it’s always good to brush up on the fundamentals.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/12.jpg

DAILY 4 HOUR DOUBLE-EXPERIENCE BOOST

From 29th January to 26th February, completed matches will award DOUBLE EXP between 18:00 and 22:00 CET (12:00 and 16:00 CET Eastern for USA players). Take advantage of the bonus EXP to rank up and get your rebalanced rank rewards! Read more about these rewards in our prior update: http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/135439363750494898

notes.title: Reach 999+ Days = GET PERMANENT WEAPON
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/1.jpg                    http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/2.jpg

Now everyone can get every WEAPON PERMANENT way easier.
If any of your weapon reaches 999+ days duration, you can convert it to PERMANENT with one click.

The latest 8th January update to CSN:Z has added a new way to get your hands the weapons you love for PERMANENT. The Item Extension system has been improved to allow weapons with longer durations to be converted to Permanent with no items or cost required!

Now every time you craft a weapon can get you closer to that PERMANENT status! No crafting attempt is wasted. And while trying you can still receive permanent weapon instantly!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/3.jpg
 
If there is an item in your inventory with 999 or more days of duration, notice the ‘Extend’ button has changed for the weapon as it appears in your inventory. Click it, and you can set it as PERMANENT instantly!

Perfect Pick Recipe Promotion

How does Henry turn Blueprints and Durables into weaponry? That Gunsmith isn’t sharing his secrets, but now you can getting your hands on the newest weaponry in CSN:Z instantly!
   
Introducing the “Perfect Pick Recipe”, a Crafting material that will guarantee the outcome of crafting be a specific weapon if included with its needed components. You can find this Recipe in the shop, included in Crafting bundles that contain all components needed to craft one of the new CSN:Z weapons!

For the 8th January Update, the following Perfect Pick Recipe bundles can be found in the shop:

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/4.jpg http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/5.jpg

•MG42
Does it belong in a museum? Not when the dead keep rising! This weapon made its mark on history during World War II and an incredible rate of fire may just keep you alive against hundreds of Zombies barreling down on you.

•AT4CS
Even the odds against the Bosses of Zombie Scenario mode with some incredible firepower! Of course, the CSN:Z Team won’t judge you for wanting to have a rocket launcher just-because. 

Perfect Pick Recipe bundles for the MG42 and AT4CS will not be around forever! Visit the shop to pick up a bundle today to get your hands on these great offers while they are still available.
