notes.title: [PART 2/2] ALL ZOMBIES PERMANENTLY FREE
notes.content:
ICE BREAKER

From 8th to 29th January, those freezing winter temperatures may yield some incredible prizes in CSN:Z, including all new classes for PERMANENT.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/7.jpg
Every day, you’ll be given a block of ice with a reward inside. How well you can break open the ice will improve the value of the rewards waiting for you.

Stage 1
Play for 30 minutes or more first and you may be awarded a Lv. 3 EXP Coupon or a Lv. 3 Point Coupon, or instead the Ice Block may upgrade to Stage 2…

Stage 2
Play for 30 minutes or more first and you may be awarded 3x Crafting Bundles (Blueprint [A], 3x 24-30 Durables, and 19,200 Points), or the Ice Block may be upgraded to Stage 3…

Stage 3
Your Ice Block has taken a lot of damage! Use it immediately and earn one of the following rewards:
• 3x Crafting Bundles ( Blueprint [S], 3x 24-30 Durables, and 19,200 Points)
• PERMANENT Male Class Keith Ichan
• PERMANENT Male Class Spade.

Make sure to log in every day to get your Stage 1 Ice Block to try and earn those top quality Crafting materials or PERMANENT Keith Ichan and Spade Male Classes!
(NOTE: Ice Blocks are removed from your inventory each day at 00:00 CET \ 18:00 US Eastern). 

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/8.jpg

MAKE DURATION WEAPONS PERMANENT

The 8th January update is not just for the undead. The CSN:Z Team is introducing a new way to increase your collection of PERMANENT weapons.
When a limited duration weapon has 999 or more days of duration in your Inventory, you can then set it as PERMANENT with the push of a button. It is then forever your weapon in CSN:Z!

Every day added to your favorite weapon, whether through Crafting or Item Extension Coupons, takes you closer to its PERMANENT status!

FREE POWERFUL GUNS IN ZOMBIE SCENARIO, SEASON 3

What’s always great to hear when staring down a few thousand Zombies?
FREE GUNS !

Starting 8th January and ending 29th January, three Zombie Scenario maps of Season 3 have some incredible firepower unlocked for free. 

Check out the new Free Trial Weapons!

-       First Contact : BALROG-VII (Machinegun)
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/12.jpg

-       Enemy Behind : JANUS- 11 (Shotgun)
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/13.jpg

-       Panic Room : SKULL-6 (Machinegun)
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/14.jpg

There’s no Crafting, points purchase, or cash purchase required to play with these guns. They are already in your inventory on 8th January!

The weapons will only work in their respective Zombie Scenario map, and you must have enough Dollars earned in the match to select them from the Buy menu in-game.

INTRODUCING: JANUS-3

What’s better than a Tommy Gun?
A Tommy Gun equipped with the JANUS Transformation System that can unleash an unlimited ammo barrage during its transformation!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/16.jpg

The JANUS series is being expanded with CSN:Z’s 8th January update, and is one of the possible weapons to be crafted from the Grade-3 Blueprint.

UPDATED BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY REWARDS

You’ll find new rewards waiting for you in the Battlefield Supply, remember to redeem your reward every day to earn yourself a 20 Day 

UTS-15 Shotgun for the 6th reward and 20 Day Dual Infinity Pistols for the 7th rewards.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/10_en.jpg

In addition, there’s some new high value Random Rewards to be had every time you redeem your Battlefield Supply Reward, including:
•M4A1 RED PERMANENT
•Blueprint [S]
•5x 72 Day-Permanent Durables
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/11.jpg


Let us know how you’re enjoying the latest update to CSN:Z on the Steam Forums, Facebook, and Twitter!
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

UTS-15 Shotgun for the 6th reward and 20 Day Dual Infinity Pistols for the 7th rewards.

notes.title: [PART 1/2] ALL ZOMBIES PERMANENTLY FREE
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0108/en.jpg

5 NEW PLAYABLE ZOMBIE CLASSES

It’s a new year, and that means it’s time to bring some new fear to the hearts of the living... five flavors of fear in fact!

PSYCHO 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/4_1.jpg
What is worse than a hoard of attacking Zombies? Not seeing them coming. A well placed Smokescreen from the Psycho Zombie can really throw off the living. 

VENOM STING 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/1.jpg
 Agility and precision come together with this Zombie menace. Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee. An undead bee?

VENOM GUARD
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/2.jpg
For the Zombie enthusiast who truly wants to soak up the lead: excelling at enduring attacks and healing after barrages of gunfire.

BANSHEE
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/3.jpg
Some of her devilish tricks can disrupt even the best Human encampment. Pull foolish targets away from safety, or disguise yourself as a Human to score some truly humiliating kills.

STAMPER
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/4.jpg
When a guy brings an Iron Maiden to a gun fight and you know he’s serious about pain. Plant the Stamper’s Iron Maiden to disrupt enemies, block gunfire, and even help reach new heights.

ZOMBIES, FREE FOR ALL

The latest CSN:Z update is making some huge changes to the war between the living and the living-dead. 
Starting 8th January, all Zombie Classes are becoming default items for all CSN:Z players. Players no longer need to purchase their preferred Zombie combatants, as they are now permanent in every player’s inventory!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/5.jpg

In addition, a large number of PvP Zombie items are also set as default for all CSN:Z Players.
•Hammer, Nata Knife, and Flame Grenade weapons.
•Superior DNA, Persistent Survival, and Bomb Expert items.

And, yes, this includes the five Zombie classes new to the frontlines with our 8th January update!

INTRODUCING: THE PERFECT PICK RECIPE

New weaponry is coming to the warzones of CSN:Z, and with the new Perfect Pick Recipe for Crafting you can get your hands on the latest and greatest armaments against living or dead foes alike!

The 8th January update for CSN:Z is adding new Crafting Bundles to the Item Shop. These bundles include the Perfect Pick Recipe in addition to all the Materials and Points needed to turn a Blueprint into a weapon.  Using the Perfect Pick Recipe while crafting will guarantee that only the recipe’s specific weapon will be crafted. Visit the Item Shop to get these bundles for the new MG42 and AT4CS!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/9.jpg

BOOST TO MISSION REWARDS

CSN:Z’s update for 8th January is giving a needed boost to the Random Rewards possible from the Missions menu. Daily, Special, and Weekly Missions now offer better quality Blueprints when choosing a Random Reward as the mission prize.

RANK UP REWARD REBALANCE

The 8th January update is also working to improve how your efforts are rewarded for the EXP earned slaying Zombies and Humans alike. 

Not only are newcomers to CSN:Z getting better rewards for making new accounts, but all of the rank rewards are getting attention!
You earn these rewards by opening the Level Up Box from your Inventory. Each Level Up Box contains rewards, and the next rank’s Level Up Box for you to work towards.

Among the rewards are more crafting materials, male classes found in the Item Shop, and items to help you stay alive in Zombie Scenario. There are other rewards to be had, including the occasional JANUS\BALROG\SKULL weapons for certain ranks!

CRAFTING OUTCOME REBALANCE

Henry and the CSN:Z Team have kept a close eye on Crafting at the end of 2014. Players may recall details about high-powered weapon series getting attention in their Crafting frequency for our 2014 Xmas updates!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/15.jpg

There’s been more work behind the scenes for our 8th January update. While we can’t divulge the secrets of the process (Henry may be taking that to his grave…) please stop by the Craft menu to check out our work towards getting the right weapons in your zombie-slaying hands.

Need a refresher? Check our Henry’s Crafting Essentials Guide:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=353139785

Let us know how you’re enjoying the latest update to CSN:Z on the Steam Forums, Facebook, and Twitter!
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.content:

Dear soldiers, 

We would like to invite you to join a new adventure in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, where you can compete globally with users from all over the world.

The Turkey service will be available on Steam from 22nd December 2014. 
The fully localized client will be released in the first quarter of 2015. To show our gratitude for your support, we have prepared great gifts for all formal Counter-Strike Online players. 

In addition, transaction by Turkish lira will be available from Jan 8th. It may cause your inconvenience.

However, once you join CSN:Z on Steam and create ingame name from 23rd December to 31st December you will receive special package instantly. Craft your powerful weapon from the start. 

Ayrıca en kısa sürede daha az zorlukla Zombie Scenario'yu geçebilmek için  50x Round Retry, 50x Battle Revival, 100 Large Medical Kit ve 100 Small Medical Kit alabilirsiniz.

Once again we thank you for great time together in Counter-Strike Online and hope see you in CSN:Z! 

All the best,
Nexon Europe Team

notes.title: Merry CSN:Z Giveaways – SKULL Series PERMANENT and festive Xmas Series Weapons!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2014/1212/Dec2014SKULL.jpg

The Christmas season has many traditions with both the prospect of surprise gifts and obnoxious decorations amongst them. Starting on 20th December, CSN:Z will do its part to celebrate such time honored traditions, but without the deceivingly wrapped socks or suspicious holiday fruitcake.

PERMANENT SKULL-SERIES WEAPON GIVEAWAY

Starting on 20th December and ending 7th January, each day between 14:00 CET and 22:00 CET, there will be players randomly selected to receive PERMANENT SKULL series weapons for free! (That’s 08:00 to 16:00 EST for our USA players.)

All of our current SKULL Series weapons will be given away repeatedly during the event (1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11). 

http://s17.postimg.org/oyk86tr3j/image.png

While the event is active, 9 players will each be awarded a single random SKULL Series weapon for PERMANENT, repeated every 2 hours. Hundreds of players will get their hands on these Zombie slaying weapons!

Winners of weapons will be stated in game as they are selected via text announcements made by the game server in the chat log.

FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY

Seeing as skulls are not common Christmas decorations, The CSN:Z Team needed to compensate with some large caliber festive firearm decorating. 

http://s18.postimg.org/kvw3esn09/image.png

From 20th December through 7th January, CSN:Z will be awarding players a Christmas weapon each day. By being logged in at 18:00, 20:00, and 22:00 CET (That’s 09:00, 11:00, and 13:00 EST for our USA players.), you will receive one of the following weapons randomly: 

-- Christmas M95 
-- Christmas MG3 
-- Christmas M134 
-- Christmas MG36 
-- Christmas Winchester 
-- Christmas Spray

Xmas items awarded are for 1 Day duration, but you can receive more prizes at the awarding times every day of the event! Keep playing CSN:Z from 20th December through 7th January to keep your stocking stuffed with these special Xmas series items.

Make sure to follow CSN:Z on Steam, Facebook, and Twitter for the latest updates.
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: Merry CSN:Z
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1216/en.jpg

Merry Christmas, CSN:Z! New PERMANENT Female Classes, Free PERMANENT SKULL Series Weapons, 50% Off Sale, and More!

Have you been logging in every day for your free Blueprint [S] and crafting materials? How many weapons have you upgraded to earn your free PERMANENT upgraded variant? The whole CSN:Z Team hopes you’ve been enjoying our big events for the end of 2014, but there’s still more for December!

NEW PERMANENT FEMALE CLASSES
http://s21.postimg.org/t8nl2jwhj/image.png

http://s30.postimg.org/ackfbhtk1/image.png

CSN:Z is getting some new dangerous combatants for December: Ritsuka is joining forces with the Terrorists, and Ji Yoon Choi is enlisting with the Counter-Terrorists.

Starting 16th December, these two skilled warriors are available for PERMANENT durations in the Item Shop for a cash purchase.
You can purchase them individually or get both Ritsuka and Ji Yoon Choi in a combined bundle. These classes will not be available forever, so get them while you can! 

50% OFF FOR THE HOLIDAYS
Starting 16th December and ending 31st December, take advantage of 50% off select cash items in the Item Shop! Gift your friends in CSN:Z with crafting bundles for some seasonal generosity, or just grab some for yourself with any Steam Wallet Cards you get in your Christmas stocking this year. It’s a great time to stock up on those 30x Crafting Bundles to build a merry arsenal.
NOTE: 50% off sale does not apply to classes Ritsuka, Ji Yoon Choi, or the bundle containing these classes.

PERMANENT SKULL-SERIES WEAPON GIVEAWAY
Some CSN:Z players are going to be very lucky this holiday season…

Starting on 20th December and ending 7th January, each day between 14:00 CET and 22:00 CET, there will be players randomly selected to receive PERMANENT SKULL series weapons for free! (That’s 08:00 to 16:00 EST for our USA players.)

Every 2 hours during the event’s active time, 9 players will each be awarded a single random SKULL series weapon for PERMANENT. Hundreds of lucky players will get a free PERMANENT SKULL series weapon just for playing CSN:Z this holiday season!

http://s17.postimg.org/oyk86tr3j/image.png

Santa isn’t the only one bringing goodies and gifts this December, and his presents won’t be half as good for killing Zombies. Make sure to drop by every day of the event for the best chances to be selected!

FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY
Hanging Christmas lights can be dangerous, especially if the conditions are icy! Play it safe and decorate guns with CSN:Z instead.

From 20th December through 7th January, CSN:Z will be awarding players a Christmas weapon each day. By being logged in at 18:00, 20:00, and 22:00 CET, you will receive one of the following weapons randomly:

-- Christmas M95
-- Christmas MG3
-- Christmas M134
-- Christmas MG36
-- Christmas Winchester
-- Christmas Spray

http://s18.postimg.org/kvw3esn09/image.png

For our USA players, these times are 12:00, 14:00, and 16:00 EST.

Stop by CSN:Z daily to celebrate the season with irresponsibly decorated high caliber firearms!

Xmas Crafter Booster! – 6x more likely to get BALROG, JANUS and SKULL Weapons!
Did you ask for a BALROG-XI, JANUS-7, or SKULL-9 from Santa this year? Probably should have left the milk and cookies out for Henry instead. He’s hitting the workbench hard this holiday season to get even more BALROG, JANUS, and SKULL weapons in your hands for Christmas! 

From 16th December you will far more likely receive BALROG, JANUS and SKULL weapons from crafting. During this event, the odds of crafting one of these powerful weapons will be SIX TIMES more likely! 
http://s13.postimg.org/m6frvjbpj/image.png

notes.title: Report #12: Sandstorm
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1114/4.jpg

This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
************** 
Report #12: Sandstorm

While the Investigation Team was fighting against zombies and bosses, the Transport Team was carrying the Sample of Prototype Phobos across the desert. On their way, they were attacked by unknown enemies who had both elite soldiers and air weapons. 

Victor decided they had better split up into two groups. The group who were carrying the Sample retreated to the back, and the other group had to fight against the enemies. 

Surprisingly, they also brought a Comanche to attack, but troops succeeded to destroy it by securing the abandoned building.

notes.title: Permanent Weapon Upgrades, New Classes, and More!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1128/en.jpg

Avoid the crowds this holiday shopping weekend and score some amazing deals in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies! Of course, this isn’t just a weekend to take advantage of retail stores, online games, and Gabe Newell offering incredible discounts. For our players in the USA, this weekend is also a time to give thanks.

What better way to give thanks than with new guns, new features, and some great events for scoring free rewards?

PERMANENT UPGRADEABLE WEAPONS 
[From 27th November to 30th December]

Blueprints can now craft new weapons, and these weapons can be upgraded into even more powerful versions. After all, why stop at Double Barrels when you can upgrade to Triple Barrels? That’s just science.
By scoring kills with below, you can upgrade them into new and improved versions.

The following are the points required to complete each upgrade:
-Minigun: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Minigun Predator
-Combat Knife: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Master Combat Knife
-Kriss Super V: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Double Kriss Super V
-Double Barrel: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Triple Barrel
-SL8: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to an SL8 Custom
-Dual Infinity: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Custom 
-Dual Infinity Custom: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Final

Please observe the following rules and details concerning weapon upgrading:
-Zombie Modes (Original, Mutant, Hero) award 15 for killing a Zombie, and 5 for killing a Human.
-Zombie Scenario awards 1 point for each kill.


http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/14.jpg

…But it’s not just an upgrade. If you complete an upgrade on a weapon you’ve crafted, that weapon will become permanent! As it’s always been in CSN:Z, this means you can put those free crafting materials you earn towards these new permanent weapons.

BLACK FRIDAY SALE – 70% OFF CASH ITEMS

Now is the time to stock up on Crafting bundles and Classes from 27th November through 4th December with 70% off of select Cash Items.
Remember, you can pick up Crafting bundles in 10x and 30x amounts that offer even further savings over buying bundles individually.

DAILY FREE [S] CLASS BLUEPRINT

…But it’s not just a free permanent upgrade. We’re giving away [S] Class Blueprints every day from 27th November through 14th December. Drop in to CSN:Z every day to collect the top tier of Blueprints available in the game and try to get yourself the new upgradeable weapons!

CRAFT YOUR WAY TO FREE UPGRADABLE WEAPONS

…But can there still be even more to these upgradable weapons?
Yes! From 27th November to 30th December, successfully performing 7 Craftings with [S] Blueprints will immediately award you a 10 Day upgradable weapon of your choice. 

This event can be repeated, making it even easier to get yourself some PERMANENT upgraded weapons throughout this holiday season!

NEW CLASSES + 300,000 POINTS BUNDLES
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/3.jpg
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/4.jpg
There are some new faces on the battlefield with CSN:Z’s latest update: Vigilante for TR, and Thunder Squad for CT.

Picking up these new classes from the Item Shop doesn’t just allow you to use a new look while fighting over hostages, these classes also offer a 10% bonus to EXP and Points rewards for using them in matches. On top of this 10% bonus, a whopping 300,000 Points is bundled with the purchased class to let the owner of these new warriors grab some Medical Kits, too!

SERIOUS SCENARIO SLAUGHTER! – Free Balrog, Janus, and SKULL Weapons for Zombie Scenario maps
It’s nearly the holidays, so take a load off in CSN:Z! At least it will be a vacation for you because the Zombies won’t know what hit them with our latest event.

From 27th November through 30th December, you can use some of the best Zombie slaying weapons in the game for specific Zombie Scenario maps at no cost and as much as you want.

Season 2, Poisonous Wound – BALROG-IX (Melee) 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/2.jpg 
Season 2, Decoy – SKULL-5 (Rifle) 
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/10.jpg
Season 2, Angra Nest – JANUS-7 (Machine Gun)
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/11.jpg

Each weapon can only be used in its respective Zombie Scenario map, and these weapons will be removed 30th December.

BIG HEADS, EASY TARGETS
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/13.jpg

Big Headed Zombies! From 27.11 to 15.12, log into the game and receive Soi's Big Head Solution (3D) item. When you have this item and create a Zombie Scenario mode room, all Zombies, including bosses, will appear with large heads.

Aiming has never been so easy!

CHECK OUT THESE NEW ITEMS

You’ll also encounter some new items in CSN:Z with this latest update to help you have a great time while filling zombies with lead.
--Special Mission Reset: if you end up assigned a Special Mission that you’re not fond of, use this item to receive a new Special Mission instantly! You can find this in the Item Shop for Points.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/5.jpg
-- Item Extension Coupon: add days of duration to items already in your inventory to help keep your favorite guns around longer. This new item is obtained by disassembling items in the Craft menu.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/6.jpg
--Detailed Damage Display: with this item in your inventory, both damage dealt and received will be outlined in detail on your HUD during gameplay.  You can find this in the Item Shop for Points.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/7.jpg
--Nickname Change: whether your friends all want to use themed names, or you’re having second thoughts about “pwnMSTR1337”, a Nickname Change item allows you to assign a new name to your character. You can find this item in the Item Shop for Cash.
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/8.jpg

BIGTIME BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY

Make sure to stop by every day from November 27th through December 30th to get some huge gifts from CSN:Z and the Battlefield Supply system.
For the holidays, Battlefield Supply has been updated to award the Zombie class Deimos for 20 days on the 6th day, and the PKM Machine Gun for 20 days on the 7th day.
That’s not all, because it wouldn’t be proper festivities without some surprises! In addition, from November 27th through December 30th there are three incredible prizes added to Random Reward;
--72 Day-Permanent Durable (1x)
--The MG3 Machine Gun for 90 Days
-- …and the badass AWP RED Sniper Rifle for PERMANENT duration!
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/12.jpg
Every day of collecting your Battlefield Supply Reward is another chance you could get some great loot this holiday season!

GROZA ENHANCEABLE!

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/9.jpg
Starting 27th November, you can now apply Enhancements to the Groza rifle when it is in your inventory.  Pick up bundles of Normal Enhancement Material from the Item Shop for Points and try boosting the Groza’s stats if you craft it!

notes.content:

50 Round Retry

50 Battle Revival

We are happy to provide great game experience to all of our fans!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - 11-27 Content Update
notes.content:
In addition to new content added to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for the end of year holidays, changes have been made to address feedback and problems reported by the CSN:Z Community.


Design Changes: 
•If you leave a Family, now only 2 days are required before being able to join a new Family (instead of 2 weeks).
•Upgrading a Zombie Class now only requires 5 skills to be raised to at least Level 5 first.
•Rankings for new players have been rebalanced, with less EXP required per rank through Lv. 10.
--NOTE: This design change may result in your rank level being higher following the update.
•Recipe slots have been removed from the Crafting menu as the CSN:Z Team makes further changes to improve Crafting.

Bug Fixes: 
•Added support for 1366x768 and 1360x768 game resolutions during gameplay.
•Set CSN:Z window to a borderless mode when game is launched on smaller sized windows desktops.
•Corrected incorrect name of Zombie Scenario boss from “Seize” to “Siege”.
•Corrected reward notifications for certain Scenario maps stating the wrong map completed.

Other Details: 
•Made general improvements to text through game for all supported languages.

Right after the Investigation Team finished combatting Siege Type Phobos, other troops finally succeeded to capture Siege Type Oberon, who had escaped from the laboratory.

notes.title: Want free Permanent Guns? Just Name It!
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1117/en.jpg

Feeling a little sluggish as the days get shorter, the temperature drops, and all that extra Halloween candy is bogging you down?
Bet some free permanent guns and crafting materials would perk you right up!

Not to worry, CSN:Z is going to make it easy. Take a break from the autumn chill to get yourself the 4 new Battle series weapons (Glock 18C, FAMAS, Galil, and Hunting Dagger) and top grade crafting materials ( [S] Grade-2 Blueprint, [S] Grade-3 Blueprint, and 72-Permanent Durable)!

Playing in our Just Name It! event is as easy as, well, playing! Collect letters to complete the names of the prizes as you play Original, Zombie Scenario, or any of the game modes in CSN:Z. Letters are awarded to you randomly as you score PvE or PvP kills in any mode.

Redeem all of the needed letters to complete the name of the prize and it’s yours to keep. Some prizes will use the same letters, or will require more than one of the same letter, requiring you to collect more than one of some letters to complete the whole list of prizes.

“Com’on Nexon! I don’t like RNG; it’s out to get me!”
Don’t you fret! In addition to the letters, Joker Pieces are included in this event can help tip the odds in your favor. A Joker Piece can be used in place of any letter to help you complete a prize’s name.
Joker Pieces can be obtained in the same way as letters, or by logging in on at least 10 of the days during this event to receive 5 Joker Pieces instantly! Don’t forget to stop by CSN:Z every day to get those 5 Joker Pieces.

Make sure to take a break from the cold to collect those letters, as the Just Name It! event is only lasting from November 20th through December 3rd. We recommend extra socks and hot cocoa for staying cozy as you mow down Zombies with your new permanent Battle series weapons.

But hey, that November chill has been affecting The CSN:Z Team, too! Removing discounts is a lot of work, and it's too cold for changing prices. We're extending our -50% sale in the Cash Shop all the way to November 27th, keeping the discounts on both Crafting bundles and Classes around a little longer. Stock up and bundle up!

notes.title: Report #8: The Lost City
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1028/banner4.jpg
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
**************

Report #8: The Lost City
The Leading Team fought against zombies in the Lost City, a large number of whom weren’t easy to force to retreat. They built a wall to slow down the zombies, but it wasn't enough. 

The Leading Team called for back up, but they couldn't reach HQ. While they were re-organizing their troops in the safe area, they spotted two strange people. Members of the team tried to talk to them, but the two ran away, leaving some radio equipment behind. 

Leading Team forces collected the equipment, but they didn't know whether the equipment would help or hurt them, so they took the risk and set it up anyway on the roof. Over the airwaves, they heard a mysterious voice introduced himself as Dr. Rex. Within an instant, the zombies were there and successfully infected the team.

The Lost City was once a small town in North America. There were many factories and warehouses, but most were closed as a result of a long recession. Since the Lost City was abandoned, it was the perfect place for Dr. Rex to carry out his research. 

Erika was originally from the extraction team, but she was saved by David Black. Erika was the only survivor of the Lost City.

David thinks it was not just a coincidence. He is certain that there is something special about Erika, for her to have joined AFC with him.

Report #7: Aegis Institute
When Counter-Terrorists realized that zombies had been mass produced by Dr. Rex, they decided to put an end to it. They founded Aegis Institute for zombie research and invented anti-zombie weapons. In addition, they assembled the Annihilation Forces to declare war against the zombies. 

Aegis Institute consists of top scientists from around the world who are not only experts in science, but also in weapons. They are trying their best to produce anti-zombie weapons for the forces, as well as finding the cure. 

Senior Researcher Soy might be young, but she has valuable expertise in producing massive weapons. She is currently developing ammo that is so powerful that it can stop zombies for good. Her invention is expected to be one of the most powerful weapons at Aegis Institute.

No one seems sure about Dr. Rex. If the rumor is true, that he is helping the Counter-Terrorists, than at least he is not an enemy.

Aegis Institute was maintaining neutrality between Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists from the beginning. This kind of action made it possible for those two factions to carry out their missions. 

Especially for AFC David Black and PMC Gerard, the main forces who made it possible to carry out co-op operations.

Report #6: Beginning of the Nightmare
In order to succeed with the Super Soldier Project, Dr. Rex started to create a massive number of zombies in a closed factory, called Abyss 3, at the outskirts of the city. While he was focusing on his research, one munitions company approached him and agreed to invest in the Super Soldier Project. 

When rumors about Walking Corpses began circulating, Counter-Terrorist Forces were assembled to start the investigation. They uncovered that Dr. Rex was creating Zombies in Abyss 3, and they decided to quarantine the whole city. The government sent a research team to investigate the area, but they quickly lost contact. As a result, Counter-Terrorist Forces assembled an army and declared war. 

Upon close investigation, it seems Dr. Rex wasn't continuing the research for the money. In fact, former aids and people who knew him testified that his addictive personality and his fear of failure made this project spiral into uninhibited obsession.

notes.title: Ranking System - How it works
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,
We know that you are curious about Ranking System details.
Please find answers to your questions in the FAQ section below, that we’ve prepared for you.

What is the League Ranking System?
- Players will be assigned to certain groups based on their current levels. 
The group will be assembled with similar level players, and they will have to compete against each other in the group.
Players who have reached high ranks will be promoted to higher level groups, and players who are in lower levels will be demoted to the lower level groups.

How is the league formed?
- There are a total of 4 leagues, according to the League Modes: 
Original League, Zombie League, Zombie Scenario League, and Death Match League.
Each league will have 5 groups, each group will have 
4 small groups, except Headquarters.
Headquarters is where the highest level players compete.

How many players can join a group?
- Normally 20 players will be in a group to compete each other.

When do I get promoted?
- You will either be promoted or demoted once a week (every Monday, 06:00 CET). 1st - 3rd Rank players will be promoted to the next group, and the 3 lowest level players will be demoted.

What is the Hall of Fame?
- The player who ranked 1st in the Headquarters League will be recorded in the Hall of Fame.

How can I check my friend's ranking?
- You can check your friend's ranking by using the search function or by right-clicking on their nickname.

How can I check other players' rankings?
- Press the Tab key during the game, and you will be able to see emblem images for each group.

notes.title: Report #5: Dr. Rex's Zombie Research
notes.content:
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1028/banner1.jpg
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
**************

Report #5: Dr. Rex's Zombie Research
After some time of obsessing over his research, Dr. Rex lost all sense of reality. His obsession neared him closer and closer to lunacy, until his plunge into the deep end after his failure on the 1st Super Solider Project.
He couldn't accept his failure.
It wasn't easy for him to continue his research, since his lab was destroyed by terrorists. After that harsh blow, he got yet another one when the government stopped funding his research entirely. He was the only one left to support himself now. He had to spend every last piece of money he had for his research.
 
When Dr. Rex could no longer acquire test subjects from official routes, he had to continue his research with other corpses, until one day, he finally created Heavy Zombies.
Heavy Zombies had different parts from several corpses.
Light Zombies were created from the weakest bodies. Originally, its purpose was to test the Enhancement Limits.
The Dr. Rex Virus started to mutate.
There was no change in the strength of those infected, however, their flexibility and agility were enhanced.
Dr. Rex found that the results differ depending on the test subject.
And he used that fact to further his research.

notes.title: Report #4: The Rex Virus
notes.content:
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world.
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story.
**************
Report #4: The Rex Virus
http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/20141021/4.jpg
After hitting a roadblock in his research for the Super Soldier Project, one day, Dr. Rex received a private report from an anonymous informer. This report revealed that mutant, powerful animated corpses, referred to as zombies, had existed in Europe decades ago.
Dr. Rex was invigorated by the private report. He sent his team to bring back the excavated bodies, set up a secret laboratory below ground, and began studying the corpses. 
He continued, obsessively, for months with his horrible study.
Dr. Rex eventually succeeded in formulating the Rex Virus, which enhances the strongest power in the human body, without any pain to that human.
However, there was a side effect... Upon infection by the virus, the human would become a zombie. These zombies had no self-consciousness and their sole purpose was to murder all humans – regardless of their association with Terrorists or Counter-Terrorists.
For Dr. Rex, consciousness was an important prerequisite for using his high-tech battle gear, so he couldn’t have mindless zombies being equipped with that much power.
In the end, he decided that his experiment had failed and sealed the secret underground laboratory for good.

Report #3: The Rex Laboratory and the Super Soldier Project

The Rex Laboratory is most commonly known as an institute for the production of American military weapons, but there is more going on behind closed doors.

Dr. Steve Rex, the director of the institute, is one of the foremost authorities in the field of bio-engineering and mechanical engineering, and is leading the classified Super Soldier Project.

Dr. Rex is developing very powerful “Super Soldiers” in a classified area, whose sole purpose are to defeat Terrorists.

However, due to limited strength and endurance, none of the soldiers have been able to control Dr. Rex's high-tech battle gear. As a result, it has been impossible to complete the Super Soldier Project.

Dr. Rex assessed that the human body has limited capacities and he is looking for a way to overcome this obstacle.

Report #3: The Rex Laboratory and the Super Soldier Project

The Rex Laboratory is most commonly known as an institute for the production of American military weapons, but there is more going on behind closed doors.

Dr. Steve Rex, the director of the institute, is one of the foremost authorities in the field of bio-engineering and mechanical engineering, and is leading the classified Super Soldier Project.

Dr. Rex is developing very powerful “Super Soldiers” in a classified area, whose sole purpose are to defeat Terrorists.

However, due to limited strength and endurance, none of the soldiers have been able to control Dr. Rex's high-tech battle gear. As a result, it has been impossible to complete the Super Soldier Project.

Dr. Rex assessed that the human body has limited capacities and he is looking for a way to overcome this obstacle.

Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world.

Report #2: The appearance of Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists

There seemed to be a moment of peace after the Cold War era, but the imbalanced distribution of power across the globe caused both political and economic crises to occur simultaneously.

After receiving excessive benefits and choosing not to distribute them proportionately, the government began facing harsh backlash from Terrorist organizations.

The main goal of the Terrorists was to break down the government's power in order for society to start anew, on fair and even ground. However, the peace they envisioned was inevitably corrupted and threatened. To stop the Terrorists, Counter-Terrorist forces were founded in each country.

Conflicts between Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists gradually intensified…
In this war-like atmosphere, officials began investing more in War Technology research.

notes.title: Report #1: The Heorgen Case
notes.content:
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies

Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world.

Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story.

http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/20141021/1.jpg
*****************************************************************************************************

Report #1: The Heorgen Case

For generations, the isolated townspeople of Heorgen survived under tyrannical rulers. In an attempt to overthrow the oppressive regime, an illicit spiritual group was founded.

This group met regularly in cellars, and focused their energies on worshipping witches, whom they believed could deliver them from their seemingly endless subjugation. However, they were eventually discovered.

The leaders, to maintain their harsh and pervasive authority over the people, sent torturers to infiltrate the gathering place and brutally murder the worshippers. The mutilated bodies were displayed in the town square for months in order to further instill fear in the townspeople and to deter similar assemblies from founding.

Over time, a mutant bacteria appeared upon one of the twisted corpses. This bacteria originally caused the muscles of the rotting body to pulsate slowly, but over time its movements became stronger, and more apparent. The corpse began standing, was destructive and fearless, and its mental state was nothing more than that of an aggressive wasp.

The first to be attacked by this animated corpse were the torturers. They were bitten and bludgeoned to death.
Then, the same bacterial mutation occurred in one of the corpses of the former torturers, and then them all, and that is how the virus began spreading from one body to another. Eventually, all the dead bodies rose up and terrorized the town. Before long, the town was covered in walking dead. There were no survivors.

The European Union took drastic action to stop the critical incident in Heorgen. 
These walking dead were officially categorized as 'zombies', and to prevent the widespread risk of infection, the EU isolated the town completely, and intelligence officials classified this as a top secret case. 
Furthermore, high-ranking troops who had taken oaths of secrecy were dispatched to the remote town and ordered to destroy the zombies at all costs.

From that point on, all records referring to those zombies and to the town of Heorgen were completely destroyed.

notes.title: [Maintenance] 16.10.2014, COMPLETED! Servers are Open
notes.content:
We are going to perform a short maintenance on 16.10.2014 from 06:00 – 07:00 CEST. 

An update to CSN:Z is being released today to help address player reported issues and some further polish to the overall game.
We hope this resolves problems that players have been facing and improves the experience overall for everyone. Make sure to stop by the discussion forums to let us know how things are shaping up when you get a chance to play following the update!

Design Changes: 
•Increased the minimum possible damage to walls and obstructions in Zombie Scenario to improve how much time is required to pass blockades.
•Gifting in Shop has been re-enabled.
• Automatic selection of High-performance GPU on systems where multiple graphic cards are available

Bug Fixes: 
•Gifting to a player who is offline now fully processes.
•Applied fixes to properly enable Steam Achievement activation.
•Applied fixes to address potential crashing issues in Zombie Scenario.
•MP7A1 Extended Mag, SCAR 5.56 Limited , and XM-8 Carbine Limited can now be disassembled.
•Applied fixes to address lobby window displaying at incorrect resolutions.
•Improved Hackshield compatibility to address false-positive kicking.

Other Details: 
•Improved various text issues across all supported languages to address phrasing and display issues.
• Corrected Family Point Message 

-> upcoming next updates (not a final list):
- Full support for Norwegian Krone and Canadian Dollar
- Reconfiguration of Crafting Point Mechanics (need more time for testing and analysis) 
- Further improvements to Russian Servers
- Reported bug fixes

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: The Competitive Edge – Matchmaking Server
notes.content:
Let’s be honest, there’s an elephant in the room that needs addressing. And, no, CSN:Z is not introducing a pachyderm themed addition but then again there are some truly unique styles of play in FUN mode...

Counter-strike has a deep history with competitive FPS gaming, and while CSN:Z offers everything from the original CS to Zombie Escaping there’s a feature not getting put through its paces.

Time to get introduced to Matchmaking Server!

How you’ll play in the Matchmaking Server is a little different than the usual, but not by a whole lot. A key difference to understand is that game rooms are not freely selectable but instead are assigned by the server itself.

When in a Matchmaking Server you’ll see a “Play Game” tab near the top of the menu, and within this page of the Matchmaking Server you can select which mode of play you’ll be assigned to. For now we only offer Original mode gameplay to help players focus on understanding the basics of how the server works at CSN:Z’s launch. Clicking on the “Original” mode image will get you stated.

As this is an environment focused on competitive matches, it is to your benefit to get a good team assembled as the opposition may be just as organized! This is done with the Clan system in CSN:Z, which allows you to form a group of trusted team mates for exclusively the Matchmaking Server. It is separate from the Family system, so members of your Clan can be recruited from within or beyond a Family if you are a part of one.

To create a Clan, join the Matchmaking Server and choose the “Create Clan” button. You can invite members into your Clan both in any server by right clicking a player’s name from the lobby and choosing to send a Clan Invite.

Got a Clan? Got a Party formed in Matchmaking Server? Once you’ve been paired with an opposing team, the pressure is on as your performance is uniquely tracked in the Matchmaking Server! See where you stand by clicking the “Home” tab while in the Matchmaking Server, or see how others are ramping up their efforts in the Season Ranking tab.

There’s no cost to create a Clan either! Drop in on the Matchmaking Server and rise through the ranks of the best in CSN:Z.

notes.title: CSN:Z Trading Cards are now Live!
notes.content:
With CSN:Z being published exclusively on Steam, we felt it was a given that CSN:Z supports its Trading Card system.

Please review the following FAQ to understand how this system works and what it gives to Steam users.

What are Steam Trading Cards?
•	Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Collect a set of cards to earn items that help you customize your profile and show off your interest in CSN:Z.

How does someone receive a card in Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies?
•	As CSN:Z is a Free-to-Play game, Trading Cards can be obtained after having made cash purchases in its Shop. Spending more in the CSN:Z shop on cash purchases enables more Trading Cards to be obtainable.

Once you've earned a possible Trading Card drop in CSN:Z, playing the game will randomly add cards to your Steam inventory automatically.

•	CSN:Z Trading Cards can also be traded with other Steam users, and purchased from the Steam Community Market if others are offering to sell them.

What are Steam Badges?
•	Once you’ve collected a full set of cards (9 available in CSN:Z) you can craft them into a game badge. A badge is an icon on your profile (and it is tied to your account) that represents the trading card sets you've collected.

How to craft a badge?
•	From your Profile page, click on the "Badges" link near the top of the right column or select "Badges" from your profile name drop down in the Steam menu. From your Badges page, the "Badges in Progress" tab will show which badges are ready to be crafted. Select a ready to craft badge to view its details and click on the blue "Craft a Badge" button.

Are there different type of badges?
•	Each game has 6 types of badges: 5 levels of the standard badge, and the foil badge. When you craft a game's badge the first time, you'll receive the level 1 version of the badge. Crafting it again will upgrade the badge to level 2, and so on, up till level 5. Once you reach level 5, you cannot craft that game's cards into a badge again. The foil badge for a game can only be crafted once.

How do I craft a foil badge?
•	In addition to the 5 levels of the standard badge, each trading card set has a foil badge. You earn the foil badge by completing a set of foil versions of the cards for that set. Foil cards are rarer than the standard cards, and thus the foil badge is much more difficult  to obtain.  

Do I get anything from crafting a badge?
•	All badges give you XP which contributes to your Steam Level, a summary of your badge collection. Each level of a badge is worth 100 points of experience (so a level 5 badge is worth 500 experience.) If your Steam Level increases, the limit on the size of your friends list will be increased by five, and potentially you'll unlock the ability to customize your profile with showcases.

•	Most importantly crafting game badges earns you marketable game related items like:

	CSN:Z emoticons - Steam emoticons can be used anywhere on Steam where you can type, like chat, discussion boards, and profiles (Note: emoticons do not function for CSN:Z's in-game channel and room chat), 
	CSN:Z profile backgrounds that can be used to customize your profile with a background image. (5 in CSN:Z – 2 common, 2 uncommon, 1 rare). 
Level up your badge by collecting the set again and earn more items!


What is and how can I get a booster pack?
•	Once you have received all of your random card drops, you become eligible for a booster pack, which is a set of 3 trading cards that may include both basic and foil cards. Booster packs are granted randomly to eligible users as more badges are crafted by members of the community. Make sure you log in to Steam each week to maintain eligibility. 

Note: We also added Steam’s CSN:Z avatars that can be used by anyone for free for their Steam Profile. Check out the available avatars here

CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is now Available!
notes.content:
Welcome to Official Launch of CSN:Z!

We hope you are ready to enjoy the game and events.

For those who had the chance to join in on the Open Beta of CSN:Z, you’ll notice changes have been made with the latest version of CSN:Z available at launch. Take a look over the following list to get a quick outline of what changes you can expect.

To everyone else who’s joining CSN:Z for the first time with our official launch, you are still welcome to look over the following changes, as The CSN:Z Team really can’t stop you from doing so.

Design Changes:
•Synthesis of Crafting materials no longer requires a fee of Points.
•Disassembly of items no longer requires a fee of Points.
•Leaving a match in progress no longer incurs a penalty of points.
•Lobby UI is now permanently in windowed mode. Video settings for fullscreen and different resolutions are applied when entering gameplay.
•Length of chat messages increased to 60.
•List of Daily Missions updated to include more 

Bug Fixes:
•Quick Start button now correctly searches for matching game rooms when player is not already inside a channel.
•Music no longer missing from Challenge maps.
•Non-functional Find option for rooms list has been removed.
•Buy Menu for Terrorist SMGs no longer shows an MG or other incorrect weapons for its 2nd slot.

Other Details:
•Improved instructions for Crafting menus to help players learn about different grades of quality for Crafting materials.
•Added color coding to game mode names to help players browsing through the list of game rooms.
•Altered appearance of buttons for in game Buy menu to direct players to important functions.
•Changed which pages appear first for Crafting and Mission menus to help direct users to most commonly used pages.
•Secondary Password system disabled for Crafting menus.

notes.title: CSN:Z LIVE Today at 6 PM (CEST)!
notes.content:
Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is officially and metaphorically opening its doors to the public and on Steam, Today at 6PM (CET)/ 9am (PST)! 

Still no need to purchase it just like in our Open Beta, CSN:Z is Free to Play and in just a few clicks you will be able to get started playing.

But before that, please take a moment to check out these special CSN:Z Launch Events and Sales!

1)	Consecutive Attendance Event – Free Crafting Materials!
Period: 07.10.2014 – 05.11.2014
Rewards: Light Zombie, Nata Knife, Bomb Expert, MK48, Battle Revival, Perm Durable, Grade-1 Blueprint [S]

2)	Zombie Scenario Season 2 Chronicle Event – Rewarding Zombie Slaying
One of the biggest modes in CSN:Z is Zombie Scenario, combining PvE action with the characters and story surrounding how the undead have risen! Through 22nd October, completing Season 2 of Zombie Scenario in chronological order will earn you some big rewards for your efforts!

By completing all maps of Season 2, you will be rewarded with the following: 
UTS-15 (15 Days), MK48, AS50 (15 Days), King Cobra (15 Days), Dual Katana (15 Days), Medical Kit (L), Round Retry x20, Battle Revival x20
[NOTE] – Chronicle Event rewards can only be earned once per map for the event’s duration.

3)	Play and Craft – Free High End Crafting Materials!
You’re here to play, right? There are plenty of modes and maps to choose from for that! But to sweeten the deal, how about getting everything you need to craft just by playing?

It starts when you log in, but you’ll get more rewards, the more play time you clock!

Play 10 min, 20 min, and 60 min to receive rewards.

4)	As we promised we’ve got a special treat for users who participated in the OBT and came back for the official launch!
a)	Log into the game 07.10 - 05.11 to receive a Nickname Change Coupon
b)	Log into the game on 07.10 to receive Random Grade Blueprints [A] (x3) and 24-30 Day Durables (x3)
* Users who purchased the Big Support Package during the OBT will receive 72 Day - Permanent Durables, Grade-1 Blueprint [S] and 25,600 points, as promised.

5)	Limited Time Offer – Jennifer and Natasha Permanent Sale
We are celebrating the launch of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies by letting our diehard fans get in on a rare opportunity. Visit the Item Shop from 7th October to 5th November to find both Jennifer and Natasha available for permanent durations!

6)	Weekend Hot Time – Increased EXP and GP!
Starting 11th October and ending 2nd November, every Saturday and Sunday will offer bonus 50% EXP and GP for all matches completed! Join in on the frenzy of PvE and PvP Zombie gameplay, hit up some classics of CS, or try out the unique offerings of FUN mode…

Whatever your pleasure, you’ll be rewarded greatly!

notes.title: Join the CSN:Z Open Beta!
notes.content:
With loads of Zombie PvP and PvE action, matched with the competitive Counter-Strike FPS experience, topped off with an incredible amount of content… what else is left?!

Free stuff, of course!

Read up on our OBT events below:
1)	Craft Your Weapon!
•	How to participate?: Log in once from 23rd to 25th September (CEST).
•	Reward: 3x 30 Day Durables, 3x Random Grade Blueprint [S]

2)	Item Shower
•	How to participate?: Log in once per day from 23rd to 25th September (CEST).
•	Reward: Light Zombie, Large Medical Kit, M134 Mini Gun

3)	Special Treat 
•	How to participate?: Log in on 23rd September (CEST), and again on the CSN:Z official launch date (to be announced).
•	Reward: 1x Nickname Change Coupon on the CSN:Z launch date.

We also have the best deal ever for 3 days only!

Bulk up your Zombie game with the Merciless Destroyer (10 Days) + Heavy Zombie (10 Days) + Fire & Curse (10 Days) Set! If you buy this discounted set during the OBT, you will be eligible to receive it again after the launch FOR FREE! 

Moreover, we'll throw in an additional package with the Grade-1 Blueprint [S] + Permanent Durables, and 25,600 points at launch as part of this special offer!

CSN:Z’s Beta is a small taste of the vast amounts of content, but we won’t stop you from trying to experience it all at once. In fact, we will support you with these free rewards! 

All these rewards will be a lot to take in, but we’re confident you can pull it off! Keep stopping by CSN:Z throughout the Open Beta, running between Sept 23rd 6PM CET and Sept 25th 6PM CET. 

Following the Open Beta, The CSN:Z Team will have to wipe information from accounts that participated. However, nicknames registered –will- persist from Open Beta to Launch. Make sure to log in on both the Launch Day and the Last Day of Open Beta to get that free Nickname Change Coupon for a free revision on what name you snagged!

As this is a Beta there may be issues which arise. This includes both game server instability, which may result in unscheduled reboots of our servers, and game bugs. We will be eager to hear both feedback about the Open Beta and reports of bugs which players have come across. Use the following sticky threads in the forums to let us know about both!

Feedback Thread: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/613936673597809716/

Bug Report Thread:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/613936673597994019/

Have fun!

notes.title: The Classic & Melee Weapons – What Set the Standard
notes.content:
The Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team is working hard to deliver a remarkable addition to the CS library on Steam. It’s not just-zombies when there’s so many modes, maps, and new additions to such an amazing competitive FPS franchise.

But that is not enough for many, and we agree. CSN:Z would not be a member of the Counter-Strike family without its downright iconic selection of weaponry! We’ve got you covered.

All weapons and equipment from the original Counter-Strike are in CSN:Z. AWP? FAMAS? Dual Berettas? Even if you’re somehow aching to storm the bomb with a TMP it is all here More than that, it is easy to setup a match to play with only those classic weapons both in the original CS maps and maps exclusive to CSN:Z.

Far more than just a means of self-defense, melee weapons have been around ever since human civilization first found its roots and remains an effective form of combat to this day. It is safe to assume the idea of a sharp blade in your hand may outlast human civilization itself should the Zombies have their way!

Melee weapons are diverse, can fit specific needs, and can be downright artistic in design. In Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies there is no shortage of options for cutting enemies down who dare to fall within arm’s reach. It’s important to offer so many options! With both Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists bringing one to battle regardless of the mode it is a vital piece of your loadout.

Plus you run faster while holding a knife. Everyone knows that.

Some might be familiar faces to those joining CSN:Z, such as the Balisong, a trusty Hunting Dagger,  or even a Katana or two. Choices for melee combat can be practical as well! A damn big Hammer can work to knock back Zombies more effectively than other weapons, for example.

However, it only takes a little exploration to see how fast the options open up to you for slicing and bashing your enemies, alive or formally-alive. The SKULL-9 is a huge axe to let you split some skulls or nail crowds with large swings. Nata knives sport a long finely sharpened blade, and the lucky few can wield one in each hand… Or just give up subtlety entirely with the BALROG-IX to throw some truly explosive punches. Literally.

Get up close and personal this Sept 23rd in the CSN:Z Beta!

notes.title: Maps - From Aztec to Vostok
notes.content:
We've heard you, the burning question in the minds of Counter-Strike fans who learnt the news of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies coming to Steam. “Is such-and-such map from the original CS going to be in it?” No one could blame fans for wanting their favorites to be represented in a game with ‘Counter-Strike’ in the title, what with some preferring their dosage of DE_Dust to be 24/7.

Did you know there’s over 70 maps in CSN:Z?! Environments that span the globe, vivid and varied battlegrounds that can let you switch up the routine every time you sit down to play. We even offer an option to setup quick map-rotations so you can sample from such a large offering with even greater ease.
How about maps to fit specific, challenging modes of play? AWP and Melee only maps that were created with just those entertaining styles of combat in mind. Many of the maps are designed for the unique modes in the game, so fighting against Zombies isn't shoehorned into a map that wouldn't be ideal for it.

What about maps which deviate from the norm? For a game loaded with Zombies, it suddenly doesn't seem so strange to find yourself in a war zone where you’re the size of rats or are facing off in a boxing ring.
However, many may have just been skimming this announcement for the big answer to the big question: Yes. 


All of the original maps from Counter-Strike are available and will be Free to Play. Come check it out on the 23rd with CSN:Z’s Open Beta!

notes.title: Zombie Shelter – Build, Secure, Defend, Survive
notes.content:
Those who manage to survive the first few days of a Zombie apocalypse must face some difficult choices. One of the most important decisions is whether to run for safety, or dig in deep and hold your ground. In Zombie Shelter you can experience the later and learn if you have what it takes to maintain a fortress against the undead.

Gameplay cycles between day and night, where the light offers opportunities to scavenge supplies and expand your shelter but darkness belongs to the dead. Build and secure your shelter with what daylight is available, but don’t get too confident as dying while carrying resources will affect the whole team! Grab your fill of lumber and iron, but if you can’t get those materials back to the Shelter they’re just wasted on your corpse.

Make use of Generators, barriers, and even lookout towers to make your Shelter not only secure but also formidable!

Becoming a master craftsmen while under attack by Zombies is one feat to boast about, but if you’re ready for a new challenge try out the maps which pit Human against Human… against Zombie! Some don’t like to play nice, and for those jerks Zombie Shelter lets you fight against an opposing team of Humans while Zombies attack anything living. Only one Shelter will survive.


Put your survival skills to the test this Sept 23rd when the Beta is open!

notes.title: Zombie Mutation – Class-Based, Zombie VS Human Combat
notes.content:
Maybe you've heard about it from friends, or maybe you've done a little research of your own, but do you really know what sort of trouble you'll face from the undead of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies?
Zombies come in all sorts of sizes and shapes (and flavors?), and the skills they have can really catch unprepared Humans off guard.

Zombie Mutation is one of the PvP Zombie VS Human gameplay modes in CSN:Z. 

As a Human, there's some support in your favor for a change! Supply Boxes are dropped throughout the map rewarding whoever nabs it with weapons or bonuses to turn the undead tide. However, it is support very-much needed in the face of such powerful monstrous Zombie classes.

As if walking corpses were trouble enough, you will face Zombie Classes that excel in speed, armor, reach, team-support, and more! Feeling oh-so confident with the corner your squad has locked down? It only takes one quick push by a Light class Zombie with her Invisibility skill to ruin everything your team worked hard to secure.

Or maybe the Humans are better on the move and can keep distance between the Zombies to outlast a round. A surprise introduction to the Stamper class and its choice of weaponized torture device can not only slow down your movement speed for easy pickings but also block your shots.

Still feeling confident about outlasting the Zombie apocalypse? Oops-- the Zombies can regenerate health if Humans let them retreat. And, oops again-- those Zombies who are best at killing are rewarded by mutating into even stronger versions of their class for earning enough kills in a single round.

There's TEN zombie classes in addition to the regular class of walking corpse you may already be familiar with. Zombie Mutation will truly separate the survivors from the stooges as you take on so many different Zombies and their powerful abilities.

Will you be ready for the Beta? On the 23rd of September you may have more Zombie on your hands than you can handle!

notes.title: Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies' Open Beta
notes.content:
New details of modes, maps, and guns emerge for this highly anticipated zombie shooter, available for Beta testing from 23rd September

We are pleased to announce the launching plan for the highly anticipated free-to-play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, as the Steam page for the game goes live. The game will have its Open Beta on 23rd September
It comes with a variety of modes, maps, guns, and character options in which to destroy the undead hordes.

A huge number of modes will be available, featuring both PvP and PvE gameplay. Possess and use, to a dangerous effect, the various unique abilities in Zombie Hero; lead a team of survivors to build and defend a base against continuous waves of zombies in Shelter Mode; or advance through intense Zombie Scenarios that will throw players into boss fights, among other activities. Even outside of zombies, there are more than 20 modes to explore, such as Beast Mode, Bazooka Mode, and Football Mode. Veteran fans of the Counter-Strike series will also surely be glad to see a number of offerings from the original iteration, such as Bomb Defusal and Hostage Rescue.

All-time favourite classic maps will be included in the game, such as the unforgettable de_dust, along with a selection of new maps, such as Big Tree, Camouflage, Rex and Greesia, and 60 others. The arsenal of weapons available will also be significantly larger and more diverse in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, with essentials ranging from sniper and assault rifles to more compact PDWs and SMGs. For players willing to be a little more adventurous, weapons such as Dragon Claws, energy pistols, and sci-fi styled machine rifles are available in zombie modes.

A wide variety of characters are available, both male and female, terrorist and counter-terrorist. Players can select characters merely based on style, or they may choose a character with which to explore the story elements surrounding the zombie outbreaks and terrorist attacks unique to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. 

“Both fans of Counter-Strike and players who are new to the game will have a full-blown shooter experience in a well-restored legendary FPS” said Kenny Chang, Nexon Europe CEO. “New weapons, new modes, and new elements inspiring new styles of play, mixed with everything that made the game such a classic in the first place are some things that we’re really looking forward to bringing to Steam.”


Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies will be playable for all those with a Steam login. 

Just head to the   Steam page  to get started and follow the official   Facebook page  and  Twitter feed.
